jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Illumbria** Illumbria exists to discover what AI makes possible and build what comes next. We are drawn to ideas that once seemed out of reach, and to possibilities that people have not yet imagined. Through product design, applied AI, and engineering, we create AI\-native applications that expand how organizations work and what they can offer their customers. We are building a company where curious, ambitious people can help shape both the ideas and their implementation. Our work crosses industries and disciplines, often taking us into problems with no established approach. That calls for independent thinking, experimentation, and the judgment to turn new possibilities into software people can depend on. We care deeply about what we build and how well we build it. We want people who question assumptions, contribute their own ideas, and take responsibility for seeing them through. The opportunity is to help define what these applications can become—and do the work that brings them into existence. **The Role** We are looking for an AI Systems Engineer to design and build applications with AI at their core. You will help turn ambitious ideas into working software, making decisions about architecture, developing the systems behind the application, and refining how they perform in real use. The work spans AI agents, data, integrations, and the application itself. You will explore approaches where established patterns may not exist, evaluate what works, and carry your decisions through implementation. This is a hands\-on engineering position with meaningful ownership of both how the systems are built and how well they work. **Responsibilities** * Work with clients to understand their needs, assess technical feasibility, and explain proposed approaches and tradeoffs. * Evaluate emerging models and techniques through focused experiments, and apply them where they improve the systems we build. * Build the application around AI workflows, including user interfaces, APIs, data models, integrations, and background processing. * Build AI agents and workflows that use tools, manage context, verify results, and recover from interruptions or failures. * Develop data\-processing and retrieval systems that give applications accurate, relevant information with traceable sources. * Develop reusable components and internal tooling that improve how we build and maintain applications. * Build evaluations and regression tests that measure changes to models, prompts, and application behavior before they reach production. * Improve response times and operating costs while maintaining quality, and make system performance measurable. * Review and test code, including work produced by AI coding agents, and document decisions so others can maintain and extend the systems. **How We Work** AI coding agents are part of our everyday engineering workflow. You will direct their work, evaluate what they produce, and take responsibility for the software you ship. We value knowing when to delegate, when to investigate further, and when to work through a problem yourself. You will have clear priorities and the autonomy to decide how to approach them. Bring ideas, question assumptions, and communicate the reasoning behind your decisions. **Requirements** * A record of shipping production software you can point to and explain in detail. * Experience building applications on top of modern LLM APIs: structured outputs, tool calling, multi\-step agent runs and the failure modes that come with them. * Strong backend engineering: data modeling, APIs, async and long\-running work, and integration with external services. * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and work through technical problems independently. * Judgment about when AI is the right tool, when deterministic code is, and how to put guardrails around the boundary. * Experience using AI coding agents, or the ability and willingness to adopt them while independently verifying their output. * Clear written communication. **Helpful Experience** Useful, but not required: * TypeScript and a modern web framework, or an equivalent stack you could carry over. * Word and PDF internals (OOXML, PDF text extraction, OCR). * AI evaluation: benchmark datasets, regression testing, human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Financial services, legal or other compliance\-sensitive software, including SOC 2\-aligned practices. * Cloud deployment and operations on AWS, Cloudflare or similar. **What We Offer** * Flexible hours and competitive pay. * Responsibility for technical decisions, with room to propose approaches and carry them through implementation. * Work across different applications and industries as projects develop. **Apply from your terminal.** ssh ingress.illumbria.com Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Hybrid remote in Grapevine, TX 76051

jobs.description: Electrical Engineer Reviewer (AI Evaluation) is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Electrical Engineer Reviewer (AI Evaluation) assignments. * Grade electrical engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Electrical Engineer Reviewer (AI Evaluation) work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About LeanSite** LeanSite is an AI\-native SaaS platform for commercial facilities management. Facility teams, service providers and field technicians use LeanSite to run work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, inventory and vendors across their properties, with Vera, our AI assistant, surfacing insights and recommended actions along the way. We serve enterprise clients across healthcare, fitness, hospitality and senior care. The platform spans four product surfaces: the FM Portal and Workforce Portal on the web, the LeanSite Agent mobile app for technicians in the field. It runs on Node.js, Express and MongoDB Atlas, with integrations for payments, email, SMS and notifications. **About the Role** As LeanSite grows, so does what our clients need from us. We are expanding our development scope to deliver more client\-driven features, integrations and workflow improvements, and we are hiring a Full Stack Developer to help us ship them. You will own feature development end to end, from shaping the technical approach with Product and Design to releasing to production. Your primary focus will be our client\-facing web portals, the FM Portal and Workforce Portal, working across both the frontend and our Node.js backend so features move from idea to release smoothly. **Key ResponsibilitiesFEATURE DEVELOPMENT** * Own features end to end across the FM Portal and Workforce Portal, from technical design through build, testing and release. * Translate user stories, acceptance criteria and Figma designs into clean, well\-structured frontend and backend code. * Build responsive, accessible interfaces that follow the LeanSite design system and work well for facility managers, vendors and technicians. * Design and build REST APIs and data models in Node.js, Express and MongoDB to support new features. * Build and maintain third\-party integrations that extend the platform for clients, such as calendar, payments and communication tools. * Work with Product to turn individual client requests into scalable features that serve the wider client base. **COLLABORATION \& DELIVERY** * Take part in sprint planning, refinement and reviews alongside Product, Design, QA and the wider engineering team. * Break features into well\-scoped Jira tickets and give realistic estimates. * Participate in code reviews, giving and taking constructive feedback. * Write unit and integration tests, and work with QA to resolve defects before release. * Contribute to release notes and technical documentation for the features you ship. * Investigate and fix production issues on the features you own. **CODE QUALITY \& PERFORMANCE** * Keep performance, security and maintainability front of mind: efficient queries, sensible state management and secure handling of data across client organizations. * Help improve shared components, coding patterns and developer tooling as the codebase and team grow. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional full stack development experience, ideally building B2B SaaS products. * Strong frontend skills in React (or a comparable modern framework), JavaScript, HTML and CSS. * Solid backend experience with Node.js and Express, including designing and building REST APIs. * Experience with MongoDB or another NoSQL database, including data modeling and query performance. * Experience turning Figma designs into polished, responsive user interfaces. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs and webhooks. * control and multi\-tenant data handling. * A product mindset: you care about why a feature matters to the user, not only how to build it. * Clear communication and comfort working with a distributed dashboards, reports or data visualizations. * Experience with Railway or similar cloud hosting platforms. * Background in facilities management, property technology or field service software. **What Close collaboration with Product, Design and leadership in a team that ships often. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your best work shouldn't be hidden behind your last employer's name.** Some of the strongest engineers we've worked with wouldn't stand out in a resume stack. They didn't all come from FAANG. They didn't all have CS degrees from the usual schools. Some did, some didn't, and it made less difference than you'd think. What made them stand out: hand them an ambiguous problem and an unfamiliar codebase, and they shipped something real. Quickly. They read the code before asking for help. They picked up new tools without being told to. They weren't thrown by systems they didn't understand on day one. And they built things that held up in production. **That's who we're looking for.** **The opportunity** Peri is recruiting Software Engineers, including founding and early backend roles, for some of New York's most compelling AI startups, from Seed to Series D\+, backed by investors including a16z, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, Notable Capital, and Thrive. We've worked closely with the founders, studied the engineers who thrive on their teams, and learned what really sets them apart. The short version: **Ownership, speed, technical judgment, and the ability to learn fast often count for more than the name at the top of your last offer letter.** You don't need to have worked on AI products already. If you have, great. If you haven't, keep reading. **What you'll actually do** Imagine joining a team where the product is still taking shape. There's no thick onboarding doc. The architecture has decisions you'd make differently. The roadmap changes when a customer says something surprising. Your job is to make it work. Understand what users actually need. Make the tradeoffs. Design the system, write the code, ship it, and fix it when real traffic finds what tests didn't. You're part builder, part architect, part problem\-solver. You'll work directly with founders. You'll own features and systems end to end, not just tickets. And you'll see your work in front of customers within days, not quarters. These roles are for engineers who like having the whole problem. **Who we're looking for** Maybe you're an engineer at a big company who keeps wanting to touch more of the stack than your team allows. Maybe you taught yourself, switched careers, or grew into responsibilities long before anyone gave you the title for them. **We take all of that seriously.** But here's the thing. **We need you to show us.** A resume won't tell us how you debug something you've never seen, how you make decisions with incomplete information, or what you do when the obvious approach falls over. So walk us through it. Tell us about a system you designed. A bug that took you days to track down. A technology you had to master in a week. Something you built that nobody asked you to build. It doesn't need to be impressive\-sounding. It needs to be real. **Why aren't the companies listed?** Because this isn't one opening. We work with several teams looking for similar engineers, each building something different. Rather than you running six interview loops in parallel, we'd like to understand how you think and what you're great at, then point you toward the teams where you'd fit best. We only work with companies we'd be excited to join ourselves. **Who is Peri?** Most technical recruiting is keyword matching: languages, frameworks, years of experience, last employer. We think that leaves a lot of great engineers on the table. So we start from the other end. We learn from founders what actually makes an engineer succeed on their team, then look for those qualities in people whose resumes may undersell them. We're most interested in engineers who are better than their credentials suggest. **How to apply** * Apply here or DM me on LinkedIn. * We do want one answer: **What's the hardest or most interesting thing you've built, and what about it makes you think you're capable of more than your resume shows?** + A few sentences is enough. A link to code or a project is even better. Specifics beat buzzwords. + If there's a fit, we'll talk, share what we know about each team, and help you figure out which roles make sense. When there's a strong match, we'll connect you directly with the founders. **And if you've ever thought, "I'm a much better engineer than my resume makes me look," we especially want to hear from you.** **One last thing** Looking past credentials doesn't mean looking past ability. If you're mass\-applying without reading the post, can't show real engineering work, have a fabricated or misleading LinkedIn profile, or aren't authorized to work in the United States, please don't apply. **It's not a good use of anyone's time.** We'll overlook a pedigree. We won't overlook a lack of effort, skill, or honesty. **Show us what you've shipped, not what you say you can ship.** Compensation Range: $150K \- $350K

jobs.title: ML Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own. We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning. Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change. Our team is based in Cambridge, MA. The Role: We are looking for a ML infra engineer to oversee the training infrastructure for our NLP and Robotics research teams. In this role, you will be responsible for * Setting up and scaling our compute resources * Enforcing efficient compute utilization * Communicating with compute vendors to get us the most competitive rates * Making compute resources easy for researchers to use * Managing permissions \& onboarding/offboarding users ML infrastructure is key to the success and productivity of our research teams. You will play in integral part in the day\-to\-day operations of our teams and help accelerate our research processes. jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Postdoctoral Researcher in Scientific Machine Learning and Cross\-scale Predictive Modeling . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Postdoc (Fixed Term) . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== The Artificial Learning and Intelligent Systems group in NLR’s Computational Science Center has an immediate opening for a Postdoctoral Researcher to pursue a cross\-disciplinary research project in cross\-scale learning from heterogeneous evidence (lab\-scale to pilot\-scale) relevant to the DOE Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation.. The successful applicant will develop methods that combine evidence across different experimental scales, conditions, and modalities to make predictions at unseen physical or operational scales where data may be sparse or unavailable. In this context, the relationships between inputs and outputs may change with scale, and the available data may come from different data sources with different modalities and amounts and have different physical contexts. We are looking for someone who has developed innovative learning methods, including multi\-modal and surrogate modeling approaches, transfer learning techniques, physics\-informed ML, and/or statistical learning methods. . **Basic Qualifications** ======================== Must be a recent PhD graduate within the last three years. **\* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.** **Additional Required Qualifications** ====================================== * Demonstrated experience developing ML models for scientific or engineering systems * Demonstrated experience in learning from one set of conditions or domains and predicting in another, including situations where the source and target distributions differ. * Demonstrated experience in combining data with different modalities, sampling rates, resolutions, fidelities, measurement characteristics, costs, accuracies, or experimental conditions. * Demonstrated experience in physics\-informed and hybrid modeling, showing the ability to incorporate mechanistic models, physical constraints, or known relationships when useful, without assuming that complete physics models are available. * Demonstrated experience in model representation and adaptation, how to represent changes in system context, operating conditions, geometry, or scale so that the model can distinguish what is transferable from what is not. * Excellent communication skills * Demonstrated experience working in multi\-disciplinary teams and collaborative software development * Demonstrated experience with python and version control **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ . **Job Application Submission Window** ===================================== The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. **Annual Salary Range (based on full\-time 40 hours per week)** =============================================================== required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions. **Benefits Summary** ==================== Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short\-term disability insurance\*; pension benefits\*; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match\*; life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance; personal time off (PTO) and sick leave; and paid holidays. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as required by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\), which includes a favorable background investigation. **Drug Free Workplace** ======================= NLR is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug\-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre\-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre\-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre\-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn. **Submission Guidelines** ========================= Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at NLR you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application. . **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Reasonable Accommodations** **E** **\-Verify** **www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify** For information about right to work E\-Verify is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. jobs.title: Product ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Today, AI is something you rent. Alpaca is building the full stack of hardware, software, models, and applications together to make it something you own. We are developing a new computer architecture that breaks the economics keeping frontier models trapped in datacenters. On top of that, we’re building a platform of models, applications, and services that give that hardware meaning. Personal AI is moving from the datacenter to the desk, and we are driving that change. Our team is based in Cambridge, MA. **About the role** We want to make local AI models capable of doing far more than answering questions. Our goal is to build intelligent systems that can understand their users, remember information over time, use tools, and reliably accomplish complex tasks on their behalf. We are looking for an ML engineer to help bridge the gap between what a model can do on its own and what it can accomplish as part of a complete system. You'll work across model optimization, post\-training, agent architectures, memory systems, and evaluation to make our AI more capable, efficient, and reliable. This is a role for someone who enjoys both ML research and building real systems. You should be comfortable fine\-tuning models, experimenting with inference\-time techniques, designing agent harnesses, and developing new approaches to managing context and memory. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with ideas, measure what works, and bring improvements directly into products used by real people. **What you’ll do** **Improve our models:** Fine\-tune, distill, and optimize language models for tool use, instruction following, and complex agentic tasks. **Build agent systems:** Develop harnesses, tool\-use architectures, planning and execution loops, and other techniques that make models more capable and reliable. **Engineer memory and context:** Build retrieval, persistent memory, context compression, and management systems that allow agents to work effectively across long tasks and conversations. **Optimize inference:** Experiment with quantization, speculative decoding, and inference\-time techniques to improve model quality, speed, and efficiency on local hardware. **Evaluate and iterate:** Develop benchmarks and evaluations for agent capabilities, long\-horizon reliability, memory, and real\-world task performance. **Research and implement:** Explore new papers, algorithms, and techniques, rapidly prototype promising ideas, and integrate successful approaches into production. **Who we’re looking for** **Strong ML fundamentals:** Experience with modern language models, transformers, PyTorch, and the training and inference techniques behind them. **Agentic systems experience:** You've built or experimented with LLM agents, tool calling, planning, retrieval, or multi\-step reasoning systems. **Memory and context engineering:** Understanding of long\-context processing, memory architectures, and techniques for working within limited context windows. **Model optimization:** Familiarity with quantization, efficient inference, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and compute. **Experience with post\-training:** Familiarity with supervised fine\-tuning, reinforcement learning, distillation, or other techniques for improving model behavior. **Research\-minded engineering:** You enjoy reading papers, implementing new ideas, and turning research into working software. **Independence:** You take ownership of ambiguous problems, move quickly, and thrive in an experimental environment. **How to apply** Send us your resume, Github, and some projects you have worked on, along with a short note about why Alpaca interests you. More than credentials, we want to see what you've made, researched, designed, or shipped. If the role sounds like you but your background is unconventional, apply anyways. jobs.description: ### ***About Givzey \| Version2\.ai*** *Givzey \|* *Version2\.ai* (http://version2\.ai) *is a fully remote, AI\-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one\-to\-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high\-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world\-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.* *Version2\.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year\-round. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest\-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.* *VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt\-out rate of just 0\.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William \& Mary.* *Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI\-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.* **About the role** ------------------ This role sits next to our Product Manager and inside the Engineering team. You'll own the operational side of how we plan, ship, and report on work: the cycle cadence, ticket hygiene, release coordination, and cross\-functional program management across product, engineering, ML, and CS. This is a hands\-on, proactive operating role. You're the person a fast\-moving engineering team routes through. You keep the work moving without waiting to be asked, and you make the way the team works a little better every cycle. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Cycle operations** * Run the team's three\-week cycle cadence, including kickoff, daily standups, scope check\-ins, demos, and retrospectives * Keep blockers moving by getting each one to the person who can clear it, the same day * Own the delivery record, the single tracker that shows the team, leadership, and CS where every piece of work stands * Log lost time against each commitment the day it happens, and flag early when scope needs a cut ### **Ticket hygiene** * Maintain high\-quality tickets with clear acceptance criteria and correct prioritization * Ensure work is properly structured (parents, dependencies, scope) * Identify and clean up orphaned, duplicate, or stale tickets * Push back on stories that are not ready for development ### **Cross\-functional program management** * Coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams, including Product, Engineering, ML, and Customer Success * Manage dependencies across areas such as integrations, data pipelines, and customer readiness * Act as the connective tissue to keep projects moving forward * Route incoming requests to the right place (on\-call, a small\-fixes queue, or a future cycle) so work doesn't get assigned through DMs ### **Release coordination** * informed without creating unnecessary noise ### **Process improvement** * Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows * Propose and implement practical improvements * Continuously evolve team processes rather than simply maintaining them * Run the team's written playbook from day one, and take ownership of it once you've run a full cycle **What we're looking for** jobs.description: ### **ABOUT ADACTION** Founded in 2013, AdAction is a leader in performance\-based mobile app marketing, partnering globally to deliver premium users at scale. Our collaborative team prioritizes innovation and strategic decision\-making, fostering a dynamic and inclusive culture. AdAction is looking for individuals who thrive in an autonomous work environment, seek out ways to meaningfully contribute to our shared success, and embrace growth both personally and professionally. Our fully remote workforce is centered in the US, LATAM, UK, and Taiwan. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located in Illinois, Texas, or Colorado. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE** AdAction is seeking a hands\-on Director of Data Science \& Engineering to lead our Data function across Machine Learning, Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering. You will set the technical direction, develop our people, and strengthen how we use data and scientific thinking to improve products and business outcomes. Reporting to our VP of Engineering, you will serve as a peer to our Director of Engineering and a member of the Technology leadership team. You will directly manage a small group of Data professionals (ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers). Our Data professionals remain embedded in cross\-functional Mission Aligned Teams (MATs), working alongside Product Managers and Engineers. You will own people leadership, technical standards, and capability development while partnering with MAT leaders on priorities and delivery, rather than creating a separate centralized delivery team. This is a hands\-on leadership role, not solely a strategy or advisory position. You will regularly write code, build and evaluate models, and contribute to production implementations. Your deepest expertise should be in applied ML and Data Science, supported by the Analytics and Data Engineering experience needed to lead the broader function credibly. We make extensive use of AI in our day\-to\-day work and are looking for an AI\-forward leader who actively uses these tools and helps the team adopt them effectively. Success means a stronger, more independent Data function, more trustworthy analysis and data foundations, and ML initiatives that deliver measurable value. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Directly manage, coach, and develop ML Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Engineers through clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance management, and discipline\-specific growth plans. Shape hiring, develop technical leaders and qualified reviewers, and delegate decisions so quality doesn't depend on your approval of every change. * Set a practical ML and data strategy with Technology leadership, Product, and business stakeholders, tied to business outcomes and the capabilities we need to build. Evaluate opportunities such as conversion quality, fraud detection, personalization, forecasting, and campaign optimization, establish baselines and success measures, and recognize when better instrumentation, a simple rule, or an analysis beats a model. Track the impact of what we ship and adjust. * Regularly contribute Python, SQL, models, analytical workflows, and production implementations, using AI\-assisted coding and analysis and helping the team adopt these tools without compromising rigor, security, or data privacy. Pair on difficult problems and leave behind tested, documented work others can maintain. * Raise the standard for scientific thinking through problem framing, testable hypotheses, experiment design, statistical reasoning, model evaluation, and metric design. Coach analysts and Product Managers on measurement plans, communicating uncertainty, distinguishing correlation from causation, and translating evidence into decisions. * Establish practical standards for data quality, reproducibility, testing, documentation, model deployment, and ongoing evaluation. Ensure important models and datasets have clear monitoring, maintenance, and operational ownership. * Lead Data Engineering practices across data architecture, modeling, pipelines, and shared datasets, improving data quality, reliability, and accessibility. Partner with our Director of Engineering, Platform team, and MAT Tech Leads on infrastructure, production integration, security, and cost. * Coordinate cross\-team data investments and capacity with MAT leaders, involving Data professionals early in discovery rather than after a solution is chosen. Build reusable capabilities and shared practices that make teams more effective while preserving local ownership. ### **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Typically 8\+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related engineering roles, including substantial hands\-on experience delivering applied ML or Data Science solutions and progressively broader technical or team leadership responsibilities. * Deep applied Machine Learning and Data Science experience, including framing business problems, de iciency in Python and SQL, with the ability and desire to regularly contribute maintainable, tested code, models, and analytical workflows. * Demonstrated use of AI\-assisted tools in day\-to\-day technical work, with the ability to evaluate their outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive data, and coach others in their effective use. * Strong statistical reasoning and analytics experience, including metric design, hypothesis testing, experiment design, and responsible interpretation of results. Ability to explain what the evidence supports and where it remains inconclusive. * Credible Data Engineering knowledge across data modeling, pipelines, warehouses, and data quality. Ability to coach Data Engineers and evaluate architectural tradeoffs without needing to be the deepest specialist in every technology. * Experience with the operational lifecycle of data and ML systems, including reproducibility, version control, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintaining solutions after launch. * Product\-oriented judgment and experience prioritizing technical investments against customer and business outcomes. Ability to align multiple teams, navigate dependencies, and balance direct implementation with people and functional leadership. * Proven ability to teach complex concepts, communicate tradeoffs, and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical colleagues in a distributed environment. We value demonstrated capability, sound judgment, and meaningful results over a particular degree or previous job title. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform
jobs.description: **Alloy is where you belong!** ------------------------------ Alloy is the AI\-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth. Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we've been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year. Check out our investors and read more about us here. **About the team** ------------------ The Data Platform team sits within Alloy's Intelligence vertical and owns the infrastructure that powers how data is modeled, governed, and delivered — both internally and to customers. We work at the intersection of data engineering and analytical depth, with a stack built around dbt, Snowflake, and Artie, and a growing investment in our semantic layer. This is an early but high\-leverage moment for Analytics Engineering at Alloy. We have the tooling, the data, and the leadership experience to build this function the right way — and this role is central to that effort. The person who joins will help establish the patterns, standards, and culture of Analytics Engineering here. The strategic stakes are real: native warehouse data delivery is becoming a core part of how we serve customers, agentic workflows depend on a well\-maintained semantic layer, and OLAP infrastructure is increasingly woven into our product stack. Analytics Engineering sits at the center of all three. Alloy operates in a hybrid\-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. **What you'll do** ------------------ You'll manage the Data Platform team: hire for it, grow the people on it and set its direction. This is a player\-coach role. Roughly half your time goes to hands\-on work on the platform, and the other half to leading the team. * Lead a team of two engineers. Set clear direction, run one\-on\-ones and performance reviews, give direct feedback and coach each person toward work that stretches them * Hire as the team grows. Define the roles, run the interview loops and decide who joins * Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and change data capture, the Snowflake warehouse, dbt and the semantic layer, and the tooling that internal and customer\-facing analytics run on * Ship native warehouse data sharing into customers' own environments, including the schema contracts customers will build on for years * Design how sensitive customer data is handled across analytics and BI, so teams get the answers they need and customer data stays protected * Set the team's technical standard for modeling, testing, documentation and code review, and meet it in your own code * Work with Product, Compliance and other engineering teams to decide what data we expose, to whom and under what constraints. Make the platform good enough that teams choose it over building their own **What we're looking for** -------------------------- You want both halves of this job. You'd be unhappy in a role that took you away from building, and just as unhappy in one where nobody grew because of you. * Deep analytics engineering and data systems experience. Strong SQL, dbt and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred), with real depth in data modeling: grain, slowly changing dimensions and what makes a model trustworthy * Experience owning architecture from ingestion through the warehouse to delivery, including ingestion and change data capture tools (Artie or similar) and how they fail: late\-arriving data, schema drift, out\-of\-order events * A record of leading people. You've set direction others followed, grown someone on purpose, given feedback that was hard to give and raised a team's standard. Formal management experience is not required. We care about what you did, not the title you held * Good judgment about sequencing. Given more good ideas than quarters, you pick what comes first and can explain why the rest wait * Experience getting other teams to adopt something you built, or agreeing a constraint with a function that had reasons to resist, with the relationship intact afterwards * Based in the New York City area and able to work from our Union Square office Tuesday through Thursday **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with native warehouse data delivery, such as Snowflake Data Sharing or Marketplace * Background in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry, especially handling PII in analytics * Experience building a semantic or metrics layer and connecting it to BI tools * Exposure to agentic or LLM\-based workflows and the data infrastructure behind them We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically! *This position has a salary range of $255,000 \- $295,000\.* **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy * Employee stock options * Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options * 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation * Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave * Home office stipend for new employees * Annual Learning \& Development annual stipend * Well\-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health * Hybrid work environment: employees are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee\-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office. **How to apply** ---------------- Apply right here! You've found the application! Alloy is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and employer. We're committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you're ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50 locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as latency\- based routing (LBR), Private DNS, Geo DNS routing, DNS failover, and integration with a plethora of AWS services. On top of that, we offer fast change propagation with a 100% availability SLA. Our service is quickly growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new services in the naming and routing space. In the Amazon Route 53 team we like to “work backwards”: start by understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software engineering. We are looking for a software development engineer who is experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands by collaborating remotely with teams. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow. Key job responsibilities * Design and build highly available, low\-latency distributed systems that power DNS and traffic management for customers operating at global scale, handling billions of queries daily. * Own the full software lifecycle — from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and operational support — for critical services with stringent availability and performance requirements. * Write high\-quality, maintainable code in languages such as Java, Rust, or C\+\+, and contribute to architecture decisions that improve scalability, resiliency, and efficiency. * Solve complex technical problems involving networking protocols, fault tolerance, and large\-scale data processing, balancing trade\-offs between performance, cost, and reliability. * Mentor junior engineers, participate in code and design reviews, and raise the technical bar across the team. * Drive operational excellence by building monitoring, automation, and tooling that reduce operational load and improve system health. * Collaborate with product managers, senior engineers, and cross\-functional partners to deliver features that delight customers. About the team Amazon Route 53 team works on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AIO Visualization and Reporting
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join a team that builds the experiences every AWS customer uses to understand, monitor, and optimize what they spend, from individual developers to enterprise FinOps teams managing tens of millions of dollars in monthly spend. The AWS Billing Console Platform team owns the console's hosting platform, on which around thirty AWS engineering teams build their console pages; over fifty customer\-facing billing and cost pages of its own; and the rendering engine that turns an AI agent's cost data into the charts, tables and reports customers see. Two AWS agents answer cost questions today, a FinOps agent and Amazon Q in the console, and chatbots and console pages form one ecosystem customers navigate between to get problems solved and questions answered. Today each renders its answers its own way, and a cost figure has to be right the first time. This team is building the rendering layer both agents will draw on: an engine that checks every plotted value against the data the agent gathered, an open artifact format any agent host can render, and the component catalog that makes a cost chart look the same wherever it appears. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to extend this rendering platform to provide effective visualization for any problem that our web pages handle, especially for risky mutative actions. You'll use only the latest genAI, open source and proprietary technologies to directly enhance agents to give them the power of our AWS management console pages for problems that can only be solved visually or that require supervision by users. Key job responsibilities * Design, build, test, and operate the rendering engine behind AWS's cost agents: the components, the emit path, and the checks that verify every number before a customer sees it. * Bring generated cost visualizations into agent conversations against the accuracy and customer\-outcome bars the team sets, and keep two agent hosts rendering the same artifact from the same data. * Define and publish a rendering format for cost artifacts and adopt the open protocol the console ecosystem is converging on. * Build and operate customer\-facing console pages on the team's page\-building platform and component library. * Help scale a platform that absorbed the work of three teams in a 2026 reorganization: drive down operational load through automation, observability, and legacy\-service decommissioning so the team can invest in new customer experiences. * Own services end to end, including participation in the team's on\-call rotation for production support. * Raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, automated evaluation, and operational excellence, and partner with product managers, applied scientists, designers, and the agent teams across AWS. A day in the life You start by checking the health of the services you own and clearing anything handed off from on\-call, then pick up your current project: maybe a new artifact type, where you run the agent's answers through the team's fidelity scorecard, read where a figure drifted from its source, and fix the emit path. Midday you review a teammate's component, then join a design review where the team and the agent teams weigh how one artifact renders in two hosts. In the afternoon you pair with an applied scientist on the evaluation set for the next release and sketch the components a new chart needs. Across the week you balance net\-new rendering and platform work against the operational excellence that billing customers depend on, and rotate through on\-call. The problems are open\-ended, the customer scale is large, and the design space is new, so there is room to set technical direction and take on new scope. You will have the support of an experienced team and a manager invested in your growth. About the team The AWS Billing Console Platform team owns the platform, the customer\-facing pages, and the rendering engine that AWS customers and AWS's cost agents use to manage cloud spend. We operate at scale. Around thirty AWS engineering teams build their console pages on our hosting platform, which gains two to three new console pages every year, and we own over fifty customer\-facing pages ourselves, with a production footprint consolidated from three teams in a 2026 reorganization and driven toward lower operational load through automation and legacy\-service decommissioning. We own generative UI for billing and cost management, the rendering engine the FinOps agent runs in production and the cost\-visualization skill Amazon Q is launching, and we are extending that ownership into a platform: the agent interfaces, the generated experiences, and the open format customers will see across AWS's cost agents. That combination, a large operational platform plus a green\-field AI mandate, means an engineer here can take on scope quickly and see a clear path to the next level. We operate what we build, hold a high bar for operational excellence, and care about inclusion, mentorship, and work\-life harmony, so engineers at every level can do their best work and grow their careers.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Pricing Optimization Scientist, Pricing Science
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Take hard sequential decision problems, like delayed rewards, shifting demand and strict business constraints, and turn them into pricing policies that run at Amazon scale. Few places let you test RL ideas on a problem this large. Key job responsibilities Every day, Amazon makes hundreds of millions of pricing decisions. Each one is a choice made with incomplete information: demand shifts, competitors move, inventory runs low, and every price we set changes the data we learn from next. The P2 Optimization Science (P2OS) team builds the science behind these decisions. Our work includes demand response models, the optimization systems that turn them into prices, and the experiments that prove those prices help customers and the business. We're hiring an Applied Scientist to build sequential decision\-making methods for pricing. Most pricing systems estimate demand first and optimize second. We want systems that learn while they decide. That means deciding when to explore and when to exploit, how to trade short\-term revenue against long\-term customer trust, and how to set safe prices in categories where we have little history. You'll work on contextual bandits, reinforcement learning and online optimization problems that most research setups ignore: delayed and noisy rewards, hard business constraints, non\-stationary demand, and a catalog too big for a separate model per product. This is an applied role. You'll take methods from offline simulation through online experiments and into production. Your success will be measured by what changes for customers and the business, not by benchmark scores. You'll partner closely with senior scientists, economists, software engineers and product managers. You'll also help shape the team's long\-term direction on how Amazon prices adaptively. If you like hard optimization problems with real stakes, and you'd rather ship a method that works than publish one that doesn't, we'd like to talk to you. A day in the life As a Pricing Applied Scientist, you'll shape the prices customers see on a very large share of Amazon's catalog. In a typical week, you might: * Prototype a contextual bandit policy for a product segment with sparse sales history, then stress\-test it in simulation against the current production approach. * Dig into why a policy is exploring more than expected and trace it to a reward signal that arrives days late. * Work through a reward design with an economist: how to credit a price change that lifts conversion today but may affect repeat purchases next month. * Review an online experiment readout with your product manager and decide whether the policy is ready to scale or needs another iteration. * Write a short science proposal on a new constraint, like limiting how often a price can change, and estimate its cost to the objective. * Pair with an engineer to make a policy fast enough to update prices in near real time. * Present your findings at the team's science review, or develop them into a paper for a venue like KDD, NeurIPS or EC. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon’s network is a key differentiator for Amazon Cloud Computing and Web Services (AWS), enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across millions of servers worldwide. The AWS Networking team develops and operates the network platform for all of Amazon including e\-commerce products and cloud computing solutions. This platform is industry\-leading for its efficiency, throughput and reliability, and it is critical to the success of hundreds of thousands of AWS customers. We have developed and maintained a wide gamut of tools to help planning/scaling/operating our network seamlessly and automatically. We are now facing the next challenge: providing a software ecosystem capable of amalgamating all tools, operations, procedures in a single manageable, scalable, automated entity. The ideal candidate will be clearly passionate about the large opportunity for software innovation that Amazon’s network presents and about web services in general. This person has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality solutions in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift fast. If you're looking to solve challenging technical problems and create great products that protect and enhance customer availability, then we would like to talk to you. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Wallet Intelligence and Machine Learning
jobs.description: Summary Are you motivated to protect users and their accounts while delivering the best possible customer experience? Come join the Wallet Intelligence and Machine Learning team, where we help secure users' digital lives across Apple's devices without sacrificing privacy. Machine Learning Engineers here build analytical solutions and think deeply about where they fit into a larger system, staying ahead of fraud and applying the best privacy\-preserving and fraud\-prevention methods available to make Apple products, and especially Apple Pay and Apple Wallet, the safest platform people can use. The On Device Insights team at Apple develops machine learning models that run directly on users' devices to protect them from fraud, holding themselves to an exceptionally high bar for privacy. As part of the Wallet Intelligence and Machine Learning team, you will help secure users' digital lives across Apple's devices — including Apple Pay and Apple Wallet — without sacrificing privacy. This is a mission\-driven team that thrives on hard problems, healthy skepticism, and open collaboration. Description We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help develop and launch on\-device technologies that keep our users safe, working closely with engineering, security, program management, and business partners. Our work is applied and pragmatic by necessity. Models must run in real time and in the background on the device without slowing down something as simple as an in\-app purchase, which means designing within real constraints like model size, inference budgets, and memory. Because we often need to anticipate fraud rather than react to each new pattern as it appears, we have to be proactive and think ahead. This role is a chance to take ownership of a problem area, build a system\-wide understanding of where our models fit, and apply your expertise in machine learning in an innovative and fast\-moving environment. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by a meaningful mission, and the kind of person who digs beneath the surface and questions your own assumptions before forming a recommendation, we'd love to hear from you. Minimum Qualifications * Experience with machine learning methods such as classification, clustering, and anomaly detection. * Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, Scala, or Java. * Experience processing and analyzing data at scale using distributed data or compute frameworks. * Ability to communicate the results of analysis clearly and succinctly to a range of audiences. * Experience delivering results on ambiguous, loosely defined problems, working with others. * Rigorous analytical thinking, including the ability to question assumptions, reason through a problem, and justify a recommendation with sound evidence. Preferred Qualifications * Experience deploying machine learning in resource\-constrained or real\-time environments, such as on\-device deployment, model compression, or optimizing for inference budgets. * Experience with distributed data and compute frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or Daft. * Familiarity with privacy\-preserving machine learning techniques. * Background in fraud detection, risk modeling, or security\-focused machine learning. * Familiarity with iOS development. * We're open to a range of specializations and are excited by candidates who bring a differentiating strength to the team, whether that's a research background, deep systems thinking, or expertise we don't yet have. Within ASE, the Apple Data Platform SRE team keeps a massive, multi\-cloud platform running for thousands of internal engineers building the next generation of data and AI products at Apple.
