jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: As an AI Engineer, you're responsible for designing, building, and shipping AI systems that real people use, from AI features inside products used on over 30 million websites to internal tools built on our behavioral and operational data. You will turn messy real\-world data and a user's goals into output people can trust and act on: generated campaigns and content, plain\-English recommendations, and automations that save hours of work. We hire for caliber first, then match you to the team where you will have the most impact. ***Interested in applying?*** ***Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.*** ***Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)*** **To love this role, here's the type of person you are:** * You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools, you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive. * You care more about how good the output is than which model produced it, and you get restless when an AI feature is just fine. * You're a self\-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next. * You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it. * You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project, from data exploration and model selection to the API, the interface, and deployment, and making sure it actually works in production. * You build with AI every day, and you still verify everything before it ships. "The AI did it" is never your answer. * You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down. * You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work: clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path. * You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, and you share what you learn so the people around you get faster too. * You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside developers, product, design, and marketing, and doesn't take critical feedback personally. **Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):** * Designing and shipping AI features that turn a user's goal, website, or data into campaigns, content, and recommendations they can act on. * Building AI\-powered internal tools and data\-driven systems used across the organization: analytics platforms, reporting automation, and workflow intelligence. * Designing and building LLM pipelines with solid prompt design, structured and validated output, RAG, guardrails, and agentic workflows. * Cleaning and analyzing messy product and behavioral data, and grounding AI output in the facts so it never makes numbers up. * Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale. * Setting up evaluation and observability so every iteration is measurably better than the last, and failures are caught before users see them. * Owning the full path from model output to what the user sees, across backend and frontend. * Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case, balancing quality, cost, and latency. * Watching how people actually use what you build, and turning that into the next improvement. * Writing clean, well\-tested, production\-grade code with proper error handling, logging, and observability. * Documenting your work, including how you used AI to build it, so others can learn from it and reuse it. * Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team. * Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production, with AI features that real users touch (not just POCs or hackathon projects). * Strong proficiency in Python, including production\-grade practices: proper packaging, testing, type hints, and async where appropriate. * Full\-stack experience. You can lean backend or frontend, but you work on both: Python or Node services and a modern frontend such as React. * Hands\-on LLM engineering: prompt design, structured output, tool calling, RAG, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality. * Hands\-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch. * Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models. * Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, n ics, or personalization experience. * Experience with eval and observability tooling such as Langfuse, DeepEval, RAGAS, or LLM\-as\-a\-judge setups. * Experience building multi\-agent systems using CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks. * Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, or similar LLM integration patterns. * Experience with model fine\-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and quantization for cost optimization. * Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, drift monitoring, and experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, etc). * Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms. * Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context. * Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non\-technical teams rely on daily. * Published research, open\-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding. **Benefits** **Working for a fast\-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.** * Competitive Salary. * Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment for all full\-time team members during their employment. * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full\-time U.S. employees. * Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine. * Work from your home. We're spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more. * Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family. * Holidays (based on your location) * Paid Parental Leave. * We happily provide or reimburse software you'll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning. * We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all\-company retreat and mini\-team meetups). * Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary. * We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference. * Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions. * And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks. **Location** **This is a remote position \- our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am \- 5pm ET (UTC \-5\). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.** **Inclusion Statement** **At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.** **How to apply?** **If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!** *Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)* We won't be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you're a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly. Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **About us** Axiomatic AI is building a new class of AI systems designed to reason with the rigor of the scientific method. By combining deep learning with formal logic and physics\-based modeling, we create verifiable, interpretable AI systems that collaborate with and support human researchers in high\-stakes scientific and engineering workflows. Our mission, 30×30, is to deliver a 30× improvement in the speed, accessibility, and cost of semiconductor and photonic hardware development by 2030\. We aim to revolutionize hardware design and simulation in these industries and are building a team of highly motivated professionals to bring these innovations from research into commercial products. #### **Position overview** We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to own the agent platform that lets AI agents run scientific and engineering workflows reliably and safely. Some of these workflows run in lab environments where reliability and safety matter as much as speed. You will join a small, cross\-functional team and be the main owner of the agent platform code. You will scope your own work and make the calls on how it is built. #### **What you will do** * Own the agent platform end to end: design, implementation, releases and support. * Design the typed, tested tools that agents use to plan, run and verify work, and decide what belongs in a tool and what belongs in a prompt. * Keep the platform portable and well documented, so it is easy to adopt and extend. * Build safety and traceability into the platform from the start. * Run evals that drive decisions: your own golden task sets, baselines for every release, and comparisons across clients and models, including local ones. * Ship changes in small, reversible steps, with upgrade paths that need no manual work from users. * Turn research experiments into production features, and work with scientists to bring their workflows into the product. * Write ADRs and review code with the rest of the team. #### **Key requirements** * 5\+ years of software engineering, mostly in companies shipping software to real customers. Research or academic experience is welcome, but it should not be your only background. Software engineers who moved into AI are a good fit. * 2\+ years building LLM features that run in production at a company, beyond prototypes. * Strong Python: packaging with uv or Poetry, type hints, async, testing and building CLIs. * Hands\-on experience building or extending MCP servers and designing tools for LLM tool calling. * Good working knowledge of current agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar): plugins, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP support, and where each one falls short. You use them every day in your own work. * A working understanding of agent architecture: how the model, the harness, tools and state fit together, and which decisions belong in code instead of a prompt. * Experience running evals on LLM systems: building test sets, catching regressions and explaining the results to others. * A safety mindset: human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, guardrails in code, audit logs and awareness of prompt injection. * Care for compatibility: versioning, smooth upgrades and installers you can run twice without breaking anything. * CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker. * Comfort in a small team with unclear requirements. You can scope your own work and ship it with little support. * Clear, confident communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including the ability to challenge or push back constructively when needed. * Professional fluency in English. #### **Nice to have** * Experience running LLMs and software in restricted or customer\-managed environments. * Pydantic AI, LangGraph or similar agent frameworks. * Lab automation, instrument control or hardware connections (VISA/SCPI, OpenTAP). * Observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Logfire, Sentry). * Exposure to photonics or semiconductors. * Open\-source contributions to agent tooling. #### **What we offer** * **Competitive Compensation:** A competitive compensation package. * **Stock Options Plan:** Empowering you to share in our success and growth. * **Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and collaborative opportunities with leading experts in artificial intelligence, physics, hardware and electronic design automation. * **Work\-Life Balance:** A hybrid work arrangement with three days per week in our Boston office. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunities to attend industry conferences, present research findings, and engage with the global AI research community. * **Impact\-Driven Culture:** Join a passionate team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI and hardware. #### **Work model \& location expectations** Hybrid from our Boston office, 3 days per week. #### **Why join us?** At Axiomatic AI, you will be working on technology that drives innovation in AI for scientific and engineering applications in line with our 30×30 mission. This is your opportunity to contribute to the development of new AI architectures that can reason coherently and produce interpretable and verifiable solutions, and to see those ideas commercialized into products that will shape the future of hardware and computing, while collaborating with a global team of engineers and AI specialists. We believe in pushing the boundaries of what is possible and continuously seek to redefine the intersection of AI, with a focus on formal consistency. If you're ready to take your expertise in artificial intelligence and physics to the next level, we want to hear from you! *Worried about not meeting every qualification? Studies show that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every listed requirement. At Axiomatic AI, we are dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If this role excites you but your background doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this position or another opportunity with us.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Azenta Inc. ### **At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.** **All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity** **Job Title** ------------- Full Stack Software Engineer **Job Description** ------------------- **Position Title:** Full Stack Software Engineer **Location:** South Plainfield, NJ **Intro** **Company Overview** At GENEWIZ by Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer\-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships. As a global leader in R\&D genomics services, GENEWIZ, leads the way in providing superior data quality with unparalleled technical support to enable researchers around the world to advance their scientific discoveries faster than ever before. Our customers at top\-tier pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic institutions, as well as cutting\-edge start\-ups, rely on our proprietary technologies for consistent, reliable, high\-quality data, even on the most difficult projects. A full\-service provider, we provides Sanger DNA sequencing, gene synthesis, molecular biology, high throughput/next generation sequencing, bioinformatics, and GLP regulatory services **How You’ll Make an Impact** We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and support a laboratory operations platform that connects day\-to\-day lab workflows with our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). As an individual contributor, you will develop intuitive user interfaces, back\-end services, APIs, and reliable data integrations that improve sample and workflow tracking, automate manual handoffs, and provide laboratory teams with timely operational visibility. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer who can turn existing prototypes, laboratory processes, and user needs into secure, traceable, and intuitive software. You will partner with Lab Operations, Bioinformatics, LIMS, Quality, and IT teams to define requirements and deliver a scalable platform that supports workflow orchestration, bidirectional LIMS data exchange, exception handling, auditability, and future laboratory applications. **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full\-stack capabilities across user interfaces, services, APIs, integration middleware, and data layers, including converting prototypes into formal, scalable software solutions. * Translate user requests and operational needs into intuitive workflows and user experiences that simplify laboratory work and improve usability. * Define data models and build secure, traceable APIs for exchanging core sample, workflow, status, and metadata between the platform and the LIMS, with support for additional data domains as the platform evolves. * Contribute to architecture decisions and optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, security, observability, and supportability. * Extend the platform to integrate with laboratory instruments and automation systems as priorities evolve, including data capture, validation, error handling, retries, and operational monitoring. * Collaborate with Quality Assurance to produce requirements, design specifications, test evidence, release documentation, and audit\-ready records for regulated workflows. * Collaborate with teams across the U.S., EMEA, and APAC to deliver consistent, reusable platform capabilities and support regional laboratory needs. Integrate the laboratory platform with enterprise identity, messaging, data, and monitoring services using supported APIs and security standards. * **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional full\-stack software development experience building and supporting enterprise or operational platforms. * Strong proficiency with a modern front\-end framework such as React or Vue, including reusable component development and responsive user\-interface design. * Strong back\-end development experience with .NET or Python, including REST APIs, service design, relational databases, and data modeling. * Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing and CI/CD, Docker or similar container technologies, and deployment on AWS. * Experience designing secure, scalable, observable, and supportable applications, including authentication, authorization, logging, monitoring, and error handling. * Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, web services, messaging, or file\-based interfaces; experience with operational, manufacturing, healthcare, scientific, or other workflow\-intensive systems is applicable. * Solid understanding of modular architecture, distributed\-system design, data integrity, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices. * Ability to translate complex operational workflows and requirements into clear technical designs, testable acceptance criteria, and intuitive software solutions; familiarity with laboratory workflows is helpful but not required. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Lab Operations, Bioinformatics, LIMS, Quality, and IT teams. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing enterprise, operational, manufacturing, healthcare, scientific, or other workflow\-intensive software platforms; exposure to laboratory informatics or LIMS is a plus. * Experience integrating software with external devices, automation platforms, robotics, or specialized equipment using APIs, messaging, serial, file\-based, or vendor\-specific interfaces. * Familiarity with workflow, transaction, status, result, and metadata models used in operational system integrations; exposure to sample\-management or LIMS data models is a plus. * Experience delivering software in regulated or quality\-controlled environments and contributing to validation or assurance activities, data\-integrity controls, audit trails, and release documentation. * Previous experience contributing to platform modernization, service decomposition, or migration from manual and legacy processes to scalable digital workflows. * Experience creating responsive, accessible user interfaces or reusable component libraries for operational users in desktop and mobile environments. * Experience working in an Agile software delivery team and collaborating with operational users, product partners, Quality Assurance, enterprise\-system owners, and IT stakeholders across regions. Exposure to AI\-assisted workflows using APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, or vector search is helpful but not required. * Illustrative technologies may include: * Frontend: React, Tailwind, Storybook * Backend: .NET, Python * Database: SQL (PostgreSQL/SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB/DynamoDB). Test and Tooling: Cypress, Jest, Docker, AWS * **EOE M/F/Disabled/VET** ### **If any applicant is unable to complete an application or respond to a job opening because of a disability, please email at** **Recruiting@azenta.com** **for assistance.** **Azenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, age, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.** United States Base Compensation: $114,000\.00 \- $142,000\.00 The posted pay range for this position is an estimate based on current market data and internal pay structure. Final compensation may vary above or below this range depending on factors such as experience, education (including licensure and certifications), qualifications, performance, and geographic location, among other relevant business or organizational needs.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** BAE Systems, a top ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of War, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence \& Security provides services and products to the Department of War, the intelligence community, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world. We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to support the design, development, and deployment of intelligent systems that can learn from data, make predictions, classify objects, and generate insights supporting a new Enterprise lab environment across multiple classification levels. The lab supports new and emerging paradigms to support and enhance customer capabilities and tradecraft. The enterprise lab environment will encompass multi\-intelligence data infusion to enable innovative tradecraft development modeling and simulation to provide solutions for customer problems and needs. Th AI/ML Engineer will develop high\-quality analytic algorithms that drive business value and mission\-critical use cases in support of an IC customer. As the AI/ML Engineer you will: * Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models using popular libraries and frameworks. * Conduct feature engineering and feature selection to optimize model performance. * Collaborate with Data Engineers to prepare data for AI/ML model development, ensuring that the data is in a suitable format for model training. * Implement AI/ML algorithms, including design, training, testing, verification, and validation activities. * Develop and implement data pipelines to enable retrieval of data from federated data systems (e.g., cloud storage or on\-premises databases). * Develop and implement monitoring systems to ensure AI/ML model reliability and performance, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic. * Stay up to date on best practices and emerging technologies in AI/ML, including advancements in deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. * Assess and provide recommendations on emerging intelligence methodologies and tools * Validate work against real and simulated data – making corrections for non\-ideal data artifacts. * Brief internal stakeholders, internal subject matter experts, and potentially customers. * Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers, both internally and externally, across the organization. XYZ **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related STEM field and 10 years work experience or equivalent experience * Understanding of the AI/ML development process, Large Language Models (LLMs), and their applications in AI. * Knowledge of AI/ML libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Pytorch, Scikit\-learn). * Knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn) and data storytelling techniques. * Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision libraries (e.g., NLTK, spaCy). * Experience with ETL/TS tools and frameworks (e.g., Apache Beam, AWS Glue). * Familiarity with big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka. * Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering disciplines * Excellent organizational and follow through skills. * Strong communication (written and verbal) skills. * Detail oriented with problem\-solving skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $149603 \- $254317 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. jobs.title: AI Data Engineer - AI Training data
jobs.description: **About Blueprint** Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. **Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.** **In This Role** ---------------- You will contribute to the development of AI training datasets by building and maintaining Python\-based data processing pipelines. You will work with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets, transforming raw documents and text into high\-quality, validated data for AI model training. This role requires hands\-on experience creating datasets from the ground up, developing scalable data workflows, and managing data processing in Azure environments. You will collaborate with data scientists and engineering partners to improve data quality, processing efficiency, and dataset reliability while ensuring data integrity, traceability, and security. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Python\-based data pipelines for large\-scale data ingestion, processing, and transformation. * Build datasets from the ground up by collecting, organizing, cleaning, validating, and preparing raw structured and unstructured data. * Develop workflows for OCR processing, text extraction, normalization, filtering, segmentation, and deduplication. * Execute and monitor large\-scale batch processing jobs, troubleshoot failures, and implement automated retry and recovery mechanisms. * Develop automated data quality checks to identify missing or corrupted files, incomplete processing outputs, duplicate records, formatting issues, and metadata inconsistencies. * Prepare high\-quality, training\-ready datasets through data filtering, tokenization, text segmentation, and conversion into standardized formats. * Manage bulk data uploads, downloads, and synchronization between local processing environments and Azure storage platforms. * Maintain organized datasets with consistent naming conventions, metadata, version control, and source traceability. * Optimize data processing performance, memory utilization, storage efficiency, and cloud resource consumption. * Monitor dataset statistics, processing coverage, quality metrics, and exceptions while generating operational reports. * Collaborate with applied scientists and engineering teams to translate AI training requirements into scalable and repeatable data workflows. * Maintain documented, tested, and version\-controlled code while following established data security and governance requirements. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or data science with substantial hands\-on programming responsibilities. * Strong proficiency in Python, including developing reusable modules, debugging, testing, logging, and error handling. * Demonstrated experience building and developing datasets from scratch, including data ingestion, cleaning, transformation, validation, and preparation. * Hands\-on experience processing large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets using memory\-efficient, parallel, or distributed processing techniques. * Practical experience with Azure Blob Storage or Azure Data Lake Storage, including bulk data transfers, storage organization, and access troubleshooting. * Experience with Python data\-processing libraries and formats such as pandas, NumPy, JSON/JSONL, CSV, and Parquet. * Working knowledge of SQL, Git, Linux environments, and command\-line tools. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with a focus on data quality and integrity. * Ability to communicate technical challenges and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional engineering and data science teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience developing OCR pipelines, processing scanned documents, multilingual text, or document\-layout data. * Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, or other workflow orchestration platforms. * Familiarity with Hugging Face Datasets, AI/ML tokenization, near\-duplicate detection, and training/evaluation data separation. * Experience with large\-scale dataset curation and preparation for AI or machine learning model training. * Knowledge of distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as PySpark. * Experience with dataset lineage, reproducibility, containerized environments, and CI/CD practices. * Experience optimizing data pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. **Salary Range** At Blueprint, jobs.title: Research Engineer - Robotics AI
jobs.description: **Company Description** The Bosch Research and Technology Center North America with offices in Sunnyvale, California, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Cambridge, Massachusetts is a part of the global Bosch Group (www.bosch.com), a company with over 70 billion euro revenue, 400,000 employees worldwide, a very diverse product portfolio, and a history spanning over 125 years. The Research and Technology Center North America (RTC\-NA) is dedicated to providing technologies and system solutions for various Bosch business fields, primarily in the field of artificial intelligence, energy technologies, internet technologies, circuit design, semiconductors and wireless, as well as advanced MEMS design. As a part of the global research, our AI research in Silicon Valley focuses on Foundation Models, Explainable AI (XAI), Agentic AI, Computer Vision, Data\-driven Robotics, Data Science, AI System Engineering, Time\-series Analysis. We develop scalable, intelligent, and trustworthy AIoT solutions for Bosch products and services in application areas such as automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics, smart manufacturing, enterprise AI, health care, smart home and building solutions. Originating from the AI research in Silicon Valley, our Embodied AI group is responsible for enabling future autonomous Bosch products by pushing the boundaries of automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), robotics and automation through key innovations that encompass system architecture and AI components. These include methods for motion planning, high level task planning and decision making as well as systems for making these technologies work on real products. We work with internal partners of different Bosch business units to transfer our solutions into future products. We also actively collaborate with leading groups in academia and industry to promote research ideas and publish research findings in internationally renowned conferences and journals such as CVPR, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS and CoRL. **Job Description** As a Research Engineer \- Robotics AI, you contribute to research projects at the forefront of the Robot Learning field. Key responsibilities include: * **Conduct engineering** in core AI and machine learning fields to enable Embodied AI (including computer vision, autonomous planning, open\-world learning, and so on) for related business domains of ADAS/AD, industrial automation, robotics etc. * **Push the boundaries** in AI based Robotics, incorporating advancements in large vision\-language\-(action) models to aid reasoning capabilities and explainability. * **Collaborate cross\-functionally** with global research and engineering teams to ensure seamless technology transfer and system integration. * **Implement research results** to solve real\-world challenges, ensuring high\-quality system integration within Bosch's existing platforms. * **Stay at the forefront of innovation** by actively engaging with academic and industry communities through conferences, workshops, and technical events. * Collaborate to document and disseminate research findings through high\-caliber publications and/or patent submissions. **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics or a related discipline or outstanding Master's degree. * A minimum of 2 years of R\&D experience, or an equivalent graduate research background, primarily in AI technologies including Computer Vision and Robotic or Automotive Motion and Behavioral Planning. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in machine learning (e.g., Python, C\+\+, Rust). * Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork capabilities. * Knowledge of major machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. * Hands\-on research experience in agentic robotics / real2sim2real. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with real\-world product development and deployment of autonomous systems. * Hands\-on experience in reinforcement learning for behavior or motion planning or other applicable contexts and familiarity with common RL techniques (e.g. PPO, DQN, DDPG). * Hands\-on experience building and applying multimodal transformer\-based sequence\-to\-sequence models, especially multimodal vision\-language\-action models. * Hands\-on experience in computer vision and deep learning, with work in any of the following areas: multimodal transformers, multimodal language models, diffusion models, NeRF, gaussian splatting, object detection / segmentation, 3D scene understanding, sensor calibration, SfM, voxel/BEV grid\-based feature representation * A strong portfolio of publications in premier machine learning, deep learning, robotics and computer vision journals and conferences. **Additional Information** We offer a competitive base salary for this position with a range in US\-California of \-$160,000 \- $180,000 along with an annual corporate bonus, and a long\-term incentive bonus designed to reward sustained impact and contribution over time. Within the salary range, the individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your well\-being matters at Bosch! We offer a a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. Your Recruiter can share more details for this position during the interview process. Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome. **Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.** * Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug\-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date. *\#LI\-JM1*

jobs.title: Security Automation Engineer II, BU Info Security
jobs.description: Help secure a major research university's IT systems, and automate as much of that work as you can. You'll work with technologists and business units across Boston University to define, implement, and evaluate security risks and controls, and to make sure what we build matches our enterprise architecture standards and Information Security policy. You'll deploy and maintain security services, both commercial and home\-grown, and help refine the policies and standards that govern them. What makes this role different is how we expect the work to be done. Security delivered as code, with version control, automated tests, and pipelines — and automated security checks living inside the pipelines our IS\&T colleagues already use. We also want real fluency with current AI tooling: working in AI\-assisted development environments day to day, using AI to help generate and validate tests and review code, building AI\-assisted security tooling and MCP integrations, and being the engineer who can look hard at the AI systems other units want to deploy and say something useful about them. Raising everyone else's capability is a permanent part of this job, not a side project. You'll pair with colleagues, build patterns they reuse, run working sessions, and be the person others come to with a question about doing this safely — and you'll keep doing it, because the tooling keeps moving. Collaborative team, real problems, and strong benefits including tuition remission. Required Skills * Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience; master's degree preferred. * 3\+ years of related experience in security engineering, security architecture, or adjacent infrastructure and software engineering roles. * Proficiency in at least one general\-purpose programming language: Python, Go, Java, C\#, or PowerShell. * Git\-based version control, and experience building CI/CD pipelines that include automated testing. * Practical experience writing automated tests, including unit, integration, and regression tests. * Working knowledge of cloud and on\-premises security controls, identity protocols, and network and system administration. * Demonstrated fluency with current AI tooling, including routine use of AI\-assisted development environments and practical experience integrating large language models or AI services into working tools using tool and function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agentic patterns. * Judgment about where AI output requires verification, and an understanding of how AI\-generated code and tests fail. * Working understanding of AI\-specific security risk, including prompt injection, data leakage through model context, and authorization for agentic systems. * A track record of teaching or enabling colleagues: pairing, internal training, documentation others actually use, or reusable patterns adopted by a team. * Detail\-oriented, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Bonus Qualifications: * If you do not meet these, you are still encouraged to apply; we value employees with a willingness to learn. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or client development. * Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) * DevSecOps tooling for dependency, container, secrets, and infrastructure\-as\-code scanning. * Higher education experience. Boston University offers an excellent benefits package including: * Time Off: In addition to PTO and leave policy, BU employees have a paid intersession break and 13 paid holidays. * Retirement: University\-funded retirement plan with full vesting after 2 years of eligible service. * Tuition Assistance Program: Competitive tuition assistance program for yourself and family members. * Check out https://www.bu.edu/wellness/ and https://www.bu.edu/hr/part\-time\-employee\-perks/ for more information! Boston University IS\&T invests in our staff and their personal and professional growth. We promote staff learning including lunch and learn sessions, an extensive library of online courses, Fun Advisory Board (FAB) arranges a number of events throughout the year and opportunities to engage with peers at NERCOMP and EDUCAUSE events. If you require a reasonable accommodation in order to complete the employment application process, please contact the Equal Opportunity Office at 617\-353\-6474\. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We, at IS\&T, appreciate each individual's knowledge, experiences and insights which enhance who we are, and as our DEIA knowledge and practice grows, we will ensure that our Mission, Vision, \& Practices remain equitable and welcoming to all. *We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race,* *color**, natural or protective hairstyle, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military service, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, or because of marital, parental, or veteran status. We are a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Omni
jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** The Omni team is pioneering a planet\-scale data platform that will transform how information flows through our ecosystem. We're not just building infrastructure—we're creating the foundation that will power Box's next generation of innovations. Our ambitious platform seamlessly handles both object and graph data with a flexible schema overlay, designed to scale to truly impressive dimensions: trillions of nodes interconnected by hundreds of billions of relationships. As this vast data universe expands exponentially year after year, we thrive on the cutting\-edge challenges that demand our creativity and technical excellence. We are looking for a strong backend engineer to help us build and scale these critical distributed systems. This is your opportunity to solve fascinating problems at the intersection of massive scale, performance, and innovation, that have a direct and massive impact on how millions of people work with their most important content. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead design, build, and operate highly\-available, scalable, and resilient distributed backend services that form the core of our platform. * Develop systems for managing data across multiple geographic regions, solving complex challenges related to data sovereignty and compliance. * Collaborate with your team, product managers and other engineering teams to define and implement the APIs and services that power Box's platform. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code, and participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high standards of quality. * Mentor other engineers on the team, promoting best practices in software development and distributed systems design. * Take ownership of the entire software lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and operational support. * Strengthen engineering processes, principles, and culture within the team by championing a culture of learning and continuous improvement. * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. Required skills * You have 5\+ years of professional experience in backend software development, with a proven track record of building and shipping complex, large\-scale services. * You possess deep expertise in designing and working with distributed systems, understanding the trade\-offs between consistency, availability, and performance. * You are proficient in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Scala, Go, or Python. * You hold a BS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or have equivalent practical experience. Preferred skills * You are a product\-minded engineer who thinks about the "why" behind the "what" and is passionate about solving customer problems. * You have experience with data\-intensive applications, search technologies (like Elasticsearch or Solr), and/or database and query systems (SQL or NoSQL). * You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable working in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment. * Experience with at least one public cloud platform (e.g. GCP, AWS, Azure) and containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) is a plus. Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process. At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply! **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and is committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. Inclusiveness is core to our culture at Box, and we strive to ensure you get the most from your interview experience. Box makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please complete this form. Reasonable accommodations may include scheduling adjustments, document dictation and beyond. Notice to applicants in Los Angeles: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chance Ordinance is provided here. Notice to applicants in San Francisco: Box, Inc and its related branches will consider for employment, qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chair Ordinance. The Fair Chance Ordinance is provided here. For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice. If you are a California\-resident, please read our California Applicant \& Candidate Privacy Notice here. **NOTICE OF USE OF AI** At Box, we believe in the power of AI to improve the recruiting process while keeping people at the heart of every decision. For more information on the use of AI in our hiring process, please visit our webpage here.

We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** As a Staff Product Manager for Threat Detection and Prevention, you will be the strategic product leader responsible for safeguarding the world's most sensitive enterprise content across the Box Intelligent Content Management platform. Content security is existential to Box and top\-of\-mind for our enterprise customers, CISOs, and security leaders worldwide. jobs.description: The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees. We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of. We’re trusted by 250\+ brands managing $30B\+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you. **The Role** ------------ Every day, Confido processes remittances, deductions, retailer disputes, and trade spend for some of the fastest\-growing brands in CPG. Our customers trust us with their bank data, ERP credentials, and retailer portal logins. We're hiring our first Security Engineer to make Confido the most trusted place for CPG brands to run their financial operations. jobs.title: Staff Storage Engineer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** At Crusoe, we are on a mission to align the future of computing with the future of the climate. As a Staff Storage Administrator on the Storage Team, you will be the lead architect and operator of the data layer for our vertically integrated AI cloud. This team sits at the critical intersection of massive\-scale data ingress/egress and high\-performance GPU workloads, ensuring that our sustainable clusters deliver world\-class data throughput for the world’s most demanding AI and HPC use cases. You will manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of our world\-wide storage environment from initial bring\-up and configuration to high\-level vendor strategy. In this role, you will have a direct hand in shaping our enterprise infrastructure, collaborating on vendor RFPs and reviewing responses while working directly to influence vendor product roadmaps. Your work ensures that Fortune 500 companies and leading AI researchers have the performant, reliable, and sustainable storage needed to power the AI revolution. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Performance Analysis \& Optimization:** Evaluate performance of block, file, and object storage systems across diverse workloads. Identify bottlenecks at the hardware, firmware, OS, and application layers. Develop and execute performance test plans, benchmarks, and stress tests. Tune storage stacks (I/O schedulers, caching layers, drivers, protocols) to achieve target KPIs. * **Validation \& Testing:** Design and execute Proof of Concept (PoC) exercises to take new arrays through their paces. You will validate new vendor software releases in staging environments before rolling them out to our global production footprint. * **Full\-Stack Administration:** Own the initial bring\-up, configuration, and ongoing performance tuning of large enterprise arrays. You will manage the lifecycle of the storage OS, ensuring all systems are optimized for AI training and inference I/O patterns. * **Enterprise Infrastructure Building:** Collaborate with the Compute and Networking teams to build a seamless "gold standard" cloud infrastructure. You will design cloud\-scale storage systems that can excel in high\-concurrency, high\-throughput environments. * **Storage Strategy \& Selection:** Lead the technical evaluation of new storage technologies. You will be responsible for authoring RFPs, reviewing vendor responses, and leading "down selection" processes to ensure we invest in the best hardware for AI workloads. * **Vendor Roadmap Influence:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact for storage partners (such as VAST Data, Pure Storage). You will sit with their engineering teams to provide feedback on bugs, missing features, and prioritize Crusoe’s requirements on their development roadmaps. * **Cross‑Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with service engineering and architecture teams to influence design decisions. Provide performance guidance during feature development and release cycles. Communicate findings to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * 10\+ years of experience in storage systems administration, with a heavy focus on petabyte\-scale, on\-premise data environments. * Hands\-on production experience administering VAST Data and/or Pure Storage (Everpure) arrays, including bring\-up, configuration, upgrades, and performance tuning. * Strong understanding of storage architectures (block, file, and object) and I/O paths. * Hands\-on experience with performance benchmarking and observability tools (FIO, ElBencho, blktrace, nvme\-cli, nfs\-gaze, eBPF, etc.). * Experience with SSDs, NVMe, RAID, caching, or distributed storage systems. * Deep familiarity with enterprise flash arrays and distributed file systems. * Proficiency with scripting (Python, Go, or Bash) to automate array management and monitoring. * Ability to analyze complex performance data and present clear conclusions. * Proven ability to lead the authoring of technical requirements, evaluate RFP responses, and manage complex vendor relationships. * Experience with system design for specific I/O use cases (AI training and inference), and a disciplined approach to testing and validating new vendor releases. * A genuine interest in Crusoe’s mission to reduce the environmental impact of the AI revolution through sustainable infrastructure. **Bonus Points** * Experience with RDMA, iSCSI, NVME\-oF, RoCEv2 or InfiniBand networking as it relates to high\-performance storage. * Previous experience at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP) or a high\-scale AI infrastructure company. * Familiarity with distributed storage systems (Ceph, Lustre, Gluster, etc.). **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 \- $255,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Entity:** CSL Behring **Job Category:** Information Technology **Job Family:** IT Multi Discipline **Job Type:** Full Time **Location****:** King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States **Employer Reference:** R\-295164 **Job Description** ------------------- Deliver robust, tested and supportable systems from the team's working prototypes to R\&D scientists. The Associate Director is the team's senior full\-stack engineer and architect. The role owns the engineering standards, development and deployment patterns, and production readiness for every application the team ships, and decides how software built with agentic tools by scientists and colleagues becomes durable, validation\-ready systems. Its decisions set how quickly prototypes become products, how reliable those products are, and whether they are ready for validation. The role partners with a peer Associate Director, AI Platform \& Enablement, who turns proven team patterns into shared platform capabilities over time. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role: the Associate Director designs, builds, debugs and reviews production software, working in agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) throughout the day, alongside validated\-system work that follows its own procedures. **Responsibilities:** * Own engineering standards and production readiness for every application the team ships. Select and maintain the team's standard languages, frameworks and supported versions based on security, maintainability, enterprise compatibility and what AI\-assisted development builds most reliably. Make architecture, release and incident\-response decisions without escalation, within agreed governance, security and quality requirements. * Take prototypes built by scientists and colleagues with agentic tools to production grade: refactor, strengthen and productize them with sound architecture, tests, observability, security, documentation and operability. Assess prototypes against agreed engineering standards and work with stakeholders to recommend and implement retain, rebuild or retire decisions. * Own application\-to\-platform integration: the production concerns that recur across applications, such as authentication and single sign\-on, secrets, networking, deployment and monitoring. Solve them for the team, build them once into reusable patterns, and work with the AI Platform \& Enablement Associate Director and enterprise platform teams to move proven patterns into the platform. * Establish and maintain the team's standard development and deployment patterns: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments, starter templates, monitoring and operational runbooks for the team's applications and agents. * Own code\-review standards and the merge gate for the team's repositories, reviewing and approving changes from scientists, colleagues, contractors and embedded delivery engineers, none of whom report to the role. Run design and architecture reviews before applications enter shared environments, and set the review standard for AI\-generated code. * Design and build full\-stack, cloud\-native systems: APIs, orchestration and workflow services, data and vector stores, identity and access, and scientist\-facing front ends, favoring managed services and simple, maintainable designs. * Partner with Quality and computer system validation colleagues to define and implement risk\-based engineering and validation practices for LLM and agent\-based applications, and build the evidence case for them. Practices may include requirements traceability, model and configuration change control, regression evaluations, controlled releases and auditable records. Quality retains decision authority. * Work directly with R\&D scientists and the team's scientists to define software requirements, review their code and build engineering capability through pairing. Lead the productization of the team's flagship applications, directing embedded delivery or professional\-services engineers and coaching colleagues on engineering practice. * Gain acceptance from platform teams and Cyber for the team's deployment and access patterns. Implement application security practice in line with Cyber standards, and ensure the team's applications and delivery practice comply with the company's quality management system, security guidelines and IT policies. * Own the production\-support approach for the team's applications, including triage, escalation, incident follow\-up and engineering fixes, with support responsibilities agreed across the team and platform partners. * Bring production\-readiness and risk assessments to senior leadership, with recommendations on build versus buy and on which prototypes to harden or retire. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a physical, life or quantitative science or in engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years building and operating production software, with a substantial share as a hands\-on architect or principal\-level engineer who thinks in systems. * Experience building or operating software in regulated, validated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, IQ/OQ/PQ, requirements traceability) required. * Demonstrated, sustained daily use of agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to design, build and ship software, with full ownership of generated code, evidenced by delivered software, professional or personal. * Experience owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and release engineering with a globally distributed team: pipelines, environments, deployment and rollback, and observability. * Track record of taking inherited or prototype code to production grade: refactoring, test coverage, security hardening, performance and operability. * Experience solving the production concerns that sit between applications and platforms (e.g., authentication and SSO, secrets, networking, access control) and turning them into reusable patterns. * Fluency in at least one production language and the judgment to direct agents across a polyglot stack (the team's is Python, TypeScript and PostgreSQL). * Deep cloud\-native experience, AWS preferred (equivalent Azure or GCP depth considered): containers and serverless, workflow orchestration, IAM and least\-privilege design, managed data stores. * Hands\-on LLM application patterns (RAG, vector search, multi\-stage pipelines) preferred. * Experience working directly with research scientists preferred. **About CSL Behring** --------------------- CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/. **Our Benefits** ---------------- For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well\-being \| CSL. **You Belong at CSL** --------------------- At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future. To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion\-and\-belonging **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility\-statement.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Western Europe
jobs.description: Solutions · Full\-time · London SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. **FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER \- WESTERN EUROPE** You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production\-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent\-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident\-to\-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics * Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding\-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org * Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage * Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs * Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever * Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption * Work directly with Staff\+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results * Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * You have 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science * You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system * You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path) **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders * Hands\-on depth in several of: agents and tool\-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI\-native coding workflows in a real repo * Experience as a forward\-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end
