jobs.description: **Department Overview** The Information Security organization is advancing Application Security to help the enterprise deliver products and services securely as software development practices rapidly evolve. The Application Security Engineering and Innovation team builds, integrates, operates, and matures modern security capabilities across the software development lifecycle, with a particular focus on automation, developer experience, software supply chain security, and AI\-enabled security engineering. **Job Overview** The Application Security Engineer, AI and Agentic Security is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, prototyping, evaluating, and operationalizing generative and agentic AI capabilities within Application Security. The role combines hands\-on software engineering, Application Security expertise, and practical experience with AI\-enabled development patterns. It will help establish safe, scalable approaches for AI\-assisted vulnerability identification, code analysis, remediation, validation, and security workflow automation. This engineer will partner with Application Security, software engineering, cloud and platform teams, Security Architecture, AI Governance, and other information security functions to move promising concepts from experimentation into governed, supportable enterprise capabilities. The role is expected to balance innovation with disciplined engineering, security controls, measurable outcomes, and long\-term operational sustainability. ***Responsibilities*** * Design, build, and test prototypes and production\-ready capabilities using generative AI, large language models, AI agents, and multi\-step agentic workflows. * Develop Python\-based services, automation, integrations, evaluation harnesses, and supporting tools for Application Security use cases. * Evaluate AI\-enabled security products and frameworks for vulnerability discovery, exploitability analysis, secure code guidance, remediation, validation, and developer workflow integration. * Create controlled workflows in which AI capabilities can analyze code, use approved tools, recommend or generate changes, execute tests, and produce auditable evidence while maintaining appropriate human oversight. * Establish technical guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, data access, tool use, repository access, secrets handling, logging, traceability, change control, and safe failure or termination. * Develop test plans and benchmarks to assess accuracy, security, reliability, repeatability, cost, latency, false positives, remediation quality, and operational value. * Perform security testing of AI and agentic workflows, including prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive agency, data leakage, insecure output handling, dependency and supply chain risks, and authorization failures. * Integrate capabilities with source control, CI/CD pipelines, developer tools, issue management, security testing platforms, and vulnerability management workflows. * Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical requirements, runbooks, and operational support models for approved capabilities. * Partner with governance and architecture teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise AI, security, privacy, data protection, and technology standards. * Support pilots with application teams, capture feedback, measure outcomes, and recommend whether capabilities should be scaled, redesigned, purchased, built, or retired. * Maintain awareness of developments in generative AI, agentic systems, secure AI engineering, Application Security, and software delivery practices. * Strong hands\-on Python development experience, including API integration, automation, testing, data handling, and production\-quality engineering practices. * Experience building or integrating solutions using large language models, model APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, or agent frameworks. * Experience designing and evaluating agentic workflows that use tools, maintain state, make bounded decisions, and operate with human approval where appropriate. * Strong understanding of secure software development, common application vulnerabilities, threat modeling, secure design, authentication and authorization, secrets management, and software supply chain risk. * Experience with Application Security capabilities such as SAST, SCA, secrets detection, DAST, API security, container security, IaC security, and vulnerability remediation workflows. * Experience with Git\-based development, pull requests, CI/CD, automated testing, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native development patterns. * Ability to evaluate AI output quality using repeatable test cases, metrics, red\-team scenarios, and evidence\-based comparison rather than demonstration results alone. * Understanding of AI security risks and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, insecure tool use, mo tion development, LLM integration, agentic systems, or AI\-enabled developer tooling. * Experience with one or more additional languages or platforms such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET/C\#, or Go. * Experience with cloud services, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and enterprise developer platforms. * Experience with AI evaluation, adversarial testing, red teaming, observability, or governance controls for AI\-enabled systems. * Knowledge of industry guidance such as the OWASP Top 10, OWASP guidance for LLM or agentic applications, NIST Secure Software Development Framework, and NIST AI Risk Management Framework. * Relevant security, cloud, or software credentials are beneficial but not required; examples may include CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, GWEB, or cloud\-provider certifications. **What Is Expected of You and Others at This Level** * Applies advanced knowledge of software engineering, Application Security, and AI\-enabled development to solve complex and ambiguous problems. * Leads or materially contributes to complex projects with broad scope, significant technical impact, and long\-term operational implications. * Recommends new practices, architectures, controls, metrics, and engineering approaches for emerging capabilities. * Independently determines methods for completing new or undefined work while receiving guidance on overall objectives. * Experience in providing solutions and technical patterns that help establish precedents for technical findings, risks, trade\-offs, and recommendations to engineering, security, governance, in various leadership forums. * Acts as a mentor and technical resource for less experienced jobs.title: Identity Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences serves hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and continues to grow at double\-digit rates. Its molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data support software that helps ensure a cancer patient's report is right, complete, and on time. The Senior Software Engineer \- Identity Resolution \& Master Data Management designs, builds, and operates the production identity capabilities that regulated clinical workflows depend on: matching, linking, merging, and separating identity records under auditable controls, so that clinical information lands on the correct patient and provider records across complex healthcare data flows. The engineer improves resolution quality, data integrity, and operational reliability, and every change ships through controlled, testable delivery practices. The engineering environment supports advanced AI coding assistants and agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay serve as executable evidence, and onboarding is harness\-first: the engineer builds or extends those tests to capture current behavior as repeatable validation evidence. Delivery runs on CI/CD, automated testing, application\-level observability, and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. The specific technology stack is discussed during the interview process. Reporting to an Engineering Manager or Senior Engineering Manager in Clinical Software Engineering, this senior individual contributor leads technical delivery in the identity\-resolution domain, participates in architecture and design decisions, and maintains software subject to SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements. Location: Irving, Texas (Dallas–Fort Worth), on\-site/hybrid, minimum three days per week on campus; co\-located with Caris's laboratory and clinical operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, and maintain identity\-resolution and MDM services for patient and provider data. * Develop and tune deterministic and probabilistic matching across names, addresses, dates of birth, contact information, identifiers, and other approved attributes. * Implement workflows to merge, unmerge, link, and separate records, with durable audit trails and safeguards for downstream clinical use. * Define and monitor resolution\-quality, data\-quality, performance, and reliability measures; investigate anomalies and strengthen controls. * Own the data models, APIs, and integration patterns that connect upstream and downstream clinical systems. * Partner with product management, data governance, clinical operations, compliance, and engineering to refine requirements and manage identity\-related risks. * Write and maintain the technical record: design documents, architecture decision records, data\-flow documentation, and operational runbooks. * Review code and submit work for review; contribute automated unit, integration, regression, and performance tests. * Automate recurring engineering and operational tasks: repeated manual steps become scripted, reviewed automation rather than standing process. * Instrument and support production services; participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, and corrective\-action work. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. * Work AI\-first: use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as daily practice across design, implementation, and test generation, with peer and engineering review as the quality gate. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software systems. * 3\+ of those years designing or operating entity\-resolution, record\-linkage, MDM, or comparable identity systems in production. * 2\+ of those years building system integrations through APIs, event\-driven patterns, or batch data pipelines. * A track record of implementing matching logic across multiple identity attributes and evaluating it against measurable quality controls. * Experience designing data models and remediation workflows for duplicate, conflicting, or incomplete records. * Command of full SDLC practices, automated testing, code review, and controlled production delivery. * Operating experience with high\-volume production services: observability, incident response, and root\-cause analysis. * Hands\-on fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows in real engineering work. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Experience with MPI or enterprise identity\-resolution platforms. * Familiarity with HL7 messaging and FHIR. * Depth in relational and document databases: SQL, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience applying graph databases, probabilistic methods, or ML to entity resolution. * Experience with CI/CD, automated regression testing, and production observability. * Experience implementing or operating controls aligned with SOX ITGCs or FDA requirements under 21 CFR. * Experience in CLIA\- or HIPAA\-governed environments. Regulated\-domain experience is preferred, not required. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to critical patient\-identity or clinical\-data issues and participation in periodic scheduled on\-call rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.title: Engineer, Cloud
jobs.description: **CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD** Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast\-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone. **THE OPPORTUNITY** The Engineer – Platform Engineering (Cloud Engineer) is responsible for building and managing Chipotle’s cloud and on\-premises infrastructure, with a focus on automation and scalability. You will implement and maintain core platform services (such as cloud resources, servers, and CI/CD pipelines) that power our restaurants and enterprise systems. By utilizing Infrastructure\-as\-Code and robust monitoring, you’ll drive improvements in reliability, performance, and security. This role plays a key part in Chipotle’s modernization initiatives, contributing to cloud adoption and platform innovation in line with our Infrastructure Strategy. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Configure, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and on\-prem servers, ensuring systems are set up following best practices for security and performance. * Develop and maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code templates and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Terraform scripts, Azure DevOps tasks) to automate provisioning and configuration of resources. * AI \& Automation: Comfortable leveraging leading LLMs and hybrid AI models to accelerate engineering work, including generating and validating Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripts, automation, and troubleshooting workflows. * Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for platform components to quickly detect issues and optimize system performance * Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues (network, OS, or cloud service problems), working with cross\-functional teams to restore service and identify root causes. * Research and introduce new technologies or tools (containers, configuration management, AIOps platforms) that can improve infrastructure efficiency, scalability, or cost\-effectiveness. **WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE** * Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4\-year college or university. * 3\-5 year’s experience * Solid hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS), virtualization, and containerization, along with a strong grasp of core infrastructure components (servers, storage, networks, security). * Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines) to build and manage infrastructure as code, driving consistency and efficiency. * Hands\-on experience with leading LLMs and AI coding tools, including using AI to generate, review, and validate Infrastructure as Code and automation, plus an understanding of hybrid AI architectures. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for infrastructure issues – able to dissect complex problems under pressure and implement reliable solutions. * Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally (e.g. with developers, support teams) and clearly document technical processes. * A security\-minded and detail\-oriented approach – jobs.description: **Description** **Senior Security Engineer, AI Security \& GenAI Data Protection** Citizens is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to help design, implement, and operationalize its AI Security and Generative AI (GenAI) data protection capabilities. This role will provide hands on engineering expertise for the AI Gateway platform, supporting evaluation, deployment, configuration, policy engineering, inline remediation, integration, and ongoing optimization across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI usage. The Senior Security Engineer will work closely with Cybersecurity, Data Protection, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to reduce data loss risk while enabling responsible enterprise adoption of AI and GenAI technologies. **Work Arrangement** Hybrid, 4 days onsite and 1 day remote in one of the following hubs: Johnston, RI \| Boston, MA \| Marlton, NJ \| Pittsburgh, PA \| Phoenix, AZ \| Irving, TX \| Manchester, NH **Key Responsibilities** * Engineer, configure, and support AI Gateway capabilities across evaluation, proof of concept, deployment, policy tuning, operational support, and continuous improvement. * Support phased implementation of AI security controls from monitor mode to warn and coach to targeted blocking, using observed AI traffic, risk metrics, and user behavior to inform control decisions. * Develop and tune controls for GenAI prompts, file uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, sanctioned AI platforms, and unsanctioned AI applications. * exceptions, and enforcement outcomes. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Citrin Cooperman's Applied AI Practice designs, builds and runs AI agents inside clients' businesses. Those clients are middle\-market companies, private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies, and enterprise clients our team has served for years. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the technical side of an engagement. You work in a pod with a Deployment Strategist, who owns the business case, the scope and the executive relationship. You own the architecture, the code, and whether the system holds up in production. Most of our clients don't have large IT or data teams. A typical engagement starts with scattered data, an older ERP, a small IT staff, and a CFO who wants to see the controls before an agent touches the general ledger. You leave with a system in production and a client team that can run it. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD** * Agents for sales, marketing, service, operations, finance and accounting work, connected to clients' ERPs, accounting systems and CRMs * MCP servers, agent skills and integrations that give models safe access to client systems, written so the next engagement can reuse them * Data pipelines that prepare client data for AI: you profile, clean, model and connect the sources before an agent depends on them * Evaluation suites, monitoring and audit trails, so every agent ships with a measured accuracy baseline and every action it takes can be traced and reviewed **DISCOVERY AND DESIGN** * Run technical discovery with your Deployment Strategist: map the client's workflow, systems and data, then turn the business problem into an architecture * Pick the right stack for each client: Anthropic or OpenAI models, AWS, Azure, GCP, Salesforce Agentforce, or a mix * Build proofs of concept quickly, and know what it takes to turn one into a production system **DELIVERY AND PRODUCTION** * Own components from architecture through deployment, monitoring and handoff in the client's environment * Get systems through client security reviews, access controls and data\-handling requirements, including at regulated clients * Train client teams to operate and extend what you deliver **PRACTICE BUILDING** * Turn what works into reference architectures, starter repos, eval templates and playbooks for the rest of the Practice * Review designs and code from other engineers on the team * Send field lessons and platform gaps back to the Practice and to our technology partners **What Success Looks Like in the First Year** * Systems in production at clients, each with a measured accuracy baseline and an audit trail * Reference architectures and starter repos that other engagements reuse * You meet the billable utilization target and earn strong client satisfaction scores * Five to eight years of software engineering experience, including at least one production system you can walk us through in detail * Client\-facing technical delivery experience in consulting, professional services or a forward deployed role; this is a requirement * Deep expertise in at least one platform: Salesforce, AWS, Azure, GCP, or a frontier lab ecosystem (Anthropic or OpenAI APIs, agent SDKs and tooling) * Production experience with large language models: prompt design, tool use, agents and evaluation, including why an agent failed and what you would change * Fluency in Python or a strongly typed language, and working SQL * Experience designing APIs, data models and integrations, beyond using them * Able to explain technical trade\-offs to finance leaders and executives as clearly as to engineers * Willing to travel about 25% of the time **Preferred Qualifications** * Finance and accounting operations experience: close, AP/AR, FP\&A or audit * Private equity experience: sponsor work, portfolio operations or value\-creation plans * Delivery in regulated industries such as financial services or healthcare * Middle\-market consulting, where clients have small IT teams and fixed budgets * Certifications from Anthropic (Claude Certified Developer, Claude Certified Architect), Salesforce (Agentforce Specialist, Platform Developer I), AWS, Azure or GCP * Experience with MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Agent/Messages SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph) or cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Salesforce Data 360\)

jobs.title: AI Engineer

This role builds components of the AI Harness, agent frameworks, evaluation systems, and developer workflow tools, while partnering with engineering teams to translate practical delivery needs into reliable AI\-enabled solutions. The AI Engineer II contributes to production\-quality AI applications and helps improve the consistency, safety, and usefulness of AI\-supported engineering workflows. **Responsibilities:** Develop AI Harness \& Platform Capabilities * Design, build, test, and maintain well\-defined AI platform components, services, connectors, and internal tools. * Implement model routing, prompt execution patterns, API integrations, and reusable utilities aligned to platform standards. * Improve reliability, performance, observability, and usability of AI engineering tools. * Support production operations for AI\-enabled services, including troubleshooting, monitoring, and issue remediation. * May be responsible for on\-call rotation and front\-line incident response for AI\-enabled production services, including triage, escalation, and remediation. Build Reusable Agents, Skills \& Connectors * Develop reusable agents, skills, workflow components, and connectors that can be used across engineering teams. * Implement agent behaviors, tool calls, structured workflows, and integration logic that support AI\-assisted SDLC use cases. * Apply standards for modularity, permissions, traceability, and maintainability. * Partner with more senior engineers to refine shared libraries and reduce duplicate AI engineering work across teams. Implement Evaluation, Testing \& LLMOps Workflows * Build and maintain evaluation workflows for prompts, agents, tools, and AI\-generated outputs. * Develop automated tests, regression checks, quality benchmarks, and validation approaches for AI\-enabled capabilities. * Support versioning, release management, rollback readiness, and lifecycle management for prompts, agents, and AI components. * Analyze model and agent behavior to identify quality, cost, latency, security, or reliability concerns. Apply AI Security \& Governance Controls * Embed approved logging, access control, data classification, and risk controls into AI\-enabled workflows. * Work with security and governance partners to address implementation requirements for responsible AI use. * Validate that AI tools and agents are handling sensitive data appropriately and operating within defined guardrails. * Support remediation of security, compliance, or audit findings related to AI engineering solutions. Partner with Engineering Teams on AI\-Assisted Delivery * Collaborate with software engineering teams to understand delivery pain points and identify AI\-enabled workflow improvements. * Build examples, templates, and golden\-path patterns that accelerate adoption of shared AI engineering capabilities. * Support onboarding, technical guidance, and issue resolution for engineering users of AI platform tools. * Contribute to team standards, documentation, and communities of practice around AI\-assisted development. **Requirements**: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience, with typically 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, platform engineering, automation, or developer productivity roles. * Strong programming skills are required, preferably in Python and one or more modern application development languages. * Candidates should have experience building APIs, services, integrations, automated tests, and cloud\-based applications. * Experience with LLM application patterns, prompt engineering, RAG, agent frameworks, LLMOps, evaluation techniques, or AI\-assisted development tools is strongly preferred. * Candidates should demonstrate sound engineering judgment, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to independently deliver reliable technical solutions in a secure environment. The Sr Software Engineer is primarily responsible for the support of the existing software applications and enhance software components deployed in the Cotiviti product suite. The successful candidate will be required to collaborate effectively with senior developers, offshore development team members, business owners, project management, and other internal stakeholders. Responsibilities: * Design and implement event\-driven microservices and the Angular/React front ends that consume them * Own technical design decisions across the full application life cycle, from requirements through production support. * Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues in distributed systems, partnering with support and development teams. * Configure and improve CI/CD pipelines and build automation. * Evaluate and apply open source technologies to meet enterprise requirements. * Lead code reviews and promote secure coding, testing, and documentation standards. * Verify any AI\-generated code for correctness, performance, and security before it is committed, using only company\-approved tools and never sharing sensitive data (credentials, PHI, PII, or proprietary code) with unapproved ones. * Balance long\-term architectural health with short\-term delivery needs * Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team. * Complete all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan. * Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. * Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Founded in 1921, the Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is a leading nonprofit membership organization, research center, and publisher, with headquarters in New York, an office in Washington, DC, and programs nationwide. It is dedicated to increasing America's understanding of the world and contributing ideas to U.S. foreign policy. CFR’s 5,000\+ members are leaders in international affairs and foreign policy. CFR also publishes Foreign Affairs, the preeminent magazine on global issues, and provides up\-to\-date information about the world and U.S. foreign policy on its award\-winning website, CFR.org. Position Summary: The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is seeking an experienced DevOps engineer / Site Reliability Engineer. This role is responsible for maintaining the secure and reliable functioning of our digital properties including CFR.org, ForeignAffairs.com, Think Global Health, The China Open Source Observatory, and other associated web and mobile sites. The portfolio spans a managed WordPress VIP publishing platform, Pantheon publishing platform, and custom AWS applications. This role owns the reliability, resilience, security, and observability of those properties, the delivery pipeline that ships to them, and a growing set of AI and agentic services built on top of them. Your goal is to prevent outages; when incidents happen, you lead the response and make sure we learn from them. You will work closely with the software engineering team and report to the associate vice president of product, design, and engineering. This full\-time position is based in CFR’s New York City or Washington D.C. office on a hybrid basis. CFR currently defines hybrid status as working at least four days a week onsite, with Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays considered institutional anchor days where all staff are required to be onsite. Essential Functions/Responsibilities: * Define and track SLOs and error budgets for each property. Own on\-call, incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems. * Run observability, logging, and alerting systems (Datadog, Dash0\) to track service health, improve resilience, and prevent downtime, and raise issues before visitors or stakeholders ever see a problem. * Own infrastructure, backup, and disaster recovery documentation and execution. * Maintain the CI/CD pipelines for CFR.org and our applications, including WordPress VIP and Pantheon deploys as well as custom AWS apps; debug failed runs and keep configurations current. * Provision and manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform, with policy checks and drift detection in the pipeline. * Identify opportunities to use automation, testing, and deployments. * Build security into every stage of delivery: manage Okta\-based role\-based access, own secrets, key management and rotation. * Own infrastructure, backup, and disaster recovery documentation and execution. * Own AWS security posture and edge/WAF configuration. * Lead incident response, determine root cause on production issues, mitigate, and provide technical support to the engineering team as needed. * Assist DevSecOps contractors, vendors, and cross\-functional technical contributors to deliver against the platform roadmap Minimum Qualifications: **Experience*** 3\-7 years experience in DevOps, SRE, platform or security engineering. * Proven experience with AWS and infrastructure as code with Terraform. * Experience with managed platforms such as WordPress VIP, Pantheon, Acquia, or similar. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and multi\-environment deployments. Familiarity with supply\-chain security tooling. * Hands\-on experience applying zero\-trust principles. SSO/MFA through an identity provider (Okta), least\-privilege IAM, short\-lived credentials, and secrets management (1password, AWS Secrets Manager or similar). * Scripting in Bash and Python. Working familiarity with PHP and Node.js/TypeScript. Working knowledge of WAF/CDN services such as Cloudflare, Cloudfront, or, Fastly. * Strong communication and problem solving skills, serving as a collaborative bridge across engineering, operations, IT, and vendors. Required Application Materials: Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position. Compensation and Benefits: * The full\-time annual compensation range for this position is $150,000 – $175,000, depending on experience. * In addition to competitive salaries, the Council on Foreign Relations offers a benefits package that is among the best offered by nonprofit institutions today, including an award\-winning health and wellness program, an on\-site fitness center, and generous leave policies and health insurance programs. About CFR: The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is committed to fostering a foreign policy community in the United States that is more representative of American society, recognizing that diverse backgrounds and perspectives contribute to broader, more informed participation in the foreign policy debate and lead to an enhanced understanding of the world and the United States’ role therein. To that end, CFR is dedicated to continuing to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout its work and workplace by building a more diverse membership and staff, producing and dispensing thoughtful analysis on a broad range of foreign policy issues, and developing relevant, wide\-reaching programming that also serves to expand the foreign policy talent pipeline to underrepresented populations.

Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements. Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence. D\-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise\-grade systems available on\-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99\.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D\-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D\-Wave is shaping the quantum\-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com. **About the role** D\-Wave is seeking a Staff Software Engineer for the Calibration, Automation, and Tools team to design and build intelligent software that improves the calibration and operation of quantum processing units (QPUs). You will combine strong software engineering with hands\-on machine learning and artificial intelligence experience to turn experimental data into reliable models, automated workflows, and tools used by scientists and engineers. Working closely with physicists and quantum, software, firmware, and hardware engineers, you will take solutions from exploration and simulation through validation and production deployment. As an individual contributor, you will shape a single technology or product line and remain hands\-on in delivering ML and AI improvements to calibration quality, reliability, and efficiency. **What you'll do** * Lead one or more projects within QPU calibration and automation software, coordinating cross\-functional work with scientists and engineering teams as needed * Develop and evaluate ML approaches for calibration and operations, including parameter estimation, surrogate modeling, anomaly detection, drift detection, and adaptive experiment selection * Contribute to implementing process improvements for reproducible data and model pipelines, including data validation, training, versioning, deployment, and monitoring * Partner with scientists to define meaningful metrics and compare models against established numerical and statistical methods using simulation, historical data, and controlled hardware experiments * Integrate validated models into calibration workflows with appropriate operational limits, fallbacks, and traceability; investigate model failures and changing data distributions * Architect and maintain Python services, REST APIs, relational data stores, and user interfaces that make experimental results and model behavior understandable and actionable * Contribute to evolving technical processes and quality practices, helping improve testing, observability, and reliability within the team * Mentor junior and new team members, participate in design reviews, and apply sound judgment when using AI\-assisted development tools, independently verifying generated code and analyses **About You** * MS or higher in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, including delivery of production systems and contributing to technical decisions within your team * Demonstrated ownership of ML initiatives from problem definition and model development through rigorous evaluation, operational deployment, and measurable outcomes * Strong Python skills and experience with scientific computing and ML libraries, such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow; proficiency in another language such as Go, Java, C, or C\+\+ * Practical understanding of statistical modeling, optimization, experimental design, and model evaluation, including data leakage, overfitting, uncertainty, and reproducibility * Experience translating a scientific or engineering problem into an ML task, choosing suitable baselines, and explaining results and limitations to domain experts * Experience building maintainable services and REST APIs, using SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and developing interfaces with React, Angular, Vue.js, or comparable technologies * Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, AWS, and automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing * Familiarity with LLM\-based coding assistants and sound judgment in reviewing their output for correctness, security, and maintainability **A D\-Waver's DNA** * We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other. * We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions \& take responsibility so that we can act \& support each other. * As leaders we motivate \& engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams \& creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling \& coaching. **Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:** We believe providing D\-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team. **During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D\-Wave. **The Fine Print:** No 3rd party candidates will be accepted *It is D\-Wave policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.* *Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on* *D\-Wave Careers site* *using our applicant system. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Production
jobs.description: **About David AI** ------------------ David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R\&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high\-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in. David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors. Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight\-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI. **About our Engineering team** ------------------------------ At David AI, our engineers build the pipelines, platforms, and models that transform raw audio into high\-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We're a tight\-knit team of product engineers, infrastructure specialists, and machine learning experts focused on building the world's first audio data research company. We move fast, own our work end\-to\-end, and ship to production daily. Our team designs real\-time pipelines handling terabytes of speech data and deploys cutting\-edge generative audio models. **About this role** ------------------- We generate audio data for the world’s leading speech and audio labs. Data only matters if it makes a customer’s model measurably better, and finding out whether it does is your job. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, Production, you’ll own the loop between a customer’s model, our research team, and our data production. In a typical week you’ll run an ablation on Monday, see a signal on Tuesday, change how we collect data on Wednesday, and ship a recommendation that makes it to the customer by Friday. You’ll be shipping something on the order of days, not weeks. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable in a codebase, translating customer requirements into how we produce data, and in the details of how we ship product features to yield data that improves our customers’ models. You’ll care about why a model regressed, and also about which recording setup, product experience, or automated QA step caused it. **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * **Run the daily experiment loop.** Turn customer questions into fast, rigorous experiments, get results in days, and iterate until the answer is clear enough to act on. * **Design ablations and benchmarks that change decisions.** Work with our research engineers to isolate what drives model behavior. Then translate the results into concrete changes in what we collect, how we collect it, and how we filter and weight it. * **Develop operational intuition for data quality.** Get close to how our data is produced, including recording conditions, contributor pools, annotation, and QA, so you can trace model outcomes back to operational causes and fix them at the source. * **Build the tooling that makes speed possible.** Ship the eval harnesses, pipelines, and analysis tools that make the next experiment faster than the last, across every customer. * **Close the loop with the model improvement lifecycle.** Make sure what you learn changes what we produce, so our data keeps improving the models that depend on it. * **Shape how we work.** Help define our experimentation practices, engineering culture, and roadmap as the team grows. **Your background looks like** ------------------------------ * AI\-native coding experience with a track record of fast, impact\-driven experiments and product features across the stack. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team. * Ability to translate open\-ended research questions into concrete experiments and clear recommendations. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both researchers and non\-technical stakeholders. * Desire to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly as the audio AI field evolves. * Excited to join our team in\-person in San Francisco. **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * At least 3 years of relevant engineering or product experience (product engineering, ML engineering, or applied research) * Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience working with audio or speech models, or with audio/signal data more broadly. * Familiarity with machine learning research workflows — training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and metrics. * Experience working directly with technical or enterprise customers. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO. * Top\-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans. * FSA \& HSA access. * 401k access. * Meals 2x daily through DoorDash \+ snacks and beverages available at the office. * Unlimited company\-sponsored Barry's classes. **Visas** --------- We sponsor international candidates across a range of visa types, including H\-1B transfers, H\-1B1, O\-1, E\-3, and TN, and we support STEM OPT. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world. Compensation Range: $165K \- $225K

jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience coding in one or more general purpose languages (e.g., Python, Java, C or C\+\+). * 5 years of experience designing and launching large\-scale production software products or foundation AI systems. * 4 years of experience in software development. * 3 years of experience leading software design and system architecture for high\-throughput distributed systems, foundation model runtimes, or client applications. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role setting technical direction and guiding project teams. * 3 years of experience driving complex cross\-functional initiatives across research, engineering, product management, and UX design in complex matrixed environments. * Experience developing, evaluating, or serving large language models, agentic workflows, multimodal pipelines, or AI runtime APIs (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Triton, vLLM, Gemini API). **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. The GenAI Eval Platform team’s mission is to provide a rigorous, high\-velocity, and scalable evaluation backbone that powers the development and deployment of Google’s frontier AI models. Working in close collaboration with Google DeepMind (GDM) research teams, you will build the evaluation platform that serves as the steering wheel for AI progress—determining model capability, safety, reasoning depth, and readiness for global launch. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design and optimize distributed evaluation execution engines to orchestrate large volumes of inference steps across TPU and GCU pools with high throughput and low latency. * Build foundational abstractions for evaluating complex LLM agent loops, tool use, and automated LLM\-as\-a\-judge rating systems. * Design robust error classification, automated retry policies, and observability dashboards to maintain strict SLOs for evaluation pipeline success rates. * Partner closely with GDM research scientists and data science teams to anticipate frontier model evaluation requirements and translate them into scalable infrastructure solutions. * Mentor fellow engineers, set high standards for code quality (Python in Google3\), and advocate rigorous testing and system design practices. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Agent Ops, Technical Product Management (Forward Deployed Engineer)
jobs.description: **Agent Ops, Technical Product Management (****Forward Deployed Engineer)** **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology,** to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an **Agent Ops, Technical Product Management** on our **Servers Agent Ops builds** **team** in **Round Rock, Texas**. **What you’ll achieve:** The Servers Agent Ops team builds and operates AI agent capabilities for Dell's server \& networking organization. As an **Agent Ops, Technical Product Management**, you will work directly with product, engineering, and operations teams to understand their problems, identify the patterns behind them, and define and curate agent\-based solutions. You'll combine a product mindset (discover and define) with a working technical foundation (code, data, and modern AI tooling), as part of a small team led by a senior technical lead. **You will:** * Work with server teams to understand workflows and pain points and turn them into well\-defined problems * Analyze data and processes to identify recurring patterns and automation opportunities * Define, curate, and prioritize agentic solutions, including requirements, success measures, and data and tool integrations * Prototype and contribute to solutions using code and integrations, including MCP tools * Partner with engineering teams to validate solutions and move them into use and communicate findings and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 8\+ years of related experience; demonstrated scope and impact matter more than exact years * Hands\-on coding experience in at least one language (for example, Python or JavaScript/TypeScript) * Working knowledge of data structures and how data moves through systems (APIs, JSON, databases) * Demonstrated ability to analyze problems, identify patterns, and structure ambiguous work * Customer\- or stakeholder\-facing experience with strong written and verbal communication **Desirable Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field * Experience spanning full\-stack development, AI/agent technologies (including MCP), AI\-assisted software development, customer\-facing technical and product roles, and enterprise infrastructure, hardware, and software solutions **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $147,200\.00 \- $202,400\.00\. **Who We Are** We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**. Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description: About Diversify: Diversify is an advisor\-founded, advisor\-led wealth management firm that pairs institutional resources with a boutique, personalized experience. We are built for the long game, driven by innovation, focused on consistency, and committed to a remarkable experience for our advisors and the clients they serve. That commitment to innovation is why we are investing in AI. Learn more about us at https://joindiversify.com. About the Position: The AI Agent Engineer is a hands\-on builder responsible for turning well\-defined business use cases into working, reliable agents. This role partners closely with the AI Ecosystem and Integration Specialist, product owners, and business users to build, test, and improve agents that use tools, retrieve information, and complete multi\-step workflows. The ideal candidate is curious, energetic, and eager to ship. AI is changing faster than any technology we have seen. A core part of this role, not a side task, is continuously building your understanding of new AI capabilities and how they are reshaping wealth management, and turning that understanding into better solutions for our firm, advisors, and clients. Your Impact: * **Agent Development:** Build, test, and deploy agents with tool use, retrieval, and multi\-step workflows. * **Advisor Platform Support:** Build and test agents, tools, and prompt assets for the advisor platform, and use usage and quality data to improve them. * **Quality \& Evaluation:** Write evaluations and monitor agent accuracy, reliability, and cost over time. * **Business Partnership:** Work closely with business users to refine requirements and iterate quickly. * **Documentation \& Handoff:** Document and maintain what you build so others can use and extend it. * **Continuous Learning \& Industry Awareness:** Keep up with new models, frameworks, and techniques, including how they are being applied across wealth management. Test promising ideas quickly, and share what you learn with the team and the wider firm. Who You Are: * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering or automation, with at least the last two years focused on building AI agents or LLM\-based solutions directly related to this position. * Projects you have built and can show us, including side projects. * Comfortable with ambiguity and biased toward shipping. * Intellectually curious by nature. You learn constantly because you want to, you have a clear habit for staying current, and you are comfortable with a field where today's best practice may be outdated in six months. * Solution focused and user\-centric. Your Toolkit: * Strong Python, JavaScript/TypeScript skills. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks. * Familiarity with cloud deployment and basic security practices. * Experience with RAG, workflow platforms, and prompt and evaluation practices is a plus. * Curiosity about the wealth management industry, and experience in a highly regulated industry, is a plus. * AWS Bedrock and supporting tools a plus. Benefits: * **Core Benefits** \- Medical with HSA and FSA options, dental, and vision. * **Preparing for Your Future** \- 401(k) with a generous company match, access to a personal financial planner, and unique investment options. * **Great Team Culture** \- Team members consistently rave about having great colleagues. * **Time Off** \- We value family, giving back, making a positive impact in society, and creating time to enjoy life. You will enjoy 4 weeks paid time off, 12 paid holidays, and 2 days for giving back. Join Us Now! We demonstrate and act with complete and unconditional honesty and adhering to principles of sound ethics. After accepting an offer of employment, all candidates will go through a pre\-employment background check, credit check, and pre\-employment drug screen. Diversify is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This role partners closely with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to define how work is split, where humans stay in the loop, and how we know the output is good enough to ship. Evaluate which options fit our delivery model, and share regular updates with engineering and leadership on what is changing and what we should adopt. * **Orchestration \& Tooling:** Build the tooling that connects agents to repositories, test environments, and review workflows. * **Quality \& Security:** Establish quality gates, security review, and traceability for agent\-produced work. * **Platform Alignment:** Ensure delivery standards, quality gates, and traceability extend to agent\-produced work on the advisor platform, and partner with the platform owner on requirements. * **Measurement:** Measure throughput, defect rates, and cost against traditional delivery, and report honestly on results. * **Training \& Enablement:** Train engineers and business partners to work effectively with agent pods. jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1\.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI\-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As a member of the Global Data Analytics (GDA) team, you will leverage a variety of technologies to design, develop, and deliver AI\-powered features in addition to loading, transforming, and preparing data sets of all shapes and sizes. During a typical day, you will develop new features to analyze data, build AI agents, and load tested data sets into the Snowflake Enterprise Data Warehouse. You will have the opportunity to use innovative technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow while pioneering our AI agent orchestration layer. We are looking for a candidate with a positive “can do” attitude, a passion for learning, and the drive to work hard in a fast\-paced environment. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Manager, Data \& Analytics. **Responsibility** * Build and maintain scalable, efficient data pipelines and AI agent orchestrations * Develop and deploy autonomous agents using frameworks like CrewAI and LangChain * Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and manage Vector Databases to enhance LLM context and accuracy * Utilize Langgraph/CrewAI for complex stateful multi\-agent orchestration * Implement robust Evaluations (e.g., Arize) to monitor and improve model performance and reliability * Analyze and develop data quality and validation procedures to ensure trusted data for AI applications * Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and provide AI\-driven solutions * Own, monitor, and improve solutions to ensure SLAs are met * Execute projects using Agile Scrum methodologies in a collaborative team environment **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field * 8\+ years of Data/Software Engineering experience * 3\+ years of experience specifically within agentic orchestration, RAG\-based architectures, and LLM implementation * Experience developing data pipelines in Python or Java * 3\+ years of dimensional and relational data modeling experience * Experience with SQL and database management **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with LangChain, Langgraph, CrewAI, and Arize * 3\+ years in Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift * 5\+ years with AWS, Spark, and Data Lake environments * 5\+ years with dbt, Matillion, and Airflow * Experience with Claude Code, Cortex, and VSCode Copilot development models * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently or as part of a team **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $146,400\.00 \- $235,375\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. jobs.title: AI Engineer I/II/III
jobs.description: **At EQT, you won't just do a job, you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross\-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement.** **Join our Qrew!** EQT is building a fleet of AI agents that work alongside our people, and we need an AI Engineer to help it grow. You'll join an AI team that builds the shared tools agents rely on, configures and deploys the agents themselves, and keeps the whole fleet healthy once it's live. Our agents already run in production on Microsoft Foundry, posting into Salesforce and the enterprise systems our people use every day. The next step is scale: many more agents, built faster, with business users helping tune them. As an AI Engineer, you build and maintain the capabilities our agents run on, and you monitor and optimize the agent fleet once it's in production. You set up the configuration for each prompt agent and customize its tools. Then you hand off to AI Specialists and domain experts, who test against real cases and tune the prompts until the agent is right. When reasoning alone can't do the job reliably, you build a pro\-code hosted agent or specialized tooling. That's the exception, not the plan. **Who thrives here:** * **You think agentically.** You trust reasoning models to do most of the heavy lifting, and you reach for deterministic code where the outcome must be guaranteed, not by default. * **You build for flexibility.** You'd rather ship an agent that improves as models get better and cheaper than hardcode every scenario and fall behind. * **You favor progress over perfection.** You'd rather get many useful agents live and improve them than polish one forever. * **You make others better.** You enjoy building the tools and patterns that let business users and new builders do more on their own. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You follow the field, try new models and tools as they land, and want to help an organization change how it works. **The AI Engineer I/II/III responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Build and maintain shared agent tools and capabilities. * Configure Foundry prompt agents: instructions, model selection, tool assignments, permissions, and guardrails, ready for others to test and tune. * Customize and extend tools when an agent needs something the shared set doesn't yet cover. * Partner with AI Specialists and domain experts as they test against real cases, and coach them on prompt design and evaluation. * Deploy agents and monitor the fleet through the Foundry control plane: evaluations, monitoring and alerts, audit trail, and cost. * Optimize agents in production, and recognize when a deployment is drifting or needs tighter guardrails, better data, or a narrower scope. * Build pro\-code hosted agents or specialized tooling when review shows a prompt agent can't do the job reliably. * Ensure agents adhere to our security and identity standards. * Help shape the Agent Factory standards and share what you learn, so the next agent is faster to build than the last. * Stay current with models, agent frameworks, and Foundry features, and bring forward ideas that move more work from code to reasoning. **Required Experience and Skills:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (computer science, engineering, information systems, or similar), or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 3\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML roles. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents or applications: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval, and evaluating outputs against real cases. * Solid software engineering fundamentals in Python, including git, code review, testing, and working with APIs. * Working experience with Microsoft Azure or a similar cloud platform, including identity, permissions, and secrets management. * Comfort working across enterprise systems and data, including SQL and integrating with platforms like Salesforce and Databricks. * Judgment about when code is the right answer versus when a well\-designed prompt and the right tools are simpler and just jobs.description: Overview: **We are designing the grid of the future!**EPE is seeking a Staff Data Engineer, Applied Data Science III with demonstrated experience in the electric utility sector to join our consulting practice to support analytical and applied data science, data engineering and data architecture consulting projects with our utility and energy\-sector clients. In this role, you will help EPE’s utility clients translate their utility data and business requirements into well\-designed data pipelines, reliable models and integrated analytics and data science workflows. Your work will span data discovery, architecture and integration design, hands\-on development, machine learning, and model maintenance. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for a professional with 4–5 years of relevant experience, including experience in the utility sector. You will deliver defined technical components and workstreams, collaborating with senior technical staff and client architects on broader architectural decisions. Depending on the engagement, responsibilities may involve direct implementation or design specifications and advisory support for client\-owned implementation. Responsibilities: **How you can make an impact****:** **Data Engineering for Utility Clients** * Explore, evaluate, and understand utility data sets including advanced metering infrastructure interval (AMI) energy data, SCADA data, GIS data, utility asset data, customer programs data, and billing data. * Design, develop, test, and maintain repeatable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, reconcile, and deliver data from databases, files, APIs, and other approved sources. * Develop reusable Python and SQL components for data cleansing, standardization, aggregation, validation, and feature preparation. * Profile source data and establish automated checks for completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and freshness. * Develop record\-matching and entity\-resolution logic to reconcile customer, asset, device, program, and operational records. * Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues; document corrective actions. **Data Architecture and Integration Design for Utility Clients** * Translate business, analytical, and operational requirements into documented data architecture and integration designs for defined solutions or components. * Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models, entity relationship diagrams, schemas, data dictionaries, and source\-to\-target mappings. * Design data flows connecting source systems, staging and storage layers, analytical datasets, models, and downstream applications. * Evaluate and document design tradeoffs involving relational databases, warehouses or lakehouses, batch or API integration, performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost. * Incorporate client requirements for data ownership, access controls, sensitive information, retention, lineage, and auditability into solution designs. **Applied Data Science for Utility Clients** * In the context of typical utility data sets (AMI, SCADA, weather, GIS, asset, and customer programs data sets), develop and validate forecasting models, classification schemas, anomaly\-detection analysis, clustering approaches, and prioritization models as appropriate to the application. * Address overfitting, class imbalance, sampling bias, and time\-dependent validation requirements. * Monitor model performance and support documented recalibration, retraining, and model updates. * Connect analytical models to reliable data pipelines and reproducible datasets, working with client deployment teams where appropriate. * Communicate assumptions, uncertainty, limitations, and the distinction between observed, inferred, and predicted results. **Client and Technical Delivery** * Participate in requirements workshops, technical interviews, architecture reviews, and client working sessions. * Prepare clear technical reports, process maps, design documentation, and analytical presentations. * Deliver assigned work within agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. * Identify and escalate data\-access constraints, technical dependencies, methodological limitations, and delivery risks. * Contribute to peer reviews, reusable technical methods, and guidance for less\-experienced colleagues. * Use AI\-assisted development responsibly, validating outputs and protecting client information. architecture or integration design. * Experience building and maintaining repeatable data pipelines or integrations beyond one\-time data preparation and exploratory notebooks. * Experience designing data models, schemas, relationships, and source\-to\-target mappings, and explaining the rationale behind design decisions. * Strong Python and SQL proficiency, including maintainable programming, complex queries, data transformation, and troubleshooting. * Experience with pipeline testing, scheduling or orchestration, logging, data\-quality validation, and failure investigation. * Working experience with at least one cloud or distributed\-data platform, such as Databricks, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or an equivalent environment. * Strong understanding of probability, sampling, statistical inference, regression, confidence and prediction intervals, and uncertainty. * Practical experience developing and evaluating statistical or machine learning models, including appropriate validation and interpretation of results. * Experience with Git, code review, testing, technical documentation, and reproducible analyses. * Ability to communicate technical designs, analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or comparable distributed\-data technologies. without an expectation of expertise in every framework. * Experience with utility datasets, DER registries, load forecasting, sensor analytics, or engineering automation. * Master’s degree in a relevant quantitative or technical discipline.
