The new site will be built using the latest high\-tech equipment, advanced highly integrated and automated manufacturing systems, and have a focus on minimizing the impact to our environment. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Job Description:** As a Physical AI Engineer, in partnership with other teams you will deploy advanced AI models into robotic, computer vision and sensor\-based systems that make the Lilly Medicine Foundry safer, faster and more resilient. You will build and integrate edge\-to\-cloud pattern that connects cameras, sensors, AGVs, co\-bots, drones and quadrupeds to the Foundry data platform, manufacturing execution and closed\-loop quality systems, and you will use simulation and digital twins to validate those systems before they reach GMP areas. Support twin\-based use cases such as lockout/tagout and SOP guidance, wayfinding to equipment, virtual tours and XR training, and smart P\&ID and maintenance. * Closed\-Loop Quality Integration: Lilly USA is scaling AI from prototype to everyday business capability, from how we bring medicines to market to how we help patients access and afford them. The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly Data Analytics \& AI team is seeking a Principal AI/ML Engineer to build the agentic AI and machine learning platforms that power this work. You will turn prototypes into reliable, scalable, well\-governed production systems. You will also build the data pipelines, partner integrations, and ML engineering foundations that teams reuse across business use cases. **What You'll Be Doing:** As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve business teams across Lilly USA: the orchestration frameworks, end\-to\-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of enterprise data, business operations, field and customer\-facing teams, and third\-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. You will also work with technical product managers, business and field teams, and Technology at Lilly colleagues to bring those solutions into real applications in a secure and auditable way. You will reuse infrastructure and patterns so that each new business use case is faster and cheaper to ship. **Examples of the kinds of problems you might work on:** * Agentic AI workflows that help field and commercial teams prepare for engagements, surface insights, and act faster, including multi\-agent systems that reason over complex data and recommend the best next step. * Predictive and machine\-learning models that inform decisions about market access, customer outreach, resource allocation, and revenue protection, from anomaly detection to next\-best\-action. * LLM\-powered solutions that make large volumes of unstructured information usable, using techniques like retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to ground answers in trusted, cited sources. * Secure, analytics\-ready data pipelines that bring partner and vendor data into our platforms at scale, with the data quality, governance, and auditability a regulated environment demands. * Shared, reusable AI tooling for deployment, evaluation, and monitoring that multiple teams build on instead of rebuilding, so each new solution ships faster and more reliably than the last. **How You'll Succeed:** * Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent\-to\-agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms. * Build and integrate data pipelines, bringing data from enterprise systems, external vendors, and third\-party partners into secure, analytics\-ready platforms. * Deliver AI capabilities for business use cases, such as reporting, predictive analytics, process and decision optimization, and decision support for field and commercial teams. * Engineer robust, end\-to\-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine\-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability. * Stand up ML engineering foundations, including model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, and automated evaluation and rollback within each pipeline. * Apply production\-grade deployment techniques, including scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment of small and specialized models hosted in\-house, with attention to latency, cost, scalability, and data residency. * Build observability and monitoring for AI systems, including tracing of agentic workflows, cost and latency tracking, drift detection, and integration of AI evaluation into production monitoring. * Implement governance and data\-protection controls, including privacy and regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA where healthcare or pharma is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable systems in complex data domains and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues. **About the Organization:** Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities with cutting\-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Technology at Lilly is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data\-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. The Lilly USA Technology at Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. We partner closely with Lilly's market access organization, which works with payers, employers, and government customers to improve affordability and broaden access. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas and disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business. We use real\-world evidence and health outcomes data to reduce friction across the patient journey, create best\-in\-class customer engagements, improve patient outcomes, and deliver business results. **Travel percentage for this position:** 0–10% Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Ellipsis Health is creating cutting\-edge AI/ML products that solve healthcare staffing challenges and administrative burdens using conversational AI and our patented voice biomarker technology, helping deliver better healthcare for everyone. architecting, implementing, and deploying complex LLM\-powered applications, multi\-agent orchestrations, or autonomous systems in a production environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow). * workstreams, defining organizational engineering directions, or directly mentoring technical talent. * Experience working within complex, highly collaborative matrixed organizations on high\-acuity, Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five to eight years of relevant experience developing and supporting back\-end applications, database solutions, or automated data processing systems. * Strong SQL Server and T\-SQL development skills, including stored procedures, transactions, indexing, and query performance tuning. * Hands\-on programming experience with C\#/.NET or Python, including building and maintaining production applications. * Experience developing system integrations using REST APIs, authentication, and structured data formats such as JSON. * Experience building automated data pipelines and managing dependencies, incremental loads, failures, and recovery. * Understanding of relational data modeling, data integrity, and engineering, and production operations, including systems with limited documentation. * Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment. * Working knowledge of Azure services used for application hosting, data storage, or integration. * Experience working within an Agile software development lifecycle. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to data accuracy and operational reliability. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation. * Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and manage competing priorities. **Preferred experience** ------------------------ * Practical experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or Claude for jobs.title: AI & Automation Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the team:** Formic's Business Systems team builds and manages the software, data infrastructure, and integrations that power our operations. Our work touches nearly every part of the company. We build internal applications that help teams manage robot deployments and field service, connect operational data across platforms, and develop AI\-powered tools that make information more accessible and work more efficient. We also help shape the systems behind our sales, marketing, finance, and other business processes. Some solutions are custom\-built applications. Others involve integrating existing platforms, automating workflows, or rethinking how information moves through the business. We work directly with the people using these systems and own what we deliver, including adoption, reliability, and ongoing improvement. We're a small team with significant autonomy, tackling technical challenges across a robotics company where the software we build has a direct impact on real\-world operations. **About the role:** We're looking for a technically strong, AI\-forward builder who can turn complex business problems into working software. You'll work directly with teams across Formic to identify opportunities and build solutions, whether that's developing an internal application, connecting systems that don't communicate, automating an operational process, or applying AI to make existing tools more useful. You'll have the autonomy to determine what to build and how to build it, along with responsibility for getting it into production and making sure it works. We want someone who moves quickly, makes sound technical decisions, and cares as much about adoption and reliability as development. This isn't a traditional product management role or one focused exclusively on AI. It's a hands\-on opportunity for someone who loves building software and wants to see the impact of their work. We care more about what you've built than your job title or career path. You might come from software engineering, applied AI, technical product development, business systems engineering, or a startup where you've worn several hats. What matters is that you know how to turn ideas into working software and can show us what you've shipped. **In this role you will:** * Build and maintain internal applications, AI\-powered tools, automations, and integrations that solve problems across Formic * Work directly with employees and business leaders to understand existing processes, uncover inefficiencies, and determine what should be built * Design technical solutions, including application architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and integrations with existing platforms * Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, and emerging development tools, applying them where they offer a meaningful advantage * Connect information across business systems to improve data quality, visibility, and decision\-making * Take projects from initial discovery through prototyping, development, deployment, and ongoing support * Build with security, reliability, maintainability, and scalability in mind, including appropriate testing and monitoring * Gather feedback, measure adoption and results, and continuously improve the products you deliver * Collaborate with engineering and other technical teams when projects require shared infrastructure or specialized expertise * Help determine the priorities, architecture, and technical direction of our Business Systems function **What makes you a great fit:** * A strong track record of personally building and shipping software, internal products, automations, or other technical solutions that people rely on * Solid software development skills, including experience working with APIs, databases, and modern application development tools * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python or TypeScript, and experience working with APIs, databases, and SQL * Hands\-on experience integrating systems and working with data across multiple platforms * Practical experience using AI in software development or building AI\-powered applications, with genuine curiosity about emerging capabilities * The ability to make thoughtful technical decisions without overengineering solutions * Strong product instincts. You can understand what users need, distinguish symptoms from underlying problems, and prioritize work based on impact * Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and owning projects from beginning to end * An appreciation for what happens after launch, including testing, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and user adoption * The ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues * A bias toward action, intellectual curiosity, and genuine interest in how businesses operate **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agentic workflows * Experience building and deploying cloud\-based applications * Familiarity with CRM, ERP, finance, or operational systems and the data that connects them * Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven integrations, or data engineering * Experience building applications that handle sensitive business information * A background in robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation, logistics, or field service operations. * Experience working in a startup or small technical team where you've had substantial ownership. **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to accessibility@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI\-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description: **About Generalist** ==================== At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done. We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world. The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness). We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. **About the Role:** ------------------- We are looking for a Research Assistant to help design, run, and analyze experiments at the intersection of machine learning and robotics. This is an entry\-level research role for individuals with less than 3 years of machine learning research experience, and is designed to be a potential career path towards eventually contributing as a Research Scientist. At Generalist, we are building foundation models for robots. These models improve through a tight feedback loop: design experiments, collect data, train or fine\-tune models, evaluate them in the real world, analyze results, and repeat. This role helps make that loop faster, more rigorous, and more reliable. You will work closely with ML researchers and robotics engineers to run robot experiments, design evaluation tasks, brainstorm ideas, collect data, interpret results, and document repeatable workflows. A major part of this role is helping ensure our evaluations are trustworthy. We care deeply about experimental design, controls, hands\-on iteration, sample sizes, variance, repeatability, and statistical rigor. **You’ll be responsible for:** ------------------------------ * Running structured experiments on robot platforms * Setting up physical tasks, materials, fixtures, and benchmarks for robot evaluations * Collecting high\-quality robot data and tracking experimental conditions * Measuring real\-world success rates across tasks, robots, and model variants * Designing evaluations with attention to controls, repeatability, statistical rigor, and sources of bias * Analyzing results to help distinguish real model improvements from noise * Synthesizing findings and communicating them clearly to ML researchers and engineers * Preparing robots, sensors, workspaces, and materials for rollouts and evaluations * Helping kick off training jobs, run evaluations, and organize results * Beta testing internal and third\-party tools for teaching robots new skills * Troubleshooting physical setups, hardware issues, and procedural bottlenecks * Writing clear documentation and playbooks so others can reproduce workflows * Improving experimental reliability, data quality, and operational throughput over time **You might thrive in this role if you:** ----------------------------------------- * Have experience running experiments, lab studies, field studies, data collection workflows, or structured evaluations * Think carefully about experimental design, confounding factors, controls, sample sizes, variance, and what conclusions the data can actually support * Are diligent and detail\-oriented, especially when tasks are repetitive but subtle differences matter * Enjoy hands\-on work with physical systems, equipment, materials, or instruments * Are comfortable following protocols while also noticing when something is wrong or could be improved * Can coordinate many moving parts: robots, materials, tasks, data, model versions, metrics, and documentation * Communicate clearly and can summarize what happened, what changed, and what the evidence suggests * Are curious about machine learning and robotics, even if you are not yet an expert in either * Have some exposure to programming, data analysis, robotics, hardware, electronics, mechanical assembly, or experimental tooling * Prefer fast iteration, careful measurement, and empirical progress over abstract theory alone

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: GitHub is changing the way the world builds software, and we want you to help change the way we secure GitHub. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to evolve and advance the cloud security posture of GitHub and its ecosystem. As a Senior Cloud Security Engineer on the Cloud Security Engineer team, you will work alongside Hubbers across all of GitHub to help drive technical direction for all things cloud security at GitHub. This position combines hands\-on security engineering with cross\-functional collaboration to establish secure defaults, reduce security risks, and improve the developer's experience. Cloud Security Engineers at GitHub are self\-starters, able to work autonomously in ambiguous environments, and collaborative natural problem solvers with experience automating and integrating disparate technologies. You should have strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of modern cloud and containerized security threats, the ability to influence people from customers to managers through technical solutions, and the desire to be an integral contributor to securing GitHub systems. Responsibilities: * Owns complex technical security initiatives and develops solutions to address identified cloud security issues, taking intended and unintended consequences into account. Operationalizes and scales a program and solution appropriately. Identifies high\-priority opportunities and makes data\-driven recommendations for efficiencies to improve security posture and proactively prevent attacks. Assists team with understanding the implications of implementing security controls and understanding availability impacts. * Contributes to and maintains accurate and comprehensive cloud security policy, standards, and best practices that impact teams across the organization. Designs mitigation strategies to address identified gaps in policy. Recommends refinement of security policy, standards and best practices based on evolving threat conditions and industry trends. Creates and implements security controls, and solutions to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of networks, systems, and data. * Recommends mitigation strategies based on trends identified in the analysis of key metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and other data sources (e.g., bugs, unhealthy data pipeline). Defines and implements metrics to address gaps in measurement. Influences others to take action in response to findings, prioritized by severity. * Identifies and raises opportunities for automation to improve efficiency and effectiveness of security guardrails. Supports development and implementation of new automation. Proactively proposes where investment will yield greatest risk reduction. Develops and implements services and solutions and is dedicated to improving and maintaining these solutions over time. * Educates and engages with others (e.g., internal teams, external partners) to drive consistency and awareness of security risk, best practices, and standards for the cloud. Translates highly technical and complex information to nontechnical audiences (e.g., leaders, industry partners, internal teams) to effectively communicate security risks. Develops and shares reports with leaders on security risks and remediation strategies used to resolve and drive down security concerns. Collaborates with teams across the organization to address security risks and define new requirements and feature sets. Mentors shares knowledge and help develop the collective knowledge of the team. Qualifications: Required Qualifications* 5\+ years of working with cloud infrastructure * 3\+ years experience building and managing infrastructure in Microsoft Azure * 1\+ year(s) experience in software development * 7\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + OR Associate's Degree AND 6\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + OR Bachelor's Degree AND 5\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + OR Master's Degree AND 3\+ years experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + OR Doctorate AND 1\+ year(s) experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, or relevant area + OR equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications * Extensive experience building security solutions, ideally for cloud services * Experience building services in Golang (preferred), Python, Terraform and/or Ruby * Experience with networking in cloud environments and common services used to manage and implement network segmentation * Experience performing threat modeling and design reviews to assess security implications and requirements for introducing new technologies * Ability to produce concise and quality technical documentation * AZ\-900, AZ\-500, SC\-100, SC\-500, Hashicorp Terraform Associate, GIAC Cloud Security Essentials Certification (GCLD), GIAC Public Cloud Security (GPCS), GIAC Cloud Security Architecture and Design (GCAD), or other relevant cloud security certifications Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $127,800\.00 \- USD $339,000\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. GitHub Leadership Principles: **GitHub values** * Customer\-obsessed * Ship to learn * Growth mindset * Own the outcome * Better together * Diverse and inclusive **Manager fundamentals** * Model * Coach * Care **Leadership principles** * Create clarity * Generate energy * Deliver success Who We Are: GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub. Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms. Join us, and let’s change the world, together. EEO Statement: GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

applications. * Lead architectural design and technical implementation across frontend and backend systems. * Build modern web applications using component\-based architectures and responsive design jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer
jobs.description: The application window will be open until at least November 24, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Chicago, IL, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Fabrication Wet Etch Engineer, Quantum AI
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience in cleanroom semiconductor fabrication. * 2 years of experience with wet chemical etching, solvent liftoff, photoresist strip, or wafer cleaning processes and equipment. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP). * 4 years of experience developing wet etch, solvent liftoff, or wafer cleaning processes in semiconductor research or manufacturing. * Experience qualifying and managing automated wet stations, acid or solvent benches, and chemical filtration or delivery systems. * Experience with defect and surface metrology (SEM, AFM, ellipsometry, particle inspection) and data analysis (Python, SQL, or JMP). * Experience with design of experiments (DOE), statistical process control (SPC), manufacturing execution systems (MES), or superconducting device fabrication. **About the job** ----------------- Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. As a Hardware Engineer on the Quantum AI Fabrication team in Goleta, California, you will develop, optimize, and scale cleanroom wet chemical and solvent processes used to build superconducting quantum processors. Quantum devices are sensitive to surface interfaces, oxides, and microscopic defects, making wet processing critical to device performance and yield. In this role, you will lead process development and production sustaining across automated solvent stations, acid and base wet benches, and wafer cleaning systems for metal liftoff, photoresist strip, surface preparation, and wet chemical etching. You will design experiments to widen process windows, reduce defects and cycle time, specify and qualify new wet process equipment, and collaborate with lithography, thin film, dry etch, metrology, and operations teams to transition processes from research into production. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, optimize, and sustain cleanroom wet etch, solvent liftoff, photoresist strip, and wafer cleaning processes for superconducting quantum devices. * Specify, procure, qualify, and manage automated and benchtop wet processing equipment from installation through production release. * Monitor statistical process control (SPC) trends, lead root cause investigations for process or equipment excursions, and reduce defects. * Collaborate across dry etch, thin film deposition, photolithography, and metrology teams to integrate and support multi\-module fabrication flows. * Establish process change controls, write clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), and train cleanroom technicians on development and production tools. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (Remote)
jobs.description: Do you love working with a high caliber team that’s invested in delivering quality code? Are you a natural problem solver who’s able to create elegant solutions to address even the most challenging problems? Are you looking for a better work/life balance and a work from home atmosphere? If so, you may be the perfect fit for Grant Street Group! **We are currently offering all Senior Developer hires the option to work a 4x10 schedule (4 days per week, 10 hours per day).** As a Senior Software Developer at Grant Street Group, you could have the opportunity to expand the functionality of our existing products, customize systems to meet clients' unique needs, and create entirely new products from the ground up. The majority of your time will be spent on directing AI agents effectively on complex development tasks, critically evaluating their output, and helping the team adopt reliable agentic workflows while remaining accountable for the quality of delivered software. You’ll have the option to move across the organization, try out various projects and tasks, and continuously evolve your professional skill set. ### **We are looking for talented Software Developers who:** * Have 5\+ years of experience in full time software development roles * Can demonstrate the ability to write great code in any commonly used programming language, such as Python, Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Ruby. (If you've mastered one language, we know you'll be able to learn our tech stack quickly) * Can demonstrate the ability to design and improve relational data models in any commonly used database, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to support implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while applying independent judgment to the resulting work * Read, explain, and evaluate code—including AI\-generated code—and identify when a proposed solution is incomplete, incorrect, unnecessarily complex, or inconsistent with existing patterns * Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability as development practices and AI capabilities evolve; be willing to learn new tools and incorporate effective approaches into day\-to\-day work ### **Here are just some of the tools and approaches we use. Experience with any of them is helpful, but if they are new to you, don't worry. We're able to provide the training and guidance that you'll need in order to get up and running:** * Perl and Go * MySQL * Vue.js, jQuery, Ajax * Devin, and other AI\-assisted development tools * git * Linux environments (Ubuntu) * Data warehouse (Exasol) * Messaging frameworks (rabbitmq) * ETL/Scheduling frameworks (NiFi) * Agile software development process **Why consider Grant Street Group as part of your future?** Grant Street Group is an innovative and rapidly growing software company that supports a variety of clients in specialized financial transactions. Our hosted Software as a Service (SaaS) applications focus on tax collection, electronic payments, bond auctions, and more. We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Using the best collaboration tools available, we offer a technology\-rich work environment that makes it possible for us to support on\-site and telecommuting positions tailored to the needs of our employees. If you are passionate about your work, you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and you want to be on a team of exceptional professionals, then maybe Grant Street is for you! If this sounds like something you would enjoy, then let’s start a dialogue about your long\-term goals and ours. Begin by submitting your resume and let’s start getting to know each other! If you are selected for an interview, please note that you will need to have a working camera on your device so that we can interact "face to face." Please note that Grant Street may not consider your application if you have previously submitted an application for this role within the last 12 months. We thank you for your understanding. There is minimal travel: 1\-2 weeks per year for on\-site meetings. *Expected Salary Range: $100,000 – $200,000 base salary* *Recruitment Fraud Warning:* *It has come to our attention that various individuals have been posing as Grant Street Group employees and contacting job seekers to schedule interviews and/or complete pre\-interview screening questions.* *All legitimate Grant Street Group positions require completing an application on our website before an interview. When you are contacted by Grant Street Group, all correspondence will come from an email address ending in “@**grantstreet.com**”.* *The hiring process usually takes several weeks and begins with a phone or video interview. Grant Street Group will not ask you to use any platform other than Google Meet or Zoom to conduct an interview. We will not ask you to make payments or to provide your date of birth, social security number, or banking details during the interview process.* *If you believe you have been a victim of recruiting fraud concerning Grant Street Group, please contact us at* *jobs@grantstreet.com**.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software AI Engineer 4

Join a team where your work in AI and digital diagnostics directly supports clinicians in delivering better care for women. **Job Summary** **Hologic** is seeking a Software Algorithm Engineer 4 to design, train and validate deep learning models for cytology on the Genius™ Digital Diagnostics System. This role owns the cell\-level CNN classifier, nuclear\-to\-cytoplasmic (NC) ratio segmentation pipeline, and the technical evidence needed to support FDA and other regulatory submissions. The engineer serves as the technical lead for model design and verification under design controls, working closely with cytopathologists, imaging scientists, regulatory and quality teams. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, train and tune multi\-class CNNs to classify cells and aggregate predictions into specimen\-level diagnostic categories. * Develop multi\-task models with shared encoders and feature heads for diagnostic class, cytomorphologic features and NC ratio category. * Build nucleus and cytoplasm segmentation networks to measure NC ratio and nuclear area, including overlapping cells in clusters. * Own the data pipeline, including patient\-grouped splits, color profile application, class balance and imaging metadata. * Run disciplined experiments, benchmark lightweight backbones against larger reference models and define evaluation metrics and reports. * Collaborate with pathologists on labeling protocols, inter\-observer agreement and adjudication processes. * Prepare design documentation, verification/validation protocols and technical content for regulatory submissions. * Mentor engineers and establish coding, reproducibility and MLOps standards. * Ensure model performance and interpretability, including Grad\-CAM checks and feature outputs that align with pathologist expectations. * Support regulatory strategy for AI\-enabled medical devices under design controls and PCCP guidance. **Qualifications** **Education** * MS or PhD in computer science, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering or a related field, or BS with equivalent experience. **Experience** * 7\+ years of software development, including 4\+ years building and deploying deep learning models for computer vision. * Coaching and mentorship experience a plus **Skills** * Expert Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow), including CNN fine\-tuning, transfer learning and segmentation (e.g., U\-Net, segmentation\_models\_pytorch). * Experience with imbalanced, multi\-class and multi\-task problems, and metrics such as per\-class sensitivity, F1, kappa and AUROC. * Experience with medical or microscopy imaging, including color handling, stain variation and high\-resolution tiling. * Strong discipline in data splitting, leakage prevention, experiment tracking and reproducible training. * Clear written communication for technical reports and design documentation. * Preferred: digital pathology or cytology AI experience (ideally urine cytology); experience with FDA 510(k), De Novo, PMA or EU IVDR; familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820 and FDA PCCP guidance. * Preferred: ICC color management, stain deconvolution and scanner color calibration; cell instance segmentation tools (StarDist, Cellpose) and annotation tools (QuPath, CVAT, napari). * Preferred: model optimization for edge or embedded inference (quantization, ONNX, TensorRT) and experience leading or technically guiding a small team. **Why join Hologic?** We are committed to making Hologic the destination for top talent. For you to succeed, we want to enable you with the tools and knowledge required and so we provide comprehensive training when you join as well as continued development and training throughout your career. The annualized base salary range for this role is $133,000 \- $190,000 and is bonus eligible. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description **Lead Software Engineer** **Location:** US Remote **Preferred Location:** Oregon Remote **Are you ready to make a difference?** ICF is seeking a hands\-on Lead Engineer to deliver and improve EDT, an established software product. This is a technical leadership role, not a people\-management position. Active coding and code review are central to the work, alongside architectural ownership, stakeholder communication, technical planning, and coordination of engineering activities. The right candidate combines strong development skills with the judgment to set direction, make final technical recommendations within their area of ownership, and build consensus around implementation choices. **What you will be doing**: * Build and improve application code using C\# and .NET, TypeScript and React, with hands\-on development as a primary responsibility. * Review code and provide constructive technical feedback that supports maintainable implementations, consistent application of established patterns, and adoption of new patterns where the product’s architecture needs to evolve. * Own architectural decisions and design direction for defined areas of the product, ensuring that solutions align with broader product goals and established enterprise standards. Lead day\-to\-day engineering execution by translating that direction into actionable development tickets and organizing dependencies, sequencing, and implementation work. * Make technical decisions and final recommendations within the role’s area of ownership, using collaboration to build consensus while resolving disagreements when alignment cannot be reached. Ensure the engineering team shares responsibility for implementation quality and reliability, not just coordination. * Own and evolve the medium\-term technical roadmap for defined areas of the product, sequencing architectural improvements and delivery work to balance current needs with long\-term maintainability, reliability, performance, and product sustainability. * Anticipate technical dependencies and delivery risks, raise them early, and lead the development of practical responses with stakeholders and existing technical leadership. * Communicate proactively with stakeholders about engineering progress, technical needs, limitations, and implementation tradeoffs. * Own production readiness and operational health for the product’s 2027 launch and ongoing operation, including reliability, performance, observability, deployment pipelines, operational documentation, issue resolution, and long\-term support outcomes. * Define and lead the product’s agentic engineering practices, establishing technical standards and decision criteria for how AI tools support design, implementation, code review, testing, and maintainable delivery. Own work end to end, complete objectives, ask questions early, and flag when a decision or detail has been overlooked. * **What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):** * 8\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including architecture ownership, technical leadership responsibilities, and continued hands\-on contribution to a production codebase. * Demonstrated ability to build and maintain frontend application code using TypeScript and React. * Experience leading day\-to\-day engineering execution while remaining an active contributor to the codebase, including organizing implementation work, managing technical dependencies, and reviewing other engineers’ code. * Experience owning architecture, design direction, and technical strategy for a defined solution area, including making final technical recommendations and translating direction into actionable implementation plans and well\-defined development tickets. * Demonstrated experience using agentic coding tools in day\-to\-day development, including sound judgment about where they add value and where they do not, and skill in prompting and directing them toward maintainable results. Experience owning quality without a dedicated QA team, including writing automated tests, defining test strategy, and verifying your own and others' work before release. * **What we would like you to have:** * Experience developing software in Azure. jobs.description: If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact. With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you. **Lead Software Engineer** **Semrock Optical Filters, IDEX Life Science Optics, West Henrietta, NY** **Position Overview** IDEX Life Science Optics is seeking an experienced Lead Software Engineer to lead the development and evolution of software systems that support engineering, commercial, manufacturing, operations, and product delivery. This role combines software architecture, scientific computing, data systems, and hardware integration in a highly technical environment. Working closely with engineers, scientists, and manufacturing teams, the successful candidate will develop software that enables the design, production, testing, and delivery of advanced optical products. This position is intended for a senior technical individual contributor with the potential to grow into a Principal Engineer role responsible for long\-term software architecture and technical direction. While each developer often owns specific applications or platforms, success requires thinking beyond any single system. The ideal candidate will help evolve a cohesive software ecosystem, ensuring applications integrate effectively, leverage shared components and data, and provide a consistent experience across the organization. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the primary technical owner for several software applications or platforms while contributing to the architecture and evolution of our software ecosystem. * Lead the architecture, design, development, and support of critical engineering, manufacturing, and business software systems. * Modernize legacy applications and workflows into scalable, maintainable, and extensible software platforms. * Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business and technical needs into effective software solutions. * Design software that integrates with shared databases, enterprise data flows, manufacturing systems, and workstation\-connected hardware. * Partner with fellow software engineers to promote common standards, reusable components, integrated data models, and a consistent user experience. * Promote software engineering best practices, including source control, testing, documentation, maintainability, and code quality. * Troubleshoot complex software, database, integration, and hardware\-interfa * ce issues. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and solution effectiveness. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * 10\+ years of professional software development experience. * Demonstrated success designing and delivering complex software systems. * Strong software architecture, design, and problem\-solving skills. * Experience leading technical projects and influencing engineering direction. * Ability to effectively utilize modern AI development tools and workflows. **Technical Experience** Experience designing, developing, and supporting software systems using: * C\# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, including both .NET Framework and modern .NET platforms * Desktop application technologies, including WinForms * Microsoft SQL Server and relational database architectures * Python for scientific, engineering, automation, or data\-driven applications Demonstrated expertise in: * Software architecture, industrial software environments. * Software integration with instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated production equipment, PLCs, robotics, or embedded systems. * Optical, photonics, physical science, or engineering applications for modeling or optimization. * Manufacturing automation, machine vision, robotics, FANUC systems, or related industrial technologies. * High\-performance computing (HPC), GPU\-accelerated computing (e.g., CUDA), scientific computing, computational modeling, machine learning, computer vision, custom AI/ML model development, or data\-intensive engineering applications. * Modernization of legacy software applications, databases, and spreadsheet\-driven workflows. **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who enjoys understanding the science, engineering, and business processes behind the software systems they build. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Analog and Mixed-Signal DTCO
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- **The Group:** Intel's Advanced Design Foundational IP Organization (AD\-FIP) within Design Technology Platform (DTP) drives pathfinding and development of the analog/mixed\-signal, RF, and high\-speed I/O IP that defines what Intel Foundry's leading\-edge process technologies can deliver. The AMS Design\-Technology Co\-Optimization (DTCO) team sits at the intersection of process technology, design rules, PDK, EDA tools, and circuit design, making sure each new node delivers competitive analog, mixed\-signal, and custom\-design density, performance, and productivity. **The Role:** We are seeking a senior technical leader in DTCO to define and drive co\-optimization of Intel Foundry's next\-generation process technologies for analog, mixed\-signal, and custom design. You will identify where technology definition limits design outcomes (density, drive, matching, high\-voltage support, layout productivity), quantify the impact, and drive resolution across process, design\-rule, PDK, EDA, and design teams. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with technical leadership across multiple organizations and external EDA partners. **Responsibilities:** * Lead AMS DTCO for future Intel Foundry nodes: evaluate device architecture, front\-end and back\-end design rules, metal stack, and patterning choices against analog, mixed\-signal, and custom\-design requirements. * Run a closed\-loop DTCO process: sense issues from designers, partners, and test chips; prioritize by PPA and productivity impact; drive rule, PDK, or flow changes; and validate the result on silicon and in design. * Quantify technology impact on circuits through layout studies, parasitic\-aware benchmarking, and area and performance scaling analysis of representative AMS building blocks. * Define and drive design\-rule and PDK requirements with process, design\-rule, OPC, and quality and reliability teams, including high\-voltage device support, density and fill rules, metal width and spacing options, and layout\-dependent effects. * Partner with EDA vendors on node enablement for custom and AMS flows: custom layout, analog placement and routing, physical verification, fill, and extraction; translate tool and flow feedback into technology decisions. * Represent Intel Foundry in technical engagements with EDA partners and foundry customers, and present DTCO findings and recommendations to technology and business leadership. Mentor engineers and set technical direction for the DTCO team. * **Required Skills and Experience:** * 5\+ years of DTCO experience for analog, mixed\-signal, I/O, or custom design on FinFET or more advanced process nodes, at a foundry, an IDM technology\-development organization, or an EDA vendor. * And experience in at least one of the following: + Design\-rule definition for analog or custom layout, including layout\-pattern studies, layout\-dependent effects, and test\-structure design to evaluate rule impact. + Circuit\-level technology benchmarking of analog or mixed\-signal building blocks: device\-model and parasitic evaluation, matching, and area or performance scaling analysis. EDA tool or flow enablement of analog and custom design for a new process node: custom layout, analog placement and routing, physical verification, fill, or extraction. + **Preferred Skills and Experience:** * Hands\-on analog, mixed\-signal, or RF circuit design experience (for example PLLs, data converters, regulators, high\-speed I/O, LNAs, PAs, or mmWave front ends), with an understanding of how device and interconnect parameters drive circuit performance. * Analog and RF device and passive technology: precision resistors, MIM/MOM capacitors, inductors and transformers, varactors, analog and RF device flavors, and RF figures of merit such as fT, fmax, and noise figure. * Experience across two or more of the areas in the minimum qualifications, or across both foundry and EDA environments. * High\-voltage or extended\-voltage device integration on advanced CMOS nodes. * Analog or custom layout design experience. * Gate\-all\-around transistors, backside power delivery, or advanced multi\-patterning (SALELE, EUV) technology definition as it affects analog and custom layout. * Automation of DTCO studies using Python, layout generators, or machine learning. * Customer\-facing technical engagement with foundry customers or EDA partners. * Publications at IEDM, VLSI Symposium, CICC, ISSCC, or RFIC; jobs.title: Applications Development Engineer - FaST
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry\-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next\-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R\&D through high\-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. · **Company Overview** KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. **Group/Division** With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) Division provides industry leading metrology solutions for worldwide semiconductor IC manufacturers. The FaST Division portfolio of metrology products includes hardware and software solutions for optical film thickness, optical critical dimension (CD), composition, and resistivity measurement systems. jobs.title: AI Applications Developer
jobs.description: Company Conformance Statements / Essential Personal Characteristics In the performance of their respective tasks and duties, all employees are expected to conform to the following: * Perform quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision. * Interact professionally with other employees, customers, and clients. * Work effectively as a team member. * Work independently while understanding the necessity for communicating and coordinating work efforts with other employees and organizations. * Exhibit exceptional integrity in all matters. * Lead by example. **General Statement of Responsibility** The AI Applications Developer designs, builds, deploys, and supports internal applications, AI agents, and process automations that improve how work is done across Lasting Change, Inc. and its subsidiaries. Reporting to the Vice President of IT and Data, the incumbent translates business needs into practical, secure, and maintainable solutions using approved platforms such as Microsoft Fabric Apps and Microsoft Copilot Studio, supported by AI\-assisted development tools. The incumbent is accountable for the usefulness, quality, and ongoing improvement of the solutions delivered and for adherence to the organization's security, privacy, and AI\-governance standards. This is an early\-career position; the incumbent works initially on guided, prioritized projects and assumes increasing ownership of discovery, development, deployment, and support as skills develop. Business Process Modernization * Help replace manual processes, spreadsheets, forms, and other legacy solutions with simpler modern approaches. * Automate repetitive work, reduce unnecessary handoffs, and improve how information moves through a process. * Look beyond the initial technology request to understand the problem people are actually trying to solve. * Help determine whether the best answer is an app, an agent, an automation, an existing tool, or a better process. * Improve existing solutions based on how people actually use them. Discovery \& Collaboration * Work with employees and leaders to understand business needs and turn them into working solutions. * Participate in discovery conversations, prototypes, demonstrations, testing, and feedback sessions. * Explain technical ideas clearly to people who may not be technical. * Focus on usefulness, adoption, and business impact rather than simply shipping technology. Solution Ownership \& Support * Support and improve the applications and agents developed, after they go live. * Test work, troubleshoot issues, and incorporate user feedback. * Maintain clear technical and user documentation, using AI tools where helpful. * Follow established security, privacy, data, and AI\-governance practices. * Apply modern development practices, including source control, APIs, data integration, testing, application security, and deployment. * Raise concerns and ask for help when a solution involves risk or complexity beyond experience.
