jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description: About Leena AI Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Colleagues don't just answer employee questions — they run the work behind them: case handling, approvals and transactions across systems like Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow. We compete — and win — against ServiceNow \+ Moveworks, Workday Illuminate and vertical point solutions. We do it with vendor\-agnostic, cross\-functional orchestration, the broadest connector coverage in the category, and deployments measured in weeks, not quarters. The business is working: ARR has passed $20M and tripled in the last 12 months. Gartner has named us a Leader in agentic AI three times running, and hundreds of enterprises — including Nestlé and Coca\-Cola — run on Leena AI. We're headquartered in New York, with our product and engineering hub in Gurugram. The role We're hiring a VP of Product to own what Leena AI builds, why, and how we know it worked. You'll report to Adit Jain, our co\-founder and CEO, and lead the product org across our pods — knowledge management, AI Colleague Studio, integrations, and the HR, IT and Finance agents. We've built the platform. The next stage is harder: turning a strong agentic platform into the system of record for back\-office work, while competing against incumbents who own the underlying systems. That takes a product leader who can set a sharp strategy, decompose it into metrics, and carry senior rooms — internally and with Fortune 500 CIOs and CHROs. This is not a roadmap\-routing role. We want someone who decides, holds a line under pressure, and builds a product org that does the same. What you own * Product strategy and vision. Define where Leena AI wins over the next 24 months — which back\-office workflows we go deep on across HR, IT, Finance and Legal, and where we stay horizontal. Turn that into a multi\-quarter roadmap the company can bet on. * The metric tree. Own a clear north star (e.g., autonomous resolution rate, or work completed end\-to\-end without a human) and the decomposed tree of input metrics beneath it, with owners and quarterly movement targets for every pod. If a pod's plan is a list of features rather than a model of its metric, send it back. * The agentic platform. Set direction for AI Colleague Studio, our agent orchestration layer, voice, and the knowledge layer — so customers' builders can design, test, govern and deploy agents themselves without raising a ticket with us. * Integrations as a moat. Keep our connector breadth and depth ahead of the market — Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Oracle, ADP, Salesforce and Microsoft 365 — and make sure agents land transactions correctly across them. * Enterprise trust. Make data residency, audit trails, explainability, permissions and agent guardrails first\-class product features, not RFP afterthoughts. * Field to product loop. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions and our HR domain leads so what we learn in each implementation ships to the next customer by default. Cut time\-to\-value release over release. * Go\-to\-market alignment. Work with Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Gen on positioning, packaging and pricing. Be in the room for strategic deals, QBRs, customer advisory boards and analyst briefings. * Team. Lead and grow a team of product managers and designers across New York and Gurugram. Raise the bar on PRDs, metric thinking and customer presence. Hire well and fast as we scale. * Operating cadence. Run planning, roadmap reviews and launch readiness with Engineering, Design, CS and Sales on a single prioritized backlog. **Requirements** What we're looking for * 12\+ years in product, 5\+ leading product teams — including product leaders managing PMs — at high\-growth B2B SaaS companies selling to the enterprise. * You've shipped to CIO, CHRO or CFO buyers. You understand that enterprise trust means data residency, audit trails, sub\-processor transparency and the ability to explain a wrong answer — not just model quality. * Platform and AI depth. You've owned an AI, automation, workflow or integration platform. You can reason about LLM agents, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails with your engineering leaders — and you know where today's models break. * Metric decomposition and structured bets. Given a north star, you sketch the input tree, pick the two or three highest\-leverage inputs for next quarter, and propose sequenced bets with expected movement. * Stakeholder leadership. You've run a product org where decisions routed through founders, Engineering, Sales and CS — and you held the line on a contested call. You can walk us through why it held. * CIO\-level communication. You can run a QBR, a technical deep\-dive or an escalation with a Fortune 500 executive team and leave with decisions, not just sentiment. You sound like a peer, not a vendor. * AI builder, not just AI user. You prototype with LLMs and agent tools yourself, and hold your team to the same standard. * Systems thinking. You treat backend scale (connector sync, retrieval latency across hundreds of tenants) and the admin experience as one problem, not two. * Builder mentality. You don't wait for a playbook. Speed over polish, with the judgment to know when polish matters. Nice to have * Experience in the ITSM, HCM or employee service ecosystem — ServiceNow, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Moveworks or similar. * Background in RAG, search and ranking, agent orchestration, or enterprise knowledge systems. * Experience leading distributed product teams across the US and India. * Pricing and packaging experience for AI or usage\-based products. * Engineering degree, or an early career as an engineer. Signals we value * You've rewritten a strategy after a week because the first version wasn't a real bet. * You can name the three metrics your last product lived or died by, and what moved them. * You've said no to a large customer and kept the account. **Benefits** Why this role * Define the category. Agentic AI for the back office is being decided now. You'll set how Leena AI wins it. * Real scale, real momentum. Hundreds of enterprise customers, $20M\+ ARR growing 3x, and a platform that already works — this is about where to take it, not whether it works. * Seat at the table. You report to Adit Jain, co\-founder and CEO, and shape company strategy alongside the founders and executive team.

jobs.title: Cyber-Physical Systems Reverse Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Who We Are:** Kudu Dynamics is Leidos Owned Company, forged out of a decade of experience in computer network operations and staffed with talent who have built, overseen, and enhanced capabilities throughout the entire USG arsenal. Our team of hackers and engineers have experience spanning centuries of research, development, and operations missions \- across desktop, mobile, IoT, and embedded platforms. Kudu Dynamics, a Leidos company is uniquely qualified to anticipate tomorrow’s threats and build the next generation of capabilities. We are looking for a Cyber\-Physical Systems Reverse Engineer to support a new project researching and developing novel capabilities for maritime cybersecurity. This is the kind of job where you get to poke at real systems, ask why something behaved differently than expected, and keep digging when the answer is, "Huh, that's weird." This role focuses on understanding how complex embedded and cyber\-physical systems actually behave, not just how they were intended to behave. On our team, you will work hands\-on with real embedded systems and operational technology in a lab environment, analyzing hardware, firmware, communications interfaces, and interactions between components. You will reverse engineer and emulate embedded devices, develop automated methods for exploring system behavior, and design experiments to identify unexpected or emergent behaviors, undocumented features, or even bugs and misconfigurations. This role calls for the creative application of multiple skill sets across embedded systems, firmware, software, hardware, and cybersecurity. You may find yourself building test harnesses and automated workflows, instrumenting analog and digital systems, integrating physical devices with software analysis and cyber reasoning tools, and developing code. **Responsibilities Include:** * Develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for real\-time and resource\-constrained systems, including RTOS\-based applications, device drivers, hardware interfaces, and low\-level system software * Design and implement simulation, emulation, and automated test environments for embedded and cyber\-physical systems, including tools for exploring system behavior, reproducing observed effects, and exercising hardware and firmware * Analyze and reverse engineer embedded devices, firmware, communications protocols, sensors, and other system components to understand both intended functionality and real\-world behavior * Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ and Python software to automate testing, instrumentation, experimentation, and analysis, including integration with laboratory hardware and software\-based analysis tools * Conduct hands\-on laboratory testing using embedded debugging tools and analog/digital instrumentation; critically analyze, document, and communicate technical findings. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C\+\+, including real\-time systems, RTOS concepts, interrupts, concurrency, memory\-mapped I/O, device drivers, and hardware peripherals * Experience with embedded hardware and common communications interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet, or wireless interfaces, including debugging hardware/software interactions * Experience developing simulation, emulation, automated testing, or hardware/software test harnesses for embedded systems * Proficiency with Python or similar scripting languages for automation, testing, analysis, and development of engineering tools * Experience using embedded development and diagnostic equipment such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic/protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, function generators, or similar instrumentation. **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications:** * Experience reverse engineering embedded devices and firmware, including use of tools such as Ghidra, Binary Ninja, IDA Pro, or similar tools and the ability to analyze assembly for one or more processor architectures. * Experience with program analysis and vulnerability research techniques such as fuzzing, symbolic execution, static/dynamic analysis, binary exploitation, and modern exploit mitigations. * Experience with processor or full\-system emulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), or development of custom models for processors, peripherals, sensors, or other embedded components. * Experience with digital signal processing, RF systems, software\-defined radio, wireless communications, audio/signal processing, or MATLAB\-based modeling and analysis. * Understanding of digital and analog circuits, hardware reverse engineering, low\-level computer architecture, and the interaction between software, firmware, and physical system behavior. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. **Original Posting:** --------------------- November 9, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. **Pay Range:** -------------- Pay Range $107,900\.00 \- $195,050\.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. **About Leidos** Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI
jobs.description: LiteLLM is the world’s most popular AI Gateway, trusted by companies like Adobe, Netflix, and NASA. We’ve grown ARR 6x in the last year to nearly $30M with a team of 20, and developers use LiteLLM to call 100\+ LLM providers through one API. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to lead our unified API team and make sure every new model and provider works with LiteLLM on day one. **About the role** ------------------ This is a hands\-on technical lead role. You'll own how LiteLLM unifies LLM APIs across the OpenAI and Anthropic specs, lead the engineers who build it, and set the bar for what good looks like. Every week a provider ships something new: a new API, a new modality, a new feature. The promise of LiteLLM is that it works with all of them on day one. Your job is to keep that promise: new endpoints ship on day one, open source translation issues go down, and developers can count on LiteLLM to keep up. You’ll lead our open source pod, where most issues are LLM translation issues. You’ll report to the CEO, and later to our Head of Engineering. This role is in person in San Francisco. We help with relocation and support H\-1B transfers. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the unified API team and own new model, endpoint, and provider rollouts end to end. * Design provider\-agnostic features at the gateway level, such as session management for non\-OpenAI models. * Triage open source issues and outside PRs (new providers, translation fixes) and get them merged, reviewed, or replaced with an internal fix. * Review the AI team's PRs and hold a high bar for code quality, including code written with AI. * Find the power users in your area and use what they need to decide what to build next. * Take on new unification bets with a customer who will use them and give feedback. * Own the developer experience for everyone who uses LiteLLM's Python SDK and proxy. **What is our tech stack** The tech stack includes Python, FastAPI, Redis, Postgres. We're moving the gateway to Rust. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * You've been a machine learning engineer and now build applied AI products. * 3\+ years of experience. The scope you've owned matters more than a Staff title. * Deep expertise in LLM APIs. You can speak to the differences between /chat/completions and /responses, and to each provider's nuances. * Experience building or maintaining a unified API that sits in front of many providers. * Taste in developer experience. You can tell when an API or playground is bad and explain why. * Customer empathy. You ask why a user wants something and how big the use case is before you build it. * Ready to lead a team from day one and set the technical bar yourself. * Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience at a company built on a unified API, such as OpenRouter, Vercel AI SDK, Merge, Segment, or Fivetran. * You've built your own unified API or written about what a good one should do. * You've built evals for LLMs. * You've used LiteLLM in production. * Open source contributions, especially to LLM tooling. **Why join LiteLLM?** --------------------- * Work directly with the founders every day. * Lead the team behind the core of the product: the unified API thousands of engineering teams depend on. * Own a whole area of the product. We don't have PMs: engineers talk to customers and decide what to build. * Your work ships in open source, used by engineering teams around the world. * Move incredibly fast and see your work in production immediately. * Competitive salary, equity, health, dental, and vision benefits. **About LiteLLM** ----------------- LiteLLM is the world's most widely adopted AI Gateway. We provide a unified API for 100\+ LLM providers along with routing, authentication, budgets, observability, and governance for production AI systems. Thousands of companies rely on LiteLLM to power AI in production. If you want to lead the team that keeps LiteLLM ahead of every model launch, we'd love to meet you. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

Direct Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent coding agents to create and maintain Playwright, Cypress, and Jest suites alongside engineers: generating coverage for new work, repairing suites as the product changes, and expanding depth where risk is highest. * **Develop the prompting, context, and workflow patterns** tthat make agent\-generated tests reliable: repo context strategies, guardrails, review gates, and escalation paths for when an agent should hand back to a human. * **Set the quality and test strategy for the platform**, ensuring quality is engineered in at every stage rather than inspected in at the end. * **Own the quality roadmap** Maintain a quarterly quality and test roadmap and a 6\-month forecast aligned to engineering delivery goals and platform evolution. * **Maintain quality standards** across teams. Define, evolve, and maintain the quality standards and practices teams work to, and adjust processes based on what reviews and audits reveal. * **Drive adoption across engineering teams.** Onboard squads onto the model, document what works, run enablement, and make the practice self\-sustaining without owning headcount. * **Own technical acceptance criteria** in partnership with Product Managers, and lead risk\-based functional testing across all stages of development. * **Plan and manage UAT cycles**, environment specifications, execution, and stakeholder reporting. * **Own performance and load testing.** Ensure critical services have load, stress, and performance testing in place and actively maintained. * **Ensure test data and environment readiness** so test cycles aren’t delayed by missing or invalid data or misconfigured environments. * **Establish the measurement framework.** Define quality KPIs that work for an agent\-led model: coverage quality (not just coverage percentage), escaped\-defect rates, agent output reliability, and human review load over time. * **Own service acceptance** for complex deliverables. * **Track where the frontier is moving.** Evaluate new agent capabilities, models, and testing technologies, and decide what earns a place in the platform. #### **What we are looking for** * Proven **leadership experience**, including managing others and working in cross\-team and cross\-organizational environments. * **Hands\-on AI agent development and orchestration.** Practical, sustained experience directing Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent coding agents on real engineering work. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forecasting & Real-Time Optimization
jobs.description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Marketplace teams are at the heart of Lyft's products and decision\-making. We're looking for passionate, driven engineers to build systems that empower our users (both drivers and riders) to make the most effective use of Lyft's products and experiences by making them more predictive, personalized, and adaptive. The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems with distributed computing for ML and forecasting models, and finding patterns and insights in real\-world data while building reliable systems, and is excited about working in a fast\-paced, innovative, and collegial environment. The Forecasting and Real\-Time Optimization Platform (FORTOP) team in Lyft's Rideshare Experience \& Marketplace (REM) org provides reliable, real\-time market supply and demand signals and forecasts that power the systems making critical automated decisions for Lyft's business. These signals feed many of Lyft's most important marketplace products, including Dynamic Pricing, Real\-Time Supply Management, Fulfillment, and more. As a Senior Software Engineer on FORTOP's forecasting team, you'll lead the design and operation of the production systems that turn streaming marketplace data into accurate, reliable forecasts: real\-time feature pipelines, model training and inference infrastructure, backtesting and evaluation tooling, and the serving layer that downstream products query continuously. You'll work closely with our scientists to take models from prototype to production, and with downstream teams to define the contracts and reliability guarantees they build on. The work involves forecasting both rider demand and driver supply as they shift with traffic, holidays, and major events, and keeping systems correct and fast during the peaks when they matter most. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Lead projects end to end:** Drive multi\-engineer projects from proposal and technical design through launch. Break work into milestones, align dependencies with partner teams, and own estimates. * **Architect ML systems:** Design and evolve streaming feature pipelines, training and inference workflows, and signal serving, and lead design reviews with attention to latency, correctness, scalability, and cost. Reduce complexity by consolidating or sunsetting components. * **Partner with science to ship:** Partner with scientists to design/productionize ML models. Build the rollout tooling (shadow, canary, rollback) and the backtesting and experimentation infrastructure that make launches safe and fast. * **Own signal contracts:** Define and maintain the interfaces, data contracts, and SLAs between forecasting signals and downstream consumers such as Dynamic Pricing and Driver Incentives. * **Operate what you build:** Monitor system health (latency, freshness, error rates) and signal quality (accuracy, bias, drift), and prepare systems for peak events. Take part in on\-call, lead post\-incident investigations, and drive action items to completion. * **Code quality:** Write well\-tested, maintainable code and give code reviews that improve the work of others. Coach teammates on testing and engineering practices. * **Collaborate across functions:** Work with Product, Science, and partner engineering teams to frame problems, shape the roadmap, and make clear tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, and complexity. * **Grow the team:** Mentor engineers, take part in hiring and onboarding, and share knowledge through design docs, runbooks, and tech talks. **Experience:** --------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering industry experience, including building and operating backend or data systems in production * BS/MS or equivalent in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience * Experience designing and leading delivery of large\-scale distributed systems, and owning their reliability through monitoring, on\-call, and incident response * Solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, delivery semantics, and consistency tradeoffs * Track record of leading ambiguous, multi\-engineer projects and mentoring other engineers * Clear written communication, including design docs that align stakeholders * Preferred: Experience building production ML models and infrastructure, such as model choice, feature engineering and pipelines, training and inference pipelines, model serving, or ML platforms * Preferred: Hands\-on experience with stream or large\-scale batch processing (Flink, Beam, Spark, or similar) and distributed messaging (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) * Preferred: Experience with time series forecasting systems, or familiarity with backtesting and forecast evaluation (error metrics, bias, calibration) * Preferred: Experience with online experimentation or real\-time decision systems such as pricing, dispatch, or marketplace balancing * Preferred: Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools to move faster without compromising quality **Benefits:** ------------- * Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled * Mental health benefits * Family building benefits * Child care and pet benefits * 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future * In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off * 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible * Subsidized commuter benefits * Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. \#Hybrid The expected base pay range for this position in the Seattle area is $136,160 \- $170,200, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI - Systems
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **About the Role** ================== The Applied AI org builds the systems that turn human expertise into training data for frontier models, task pipelines, expert workflows, evaluation infrastructure, and the services that tie them together. We have synthetic pipelines and modular quality control systems that run in unison to generate highest quality tasks and at scale. All of it runs on backend systems that have to stay correct, fast, and observable while the volume behind them grows every month. As a Software Engineer on Backend Systems, you'll own services in that stack: designing the data models, building the APIs, services, data pipelines that move work through the platform. This is a build role. You'll take a problem that's roughly scoped, make the design calls, ship it to production, and own it afterward. We're hiring for depth in backend fundamentals rather than any particular domain. If you've built and operated real services, handled the schema migration that couldn't take downtime, found the query that fell over at 10x traffic, designed the retry logic that made a flaky dependency invisible to users, or build a system that recover when things break that's the experience that matters here. You'll work with a talent dense group of engineers who will review your designs and push your thinking, and you'll be expected to grow into owning larger surfaces quickly. **What you will Do** ==================== * Design, build, and operate backend services in the Applied AI stack including APIs, data models, background jobs, and the pipelines that connect them. * Own features end to end: scope the problem, write the design, ship the code, instrument it, and keep it healthy in production. * Build and tune high\-throughput data and job pipelines: queuing, batching, idempotency, retries, and backpressure. * Make the system fast and reliable by adding failure recovery in pipelines, profile hot spots, Agent token and cost attribution, caching issues, and set latency, error, cost budgets you actually hold to. * Instrument what you ship: observability, metrics, logging, tracing, and alerts that proactively catch problems. * Work on modern cutting edge tools, libraries and frameworks. * Manage and launch 10s of 1000s of containers, sandbox environments, manage resource allocation and system health. * Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform. * Participate in on\-call for the systems you own, debug production incidents, and write up what you learn in RCCA. * Write clear design docs and give useful code review, we make technical decisions in writing and expect everyone to take part. * Work directly with product, operations, and research partners to turn ambiguous requirements into systems that ship. **What we are Looking For** =========================== * 2–5 years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems. * Strong fundamentals in backend engineering: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and writing code that's clear enough for the next person to change. * Hands\-on experience with **API design** \- REST, gRPC, or GraphQL, and an understanding of versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. * Solid **database skills**: relational data modeling, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation, and safe migrations. Familiarity with at least one NoSQL or key\-value store and when it's the right choice. * Practical experience with **distributed systems basics**: queues and event streams, caching, idempotency, rate limiting, and designing for partial failure. * Experience with Data Orchestration and workflow management systems like Airflow, Temporal, Dagster. * Be able to roll your sleeves up and dig deeper into the lower level infrastructure issues container, permissions, logs, traces and find the needle in the haystack. * Experience running services in production: containers, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and debugging issues under real traffic. * Comfort with ambiguity you can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and come back with a plan. * Genuine excitement for agentic development and new technology, fluency with modern AI dev tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), and a real passion for writing good code. * Clear written and verbal communication. High ownership, pragmatism, and a bias toward shipping. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience building or integrating with LLM\-backed services in production (evaluation, orchestration, or serving). * Familiarity with AI infrastructure providers like Modal, Fireworks, Baseten, Temporal **Benefits** ------------ * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $220K \- $500K

We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **About the Role** Mercor’s evals platform helps frontier labs and enterprises understand how their models perform on real work. Labs use it to decide what to train next, and enterprises use it to decide which models and agents to trust. It runs evals at scale, grades every result and explains why a model fails. The team also runs APEX, Mercor's family of benchmarks built with domain experts to measure how well frontier models do professional work in fields like law, finance and consulting. Its public leaderboard ranks the latest models, and its results appear in model cards across the industry. As a Software Engineer on the Evals product team, you will build the scorecards, failure reports and dataset views that help customers turn eval runs into decisions. You will solve hard problems in scale, grading accuracy and reproducibility, while keeping the product simple to use. This role grows with the platform, from evals into post\-training and new product areas. You will help turn the failures we find into data that improves models. **What You'll Do** * **Build the product customers use to evaluate models:** Ship the APIs, data models and UI that help customers run evals, compare models and share scores. * **Own APEX launches:** Run every new frontier model on APEX and publish correct, defensible results to the public leaderboard. * **Explain why models fail:** Build failure analysis that helps customers see where their models fail, with each pattern linked to the exact steps that went wrong. * **Make benchmarks easy to find and manage:** Build dataset views, registries and versioning that help customers find the right benchmark or bring their own. * **Take customers from first login to self\-serve:** Build onboarding, roles, key management and usage views that help new teams run evals on their own. * **Work directly with customers:** Join pilots with labs and enterprises and turn what they need into the roadmap. **What We Are Looking For** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field * Strong full\-stack skills in a modern backend language (Python, Go or TypeScript) and a frontend framework such as React * A track record of owning product features end to end, from idea to production * Strong product sense that starts from what the user needs * Experience building data\-heavy products: data models, APIs and views over large volumes of results * Excellent written and verbal communication with engineers, researchers and customers * Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of shipping iteratively * Experience with LLM evals, benchmarks or AI developer tools is a plus * Startup experience or experience building B2B developer products is a plus **Benefits** ------------ * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $220K \- $250K

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Lead AI Engineer Overview: Mastercard is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to join a small, focused AI technology team led by one of Mastercard's Distinguished Engineers. The team will initially focus on delivering agentic technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at scale and the use of open weight AI models. The team works in partnership with key technology stakeholders across the organization. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will design and build the platform capabilities that let Mastercard adopt MCP and open weight models safely and at scale, working alongside more senior engineers who set the broader technical direction. We are looking for someone with strong knowledge of modern AI technology, solid software engineering and MLOps skills, good cloud platform experience, familiarity with identity technologies such as OAuth and a practical grasp of model evaluation. In this role, you will help build the platform patterns through which Mastercard teams expose tools and data to agents over MCP, and through which the enterprise services, evaluates, and governs open weight models. You will contribute to the key technical decisions — gateway and connectivity patterns, identity and access controls, model\-serving infrastructure, and evaluation — and turn them into working, well\-engineered, production\-grade services. You will work across the MCP estate and the OW model working group, partnering closely with the team's senior engineers and with central technology, security, and governance stakeholders. About The Role: * Contribute to the design and build of the components of Mastercard's enterprise MCP deployment, such as the security gateway, the MCP registry that governs what exists and who owns it, and reference server implementations that teams build from. Take these from design through to running production services. * Implement the identity, authentication, and authorization patterns for MCP across the estate, working with the team's senior engineers and central security and identity teams so that agents, tools, and data are accessed securely and are auditable end to end. * Help set and apply the standard for internal and external MCP servers — how tools and data are exposed, discovered and versioned, and the inspection, data\-protection, rate\-limiting, and kill\-switch controls the gateway must enforce. * Build and operate open weight model serving — stand up and scale self\-hosted inference, package models for deployment, and help enable switching workloads across models and providers for cost, flexibility, and resilience. * Build the evaluation and testing tooling that benchmarks candidate open weight models for quality, cost, latency, and safety, and produces the reproducible evidence that governance and security reviews need. * Apply the MLOps practices that keep the platform reliable — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and model and service monitoring — so that what the team builds is maintainable and operable in production. * Partner with central security, privacy, legal and AI governance teams, and with the MCP SIG and OW working group, implementing their requirements correctly for the platform's architecture. * Keep current with a rapidly evolving landscape, such as new MCP developments, frontier open weight releases, and related agentic protocols, and help the team decide what to adopt, prototype, or wait on. All About You: * Strong knowledge of modern AI technology: LLMs and foundation models, agents, and the tooling and protocols (such as MCP) that connect them to enterprise systems. * Good software engineering skills: you write production\-quality, well\-tested code and build services others can depend on, not one\-off scripts or prototypes. * Solid MLOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, containers, observability, and monitoring for models and services in production. * Good cloud platform knowledge (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP valuable). Familiarity with a modern data/AI platform such as Databricks a bonus. * Practical experience with model evaluation, including building benchmarks and tests that measure quality, cost, latency and safety, and producing reproducible results others can rely on. * Hands\-on experience serving or operating open weight models, self\-hosting, and scaling inference, and ideally some fine\-tuning or adaptation to proprietary data and workflows. * Working knowledge of API security, identity, and access control, enough to implement MCP authentication and authorization correctly and partner effectively with security teams. * Awareness of the governance context that shapes enterprise AI, such as model provenance and licensing, data sovereignty, and financial\-services regulation. * A clear communicator and collaborator who works well with senior engineers, hands\-on peers, and specialist governance and security partner teams. * Intense curiosity about technology in general, and AI in particular, and who can demonstrate their learning agility outside the bounds of a specific function. * Lastly, a self\-starter: once you have a clear guidance and direction, you don’t need to be hand\-held to get to a solution or deliverable. \#AI1 Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Manager, Forward-Deployed AI Engineer — AI Mobilization & Transformation
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Manager, Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer — AI Mobilization \& Transformation Overview The Manager, Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer serves as Mastercard's embedded AI transformation leader, partnering directly with business units to identify high\-value opportunities, develop production\-grade AI solutions, and mobilize teams to adopt new ways of working. Reporting to the Director, Forward\-Deployed AI Engineer \- AI Mobilization \& Transformation, this role combines deep technical expertise with change leadership. Rather than building solutions in isolation, you will work alongside business teams to solve real problems, demonstrate the art of the possible, and develop internal capability through hands\-on engagement. Success is measured not only by the solutions delivered, but by the number of leaders, engineers, analysts, and teams equipped to independently leverage AI, agents, and multi\-agent systems in their daily work. The Role Mobilizing AI Adoption Through Bespoke Engagements * Embed within business units to identify strategic workflow, productivity, and decision\-making opportunities where AI can create measurable value. * Lead AI Transformation Engagements that combine discovery, solution design, implementation, and capability building. * Build high\-impact use cases that serve as showcase examples for broader organizational adoption. * Translate business challenges into practical applications of AI, agents, and multi\-agent orchestration. * Create reusable playbooks, patterns, and training assets that accelerate adoption across the enterprise. * Partner with business leaders to demonstrate measurable outcomes and establish local AI champions. * Support the identification and delivery of high\-value AI opportunities across business functions. * Contribute reusable assets and implementation patterns that accelerate future engagements. Building While Teaching * Design and deploy production\-ready AI assistants, agents, and orchestration frameworks that solve real business problems. * Use each engagement as a live learning environment where business and technical teams learn modern AI practices through delivery. * Coach engineers, analysts, product managers, knowledge workers, and operational teams on AI\-first ways of working. * Establish a "train\-the\-trainer" model that enables local teams to continue scaling capabilities after engagements conclude. * Facilitate hands\-on workshops focused on prompt engineering, agent design, workflow automation, Copilot practices, and AI\-assisted development. * Develop practitioners capable of independently applying AI tools and techniques within their teams. * Promote knowledge sharing and adoption of established AI best practices. Advancing Agentic Transformation * Architect and implement solutions leveraging Copilot Studio, Azure AI, agent frameworks, orchestration systems, and enterprise platforms. * Develop multi\-agent solutions that automate complex business processes and decision flows. * Introduce modern engineering practices including AI\-assisted software development, evaluation frameworks, observability, and governance. * Establish proven reference architectures and patterns that can be replicated across business units. * Help business teams evolve from experimentation to operationalized AI solutions. * Apply established AI patterns and frameworks to accelerate solution delivery and adoption. * Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and assist in translating them into practical business applications. Capturing and Scaling Organizational Learning * Document emerging patterns, successful use cases, implementation approaches, and lessons learned. * Build an enterprise library of AI\-enabled workflows, agents, and transformation stories. * Identify adoption barriers and design interventions that accelerate organizational readiness. * Contribute to enterprise readiness metrics by measuring adoption, productivity gains, capability growth, and business impact. * Create a feedback loop between field engagements, engineering teams, and organizational readiness programs. * Capture reusable assets, implementation approaches, and best practices from engagements. * Share lessons learned to improve future AI transformation efforts across the organization. All About You * Extensive software engineering experience with a track record of building and deploying production\-grade systems. * Deep experience with AI technologies including LLMs, agent fr nting and sharing repeatable patterns, practices, or implementation approaches. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience driving adoption of new technologies through hands\-on engagement and coaching. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Azure AI, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent platforms preferred. * Financial services, payments, or enterprise transformation experience preferred. * Passion for developing others and creating sustainable capability within organizations. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer - Revenue Cycle Automation-Remote
jobs.description: CityRochester StateMN RemoteYES DepartmentFinance **Why Mayo Clinic** Mayo Clinic is top\-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News \& World Report. As we work together to put the needs of the patient first, we are also dedicated to our employees, investing in competitive compensation and comprehensive benefit plans – to take care of you and your family, now and in the future. And with continuing education and advancement opportunities at every turn, you can build a long, successful career with Mayo Clinic. **Benefits Highlights** * Medical: Multiple plan options. * Dental: Delta Dental or reimbursement account for flexible coverage. * Vision: Affordable plan with national network. * Pre\-Tax Savings: HSA and FSAs for eligible expenses. * Retirement: Competitive retirement package to secure your future. **Responsibilities** The AI/ML Engineer, a full\-stack AI/ML architect for the Revenue Cycle pillar, responsible for both agentic solutions (UiPath Maestro, LLM orchestration, agent \+ bot \+ human\-in\-the\-loop patterns) and predictive ML solutions. This role sets the AI architecture direction for Revenue Cycle, defines reference patterns, and collaborates with delivery teams to bring solutions from prototype to production. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing an agentic orchestration topology and shipping a production ML model. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect full\-stack AI/ML solutions for Revenue Cycle, spanning agentic orchestration (UiPath Maestro, LLM agents, RPA bots, human\-in\-the\-loop) and predictive ML. * Define reference architectures, design patterns, and guardrails for AI use in Revenue Cycle, in partnership with enterprise architecture, security, and data governance. * Lead design of high\-complexity solutions such as agentic patient portal inbasket management, combining UiPath Maestro, AI agents, RPA bots, and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight. * Develop, evaluate, and productionize ML models using Python, modern ML libraries, and Mayo Clinic's approved cloud and data platforms. * Partner with delivery leads, app analysts, and business analysts to translate Revenue Cycle opportunities into AI\-enabled solutions with measurable ROI. * Establish standards for model lifecycle management, monitoring, bias and drift evaluation, and responsible AI practice aligned to Mayo Clinic policy. * Evaluate emerging AI capabilities (new LLM models, agentic frameworks, UiPath releases) and guide when and how to adopt them. * Mentor AI/ML engineers and developers across the program; contribute to enterprise AI community of practice. **Qualifications** A master’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, health science, or a related field and 1 year experience, OR A bachelor’s degree with 3 years of experience. * Experience applying AI and machine learning in production environments or similar highly regulated or technology focused industries, showcasing an understanding of healthcare technology. * Skill in cloud infrastructure environment and software development tools. * Experience working with large, complex, and heterogeneous data sets, preferably in healthcare. * Skill in AI/ML techniques and frameworks. * History of collaborating across diverse teams and effectively communicating complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Familiarity with best practices in data engineering, data science, AI Engineering, and the MLOps communities. * Strong interpersonal, communication, and time management skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Professional experience in AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or a combined architect/engineer role. * Proven experience designing and delivering agentic or LLM\-enabled solutions in production environments. * Proven experience building and deploying predictive ML models end\-to\-end, including feature engineering, evaluation, and monitoring. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML/AI libraries (scikit\-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent). * Working experience with UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator, Maestro, Document Understanding, AI Center) or Google Cloud Platform * Hands\-on experience with Azure (preferred) or other major cloud platforms for AI workloads, including MLOps tooling. * Experience defining reference architectures, design patterns, and technical standards at enterprise scale. * **This position is a 100% remote work. Individual may live anywhere in the US.** **\*\*This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship / we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position.** **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $116,043 \- $142,147 / year; **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** Standard Days M\-F **Weekend Schedule** As Needed **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". Mayo Clinic participates in E\-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. **Recruiter** Ronnie Bartz

jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview: We are looking for a strong Sr Data Engineer with an analytical and Data Science mindset to help transform large\-scale product, customer, telemetry, behavioral, and operational data into trusted datasets, actionable insights, and predictive intelligence. This role will initially focus on Data Engineering, including building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets. With our core data pipelines and datasets increasingly established, the role is expected to quickly expand into Data Science, statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modeling. This is a Hybrid position based in Frisco, TX. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to the Frisco office. You will be required to be onsite on an as\-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office. We are not offering relocation assistance. Position Details:**About the Role** ------------------ * Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical datasets supporting analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. * Build reliable data ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines across large\-scale product telemetry, customer, behavioral, feedback, and operational datasets. * Establish strong practices around data quality, observability, reliability, performance, and governance to ensure datasets are trusted and ready for analysis and modeling. * Use Python, SQL, Spark, and modern cloud data technologies to process, transform, analyze, and derive insights from large\-scale datasets. * Analyze product telemetry, usage, behavioral, customer feedback, support, and operational datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, friction points, and opportunities. * Develop meaningful features, metrics, cohorts, and customer segments that enable deeper understanding of customer behavior and product performance. * Progressively develop statistical and machine learning models to understand customer behavior, product usage, engagement, friction, and customer outcomes. * Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, segmentation, anomaly detection, time\-series analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling based on the problem being solved. * Develop and test hypotheses using statistical analysis and experimentation to understand the factors driving customer and product outcomes. * Build predictive approaches that help identify emerging customer issues, behavioral changes, product friction, performance issues, and other signals before they become broader problems. * Apply NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and Generative AI where appropriate to extract insights from unstructured customer signals such as feedback, surveys, reviews, and support interactions. * Evaluate analytical and machine learning models using appropriate statistical and ML techniques and ensure conclusions are supported by the underlying data. * Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate ambiguous customer and product questions into measurable data problems, analytical hypotheses, and actionable recommendations. * Move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting by translating data into insights, predictions, recommendations, and measurable product outcomes. * Develop scalable approaches for operationalizing successful models against production datasets, including model monitoring and retraining where appropriate. * Measure whether insights and resulting product or engineering changes produce the expected impact, creating a continuous learning loop between data, insights, actions, and customer outcomes. **About You*** 10\+ years hands\-on experience in Data Engineering, with experience building and supporting scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL with experience working with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets. * Experience with data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and modern ETL/ELT frameworks. * Experience working with cloud data platforms and services in environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, data transformations, performance optimization, and building reliable analytical datasets. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a demonstrated interest in moving beyond data engineering into Data Science, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics. * Working knowledge of statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, and predictive modeling. * Hands\-on exposure to Data Science and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Ability to move from raw data hypothesis analysis/model conclusion recommendation* measurable outcome. * Exposure to behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, segmentation, forecasting, predictive analytics, or other applied Data Science techniques is highly desirable. * Familiarity with NLP, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and Generative AI for extracting insights from structured and unstructured datasets is beneficial. * Coursework, certification, specialization, or a degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred. * Demonstrated ability and motivation to rapidly develop deeper Data Science and Machine Learning expertise while continuing to apply strong Data Engineering fundamentals. * Ability to convert loosely defined product or customer questions into measurable analytical problems and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. \#LI\-Hybrid Company Overview: McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment. Company Benefits and Perks: We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.:* Bonus Program * 401k Retirement * Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, Short Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability Coverage * Paid Parental Leave * Support and Community Involvement * 14 Paid Company Holidays * Unlimited Paid Time Off for Exempt Employees * 96 Hours of Sick Time and 120 Hours of Vacation for Non\-Exempt Employees Accrued Each Year We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. Pay Range: The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $123,650\.00/Yr. \- USD $203,150\.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications. Job Applicant Privacy Notice: Please click here to view and download the Job Applicant Privacy Notice, which applies to all McAfee job applicants who are residents of the state of California.

jobs.title: Sr Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 9 Dec 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== Careers that Change Lives Engineers and Scientists create our market\-leading portfolio of innovations. Join our diverse team of innovators who bring their worldview, their unique backgrounds, and their individual life experiences to work every day. It’s no accident — we work hard to cultivate a workforce that reflects our patients and partners. We believe it’s the only way to drive healthcare forward and remain a global leader in medical technology and solutions. Watch our videos below to learn more about makes Medtronic an exciting and rewarding place to work. Medtronic’s Microelectronic Solutions location in Tempe, Arizona is seeking a Sr Test Engineering Manager that will accept the challenge of developing and leading a highly effective team while continually supporting a workplace environment which reflects Medtronic’s standing as the world’s top medical device company. Help us engineer the extraordinary! Do meaningful work, make a difference, and improve lives — starting with your own! As the Sr Test Engineering Manager, you will be expected to play an active role in developing and implementing strategies that align and drive business, innovation, and talent demand for the future. jobs.title: Senior AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: There’s a particular satisfaction in finding the clue that helps everyone breathe again. You follow it. You make sense of what happened. You help people get back to the work they care about. As Mercola’s Senior AI Security Engineer, you’ll turn that instinct into something people can count on. Feel the pride of seeing a fix hold because you stayed with the problem long enough to prove it worked. Help build a team where people feel comfortable saying, “Something feels off,” and know they’ll be heard. Imagine a colleague pausing just before giving a new tool access to something sensitive. They ask one more question because you showed them what to look for. There’s a quiet pride in that moment, too. The judgment you shared stays with them, ready for the next call they have to make. ROLE SNAPSHOT * Pay $130,000–$150,000 annual base, based on relevant experience and demonstrated capability. * Location/Schedule US\-based, remote or hybrid, full\-time. * Purpose Own day\-to\-day enterprise security, lead technical incident response, and help Mercola use and secure AI across the business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Own the incident queue, risk register, and remediation backlog. Assign owners and deadlines, maintain policies and runbooks, and report progress and unresolved risks to leadership. * Lead technical incident response from triage through recovery validation. Coordinate containment, preserve evidence, and involve Legal or specialist responders as needed. * Strengthen identity, access, and infrastructure controls across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS, and connected applications. Partner with Infrastructure to verify improvements across endpoints, servers, networks, and cloud platforms. * Validate logging coverage, retention, alert delivery, and after\-hours escalation with internal owners and managed security providers. * Use AI assistants for investigation, code review, threat analysis, and automation. Independently validate findings and proposed fixes before acting on them. Secure AI applications, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations against prompt injection, excessive permissions, data exposure, and unsafe tool actions. * Partner with Engineering on application, API, and mobile security. Integrate code, dependency, and secret scanning into development workflows, prioritize exploitable findings, coordinate authorized testing, and verify remediation. * Build security automation with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or comparable tools. Document ownership, failure alerts, audit trails, and rollback procedures. * Assess vendor security, data flows, and third\-party access. Maintain security evidence for applicable contractual, privacy, and compliance needs, and coordinate security awareness and specialist support. MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS * Hands\-on experience in security engineering, incident response, or security operations, with examples of taking issues through investigation, remediation, and verification. * Practical experience securing hybrid environments across Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, cloud services such as AWS, endpoints, and networks. Ability to interpret logs and assess access, application permissions, and potential data exposure. * Experience using AI assistants in engineering or security work. Ability to explain how you limit permissions, protect sensitive information, and validate AI\-generated output. * Ability to write scripts, work with APIs, and review application code or configurations for security issues. Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows. * Ability to prioritize competing security work, coordinate technical owners and providers, and communicate risks and decisions clearly to leadership. * Sound judgment about evidence preservation, testing authorization, production changes, and when to involve specialists. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with Microsoft Defender or comparable endpoint protection, security information and event management (SIEM), or managed detection services. * Experience with Azure DevOps, application or API security testing, cloud or container security, or governance of AI coding tools and MCP integrations. * Relevant certifications or a degree are welcome. Mercola values demonstrated capability and equivalent experience equally. WHAT WE OFFER * The opportunity to shape Mercola’s dedicated Security function and establish how it operates day to day. * Direct access to leadership to align priorities, escalate risks, and secure decisions. * A hands\-on role spanning enterprise incident response, security automation, and AI security, with Infrastructure and Engineering partners who own implementation in their respective areas. Honest Challenge You’ll be the primary internal security practitioner, balancing active incidents with longer\-term improvements across a broad estate. You’ll help define backup coverage, provider responsibilities, and after\-hours escalation. Infrastructure owns platform operations, maintenance, backups, and business continuity.  able runbooks and backup ownership. **PLEASE NOTE:** While we appreciate candidates who reach out directly, given the volume, we are unable to respond to each inquiry individually. The pay range for this position is $130,000–$150,000 annually. Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws. This position is benefits\-eligible. Mercola provides competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from a healthy body to a healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life: * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage * Optional Accident, Hospital Indemnity, and Critical Illness * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Employer\-paid Life and AD\&D Insurance * Optional Supplemental Life and AD\&D Insurance * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts * Health Savings Accounts * Dayforce Wallet – get paid as you earn * Employee Discount * Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution) * Pet Insurance * Wellness Program Offerings * Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service, starting at 15 days annually. * 9 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday. jobs.title: Cloud Principal Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission. As Microsoft’s cloud business continues to grow, the ability to deploy new offerings and HW infrastructure on time, in high volume, with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the SCHIE team is instrumental in defining and delivering measures of success for hardware design, qualification, fleet support, scale, and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. Azure Memory and Storage Center of Excellence (AMS CoE) is part of the SCHIE organization focusing on memory and storage devices going into the cloud hardware servers. AMS provides memory and storage solutions to Azure and drives memory and storage suppliers to deliver high quality products that meet our requirements. AMS CoE also leads **Azure Fault Prediction and Detection (AFPD)**, the platform that predicts, detects and repairs hardware failures across the Azure fleet. We are looking for a **Cloud Principal Hardware Engineer** to scale AFPD across hardware components in the Azure fleet and to lead hands\-on hardware resiliency for the platform. **The opportunity:** Every hour a server sits unhealthy is an hour of lost customer capacity. AFPD turns hardware, firmware and OS telemetry into early detection and prediction of failures, moves customer workloads off failing nodes, and sends a targeted repair for the part that failed. Repair outcomes and supplier failure analysis then improve the next rule or model. You’ll work across the full server platform, including storage, memory, power supplies, CPUs, GPUs, NICs, HBAs/FPGAs, cabling, and other critical hardware components. As a trusted SME (Subject Matter Expert) you’ll help identify potential failures, improve hardware reliability, and prevent disruptions before they impact customers. Your impact will be felt at massive scale**.** Across millions of nodes, every reliability improvement translates into fewer customer VM interruptions, faster restoration of online capacity, and a more resilient cloud infrastructure.**Why this role:** Your impact shows up in fleet availability and customer uptime, quarter over quarter. You will set the hardware direction for a platform that influences production infrastructure at a scale, and you will work directly with Azure engineering, component teams and leading hardware suppliers. \#SCHIE \#azurehwjobs **Responsibilities** * Lead failure analysis across server components: characterize failure modes from fleet telemetry and logs and confirm root cause with repair results and supplier failure analysis. * Define the signals, thresholds, targeted diagnostics and repair recipes, and work with component teams for the root cause analysis. * Improve isolation accuracy so each repair address the source of failures: improve efficacy of the detection and repair services. * Partner with software engineers and data scientists on detection rules and prediction models; set precision targets and validation gates before a rule or model takes action on production nodes. * Leverage AI\-powered tools and data\-driven insights to analyze hardware failures, identify emerging reliability trends, and proactively improve server performance and availability. * Lead root cause and corrective actions with server components, including firmware fixes, and feed the learnings back into the platform. * Lead as the senior hardware escalation point for live\-site incidents, from triage through root cause to fleet\-wide mitigation. * Make new server generations and AI/GPU platforms platform\-ready before they reach production, with detection, isolation and repair coverage at launch. * Track and improve metrics \& mentor engineers across the team **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 7\+ years technical engineering experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience OR equivalent experience. **Other Qualifications:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:*** 10\+ years in server hardware reliability, failure analysis or fleet resiliency at cloud or datacenter scale. * Technical depth in the failure modes of at least one server component type, with working knowledge across the rest of the server (BMC, PCIe, firmware). * Experience turning failure signatures into automated detection rules, fault codes or repair procedures for a large fleet * Experience with predictive maintenance or anomaly detection on hardware telemetry, including setting precision targets and automated repair actions. * Proficiency with Kusto (Azure Data Explorer) or SQL, and Python or PowerShell, for large\-scale telemetry analysis. * Experience using or applying AI\-powered tools, machine learning technologies, or advanced analytics to support engineering analysis, troubleshooting, or process improvements. * Experience with NPI and hardware qualification for server platforms.
