jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Morgan \& Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we're their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People. **Forward Deployed Engineer** Remote, United States **About the Role** We're hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who are passionate about building high\-quality software and putting AI to work where it makes the biggest difference. In this role, you'll work directly with our business teams, such as call center reps, case managers and attorneys, to find problems worth solving and ship solutions that move a measurable business result. You'll build AI agents and full\-stack applications on AWS and MX2, our in\-house AI platform, which more than 5,000 people across the firm use every month. This is a hands\-on engineering role on smaller teams tasked with solving one problem at a time. You'll own each solution from the first conversation to the measured result, then hand it to a permanent owner and take on the next problem. There is one title for this role, with no junior or senior levels: we care most about the business impact you deliver and how well you use AI to get there, not about years of experience alone. **Responsibilities** * **Embed with the business:** Spend time with the teams doing the work to understand how it gets done and where it gets stuck * **Pick the right problem:** Agree with business owners on one measurable problem, take a baseline before building, and define how success will be measured * **Lead by example:** Design and implement reliable systems across the backend, frontend, and cloud infrastructure on AWS * **Build with AI:** Build AI agents and workflows for areas such as our call center and client intake across chat, text and voice, the early steps of litigation, practice areas beyond personal injury, and new AI products the firm is building * **Elevate code quality:** Champion test\-driven development, code hygiene, and clean architecture * **Build for trust:** Test and evaluate AI output, design human review where it matters, and protect client data under HIPAA and firm policy * **Move fast, build right\-sized:** Ship working solutions quickly and improve them in production, with the reliability and observability the problem actually needs rather than over\-engineering up front * **Measure the result:** Report the business outcome, not just the feature shipped * **Champion documentation and handoff:** Author technical design documents and transfer what you build cleanly to a permanent product or engineering owner * **Cross\-functional alignment:** Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to keep every solution aligned with the MX2 roadmap **Requirements** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software development experience, though we weigh shipped impact and AI fluency over tenure * Strong in at least one modern programming language, and comfortable working across the full stack * Hands\-on experience with agentic development: using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor to plan, write, test and review production code * Hands\-on experience building with large language models in production, such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI models, including prompting, tool use, retrieval, AI agent workflows and evaluation * Production experience with AWS and modern cloud\-native architectures * Demonstrated expertise in software testing, quality assurance, and CI/CD pipelines * Comfort turning a loosely defined business problem into a scoped build without a detailed spec * Exceptional communication skills, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders in plain language **Nice to Have** * Experience as a forward deployed, solutions or field engineer, or in another customer\-facing engineering role * Voice AI or contact center technology, such as speech\-to\-text, telephony and real\-time conversation * Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or similar AI agent platforms * Salesforce or Litify experience * Experience in legal, healthcare or another regulated industry **Why Join Us** * Be part of a fast\-growing engineering team within a stable, established company * Build AI that people across America's largest injury law firm use every day * Opportunities for career advancement, ownership, and professional development * Get recognized for the impact you deliver, and see the difference your work makes in the business * Work with passionate engineers who value thoughtful design, high\-quality code, and continuous improvement * Work remotely from anywhere in the United States This role is remote within the United States, with occasional travel to our offices and business teams. \#LI\-MB1 **Benefits** Morgan \& Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff. For full\-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and paid holidays. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Morgan \& Morgan provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. **E\-Verify** This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E\-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.title: ML Search Engineer
jobs.description: **Search Engineer (Software Engineer III)** You must be eligible to work in the US without Visa Sponsorship. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We're building intelligent product search that understands intent, learns from behavior, and gets smarter over time. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the ML/AI Search team, you'll design and build both the frontend and backend systems that power product discovery for millions of industrial buyers—from scalable retrieval pipelines, APIs, and Frontend interfaces that make AI accessible. This isn't a research role. You'll own the full lifecycle: prototyping ideas, shipping production\-grade services on GCP, and iterating based on real user data. Strong Python and React engineering is the foundation—if you also bring experience in search systems, vector databases, or Elasticsearch, you'll hit the ground running from day one. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Build \& Ship Search and AI\-Powered Systems** * Design, develop, and deploy production Python services end\-to\-end—from retrieval and ranking pipelines through client\-facing APIs. * Build and integrate ML inference pipelines: embedding models, transformer\-based classifiers, LLM\-powered query understanding, and reranking services. * Develop event\-driven, real\-time architectures using GCP services—Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GKE, Cloud Functions. * Write clean, well\-tested, observable Python backends; own your services through deployment, monitoring, and on\-call * Drive frontend architecture decisions, establishing development standards, and creating reusable component libraries. **Contribute to Search Infrastructure** * Work alongside the Search Architect and ML Architect to implement hybrid retrieval systems combining keyword search, dense vector similarity, and reranking. * Build and maintain Elasticsearch indexing pipelines, query services, and relevance tuning tooling. * Integrate vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or similar) into retrieval workflows—even if this is new territory, you'll learn fast. * Instrument search pipelines with meaningful metrics: CTR, zero\-result rate, latency—feeding the team's A/B experimentation loop. * Build clean, responsive, and production\-ready interfaces from wireframes or Figma designs. **Own the Engineering Bar** * Champion CI/CD, observability, testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code as non\-negotiables, not afterthoughts. * Lead design sessions with Engineers and Architects; translate product requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions. * Participate in code reviews and knowledge\-sharing—actively raising the team's collective skill level. **WHAT YOU BRING** **Must\-Haves** * **Strong Python****and React****foundation:**6\+ years of professional backend or full\-stack engineering experience with a deep Python/React (e.g., Next.js, Vite.js, Remix.js, Gatsby.js) focus—async patterns, type annotations, testing, and production\-grade service/component design. * **Cloud\-native experience:**Proven experience designing and deploying cloud\-native applications ( GCP strongly preferred; AWS or Azure considered). * Hands\-on experience building resilient high throughput microservices and RESTful/gRPC APIs. * Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and serverless paradigms. * Strong grounding in SOLID design principles and software craftsmanship. * Good communicator who thrives in cross\-functional, agile teams alongside ML engineers, architects, and product owners. * Comfort using AI tools to accelerate development throughput. * Strong experience of using and managing Monorepos * Strong understanding of relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and non\-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB). * **Mentorship:** Provide guidance and technical knowledge sharing to mid\-level and junior developers. **Strongly Preferred — Search \& ML** *You don't need all of these on day one—but the more you bring, the faster you'll contribute:* * **Search systems:**Experience with search platforms: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, or Algolia—index management, query DSL, relevance tuning. * **Vector search:**Familiarity with vector search concepts and tooling: embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor (ANN), FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar. * Exposure to ML/AI patterns: RAG pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, or fine\-tuning workflows. * Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Google ADK. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu) and mature CI/CD pipeline ownership. **WHO YOU ARE** **Fearless Builder** A working proof\-of\-concept beats a thousand slide decks. Speed and quality are both non\-negotiable. **Relentless Learner** You pick up new technologies fast and have a genuine eagerness to master whatever comes next. **Architecture\-Minded** You design scalable, fault\-tolerant services as second nature and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. **Ownership\-Driven** Code isn't done until it's tested, documented, and monitored. Your name on a release means something. **Search\-Curious** You may not have built a search system yet—but you're excited by the challenge and ready to go deep. **Team Multiplier** You give and welcome candid feedback and actively make the people around you better. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** **LICENSES \& CERTIFICATIONS:** None required. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** No Supervisory Responsibility **BUDGET RESPONSIBILITY:** No **COMPANY INFORMATION:** Motion Industries offers an excellent benefits package which includes options for healthcare coverage, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, vacation, sick, and holiday pay. **DISCLAIMER:** This job description illustrates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this job classification. jobs.title: AI Factory Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: NVIDIA owned the way in accelerated computing to address problems beyond the reach of standard computers. Its creation of the GPU in 1999 ignited the expansion of PC gaming and transformed modern computer graphics. Now, NVIDIA drives AI forward as a full\-stack computing firm. Its data center platforms fuel the upcoming industrial revolution, where intelligence is the product. Our efforts cover accelerated computing, AI, robotics, and the vital data center infrastructure. NVIDIA is now creating AI factories: custom facilities that generate intelligence at unmatched scale and density in data centers. These are not typical data centers; they require power\- and cooling\-heavy production setups with innovative mechanical systems, new build standards, and fresh engineering leadership. As NVIDIA expands, we seek outstanding engineers who continuously learn, are passionate about their work, and aspire to perform at their highest level. The growth of NVIDIA's accelerated computing and AI infrastructure surpasses historical data center development and operation speeds. We want a highly motivated AI Factory Mechanical Design Engineer to take charge of next\-generation liquid cooling and thermal systems for AI factories. Your responsibility will cover all phases, from concept to construction and commissioning, at a scale rarely seen before. This position is not about reviewing others' designs; you will be the engineering authority for systems lacking an established guide. You will join a small, high\-impact team where your choices directly influence what is developed. You will set technical direction across hydronic, airside, and facility heat\-rejection systems, mentor engineers across the organization, and drive programs that bring real megawatts of AI compute capacity online. Current focus areas include the technical roadmap for advanced mechanical systems, programmatic facility plans, owner\-furnished equipment strategy, and adapting standardized plans to local site conditions. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Lead data center product and facility builds, balancing cost, energy efficiency, schedule, and sustainability while integrating new technologies. * Own mechanical systems strategy and development, including liquid cooling, chiller plants, heat rejection, CDUs, and airside/hydronic systems, from concept through construction administration and commissioning. * Deliver design documentation and lead execution across all project phases (SD, DD, CD, CA) for greenfield, leased, and retrofit projects. * Partner with civil/structural, electrical, connectivity, controls, and hardware engineering to align rack\-level thermal requirements with facility design, optimized for cost, speed, efficiency, and flexibility. * Drive prefabricated and modular construction strategies and build\-to\-break\-ground schedules to accelerate deployment. * Act as NVIDIA’s owner’s representative: hold engineer\-of\-record teams accountable, prepare RFPs, manage contracts, and review change orders, submittals, RFIs, and value\-engineering proposals. * Participate in factory witness testing, commissioning, and quality verification, and support handover and knowledge transfer into live operations. Evaluate emerging technologies, standards, and sustainability targets (energy and water modeling), support site selection and master planning, and advance reliability and availability practices. * **What We Need to See:** * Possession of a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of mechanical engineering experience supporting critical facilities or large\-scale data centers. * Proven expertise in liquid cooling systems, chiller plant development, and/or hydronic system development. * Experience leading large\-scale mechanical infrastructure programs from concept through construction and commissioning. * Experience across all phases of design delivery (schematic design, design development, etc.). Strong ability to communicate technical concepts in writing and presentations to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including build reviews and executive briefings. * **Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:** * Experience with prefabricated and modular construction (build for manufacturing and assembly), plus operations and deployment handover for data center mechanical systems. * Hardware thermal engineering background, including thermal build validation and product reliability, with deep expertise in availability and reliability engineering for critical infrastructure. * Proficiency in controls systems (BMS/EPMS integration, mechanical controls logic), electrical and MEP integration, and acoustics/noise engineering and regulatory compliance for mechanical equipment. * Familiarity with advanced simulation, modeling, or AI\-driven build optimization tools. * Professional Engineer (PE) license in Mechanical Engineering required; track record of mentoring engineers and representing owner interests on large capital programs. Demonstrated success influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries, aligning engineering and business leaders around shared goals, and developing engineers for broader technical responsibilities. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Extensive experience developing and managing Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog platforms, including common features applied across engineering teams. * Experience delivering self\-service data publishing, cataloging, lineage, data contracts, or certification systems with demonstrated adoption. * Experience combining operational data from various cloud providers and internal systems, including entity resolution, inventory reconciliation, lifecycle history, and coverage measurement. * Experience designing and operating Kafka or comparable streaming systems, including partitioning, consumer behavior, offset management, backpressure, replay, and schema compatibility. jobs.title: Senior Perception AI Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description: Self\-driving cars need to understand the road ahead in real time, even without a prior map. Our team builds the online mapping system that turns raw data from multiple sensors into an accurate, continuously updated 3D model of the driving environment. This model captures lanes, road boundaries, crosswalks, intersection layouts, and traffic control information to support decisions across the autonomous driving system. You’ll write the models, write the C\+\+, and ship both into vehicles on the road, running on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. The tasks you perform will be tested at scale, on real cars, with real safety requirements. NVIDIA’s autonomous driving stack spans the full range of automation, and online mapping is a core component across it, so your work will reach L2\+\+, L3, and L4 systems. The role spans two subject areas, and we want someone who enjoys both: * Learned mapping involves training DNNs to predict map elements directly from visual sensors, laser scanning, and radar. This includes owning the GT story and collaborating with partners to provide the vital data. Geometry and C\+\+ engineering: building the post\-processing that turns network outputs into stable, consistent, production\-ready map elements. * **What you’ll be doing:** * Design, train, and improve PyTorch models that predict online map elements (lanes, road boundaries, crosswalks, road markings, topology) from camera, LiDAR, and/or radar, using BEV and vectorized\-map representations. * Solve the hardest scenes: model intersection topology (connectivity between incoming and outgoing lanes, turn paths, merges and splits) and traffic light understanding (detection, state, and association of each light to the lanes it controls). * Write production C\+\+ for geometry\-based post\-processing: curve and surface fitting, association, multi\-frame fusion and tracking, topology reasoning, and consistency checks on DNN outputs. * Apply multi\-view geometry, calibration, coordinate transforms, and sensor fusion to produce 3D maps that stay accurate and stable over time. * Optimize and deploy models alongside algorithms on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor under real\-time and safety constraints, and get them running in vehicles. * Lead the narrative around GT and the data loop by planning datasets and defining GT and labeling requirements. Work with labeling, data, and tooling partners to produce high\-quality GT. Mine data, choose metrics, and analyze failure cases to drive improvements. * Define critical metrics and build evaluation tooling to measure quality gains against large\-scale real\-world data. * Partner with perception, localization, planning, and infrastructure teams to integrate online mapping into the full AV stack, across L2\+\+, L3, and L4 programs. Contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions across the learned and geometric components of the mapping system. * **What we need to see:** * MS or PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of industry or research experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or computer vision. * Strong foundation in 3D geometry: camera models, projective geometry, coordinate transforms, optimization, and curve/surface fitting. * Strong C\+\+ skills, with a track record of designing and shipping production\-quality algorithm code that is fast, reliable, and maintainable. * Hands\-on experience training deep neural networks in PyTorch, including model design, training pipelines, debugging, and performance analysis. * Experience with data\-driven development: building datasets, defining labels and GT, choosing metrics, and improving models by analyzing failures. Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, and the ability to drive technical direction across teams. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Direct experience with DNN\-based online or HD map generation, or BEV perception (e.g., vectorized map prediction, lane topology learning), or equivalent experience to BEV perception. * Experience with intersection understanding, such as lane connectivity and topology reasoning in sophisticated junctions, or traffic light detection and lane association. * Experience combining learned models with geometric post\-processing in a production AV system and publications or open\-source contributions in 3D vision, mapping, or autonomous driving. * Background in sensor fusion, multi\-object tracking, or temporal fusion for map elements. Experience deploying DNNs and algorithms on embedded GPUs (CUDA, TensorRT), ideally on DRIVE Orin or Thor, under real\-time constraints. * \#AutonomousVehicles Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Data
jobs.description: NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high\-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help build solutions that power some of the planet's most advanced computing workloads. The MARS AI Data team owns how NVIDIA's AI research uses data: many petabytes of training data, checkpoints and datasets across multiple clouds and partners. We build the layer between storage and the workload. That covers data placement across file systems, object storage, and local NVMe. It also includes streaming loaders and caches that supply tens of thousands of GPU cores. Efficient checkpoint management. Quotas remain fair throughout numerous research groups. This is a builder's role on a team that is redefining what it does. You will help design MARS' data platform on Kubernetes from the ground up, working directly with the researchers training NVIDIA's own models. The work shows up as faster training steps, shorter restarts and fewer runs lost to complete storage volumes. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ * Design and build the AI data layer for a multi\-cloud GPU fleet: how datasets, checkpoints and scratch data are placed, cached, tiered and moved between different storage backends. * Build high\-throughput data paths for training and RL. That means streaming loaders from object storage, distributed caches, and checkpoint save and restore at thousands of GPUs, including peer\-to\-peer and local\-first restore. * Make data a first\-class part of the compute platform. Build Kubernetes\-native APIs, operators and storage integrations so a job declares the data it needs, and the platform mounts, caches and accounts for it, on Slurm and on Kubernetes. * Own quotas, capacity and data lifecycle across hundreds of research teams: usage attribution, quota enforcement, retention, clean\-up of stale data, and forecasting capacity before it runs out. * Measure how workloads use data. Build I/O telemetry and access analytics that show hot and cold data, metadata pressure and I/O stalls, and use them to drive placement and fixes. * Own reliability for what you build: on\-call, incident analysis, and changes that stop whole classes of data incidents, such as full file systems, runaway metadata load and lost checkpoints. **What we need to see** ----------------------- * BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years building production systems or data\-infrastructure software. * Deep experience with at least one of the following: parallel or distributed file systems (Lustre, WEKA, VAST, GPFS, Ceph or similar), object storage at scale (S3 or compatible), or large\-scale data pipelines and data lakes. * A clear grasp of I/O performance: throughput, latency, metadata cost, caching and how access patterns interact with each. * Strong programming in Go, Rust, C or C\+\+, plus Python for tooling and analysis. * A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better. * Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers. **Ways to stand out from the crowd** ------------------------------------ * Experience feeding large\-scale AI training: data loaders, streaming datasets, and storage behavior at thousands of GPUs. * Experience with checkpointing at scale: asynchronous or distributed checkpoints, tiered checkpoint storage, fast restart after failure. * Built or ran a distributed cache or AI\-oriented storage system, or used node\-local NVMe as a managed tier. * Built a quota, accounting or capacity system that many teams depended on. * Knowledge of RL and agentic workloads and what they need from storage: many small reads, environment snapshots, sandbox images and fast fan\-out. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Systems, AIMS
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead the AIMS Data Systems team, which builds the web\-scale datasets and systems behind personalization, recommendations, and product optimization. The team collects, processes, and attributes signals from member interactions, content, and business operations, turning them into trusted data that improves the member experience. You’ll set strategic and technical direction for large\-scale batch and streaming pipelines. You’ll ensure that data is accurate, timely, well\-documented, and trusted by product, data science, ML, and engineering partners. As a senior leader, you’ll hire and develop strong engineers, set priorities across competing needs, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. You’ll balance near\-term delivery with a long\-term platform strategy, modernizing core data pipelines and schemas while keeping downstream consumers stable. **What you’ll do** * Lead and develop a team building the ingestion, processing, and attribution systems behind engagement, content, and business data. * Set the roadmap and technical direction for batch and streaming data platforms, in partnership with product, data science, ML, and engineering teams. * Deliver reliable, timely, and well\-documented data for model training, evaluation, and decision systems. * Establish standards for data quality, observability, lineage, and operational reliability across critical datasets. * Partner with measurement and experimentation teams to improve attribution methods and validate them against causal evidence. * Modernize core pipelines and schemas while maintaining stable contracts for downstream users. * Build self\-service tools and clear data contracts that make trusted data easier to discover and use. **Minimum Qualifications** * 8\+ years in data engineering, data platforms, or analytics engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers or technical teams. * Hands\-on experience with large\-scale batch and streaming pipelines, such as Spark, Flink, Kafka, Iceberg, and Airflow or similar orchestration. * Experience owning user event and engagement data end to end: instrumentation, schema design and evolution, ingestion, and data quality. * Working knowledge of attribution concepts, such as joining exposures and outcomes, sessionization, and deduplication. * Track record of setting technical direction, prioritizing across competing stakeholders, and delivering multi\-quarter roadmaps. * Strong communication skills with product, data science, and engineering partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building data systems that feed behavioral signals back into personalization, recommendation, or machine learning models. * Deep attribution experience, including multi\-touch or incrementality\-aware approaches, and the tradeoffs between rules\-based and model\-based methods. * Experience with data contracts, lineage, observability, and SLAs for business\-critical datasets. * Familiarity with ML data needs, such as feature stores, label generation, training\-data freshness, and feedback\-loop risks. * Experience building or scaling a platform used by many internal teams, including self\-service tooling. * Background in streaming, media, or consumer subscription products at global scale. * Comfort with privacy and governance constraints on user\-level data, such as consent, retention, and regional rules. * Experience hiring, developing, and retaining senior and staff engineers, and managing through ambiguity. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $525,000\.00 \- $950,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a principal reliability partner and technical authority across our infrastructure and platform teams, setting reliability standards and technical direction for the broader SRE practice. You'll operate across our hybrid infrastructure, on\-prem and cloud, and across both the application and infrastructure layers that keep our real\-time advertising platform running at scale, proactively surfacing systemic risks and driving meaningful architectural improvements while respecting each team's ownership of their own platforms. You come from a development background and bring deep experience running reliable, high\-throughput production systems at scale. Failure domains aren't just something you read about, they're something you think about constantly, and you know how to prevent them before they happen. You influence teams through technical credibility and clear communication, not authority, and the engineers you've mentored have gone on to become strong reliability practitioners. You treat every postmortem as a learning opportunity and every alert as a question waiting to be answered permanently. This role will be based in the **New York City** office. Our team follows a hybrid schedule working in\-office three days a week and remotely for the rest. **Each day can be different here at Nexxen, but some of the things you can expect to be doing daily are:** **What You'll Do** * Influence application and infrastructure teams across the engineering org on the reliability changes that matter most, translating postmortem findings, SLO burn rates, and architectural risk signals into concrete, prioritized engineering work that teams own and execute. * Mentor and develop SREs at every level, including senior engineers, providing structured code reviews, pairing on complex reliability investigations, and building the practice standards and career ladder that raise the reliability bar across the org. * Help drive Nexxen's AI strategy within the SRE space, exploring and championing AI\-powered tooling to strengthen proactive reliability practices and operational efficiency. * Drive latency and throughput improvements at both the code and infrastructure level, profiling hot paths, identifying inefficient patterns, and producing specific, actionable recommendations grounded in data. * Lead architectural reliability reviews and map failure domains across the platform, championing patterns such as circuit breakers, timeouts at every network boundary, queue\-based load levelling, and graceful degradation, so failure is contained, not cascading. * Design and validate reliability across our hybrid infrastructure, on\-prem data centers and AWS, spanning compute, storage, networking, and serverless technologies, balancing redundancy and headroom against infrastructure cost. * Drive reliability for our core data infrastructure, including high\-throughput streaming and messaging systems, distributed data stores, big\-data platforms, and enterprise storage systems, so these hold up under real\-time, high\-volume load. * Partner with teams on infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) and platform maturity, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and GitOps workflows, and automate repetitive operational work across deployment pipelines, canary releases, and rollback procedures. * Define and maintain SLIs and SLOs, and strengthen observability across the stack using tools like Datadog, including alerting, dashboards, structured logging, and distributed tracing, so engineers have the signal they need to understand production state before, during, and after incidents. * Lead the incident postmortem process to drive systemic fixes, and champion proactive failure testing, fault and latency injection, chaos experiments, and game days that expose weaknesses before production does. **What You'll Bring** * 8\+ years of software development and site reliability or production engineering experience, including a track record of leading reliability initiatives across multiple teams and measurably improving reliability, availability, and performance of complex distributed systems at scale. * Proven ability to influence without authority, a history of convincing application and infrastructure teams to make difficult reliability\-driven changes through technical credibility, clear data, and collaborative problem\-solving rather than mandates. * Mentorship track record: you've actively coached SREs at every level, including seniors, run structured learning initiatives, and can point to engineers whose reliability skills grew materially under your guidance. * Strong understanding of observability practices, structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting, with hands\-on experience with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent. * Code\-level performance expertise: you can identify the hot path and prescribe targeted fixes, whether that's asynchronous I/O, smarter caching, reduced all now when the fix belongs in the code versus the infrastructure. * Experience with AI\-assisted observability and agentic workflows (e.g., LLM\-based coding and ops copilots, AI\-driven runbooks) to accelerate triage and root\-cause analysis. * Deep hybrid cloud expertise, on\-prem infrastructure and AWS, including multi\-AZ and multi\-region resilience, auto scaling behavior under burst, and failover handling. * Hands\-on experience with distributed, high\-throughput data infrastructure, such as streaming and messaging systems, distributed NoSQL or in\-memory data stores, big\-data or analytics platforms, and enterprise\-grade storage systems. * A near\-obsessive interest in failure domains, you study how systems fail and maintain mental (or written) models of blast radius and cascade paths. * Proficiency with Linux internals, network diagnostics (tcpdump, netstat, curl, traceroute), and system\-level debugging under production conditions. * Solid SLO/SLI/error\-budget practice: you've defined them, defended them in engineering conversations, and used budget burn rates to drive prioritization decisions. * Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), and a clear\-eyed understanding of how infrastructure changes introduce reliability risk. * Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, CDN behavior, and how these layers contribute to reliability problems in distributed systems. * Experience with chaos engineering and failure injection: you've designed and run game days, not just read about them. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. In support of pay transparency and equity, the minimum and maximum full\-time annual base salary for this role is $175,000 \- $225,000 the time of posting, with the potential of an incentive or bonus. While this is our reasonable expectation this is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, education, certifications, responsibility, and geographic location. Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location. We offer a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, 401(k), EAP, parental leave, unlimited vacation, and company\-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available will vary depending on the state, start date, and employment type. Our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any questions you may have. \#LI\-DN1 \#LI\-Hybrid At Nexxen, we value our differences, varied experiences, and collective contribution. We know that not everyone takes the same career path, so if you don’t match this job description perfectly, don’t worry! We would rather see your application than risk missing out on your potential to make an impact. *For information about how we handle your personal information please view our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice* **Important Notice from Nexxen: Your Safety Matters** At Nexxen, we care about the well\-being of our current and future employees. Please be advised that Nexxen will never request payment (whether in cash, cryptocurrency, or any other form) as a condition of employment, offer positions that require you to invest in vague or dubious financial schemes, or promote roles that resemble get\-rich\-quick opportunities. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Nexxen or encounter a questionable job posting associated with our name, please contact us at infosec@nexxen.com to verify its legitimacy. Your trust is important to us. Stay safe and informed. Nexxen Fraud Alert and Notice: Protect Yourself from Impersonation and Fraudulent Activity

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Why NinjaTech AI** We are building the unmetered intelligence workforce: autonomous AI agents that do real, end\-to\-end work for enterprises instead of just answering questions. Since founding in 2022 we have gone from research to agents running production workloads inside real companies, on secure, isolated infrastructure, backed by SRI International, DCVC, and Candou Ventures. This is a small, senior team moving at startup speed on one of the most consequential problems in technology, and the Applied AI Engineer sits at the sharpest edge of it: your work lands in front of real customers in weeks, not quarters, and directly shapes how the world's most demanding enterprises adopt agentic AI. If you want the shortest possible line between what you build and the outcomes it creates, this is a rare seat. **Why this role exists** When we close a large enterprise deal, the contract is the start of the hard part, not the end. The customer has bought an outcome, an "unmetered intelligence workforce" doing real work inside their business, and someone has to make that outcome real, fast, inside their systems, their security constraints, and their messy data. That someone is the Applied AI Engineer. We attach an Applied AI Engineer to every large enterprise account. They embed with the customer, build the first high\-value agentic workflows on our platform, and own technical success from kickoff through go\-live and expansion. The Applied AI Engineer is how a signed contract becomes a renewed and expanded one. **What you'll own** * **Land the deployment.** Embed with a newly\-closed enterprise customer, rapidly learn their operations and data, and stand up the first production agent workflows on NinjaTech in weeks, not quarters. * **Build custom, tailored solutions.** Wire our platform into the customer's real systems (their data sources, identity, ticketing, CRMs, internal APIs) and build the bespoke automations, prompts, tools, and guardrails that make agents useful for their jobs\-to\-be\-done. * **Be the technical face of NinjaTech in the room.** Run working sessions with everyone from the customer's frontline operators to their CISO and CTO. Translate their vision into an architecture, and translate our platform into their language. * **Drive adoption and expansion.** A deployment that isn't used doesn't renew. Instrument usage, hunt for the next high\-value workflow, and turn a beachhead into an org\-wide rollout. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. jobs.title: Director of Software Development — DPU Networking and Storage
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Director of Software Development to lead a greenfield Data Processing Unit (DPU) initiative spanning networking and storage. You will build and scale multiple engineering teams, establish their charters and leadership structure, and guide a new platform from initial concepts into production. The initiative involves consequential decisions: which infrastructure functions belong on the host versus the DPU, how networking and storage acceleration should be sequenced, and how to preserve predictable performance and correctness through congestion, failures, and upgrades. You will ensure that architectural choices translate into measurable infrastructure benefits and a practical path to adoption. You will own the organization’s engineering priorities, resource allocation, leadership development, delivery commitments, and software readiness. Working with senior technical leaders, you will establish technical direction and resolve major tradeoffs while enabling them to lead detailed architectural development. With hardware and consuming service organizations, you will align dependencies, integration plans, and adoption milestones. We are looking for a leader with deep networking data plane expertise and familiarity across storage architectures and data paths. Substantial storage experience would be especially valuable. You should combine strong systems judgment with a record of developing managers, building engineering organizations, and delivering production infrastructure across organizational boundaries. **What you will lead** Set platform strategy and investment priorities. Establish a multiyear direction and phased roadmap grounded in service requirements. Decide which capabilities justify investment, balancing performance, infrastructure efficiency, engineering effort, operational cost, and integration complexity. Build the organization and its leadership. Define team boundaries and ownership, recruit engineering managers and senior technical talent, and establish workforce plans. Develop managers through coaching, clear expectations, and feedback. Build succession plans and leadership depth as the initiative grows. Guide consequential technical decisions. Partner with senior engineers to establish a coherent architecture across networking, storage, software, firmware, and hardware interfaces. Ensure critical assumptions are tested through prototypes and representative benchmarks. Resolve cross\-team tradeoffs without becoming a bottleneck for detailed design decisions. Own integrated execution. Translate strategy into coordinated commitments across teams. Allocate engineering capacity, sequence dependencies, and manage risks involving scope, schedule, technical debt, and hardware readiness. Communicate decisions and progress clearly, and adjust plans as evidence changes. Connect technical performance to infrastructure value. Establish measurable goals for throughput, tail latency, storage I/O performance, reliability, and resource efficiency. Evaluate whether offload benefits justify the additional platform complexity, including host resources recovered and the engineering and operational effort required. Drive production readiness and adoption. Own readiness of the software your organization builds, including qualification, observability, compatibility, safe upgrades, fault isolation, and recovery. jobs.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is looking for a Senior Robotics Software Engineer to develop software for physical robots, turn operational data into useful evidence, and integrate AI models into robotic applications. The OCI Robotics Cloud team connects robot operations, simulation, datasets, and AI model workflows. In this role, you will build the software that captures what a robot observes and does, runs models on robot or edge computers, and helps engineers reproduce failures and evaluate improvements. You will independently own defined components from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support. You will work with robotics, simulation, and research engineers to make robot behavior reliable and measurable. This role requires direct experience developing and debugging software on physical robots. **What you will do*** Develop and maintain robotics software in **Python and/or C\+\+** , including robot application logic, sensor and actuator interfaces, and model execution components. * Build tools to collect, synchronize, inspect, replay, and analyze **robot operational data** , including images, sensor measurements, robot state, commands, trajectories, and task outcomes. * Preserve timestamps, calibration, coordinate frames, observation and action definitions, software versions, and data provenance so recordings can support reproducible tests and robotics datasets. * Integrate **AI models and robot policies** into physical robot workflows. Validate model inputs and outputs, optimize inference latency and resource use, and implement diagnostics and recovery behavior. * Debug failures across robot software, sensors, controllers, and model runtimes using recorded evidence and supervised tests on hardware. * Define component tests and task\-level metrics, compare software and model versions, and investigate the causes of changes in robot behavior. * Work with simulation engineers to reproduce physical failures in simulation and validate the observation, action, timing, and controller interfaces used by learned policies. * Deliver maintainable components with clear designs, automated tests, documentation, code review, and operational diagnostics. Communicate dependencies and technical tradeoffs early. * Use AI\-assisted development and specification\-driven workflows while checking generated code and experimental results for correctness. **Required qualifications*** A bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * At least **three years of software development experience** , including substantial direct work on robotics software or systems. * Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on **physical robots** , with clear examples of your own implementation work and measured results. * Strong programming skills in **Python and/or C\+\+** and experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting software on Linux. * Working knowledge of robotics fundamentals, including coordinate transforms, odometry, kinematics, feedback control, sensor calibration, and timing constraints. * Experience working with robot sensor, state, and action data, including timestamp alignment, calibration, missing data, and reproducible recording or replay. * Experience integrating AI/ML models or policies into robotic applications, including input preprocessing, output interpretation, inference, and evaluation using PyTorch or a comparable framework. * Practical experience optimizing model inference with **TensorRT** , including measuring latency, resource use, and output correctness on the target hardware. * Ability to independently deliver a defined software component, investigate failures across its interfaces, and explain design decisions and validation results. * Familiarity with ROS 2 or vendor robot SDKs, including communication, transforms, and timing diagnostics. **Preferred qualifications*** Experience with Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo or Nav2 for reproducing robot behavior and validating software changes. * Experience with teleoperation demonstrations, rosbag2, MCAP, LeRobot , or robotics dataset curation and versioning. * Experience with perception, manipulation, localization, navigation, motion control, or deployment of learned robot policies. * Experience with GPU\-equipped robot or edge computers, containers, and automated testing for robotics software. **Why join us** You will help turn real robot operations into better software, more useful datasets, and dependable AI applications. Your work will connect simulation and learning advances to measurable results on physical robots

jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will address system\-level questions such as host\-versus\-DPU responsibilities, predictable tail latency under mixed workloads, and correct behavior across offload transitions, failures, and upgrades. You will own a major subsystem spanning components and teams. Depending on the assignment, that could include a storage I/O pipeline, packet processing pipeline, host\-to\-DPU data path, or infrastructure acceleration subsystem. You will define architectural boundaries, align component owners, and remain accountable for integration and subsystem outcomes. We welcome engineers with deep storage data path expertise and working familiarity with networking, or deep networking data path expertise and working familiarity with storage. Your primary ownership will draw on your strengths while requiring collaboration across both domains. **What you will do** * **Own subsystem architecture and outcomes.** Turn ambiguous system requirements into an architecture, component contracts, and a phased delivery plan. Establish decision authority and resolve tradeoffs that individual component owners cannot settle independently. * **Shape foundational data path decisions.** Evaluate partitioning across host, DPU software, firmware, and hardware. Validate choices about queueing, memory ownership, acceleration, and recovery through prototypes and representative workloads. * **Lead delivery across component owners.** Decompose subsystem work, align technical dependencies, and resolve integration risks across teams. Guide implementation through other engineers while personally implementing or debugging critical paths. * **Set end\-to\-end performance expectations.** Establish subsystem budgets and targets for throughput, tail latency, resource efficiency, and relevant storage I/O or packet processing metrics. Resolve bottlenecks that span component boundaries. * **Connect storage and networking architecture.** Work with engineers in both domains to evaluate I/O processing, transport, ordering, buffering, backpressure, and recovery tradeoffs. Ensure local optimizations preserve end\-to\-end performance, availability, and data integrity. * **Own integration and production readiness.** Lead subsystem qualification and technical readiness reviews. Establish compatible interfaces, observability, fault isolation, and safe upgrade behavior; resolve systemic risks during rollout and operation. * **Develop component owners.** Mentor engineers in architectural judgment and systems debugging. Establish shared engineering practices and help component leaders make sound decisions independently. * **Establish reusable AI practices.** Guide effective AI use across subsystem engineering work, with validation and clear accountability. Share approaches that improve quality and productivity, reduce repetitive debugging and documentation, and support employee well\-being. **Required qualifications** =========================== * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands\-on experience building high\-performance storage data paths or networking data paths. * Demonstrated technical ownership of a major subsystem spanning multiple components and engineering teams, from ambiguous requirements through production integration. * Deep expertise in either storage data path architecture, implementation, and optimization, or networking data path architecture, implementation, and optimization. Relevant experience may include storage I/O pipelines, block storage or storage transport, or high\-performance packet processing and network virtualization. * Strong hands\-on C or C\+\+ expertise and deep knowledge of Linux, synchronization, memory management, multicore architectures, and performance analysis. * Working familiarity with the complementary domain: networking fundamentals and transport behavior for storage specialists, or storage I/O architecture and behavior for networking specialists. Ability to evaluate cross\-domain performance and failure interactions with partner engineers. * Experience defining component boundaries and contracts, establishing performance budgets, and resolving cross\-component correctness and reliability issues. * A record of driving technical alignment and delivery across teams while remaining actively involved in implementation and difficult debugging. * Ability to explain complex architectural decisions and develop other engineers into effective component owners. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** ============================ Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required. * **DPU architecture \-** DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies; software, firmware, and hardware interface design. * **Packet processing \-** Architecture or substantial extension of DPDK\-based systems or comparable user\-space packet processing frameworks. * **Storage data paths \-** Storage I/O pipeline design or optimization, block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization. * **Hardware and production \-** Hardware co\-design, PCIe, DMA, SR\-IOV, IOMMU, zero\-copy techniques, fleet qualification, failure recovery, or upgrade compatibility. **What success looks like** You will establish a coherent subsystem architecture, align component owners, and deliver successful integration with measured end\-to\-end results. You will resolve systemic risks early, lead consequential cross\-team decisions, and strengthen the technical judgment of the engineers around you. **Why join us** =============== Influence foundational architecture while remaining deeply involved in engineering. You will have ownership of how a substantial part of the platform fits together, performs, and reaches production, working with experienced networking, storage, and hardware partners.

practices. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead incident response, explain technical tradeoffs, and influence engineering priorities. **Key Responsibilities** jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Pantograph** is building general purpose robots by training models on internet\-scale video. We believe the path to capable robots runs through general intelligence rather than narrow, robot\-specific skills. We believe there is an enormous amount of work worth doing in the physical world that would make life better for people. As AI models make it easier to build software around our needs, we believe robots can give people that same power to shape the physical world. Across research, hardware, and software, we believe in finding simple ideas that work, doing them extremely well, and scaling them up. We value clear thinking, careful execution, and systems we can understand, trust, and improve. We're looking for an experienced software engineer to design and build the internal infrastructure that powers our customer\-facing product. You'll work closely with our product, interface, and robot software teams to build shared APIs, services, and infrastructure for accounts, access, messaging, payments, and data hosting. This is an internal platform engineering role, rather than a forward\-deployed role building integrations or managing individual customer deployments. You'll own these systems: developing shared services, keeping databases and infrastructure reliable, and improving how we build, test, and deploy software. Your work will give our team a strong foundation for building and shipping the robot product as our customer base grows. A robotics background is not a requirement. jobs.title: Software Architect Remote — Full-time Remote US / Alpharetta, GA
jobs.description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. We’re looking for a Software Architect who wants to do more than design systems on a whiteboard. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys setting technical direction and writing the code that brings that direction to life. You’ll own the architecture of enterprise applications, including how services are designed, how data flows, how systems integrate, and how applications scale securely and reliably. You’ll also help shape how AI becomes part of our products, building solutions that combine traditional software architecture with LLM\-powered capabilities and intelligent agents. This role is ideal for an experienced architect, technical lead, or senior engineer who still loves to build and wants meaningful influence over both architecture and execution. ### **What You'll Do** ### **Design and Build** * Own application architecture across services, APIs, identity, data access, and integrations. * Write production code regularly across back\-end services, APIs, and front\-end applications. * Build new services and features from initial design through deployment and production support. * Design scalable, reliable, secure, and multi\-tenant applications. * Create prototypes and proofs of concept, then turn the strongest ideas into production\-ready solutions. * Help modernize legacy applications toward cloud\-native architectures while maintaining ongoing product delivery. ### **Build AI into the Product** * Develop AI\-powered capabilities using LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and agents. * Design APIs and application capabilities that can be securely used by AI agents, including through protocols such as MCP. * Implement evaluation, guardrails, and cost monitoring to ensure AI features are reliable, safe, and sustainable in production. * Help determine where AI adds meaningful value and where traditional software solutions are the better approach. ### **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Review code, pair with engineers, and help solve complex technical problems. * Establish strong engineering practices around automated testing, observability, security, performance, and resilience. * Use modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality. * Create architecture decision records and reference implementations that engineering teams can put into practice. * Partner closely with Product, UX, QA, Security, and DevOps to turn business goals into scalable technical solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of software development experience, including 2\+ years in an architect, technical lead, or senior engineering role with ownership of system design. * Strong hands\-on development skills and recent experience contributing production code. * Experience designing and operating multi\-tenant SaaS or enterprise applications. * Experience building AI\-powered features using LLMs, ideally including RAG, agents, tool/function calling, or structured outputs. * Deep expertise in at least one modern development language such as C\#/.NET, Java, TypeScript, or Python, with working knowledge of another. * Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as React or Angular.Strong knowledge of microservices, event\-driven architecture, domain\-driven design, and API design. * Experience with Azure or AWS, containers, Kubernetes, and/or serverless architectures. * Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data design, messaging platforms such as Kafka or Service Bus, and caching strategies. * Understanding of modern identity and application security, including OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, RBAC, OWASP practices, and secure handling of data used with AI models. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, automated testing, and performance optimization. ### **How You Work** You’re an architect who likes to stay close to the technology. You can move from an architecture discussion to a pull request, explain complex technical trade\-offs to both engineers and business partners, and help teams turn good ideas into working software. You’re also comfortable using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as part of your everyday engineering workflow, while knowing when AI is useful and when a simpler deterministic solution is the better choice. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration or AI evaluation pipelines. * Experience with fine\-tuning or open\-weight/smaller language models. * Experience modernizing legacy or acquired products into a more unified platform. * Experience working in PCI DSS, SOC 2, or GDPR environments. * Background in retail, payments, loyalty, or supply chain software. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, Azure AI Engineer, or AWS Solutions Architect. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. Performs field and laboratory testing of transmission, distribution, generation, and substation equipment using established procedures, standards, and test methods. Supports engineering investigations involving equipment failures, safety incidents, asset performance concerns, and wildfire\-related events. Evaluates electrical equipment, including transformers, circuit breakers, batteries, cables, insulators, grounding systems, instrument transformers, capacitors, regulators, and related apparatus. Collects, analyzes, and documents test data, equipment condition information, inspection findings, and operational data. Supports grounding and touch potential assessments, arc\-flash studies, cable diagnostics, transmission line measurements, and equipment condition assessments. Assists with failure and root\-cause investigations through testing, equipment history review, technical analysis, and documentation of findings. Supports development and evaluation of test methods, procedures, acceptance criteria, and condition assessment approaches. Supports evaluation and deployment of monitoring, sensing, diagnostic, and data acquisition technologies for electric utility assets. Adheres to Company safety, quality, and applicable regulatory requirements. Participates in technical initiatives and knowledge\-sharing activities. jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Discovery
jobs.description: 46751 New York, NY, US, 10036 Technology New York Full\-Time Fully Remote **Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.** Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator\-first, audience\-focused, tech\-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next\-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! Consumer Platform Engineering owns the API layer that sits between Paramount's client apps (Web, iOS, Android, Roku, CTV, Apple TV, Fire TV, and more) and the downstream content, identity, and commerce systems that power them. The org is organized into three domains — Identity \& Commerce, Experiences, and Discovery. Discovery domain engineers build and operate the backend services powering content discovery across search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata. Our systems focus on helping viewers discover content at scale—delivering low\-latency, high\-concurrency services across millions of devices ranging from legacy TVs to modern streaming boxes. Role Summary We are hiring a Lead Engineer to be the senior technical anchor for a team of backend engineers building the services that power content discovery across Pluto TV and Paramount\+. You will drive architecture and design for the domain's most complex initiatives, set the technical bar through hands\-on coding and code/design review, and mentor engineers — while partnering with your Engineering Manager, Product, Data Science \& Personalization, and adjacent platform domains to ship performant services that drive viewer engagement. This is a senior individual\-contributor role: you lead through technical depth and influence, not through formal people\-management authority. Responsibilities Technical Leadership \& Architecture \- \- \- \- Drive the architecture and design for the domain's backend services and APIs (search, browse, recommendations, editorial curation, and content metadata), balancing feature delivery against platform health, scalability, and technical debt. Serve as the hands\-on technical authority in design reviews — making the call on service boundaries, caching strategies, and data models for high\-throughput systems, and staying close enough to the code to lead by example. Break large\-scale architectural initiatives (such as personalization engine overhauls and new recommendation surfaces) into shippable, measurable phases, and personally lead delivery of the highest\-complexity or highest\-risk pieces. Set and enforce engineering standards for the team: code quality, testing practices, API design conventions, and documentation. Operational Ownership \- \- \- Ensure backend services meet availability, low\-latency, and high\-concurrency targets for APIs consumed across Pluto TV and Paramount\+ client apps. Lead on\-call engineering practices, incident response, and postmortems for the team's services; be the senior escalation point for the most complex production issues. Define, track, and optimize operational KPIs (p99 latency, error rates, cache hit ratios, and API adoption), and drive the technical investments needed to keep them healthy. Cross\-functional Partnership \- \- \- Partner with Product Management and the Data Science \& Personalization teams as the technical voice for the domain, translating engagement goals into concrete technical designs. Represent the team in cross\-functional and cross\-domain technical discussions with Identity \& Commerce and Experiences, ensuring backend APIs integrate cleanly with entitlement, playback, and UI client layers. Communicate technical trade\-offs, design decisions, and risks clearly to your Engineering Manager, peer leads, and non\-technical stakeholders. Technical Mentorship \& Team Enablement \- Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design pairing, and hands\-on guidance — raising the technical level of the team over time. \- Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical aspects of hiring (interviewing, technical bar\-raising) and onboarding new engineers. \- \- Foster a culture of technical ownership and operational accountability, giving engineers context and room to drive their own implementation decisions. Support coordination with distributed or offshore engineering partners on technical execution and design alignment. Process \& Delivery \- \- Contribute to and help run agile workflows (sprint   at navigating competing priorities across cross\-functional groups, including Product Management, Data Science \& Personalization, and adjacent platform teams. Comfortable working alongside geographically distributed engineering teams across time zones, including partner or offshore engineering teams. Mindset \- \- \- Strong bias toward incremental, measurable delivery over big\-bang system launches. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist
jobs.description: Build AI That Could Help Transform the Future of Medicine Frontier AI is changing what’s possible in science, and few places let you apply it to a problem as consequential as human health. Pfizer is one of them. We have decades of world\-class biology and chemistry, rich biomedical data and the global reach to get medicines to patients. We are pairing them with the newest advances in AI and we are doing it along with the world’s leaders in building medicine. At Pfizer, we believe the next generation of scientific breakthroughs will be powered by advances in artificial intelligence. From foundation models and multimodal learning to biological reasoning and agentic systems, AI has the potential to fundamentally change how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines to patients. As a Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist, you will help create the scientific foundations behind that future at Pfizer. We are not looking for one clever model for one clever problem or applying existing models to a single problem. You will develop, extend, and rigorously evaluate advanced AI methods that generate new scientific insights, accelerate experimentation, and enable better decision\-making across the drug discovery and development lifecycle. We are building AI that compounds. A method, benchmark or model that works in one disease area should become a foundation that can impact across oncology, immunology/inflammation, internal medicine, vaccines and beyond. You’ll design for that! Working alongside world\-class AI researchers, computational biologists, engineers, and domain experts, you'll tackle some of the most challenging and meaningful problems in healthcare while building technology that has the potential to impact millions of patients worldwide. **Why This Role Is Different** **Own Meaningful Scientific Challenges:** You will own defined model components, benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and research workflows that directly influence how AI is applied across Pfizer's R\&D organization. You'll build the models, and you'll also decide whether they create real scientific value and whether that value holds up in new contexts. **Where you will push the frontier:** You'll contribute to cutting\-edge research across areas such as: * Foundation models and representation learning. * Multimodal learning across molecular, imaging, clinical and omics data * Agentic AI and scientific reasoning systems * Biological Sequence \& Structure Modeling * Graph learning and knowledge graphs * Clinical \& Real\-World Data Modeling * Uncertainty\-Aware AI, causal ML and Interpretability **Create Impact Beyond Research Papers** Publishing matters, but the goal is bigger. Your work will help scientists understand disease biology, prioritize experiments, and evaluate therapeutic opportunities across the portfolio. It will speed up medicines for the people waiting on them. **Work at the frontier, with the people who can ship it to patients.** You'll collaborate with AI researchers, computational biologists, engineers, and clinical and domain experts. Together you'll push state\-of\-the\-art methods into real discovery programs, where the data is proprietary and the stakes are real. **Help invent how science gets done** We're building an AI\-native operating model.
