jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Creative Experiences
jobs.description: Open to full\-time hires and interns. **About the role** ------------------ At Pika, we're looking for a creative, hands\-on AI researcher who can turn the latest models, APIs, and emerging ideas into compelling experiences people want to try and share. You'll combine models across image, video, audio, and language to build workflows, demos, and features that bring people to Pika and contribute to revenue growth. This is a goal\-driven applied research role, open to both full\-time hires and interns. You'll take ideas from an initial opportunity through experimentation, implementation, and delivery, then use feedback and results to decide what to improve next. Strong creative judgment, resourcefulness, and fast execution are central to the role. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Find promising opportunities. Stay close to new models, tools, creative formats, and cultural trends. Identify ideas with a clear audience, use case, and potential to drive interest, website traffic, or revenue. * Build end to end. Combine existing models, APIs, and tools into working multimodal workflows. Own the path from a rough concept to a usable demo, creative asset, or product experience. * Choose the right amount of research. Test practical approaches quickly. Use lightweight LoRA fine\-tuning or targeted post\-training when it meaningfully improves the result and fits the project's time budget. * Deliver frequently. Work in short iteration cycles, set a clear scope for each experiment, and get strong first versions out quickly. Make thoughtful trade\-offs between additional research, output quality, cost, and time to delivery. * Create work ready to share. Produce compelling demos and creative outputs that the team can use for social media, launches, and other growth efforts. Personally posting on or managing social channels is not required. * Learn from results. Use audience response, product feedback, and relevant traffic or revenue signals to decide which ideas to refine, expand, or stop. * Make successful work reusable. Leave working workflows, examples, and concise documentation so the team can reproduce and build on what you deliver. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience building with generative AI models, APIs, or creative workflows, with examples of work you have taken from idea to a working result. * Strong prototyping and coding skills: you can connect tools, debug a pipeline, and make an end\-to\-end experience work. * A creative, entrepreneurial mindset and good judgment about what makes an output compelling, useful, and worth sharing. You enjoy the pace and resourcefulness of a hackathon: testing ideas quickly and getting a working result into people's hands. * Curiosity across modalities and the ability to learn unfamiliar models and tools quickly. * Ownership and comfort with tight timelines: you can prioritize, simplify an approach, and recognize when shipping and learning is more valuable than further polishing. * A clear connection between technical choices and the intended user or business outcome. **Helpful experience** ---------------------- * Experience as a startup founder or early\-stage startup team member, or actively building and testing startup ideas. * Hackathon wins or standout hackathon projects that demonstrate rapid prototyping, resourcefulness, and end\-to\-end execution. * LoRA fine\-tuning, lightweight model adaptation, or other targeted post\-training. * Combining image, video, audio, or language models in a single workflow. * Building creative demos, interactive prototypes, or AI experiences that reached real users. **What success looks like** --------------------------- You deliver a steady stream of compelling, usable experiments; turn the strongest ideas into repeatable workflows; and use each release to learn what attracts users and contributes to Pika's growth. Success depends on the quality, speed, and impact of what you deliver.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ At Pika, we're looking for a technically strong, client\-facing AI researcher who can turn customer feedback into models and workflows that solve real business needs. You'll work directly with clients to understand what they want to achieve, identify where current model outputs fall short, and fine\-tune or post\-train models for their use cases. When the solution calls for more than model adaptation, you'll build the supporting workflow. This is a full\-time, hands\-on, revenue\-driven applied research role. Clear communication, professional client service, reliable delivery, and independent execution matter as much as technical ability. You'll help clients get value quickly, build their confidence in working with Pika, and help turn successful technical work into closed engagements and ongoing business. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Understand the client's needs. Listen carefully, ask focused questions, and translate requests and feedback into a clear problem, practical scope, and agreed success criteria. * Adapt models for real use cases. Fine\-tune and post\-train models to address client needs. Prepare relevant examples and evaluation criteria, diagnose gaps, and verify that each iteration improves the outcomes the client cares about. * Build the complete solution. Create or adapt workflows around models when needed, connecting APIs, tools, and processing steps into a usable solution that fits the client's deployment needs. * Iterate quickly with clients. Share working results early, gather specific feedback, and make focused improvements in short cycles. Balance quality, complexity, cost, and delivery speed to keep projects moving. * Communicate professionally. Explain technical options and limitations clearly, set realistic expectations, respond thoughtfully to requests, and keep clients informed about progress and next steps. Build a relationship that makes them want to continue working with Pika. * Own execution and coordinate with the team. Drive day\-to\-day work with independence while keeping teammates aligned on requirements, priorities, progress, and blockers. Ask for input or escalate risks early when needed. * Deliver for deployment. Help move successful experiments into usable deployments, with clear evaluation results, reproducible workflows, and the documentation needed for handoff. * Help close client engagements. Demonstrate the solution's value, address technical concerns, and work with the team to turn successful iterations into client commitments and revenue. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning or post\-training generative AI models, with the ability to diagnose model behavior and evaluate whether an adaptation solves the intended problem. * Strong coding and practical ML skills: you can implement experiments, work with data, debug model pipelines, and build supporting workflows. * Excellent listening and communication skills. You can understand an ambiguous request, clarify what matters, and explain technical work to clients with different levels of expertise. * Professional judgment, reliability, and a service mindset. You handle feedback constructively, communicate limitations honestly, take ownership of commitments, and build trust through consistent follow\-through. * Independence and ownership, combined with strong communication and collaboration within the team. * The ability to work in fast feedback cycles, prioritize the highest\-impact improvements, and connect technical decisions to client value and commercial outcomes. **Preferred experience** ------------------------ * Prior professional experience in a similar client\-facing AI or ML role, with end\-to\-end delivery from requirements and model adaptation through evaluation, integration, and deployment. This experience is strongly preferred. * Delivering reliable AI solutions for external clients or users and supporting them through feedback and iteration. * LoRA fine\-tuning, other parameter\-efficient adaptation methods, or feedback\-driven post\-training. * Building model evaluation pipelines, API integrations, or workflows used in a deployed product. * Participating in customer demos, technical pilots, or the delivery of paid projects. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Success is measured by how well you serve clients, how quickly you turn feedback into useful improvements, and how reliably your work meets their deployment needs. Strong performance builds client trust, helps close engagements, encourages continued collaboration, and contributes to revenue.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Overview: Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively. As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next\-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution. Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide. **Why Join Planview?** At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500\+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world\-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works. Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X. **\#LI\-HYBRID****\#LI\-CG1** Responsibilities: * Implement clearly defined software changes for product features, following established designs, team practices, and guidance from senior engineers. * Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to help write readable, testable code and add or update automated tests; review and validate generated output to support reliable delivery. * Assist with testing, debugging, and resolving software issues; consider how changes may affect related parts of the application. * Participate in code reviews, planning, and estimation for assigned work; ask questions, incorporate feedback, and raise risks when they arise. * Collaborate with Product, Quality Engineering, Customer Care, Technical Support, and other partners to understand requirements and help investigate customer\-reported issues. * Follow the team’s software development lifecycle, security, and compliance practices. Qualifications: * Foundational knowledge of software development concepts and a willingness to learn and apply them in a production codebase. * Familiarity with one or more programming languages; familiarity with .NET is a plus. * Basic understanding of data structures and algorithms, and awareness that changes can affect related parts of a system. * Familiarity with standard software practices such as version control, code review, testing, and the software development lifecycle. * Ability to assist with testing and debugging and to communicate questions, findings, and estimates for assigned work. * Collaborative communication skills and interest in working with a distributed, cross\-functional team. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best\-in\-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

jobs.title: Head of Product Engineering
jobs.description: **About Plaud Inc.** Plaud is building the real\-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 3,000,000 users worldwide since 2023\. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity. Plaud Inc. is a Delaware\-incorporated, San Francisco\-based company. With GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and EN 18031 compliance, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection. To learn more about Plaud, please visit https://www.plaud.ai and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube. **Why You Should Join Us** Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think. * Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years. * Define the next\-gen paradigm for human\-AI interaction. * Gain exposure to cutting\-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion. * Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success. * Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development. * Market\-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity\-fueled work atmosphere. You would lead the engineering teams behind our core product: the apps that connect to Plaud devices and record conversations, AI transcription and summaries, shared workspaces and collaboration, and admin tools for business customers. Your teams work across the US and Asia, and you'd own how fast and how well we ship one product across hardware, mobile, web and desktop. **What you will do** * Define and drive the engineering strategy for Plaud's core product: device connection and recording, AI transcription and summaries, shared workspaces and collaboration, admin tools for business customers, and later growth. Each team builds for every customer, from free users to large enterprises. * Lead, mentor and grow the engineering leads of every product team across the US and Asia, through hiring, coaching and a high bar for craft and delivery. * Own engineering velocity and quality across the product teams, shortening the path from idea to shipped feature on mobile, web, desktop and the device handoff. * Partner closely with Product, Design, Platform and Infrastructure to turn priorities into a single roadmap and dated commitments. * Establish clear end\-to\-end ownership, so every service, handoff and on\-call rotation has one owning team, and teams run what they build. * Build an operating model for teams that span time zones, with written specs and a fixed daily overlap, and move each team toward a single time zone over time. * Drive AI\-native engineering across every team, including evals in CI/CD, AI\-assisted development and fast experiments on AI features. * Be the Platform team's main internal customer: use shared services instead of rebuilding them, and give regular feedback on what Platform delivers. * Resolve technical disputes between teams quickly and in writing. **Skills, qualifications and experience we look for** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading managers of multi\-team product engineering organizations (40\+ engineers). * Proven track record shipping consumer or prosumer products across mobile, web and desktop. Hardware\-connected or AI\-heavy products are highly preferred. * Demonstrated success leading distributed teams across the US and Asia, with a clear operating model for teams that span time zones. * Strong technical depth: able to review architectures, challenge estimates and unblock complex projects hands\-on. * Experience shipping LLM\-powered features in production, including prompts, retrieval, evals, and cost and quality tradeoffs. * Track record of raising delivery velocity while keeping quality and team health high, backed by metrics. * Excellent cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills with Product, Design, executives and engineers. **What we offer** * **Meaningful Ownership** An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) that gives a real stake in Plaud’s long\-term success. * **High\-Impact Environment** Work in a fast\-moving, product\-driven environment where your ideas directly shape the future of AI productivity. * **Cutting\-Edge AI Tools for Productivity** Access to best\-in\-class AI tools, including Gemini, Claude Code, and other frontier AI systems to maximize engineering and execution efficiency. * **Best\-in\-Class Equipment** Choice of top\-spec laptops, high\-performance workstation setups, and cutting\-edge Plaud devices for all new hires. * **Team \& Culture** Annual company offsites, team events, and a culture that values craftsmanship, ownership, and velocity. ***Disclaimer****: Plaud is and will continue to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform
jobs.description: Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home. As a leader in the home services software\-as\-a\-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home\-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies. In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED. **Job Title:** Senior Platform Engineer \- AI Platform **Location:** United States **Workplace Type:** Remote **Job Summary** The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our **Senior Platform Engineer \- AI Platform**. ISN is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to lead AI\-first platform work at the intersection of agentic systems and production infrastructure. You'll design and ship the systems that let agents and LLMs do real work inside a high\-volume product — spanning scheduling, report intake, customer communication, billing workflows, and data extraction. You'll also own the foundation underneath it: our PHP application, AWS/ECS infrastructure, and MySQL/Aurora data layer. This role offers unusual latitude to define how AI works at ISN, backed by the scale and stability of Porch Group and the data of a category\-leading home inspection software platform. **What You Will Do As A Senior Platform Engineer \- AI Platform** * Build AI features end to end — retrieval, context engineering, structured output, tool/function calling, and evaluation harnesses that measure whether a change actually made things better * Design and operate agent orchestration systems — multi\-agent and multi\-step workflows including task decomposition, tool routing, state and memory, retries and fallbacks, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and guardrails against failure modes that don't look like exceptions * Operate non\-deterministic systems responsibly — tracing, evals in CI, prompt and model versioning, token and latency budgets, model routing, and cost controls * Own ECS container platform operations — service definitions, task sizing, autoscaling, blue/green deploys, and orchestration for both long\-running services and async workers * Architect AWS infrastructure — event\-driven and serverless pipelines (Lambda, SQS/SNS/EventBridge), IAM and network design, all managed as infrastructure as code * Build and extend services in our production PHP codebase, integrating AI capability into existing product surfaces without destabilizing them * Drive database performance at scale — schema design, indexing, replication and read scaling, zero\-downtime migrations, and query performance work across MySQL and Aurora * Raise the bar across the team through code review, design docs, mentorship, incident response, and on\-call participation **What You Will Bring As A Senior Platform Engineer \- AI Platform** * 10\+ years building and running production software, with real ownership of systems at scale * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-backed features — not just API calls, but agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation, and the operational discipline to keep them working * Strong PHP (8\.x) skills in a mature, high\-traffic codebase * Deep AWS architecture experience with hands\-on ECS operations, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), and CI/CD * Expert\-level relational database skills with MySQL and/or Aurora — able to read an execution plan and act on it * Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, observability, and application security * Clear written communication and sound judgment about tradeoffs, especially where AI is the wrong tool for the job * Nice to have: Go, MCP or comparable agent\-tooling standards, vector search and embedding pipelines, Kubernetes, document and image extraction pipelines, or real estate/proptech/field\-services domain experience The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 11/9/2026\. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs. At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia. **What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member** *Pay Range:*\* $168,800 – $236,300 annually * *Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job\-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.* Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long\-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals. Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. * Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3\) Medical plan options, two (2\) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose. * Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis. * We offer pre\-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options. * We provide company paid Basic Life and AD\&D, Short and Long\-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD\&D plans. * Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match. * Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation. * LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year\-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more. * Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company\-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-NH1 **What’s next?** Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have! Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. Porch Group is an E\-Verify employer. E\-Verify is a web\-based system that allows an employer to determine an employee's eligibility to work in the US using information reported on an employee's Form I\-9\. The E\-Verify system confirms eligibility with both the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). For more information, please go to the USCIS E\-Verify website.

jobs.title: Power System Simulation Software Developer
jobs.description: Our Values **Guiding principles for excellence** ------------------------------------- Our values drive us to deliver outstanding solutions and make a lasting impact within the power industry. #### **Quality** Strive for excellence in all services and operations, ensuring we can proudly deliver the highest standard of service to customers. #### **Innovation** Be proactive, open and adaptable to evolving technological, regulatory and market environments. #### **Integrity** Be accountable in delivering industry\-leading products and services with a clear focus on accurate, reliable and timely results. #### **Customer Focus** Actively engage with peers and clients to understand their needs, provide creative solutions, and build strong relationships through collaborative teamwork. **Why work at PowerGEM?** ------------------------- Work with some of the brightest minds in the industry. At PowerGEM, we foster an innovative environment where you can thrive. As part of our team, you’ll help shape the future of energy. * Collaborate with top industry experts and thought leaders * Succeed in a culture that encourages creativity and forward thinking * Enjoy competitive compensation while making an impact Research \& Development Power System Simulation Software Developer United States: Remote Full time We are seeking a talented and motivated software developer with a power system engineering background to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a foundation in power systems engineering coursework and an interest in software development. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects involving PowerGEM’s TARA software. #### **Key Responsibilities:** * Learn how to conduct power system steady\-state simulations and studies. * Support transmission owners, generation developers, and ISOs with TARA usage and TARA\-based studies. * Design, development and implementation of application and computational methods related to steady\- state power system analysis software for PowerGEM TARA software. * Conduct research and analysis to identify opportunities for improving the performance and efficiency of our solutions. * Participate in the testing, documentation debugging, and optimization of software applications to ensure reliability and scalability. * Develop and implement testing protocols and procedures for software applications, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements. * Perform unit tests, integration tests, and system tests to validate the functionality and performance of software components. Document test results, identify defects, and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues in a timely manner. * Provide user support and participate in TARA training. * Assist in marketing and delivering software and software projects. * May be asked to participate or assist with consulting projects performed by PowerGEM consulting department utilizing developed TARA software. #### **Key Attributes \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s, master’s or Ph.D. in electrical engineering * One to three years of experience as a power system operations/planning engineer or similar position (recent college grads are encouraged to apply) * Familiarity with programming in one or more of the following languages is a plus: C/C\+\+, C\#, Python * Coursework in power systems analysis related to power grid planning or operations, modeling techniques, and computational algorithms * Experience using PowerGEM’s software applications is a plus. * Experience with an industry tool used for power system simulations, such as PowerGEM TARA, Siemens PSS/E and MUST, PSLF, DSA tools, PowerWorld or similar, is a plus. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Authorization to work in the United States

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer – AI Healthcare
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Premier Global Links LLC is seeking a talented **Full Stack Engineer** for an innovative healthcare technology company developing AI\-powered clinical software and ambient documentation solutions. This role offers the opportunity to build and scale applications that help healthcare professionals reduce administrative work and focus more on patient care. jobs.title: Generalist Software Engineer(s)
jobs.description: **About Pylon** America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand. We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API. Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury. Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it. Join us in building **America’s mortgage rails**. At Pylon, we’re a small team building a very ambitious product in the mortgage space. At this early stage, we’re looking for engineers who can see the opportunity of what we’re building towards and want to have a hand in building it. We're in search of people who find difficult problems invigorating and who fit well into a high\-performing team built on mutual respect and reliance. If you like pushing yourself to learn a massive amount while shipping code that has a huge impact on the end product, Pylon Engineering could be a great place for you. **About you** ------------- You: * **Have strong opinions that you’re willing to defend.** We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on technical decisions. We’ll push you to defend your choices, and we want you to push back. * **Don't settle.** Challenge yourself to frequently and consistently deliver exceptional code. If something could be better, take the initiative to improve it. * **Have great ideas, and lots of them.** You should see opportunities all around you to make the code, product and infrastructure better. We’ll give you an environment where you can act on those ideas. * **Are self\-motivated.** You can take a goal and drive towards it without needing extensive hand\-holding. The team is supportive and loves to share knowledge and advice, but there’s no time for micromanaging your work. * **Are comfortable with ambiguity.** There's a million ways to do things; you should feel at ease making a decision under uncertainty while balancing competing constraints. * **Are confident you can learn quickly.** Mortgage is complex, our platform is complex, good software engineering is complex. You’ve got to have an attitude that you can absorb it, get on top of it, and build something better than what came before. * **Love strong typing.** We're a team full of people who love Haskell and Rust (and Idris!) and take pride in pushing Typescript to its limits. **About the Team** ------------------ ### **What we’re not:** * Building a CRUD app: + We’re building a platform that’s only possible due to deep technology investments and thinking hard from first principles. Cargo\-culting what’s come before won’t be sufficient. + If you’re looking to do mostly plumbing / lego piece assembling, Pylon may be very frustrating for you * A ChatGPT wrapper: + Mortgage is a sprawling mess of problems, and there isn't one tool that solves every one of them. We use LLMs, but we've reached for tools in multiple disciplines like mixed\-integer linear optimization and programming language research. * An easy job: + We’re building a lot of things from the ground up for the first time. Working at Pylon is like a research project where you have to ship to intelligent, opinionated customers regularly. + It’s basically guaranteed you’ll be handed a task that is too difficult for you to do. You might fail sometimes. You might have no idea where to start. Our team leans heavily on each other, but there’s no getting around the difficulties. ### **What we are:** * A small team: + We don’t have an army of engineers. If you find something is broken, you are probably the best one to fix it + All the code we write has to punch above its weight in maintainability and toil reduction + If you have a good idea, you have much more ability to put it into action than at a large company + We need generalists: specialization is for big companies that already have everything figured out. If you’re smart, flexible and like getting into everything, we want you. * Working in a regulated space: + Mortgage is regulated both federally and at the state level. + We move fast, but breaking things isn’t an option. **About the Job** ----------------- ### **Basics** * Job title: Software Engineer * Stock options: own a piece of the company and we all win together * Health insurance, 401K, dental, etc. ### **Our technology stack:** We don’t require that you’ve worked with any of these technologies before, this is just our stack for your information: * Typescript front and backend * Web components * GraphQL * PostgreSQL * NestJS web framework * Nx build system * Sagittarius * AWS stack using CDK for declarative infrastructure + We currently use ECS rather than Kubernetes. If you have questions about this choice and want to know more, please apply! * General philosophy: monolith until it hurts. If we can do something without introducing a new service, we will **About Pylon** --------------- The $13 trillion mortgage industry at the core of the American economy runs on broken assembly lines with human\-powered workflows, stitched\-together software, and a series of capital markets intermediates. The costs to originate are at an all time high despite foundational shifts in technology. Pylon is rewiring mortgages from the ground up. We are building the only API\-first, programmatic infrastructure that fully automates credit, compliance, capital, and operations. For the first time, originators can build and scale mortgage businesses entirely through software, not people. Our team comes from Stripe, Better, and Affirm, and we are backed by Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, Peter Thiel, and the founders of Ramp, Mercury, Blend, and others.

jobs.title: Junior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- San Francisco; Remote \- New York City; Remote \- Toronto; Remote \- Vancouver **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a Junior Fullstack Engineer who is building their foundation and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced teammates. You'll work in one of two engineering squads, Gateway or Connect, shipping real features across our React web app and Node backend that small businesses rely on every day. You'll have a dedicated mentor, well\-scoped work, and plenty of room to learn how a world\-class production SaaS platform is built, run, and scaled. **Gateway** owns the front door to Quo: how businesses sign up, choose a plan, pay, verify their business for compliance, and bring their existing phone numbers with them. You'll work on everything from the sign\-up, plan, and checkout experiences customers see to the systems behind them, like billing and subscriptions, pricing and trials, taxes, account and trust verification, and number porting. **Connect** makes Quo part of the rest of a small business's tech stack. You'll help build and maintain integrations with tools like HubSpot and Salesforce, including the in\-app experiences customers use to connect and manage them, and contribute to Quo's public API and webhooks, which let customers send messages, sync contacts, and log calls and messages in the other apps they use every day. **Some of the things you’ll do:** --------------------------------- * Spend most of your time writing, testing, and shipping code in TypeScript, across our React frontend and Node backend. * Build user\-facing features in our web app, working from designs in Figma and our shared component library. * Own well\-scoped tasks end to end: understand the customer problem behind a ticket, build and test the change, and confirm it works once it's live. * Investigate and fix bugs reported by customers and our support team. * Review your teammates' code and learn from their reviews of yours. * Write tests and documentation alongside your code, so the next person can pick up where you left off. * Use AI coding tools to move faster while maintaining personal growth. * Work closely with your mentor and squads, ask questions early, and grow toward owning larger pieces of work. **Technical stack and tools:** ------------------------------ * Our web app is built with React and TypeScript, using GraphQL and Relay for data fetching. * We build UI with Vite, Vanilla Extract, and React Aria, and develop components in Storybook. * We test with Vitest and React Testing Library. * Our backend is built on Node using TypeScript. * Our architecture is event\-driven microservices with RabbitMQ at the center, with a federated GraphQL layer. * We use a variety of databases for different purposes: Postgres, Elasticsearch, and Redis. * Observability and delivery tools. * Other tools: Claude Code and other AI coding tools, Linear, Notion, Slack, and Figma. **About you** ============= * You have at least 2 years of software engineering experience in formal, full\-time work environments * You've built web interfaces with React and TypeScript * You've written backend code, such as APIs or services, using Node and TypeScript * You enjoy working across the stack, from building interfaces people use to the APIs and data behind them. * You have a solid grasp of programming fundamentals, including HTML and CSS, data structures, APIs, databases, and writing tests, and you're eager to deepen them. * You display a strong sense of ownership of your work by monitoring performance, usage, and errors after it ships. * You're curious. You seek to understand the "why" behind things so you can better plan and build the "how." * You use AI tools in your work and think critically about what they produce. * You care about the people who use what you build. You practice empathy and thoughtfulness as you weigh trade\-offs. * You strive for code that's readable, testable, and maintainable, and you leave things better than you found them. **Nice to have:** * Experience with SQL databases such as Postgres. * Exposure to REST or GraphQL APIs, GraphQL clients like Relay or Apollo, or building against third\-party APIs. * Familiarity with web accessibility or component\-driven development. * Familiarity with message queues or event\-driven systems. * Interest in payments, billing, or SaaS integrations. **Compensation** ================ The annual base salary range for this position is as follows, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $141,000 \- $166,000 USD * All other US Locations: $127,000 \- $150,000 USD * Canada: $130,000 \- $153,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. \#LI\-Remote \#PostLI

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Quest Analytics®, we build technology that helps health plans navigate some of the most complex challenges in healthcare. We’re searching for a Software Engineer to help us build and scale our platform. You’ll own the features you build, from first requirements conversation through deployment, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers. Your input on design and architecture will carry real weight, and the decisions you help make will shape our current offerings, and new product lines as we grow. Our engineering teams value high\-quality code, open collaboration, and creative problem solving. We review each other’s work with constructive feedback, communicate early about blockers and risks, and take ownership of our results. We also embrace new technology, including AI\-powered tools, to improve both the quality and the speed of what we deliver, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how our teams use them. ### **What you'll do** * Take part in the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, and deployment. * Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers to turn requirements into working software. * Own your project timelines and deliverables, flag blockers and risks early so your team can help. * Contribute to the design and architecture of new and existing products and features. * Write clean, efficient, maintainable code built for performance and scalability. * Give constructive feedback in code reviews and hold your work to team coding standards. * Use AI\-powered tools in your daily work to improve the quality and speed of development and help shape how the team adopts them. * Make day\-to\-day technical decisions within established patterns, and bring larger choices, like major frameworks or design patterns, to your manager. * Handle confidential information with care, especially protected health information (PHI), and follow Quest Analytics HIPAA Privacy and Security Practices. * Join training and mentoring programs, as a learner or as a guide. ### **What you'll need** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience. * Three to five years of backend development with Microsoft’s .NET Framework and C\# at a commercial SaaS company, ideally working with large data sets. * Proficiency in SQL Server and in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs. * Snowflake, Databricks, or general data platform experience for large data processing. * Experience building on Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus, plus familiarity with Blob Storage or AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SNS, or SQS. * Experience with React or a comparable modern JavaScript framework for front\-end work. * Familiarity with unit testing (XUnit preferred) and SOLID principles. * Source control experience with Git. * Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, team\-oriented approach to your work. * Experience multiplying your output with AI development tools. **About Quest Analytics** For more than 20 years, we’ve been improving provider network management one groundbreaking innovation at a time. 90% of America’s health plans use our tools, including the eight largest in the nation. Achieve your personal quest to build a great career here. **What you’ll appreciate:** * Workplace flexibility – you choose between remote, hybrid or in\-office * Affordable employee medical, dental and vision plans with low employee cost * 401k Matching * Wellness benefits * Competitive salary and success sharing bonus * Flexible vacation, plus sick time and holidays * An entrepreneurial culture that won’t limit you to a job description * Being listened to, valued, appreciated \- and having your contributions rewarded * Enjoying your work each day with a great group of people **Apply TODAY!** careers.questanalytics.com **Next Steps** After you apply, you will receive an email confirming receipt of your application. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive - CFO Transformations
jobs.description: **About Qurrent** Qurrent is pioneering the future of work. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, we build fully managed, autonomous digital workforces that take ownership of complex financial operations end\-to\-end. Our customers, including leading enterprises across finance services, professional services, technology, and property management, trust us to run critical workflows like invoice\-to\-cash, procure\-to\-pay, record\-to\-report, and FP\&A. Our mission is to evolve the nature of work and we're looking for people who want to be part of building something that's categorically different from anything else in the AI landscape. **Senior Enterprise Account Executive – CFO Transformations** We are seeking a senior enterprise seller to bring Qurrent to the Office of the CFO at Fortune 1000 and upper mid\-market companies. In this pivotal role, you will open new logos, build executive relationships with CFOs and their teams, and lead complex, multi\-million\-dollar deals from first meeting to signature. This is not a transactional software sale. Qurrent delivers guaranteed outcomes, not software licenses, and you will position it with finance leaders as a lever for transformation, operating margin, and productivity. **Responsibilities:** * Own full\-cycle enterprise sales for net\-new logos, from prospecting through close. * Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive networking, ecosystem partners, and your own CFO network. * Develop senior relationships with CFOs, CAOs, Controllers, FP\&A, Shared Services, and Transformation leaders. * Lead value\-based conversations on finance transformation, back\-office modernization, AI adoption, and operating efficiency. * Navigate multi\-stakeholder buying decisions across finance, operations, IT, procurement, security, and executive leadership. * Partner with our AI Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers to shape business cases and proofs of value. * Lead commercial negotiations and drive deals to close with urgency and discipline. * Build relationships with consulting firms, BPOs, and other ecosystem partners. * Represent Qurrent at executive forums, customer meetings, and industry events, and bring what you hear from the market back into our messaging, product roadmap, and go\-to\-market strategy. **Qualifications:** * 15\+ years of enterprise sales experience selling complex technology solutions to Fortune 1000 organizations. * Proven success selling into CFO organizations: finance leaders, shared services, procurement, or transformation teams. * A track record selling enterprise SaaS, AI and automation platforms, ERP, procurement or finance systems, workflow platforms, or finance transformation technology. * Consistently exceeded enterprise quotas of 3M–5M\+ ARR. * Experience leading long, multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with multi\-million\-dollar deal sizes. * Proven ability to independently source and build pipeline in competitive enterprise markets. * Strong executive presence and the ability to engage C\-level buyers on business outcomes, not product features. * Strong understanding of finance operations, ERP ecosystems, and transformation priorities. * Operational discipline and forecasting rigor. **Bonus Points:** * An existing network of CFOs, CAOs, Controllers, and finance transformation leaders. * Experience at a leading enterprise or finance technology company such as Workday, Coupa, SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Anaplan. * Experience creating a new category, or selling outcome\-based and services\-led offerings. * Experience co\-selling with consulting firms or BPOs. * A track record of thriving in ambiguous, fast\-scaling environments. **What We Offer:** * Innovation: Be at the forefront of the AI revolution, shaping how enterprise finance work gets done. * Impact: A defining role in Qurrent's enterprise expansion, working directly with our CEO and leadership team. * Environment: A dynamic and collaborative work environment where your ideas are valued. * Compensation: Competitive base and on\-target earnings, accelerators for new logos and over\-attainment, and significant equity upside. * Teamwork: The chance to sell alongside a talented and passionate team of AI Strategists and engineers. * Growth: Continuous learning and development opportunities within a supportive and established network. Qurrent offers excellent benefits, competitive compensation packages and generous equity plans. The base salary pay range for this role is $220,000 \- $260,000 USD, with on\-target earnings of $367,000 \- $433,000\+ USD. This role is based in San Francisco; we will consider remote candidates with exceptional backgrounds. Qurrent is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion, diversity, and equity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Compensation Range: $220K \- $260K

jobs.title: Senior Web UI/UX Engineer

jobs.title: Lead Applied AI Engineer/Scientist
jobs.description: **About the Company** RNGD is a rapidly scaling organization emerging as a nationally recognized leader in construction through our unique Renegade mindset focused on innovation, creativity, and culture. The team is made up of a highly engaged group of seasoned professionals and emerging leaders. We are creators who believe that what we build drives the growth of our cities and that to fulfill our mission, we must constantly challenge the old way of doing things. Headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, we thrive on building communities, building teams, building leaders, and growing the business throughout the Southeast region with additional offices in Mississippi, Tennessee, and Alabama. **About the Role** We’re looking for a **Lead Applied AI Engineer/Scientist** that will lead the technical design, development, evaluation, and continuous improvement of applied AI systems that solve high\-value construction and business problems. This role is accountable for whether AI agents and machine\-learning models achieve defined business targets, not simply whether the technology runs. The Lead Applied AI Engineer/Scientist designs the complete workflow, evaluates performance at each stage, identifies where errors originate, and continuously improves the system until the final output meets established business requirements. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role that sets direction through architecture, experimentation, evaluation standards, and cross\-functional influence. The role works across document AI, computer vision, large language models, retrieval, tool\-enabled agents, structured outputs, deterministic software, and human\-review workflows. The Lead Applied AI Engineer/Scientist partners with estimators, domain experts, business leaders, data professionals, and software engineers to translate real\-world workflows into reliable AI products. Success in this role means AI solutions are measurable, explainable, production\-ready, reviewed at the appropriate points, and continuously improved using actual business outcomes. **Core Responsibilities** * *Business Problem Definition, Data, and Input Readiness* * + Partner with business and domain stakeholders to define use cases, expected outcomes, acceptance criteria, and measurable performance targets. + Audit real\-world inputs, including spreadsheets, vector and scanned PDFs, two\-dimensional drawings, scales, symbol conventions, revisions, specifications, images, and three\-dimensional models. + Define the information required at each workflow stage, identify authoritative data sources, and establish how missing, conflicting, or ambiguous information should be handled. + Identify input\-quality issues, workflow dependencies, and technical constraints that may affect model performance or business reliability. + Design data\-labeling and validation approaches with domain experts to establish reliable ground truth. + Maintain traceability between source information, intermediate outputs, model decisions, and final business results. * *AI Architecture and Workflow Design* * + Architect end\-to\-end AI agents and machine\-learning workflows that connect document understanding, computer vision, large language models, retrieval, tool use, business rules, and deterministic code. + Select the appropriate technical method for each workflow stage based on accuracy, explainability, maintainability, speed, cost, and business risk. + Define structured outputs, data contracts, tool interfaces, orchestration logic, and failure\-handling requirements. + Design human\-review and approval points that allow domain experts to verify outputs efficiently and focus attention on the highest\-risk decisions. + Evaluate build\-versus\-buy options for models, tools, platforms, and supporting infrastructure. + Conduct feasibility experiments before major technical or financial commitments and communicate findings clearly to business and technical leaders. * *Model Development, Evaluation, and Error Analysis* * + Develop and refine models, prompts, retrieval methods, tools, orchestration logic, and supporting data pipelines. + Build benchmark datasets and evaluation pipelines that measure individual workflow stages and end\-to\-end business performance. + Define meaningful metrics, quality thresholds, test cases, and release criteria based on business requirements. + Perform detailed error analysis to identify where failures originate and distinguish input, model, prompt, orchestration, tool, and process issues. + Prioritize improvements based on business impact, frequency, severity, and implementation effort. + Maintain reproducible experiments, evaluation records, model versions, and technical documentation to support reliable decision\-making. * *Pilot Delivery, Productionization, and Monitoring* * + Run side\-by\-side pilots using live projects and compare AI\-generated outputs with human work and verified business outcomes. + Analyze pilot results and explain accuracy, lim  performance into practical business implications. + Communicate model results, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and limitations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. + State candidly when a solution is not yet reliable enough for production use and explain what must improve. + Gather user feedback, identify adoption barriers, and incorporate practical workflow needs into product development. + Align technical priorities with business impact while maintaining realistic expectations regarding AI capabilities and delivery timelines. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, machine learning, data science, engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * Three or more years of experience building applied AI or machine\-learning systems delivered to real users, including experience providing technical direction for an AI product. * Hands\-on experience with document AI, computer vision, or complex\-document processing, including layout analysis, optical character recognition, object or symbol detection, or measurement from images. * Experience building large\-language\-model agents or multi\-step AI workflows involving tool use, orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval, and deterministic components. * Demonstrated experience developing benchmark datasets, evaluation pipelines, error\-analysis processes, data\-labeling programs, and ground\-truth standards. * Strong Python capabilities and experience collaborating on production software, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud\-based AI or machine\-learning infrastructure. * Experience in construction, engineering, architecture, or manufacturing preferred, particularly involving drawings, estimating workflows, vector PDF parsing, geometric reasoning, vision\-language models, or historical cost data. * Ability to explain technical performance, limitations, and recommendations clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. **Core Competencies** ***RNGD Values Alignment*** * Exemplifies RNGD’s core values: * Renegade Mentality * Sweep Floors * Build Together * Honor Promises * *Applied AI Architecture and Technical Execution* * + Designs reliable end\-to\-end AI systems by selecting and integrating the models, tools, data, deterministic components, and human\-review points appropriate to the business problem. + Demonstrates a Renegade Mentality by challenging assumptions, testing emerging approaches, and finding practical ways to solve complex problems. * *Evaluation Rigor and Analytical Judgment* * + Uses benchmarks, stage\-level metrics, production results, and structured error analysis to determine whether systems meet defined technical and business expectations. + Demonstrates the Sweep Floors mindset by examining the details behind performance, maintaining disciplined documentation, and following failures to their actual source. * *Business Impact and Product Ownership* * + Connects technical decisions to measurable business outcomes and prioritizes improvements according to their effect on users, accuracy, risk, cost, and operational value. + Honors Promises by communicating capabilities honestly, setting realistic expectations, and ensuring released systems perform against agreed standards. * *Cross\-Functional Partnership and Communication* * + Translates effectively between domain experts, business leaders, data professionals, and software engineers while creating shared understanding of requirements and results. + Builds Together by incorporating diverse expertise, communicating clearly, and designing solutions with the people responsible for using and supporting them. * *Responsible Innovation and Continuous Improvement* * + Balances experimentation and speed with traceability, human oversight, production reliability, maintainability, and responsible use. + Combines a Renegade Mentality with Honor Promises by pursuing better methods without compromising transparency, quality, or trust.

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer — Federal Health IT
jobs.description: **Data Integration Engineer — Federal Health IT** **Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based) **Personnel Vetting:** Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal background investigation and ability to meet applicable personnel\-vetting requirements. **Connect Critical Data. In this role, you will connect operational systems with a designated enterprise analytics environment, helping teams access dependable information for performance monitoring, reporting, and independent assurance activities. requirements. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain secure, API\-based data pipelines connecting approved operational systems with a designated enterprise analytics environment. * Operate and troubleshoot assigned data integrations to support reliable, consistent delivery of information for analytics and assurance activities. * Automate the collection and processing of maintainability, security, edge cases, and compliance. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities****Automation Development** * Develop and maintain reliable automated tests for web, API, integration, and end\-to\-end business flows. * Build and modernize maintainable automation frameworks using reusable components, libraries, and engineering standards.· * Optimize test execution, logging, reporting, troubleshooting, and maintainability across automation solutions. **AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering** * Build reusable AI\-assisted utilities that solve practical Quality Engineering challenges. * Use approved AI and LLM tools to accelerate test design, automation development, refactoring, and documentation * Apply AI to generate test data, analyze failures and logs, support defect triage, and improve test coverage. * Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, edge cases, maintainability, security, and framework compliance. **CI/CD and Continuous Quality** * Integrate smoke, regression, API, and integration tests into CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools. * Implement automated quality gates and clear reporting to provide fast, actionable feedback to delivery teams. * Partner with Engineering and DevOps to improve test environments, deployment validation, and pipeline stability. **Engineering Productivity and Collaboration** * Identify repetitive testing and engineering activities and automate them through reusable tools for test data, environment setup, API validation, orchestration, and troubleshooting. * Contribute to technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews with a focus on quality, testability, and automation. * Collaborate with globally distributed stakeholders and document standards, solutions, examples, and reusable automation patterns. **Experience, Skills, and Knowledge** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, related field or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Quality Engineering, SDET, test automation, or software development. * Proficiency in Python, Java, or Typescript with frameworks such as Playwright, Rest Assured, and Appium or similar automation tools, including reusable test components. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated test suites using Jenkins, Bitbucket, GitHub, or similar tools. * Hands\-on exposure to enterprise AI development tools and platforms such as Cursor, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable approved technologies. * Strong debugging, root\-cause analysis, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience in applying LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and agentic workflows to enhance test generation, failure analysis, test optimization, self\-healing automation, and ongoing maintenance. * Experience with prompt engineering, prompt regression testing, AI evaluation, and safety guardrails. * Experience building reusable automation utilities, internal engineering tools, or accelerators, including modernization or migration of automation frameworks. * Knowledge of microservices, cloud\-native applications, containers, distributed systems, SQL, data validation, and test\-data management. * Full stack development experience is a plus. **What You Bring** * Strong bias for action \- proactively identify quality risks and translate innovative ideas into practical, scalable QE solutions. * Challenge conventional approaches, experiment responsibly, and implement prototypes, reusable accelerators, and production\-ready improvements. * Drive end\-to\-end ownership from requirements through implementation, adoption, and support while balancing speed, maintainability, security, and responsible AI validation. * Share reusable patterns and lessons learned to strengthen engineering capability across the QE team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend, Comms Platform
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote (US) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Target Base Salary $172K – $280K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus The final compensation will depend on the location and level at which the candidate is hired. **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== Every approval request, receipt reminder, payment alert, and card notification Ramp sends has to reach the right person, on the right channel, at the right time. When it does, finance teams close faster and employees spend less time chasing tasks. When it doesn't, a missed message can mean a stalled approval, a late payment, or a flood of notifications nobody asked for. Ramp's Communications Platform team builds the shared system that every product team uses to reach customers. It handles transactional messages across email, SMS, push, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp, including templating, delivery, retries, digesting, user preferences, and delivery monitoring. The team also supports the conversational experiences that let customers work with Ramp directly from the channels they already use. We're looking for a backend engineer to own a core part of that platform. You'll take responsibility for an area such as message delivery and channel integrations, communication preferences, or platform reliability and scale, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and dependable as message volume and the number of teams building on it grow. You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering partners across Ramp to make communications faster, more reliable, and easier for every team to build on. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the design and evolution of a core part of Ramp's communications platform, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration * Build and extend integrations with messaging channels and delivery providers, including email, SMS, push, and workplace chat tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams * Design delivery workflows that are idempotent, retry safely, and confirm successful delivery, so customers reliably get the messages they need without duplicate sends * Build communication preferences and controls that let users and administrators decide what they receive and where * Make the platform simple and safe for other Ramp engineers to build on, with clear abstractions, strong defaults, and good developer tooling * Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of the platform as message volume grows * Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship **What You'll Need** -------------------- * Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows * A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time * Strong system design judgment, especially around reliability, idempotency, and correctness in high\-volume distributed systems * Product sense: you care about the experience of the people receiving each message, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience building notification, messaging, or communications platforms * Experience integrating with messaging providers or channel APIs, such as Twilio, SendGrid, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or WhatsApp * Experience building internal platforms or shared services used by many engineering teams * Experience scaling high\-volume, event\-driven, or queue\-based systems **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As an Artificial Intelligence Engineer, you’ll turn data into practical AI solutions. You’ll build, test, and deploy machine learning models, partnering with research and analytics teams to address real\-world needs. Your work will support reliable, scalable applications, from predictive modeling to natural language processing and generative AI. Your impact: By developing and evaluating useful AI models, you’ll help teams make better\-informed decisions and deliver more relevant data\-driven services. **Duties** * Prepare data pipelines, including extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data mining, and linked data integration. * Train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models using Python, TensorFlow, and other machine learning frameworks. * Apply statistical modeling, statistical analysis, unsupervised learning, and predictive modeling to research and product questions. * Build scalable solutions with cloud machine learning services, big data systems, Hadoop, and Spark; support Spark implementation and AI implementation. * Collaborate on database design, SQL databases, analytics, and data analytics; document model performance and deployment decisions. **Requirements** * Experience with machine learning, AI, model training, model evaluation, and machine learning/AI\-based analysis. * Working knowledge of Python and SQL; experience with AWS and TensorFlow is useful. * Familiarity with statistical analysis tools and research methods; SAS, R, Looker, and VBA are relevant tools. * Exposure to Java, C, Bash (Unix shell), Talend, big data, and scalability is helpful. * Interest or experience in generative AI, natural language processing, and quantum engineering is welcome; related skills are preferred, not all required. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Red Hat Identity Management (IdM) Engineering team seeks a Senior Software Engineer who will join us in Lowell , MA to help us deliver on the next generation of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) product functionalities within Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and the Red Hat Certificate System as well as contributing to open\-source projects like Dogtag PKI. As a Senior Software Engineer, your main focus will be on designing, developing, testing and collaborating with other contributors over the world to bring features on existing components or bootstrap new ones. This is an ideal position for engineers interested in contributing to open source projects, and services for enterprise \& public sector critical infrastructure. **What you will do:** --------------------- * Lead the design and development of high\-quality PKI solutions, own the quality of their code and contribute to testing frameworks. * Participate in the whole development cycle from requirements gathering, scoping, source code development to testing and verification * Practice defensive programming to deliver stable and high\-quality software for Red Hat customers and upstream communities. * Communicate and collaborate with developers and teams inside and outside Red Hat * Influence the technical direction of their team and adjacent teams by building consensus in broader discussions with internal customers or through active participation in external communities * Mentor and coach other engineers, share expertise by producing comprehensive design documents, writing blog posts, and mentoring others on documentation and communication best practices **What you will bring:** ------------------------ * Java and/or Rust programming experience; professional or academic experience is required and the ability to work Hybrid in Lowell, Massachusetts. * Knowledge of Linux operating system and its development tools; any distribution is OK * Experience with PKI, cryptography, and general system and software security technologies * Experience using AI agents to accelerate development efforts. * Good written and verbal communication in English. **The following will be considered a plus** ------------------------------------------- * Experience with an autonomous agentic software defined lifecycle * Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g. Scrum, JIRA) * Experience with Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages * Experience with software testing, CI/CD, and related frameworks * Experience with package maintenance on Fedora/RHEL * Experience with hybrid cloud systems or frameworks (e.g., OpenShift, AWS, Microsoft Azure) The salary range for this position is $136,320\.00 \- $225,090\.00\. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.**Pay Transparency** Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity.
