For positions with Remote\-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible Spending Account \- healthcare and dependent care * Health Savings Account \- high deductible medical plan * Retirement 401(k) with employer match * Paid time off and holidays * Paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave * Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more! **Note:** These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States. **Inclusion at Red Hat** Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. ### **Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. jobs.description: Please note: The the salary range listed is the actually range \- please do not ask for an amount above. All candidates must currently reside in the state of Texas. No relocation is offered. The Opportunity: We are building a new billing platform from the ground up and need the senior engineer who owns its core: the engine that moves claims and payments through their lifecycles, the background job system that runs every automated step, and the integrations with payers, clearinghouses and banks. Backend engineering on a money system, TypeScript on PostgreSQL on Azure, working directly with the CTO on a team that stays at two to four engineers. The type of engineer we are seeking: A backend engineer who has shipped a transactional system (payments, claims, orders, ledgers, anything where a row posting twice is a real problem) in a typed language, and who has been the one who found out when it broke. Experience you must have: * Seven or more years of backend engineering in production, in a typed language: TypeScript or Node.js, C\#, Java, Go or Kotlin. TypeScript is what we use. A strong C\# or Java engineer who has not written much TypeScript is fine; a Python\-only engineer is not. * A relational database as their primary store for years. PostgreSQL preferred; SQL Server, DB2, Oracle or MySQL fine. They should be able to talk about transactions, locking and a deadlock they debugged. * Built and ran something with background workers, queues and retries. The tool does not matter (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus, Hangfire, Quartz, Sidekiq, Celery, a database table). The years running it do. * Can explain idempotency and "what happens if the process dies between these two writes" from a system they built. * Integration work against outside vendors: REST or SOAP APIs, SFTP file drops, fixed\-width or EDI files, vendors who change their output without warning. * Owned production. They found out their job broke before the business did and changed the design so it could not repeat. A formal on\-call rotation is evidence, not the requirement. Questions you will be asked: * "Tell me about a system you built where the same job must never run twice at the same time. How did you stop it?" * "Tell me about a production failure you owned where nothing errored and the data was just wrong or missing. What did you change afterward?" * "What is the most TypeScript you have written?" The pitch to candidates * Greenfield core of a real money system, with an architecture already written down and a CTO who will hand it over rather than hover. * Small team, no service fleet, no twelve microservices, one database to search when something goes wrong. * Every automated step earns trust on evidence (shadow, propose, auto). The engineer who builds that gets to decide how far it goes. * Decisions are written. They will read the ones that exist and write the next ones. * Texas based, remote within the state. No relocation. * Billing is unglamorous and sticky. The agencies are the customer, the money is real, and the problems are concrete. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI\-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world. **WHY ACCESS \& CONTROLS?** Roblox operates globally across a huge number of jurisdictions, each with their own laws and regulations. Every user’s platform experience is tailored based on their age, location, parental consents, and more to ensure that Roblox is safe and compliant for them. The Access \& Controls pod owns the systems that make this possible. Our platforms allow internal teams to set feature access rules based on compliance requirements and let users customize their platform experience within those boundaries. Our services are some of the highest\-traffic systems at the company, sitting in the hot path of nearly every user action across billions of accounts and millions of requests per second. As international regulations evolve and new features are built, our systems are how Roblox enforces, manages, and gives visibility into consistent behavior across dozens of features. **You Will:** * Design, build, and operate high\-throughput, low\-latency services that shape what every Roblox user can see and do. Past examples of this team’s contributions include: * + Policy Deployment: Access rules used to ship as dynamic configuration, with no visibility into what was running in production and no way to revert without a code change. Policy deployment went from a source of anxiety to a routine, low\-risk operation for the dozens of feature teams that depend on it daily. + Age\-Checked Comms: In late 2025, Roblox introduced platform\-wide Age Checks for all Communication features, including restrictions that only allow users to communicate with others in similar age ranges. Our access platform was the backbone of this rollout, giving every feature one centralized place to answer: Is this user Age Checked? Are they eligible to Age Check? jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team:** ------------------- The Application Security team believes software should be secure because of how it was built, not because someone checked it afterwards. We set the security standards that everything Rubrik builds has to meet, and we build the controls that make those standards the default. We cover any team that builds, generates, or assembles software or automation that runs against Rubrik or customer data. That includes Engineering product code, IT\-built tooling, data pipelines, low\-code automation, and anything produced by AI coding agents. Other teams handle triaging vulnerabilities and chasing remediation. Our measure of success is the risk we eliminate by design, not the number of vulnerabilities found later. **About the role:** ------------------- You will do hands\-on work across our four focus areas: Standards, Secure Architecture and Design, Preventative Controls, Adoption and Enablement. You will own defined pieces of this work, with guidance from senior engineers, and you will be measured on the outcomes below rather than on activity. The team is small, so you will also be expected to automate repetitive work, using AI tools where they help. You are not expected to know all of this on day one. We are looking for people who have started working in this space and want to learn and grow at speed. **What you'll do:** ------------------- * Build and maintain the preventative controls in development pipelines, including secrets prevention, dependency and artifact policy, and scan configuration as code. * With guidance from senior engineers, work with development teams to establish what needs to be scanned, ensure accurate scans policies and that the results can be trusted. * Help write security standards specific enough to test and build the automated checks that show whether teams conform to them. * Ensure agent\-generated code conforms to the highest security standards and controls through defining and implementing guardrails for AI coding agents. * Support design reviews and threat modeling for applications, build tooling and internal platforms. * Enable the team to scale at speed through automation of repetitive tasks, standards checks and review support. ### **What Success Looks Like:** By the end of your first year, we would expect: * The controls you built or maintain are enforced in the pipeline and reported by organization. * The teams you worked with have accurate scan configuration, comprehensive coverage that matches the standard, with no unknown gaps. * The standards you helped write have automated checks, so conformance is measured and not self\-attested. * Agent\-generated code is covered by the same standards and controls as other code. * The repetitive team work you automated no longer needs manual effort, and the team's time has moved to higher\-value work. **Experience you'll need:** --------------------------- * BS or MS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Can write and maintain tooling in Python and at least one of Go, TypeScript, or JavaScript. * Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Buildkite, Jenkins, Git workflows, and containers. * Basic grounding in application security: OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secrets management, and software supply chain risk. * Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or Claude Code to build or automate real work, and the judgment to check the output before trusting it. * Clear writing and speaking, and a willingness to learn fast in an area that changes every few months. **Preferred qualifications:** ----------------------------- * You have built an automation or AI\-assisted workflow that replaced manual work and you can explain how you checked that its output was right. Claude skills, agents and MCP servers count. * You have set up or tested controls on an AI coding agent or assistant (permissions, sandboxing, hooks, tool restrictions), and you can describe the risk each one reduced, such as prompt injection, excessive agency, data exfiltration, or a malicious MCP server. * You have written evals, test cases, or review checks that caught bad LLM output before it was used. * You have put a security check into a CI/CD pipeline (secrets scanning, SAST, SCA, or dependency and artifact policy). * Working knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure. The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US Pay Range $124,200—$186,200 USD **Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation** ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. **Inclusion @ Rubrik** ---------------------- At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data. Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential. ### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:** * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here. * Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries. * Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** ------------------------------------------------ Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination. Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

jobs.title: Senior Storage Engineer
jobs.description: Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000\+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers. We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom\-designed compute into a 20\-foot container with closed\-loop, water\-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement). Every one of those 400,000 models has to be on the right GPU, in the right pod, in seconds. Storage is what makes that possible. That is the job. **The role** ------------ As Senior Storage Engineer, you will own the storage architecture of Runware's AI supercomputer: how model weights, caches and customer data move from object storage on two continents to the NVMe and GPU memory of the node that needs them. You will design the data path, build the first version with your own hands, and set the standard for how storage is run across every pod. This is a hands\-on senior individual\-contributor role. You will specify the systems, benchmark them on real hardware, find the reason a 70 GB checkpoint took four minutes to load instead of twenty seconds, and then fix it at the root so it never happens again. You will work directly with our inference engine, platform and hardware teams, with our storage and NVMe vendors, and with the site teams deploying pods. Success means a cold model loads onto a GPU anywhere in the fleet in seconds, a new pod has its working set warm before it takes traffic, and a disk, node or whole site failing is invisible to the developer calling our API. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own the end\-to\-end storage architecture for the fleet: the durable object store that holds 400,000\+ models, the per\-pod high\-throughput tier that feeds GPUs, the node\-local NVMe cache, and the replication and placement logic that ties them together across the US and Europe. * Design and build the model distribution path. Decide how weights get from the source of truth to a pod, how they are chunked, deduplicated, prefetched and pinned, and how a new pod warms its working set before it takes production traffic. * Drive model load latency down and keep it down. Profile the full path from disk to GPU memory, including the kernel, file system, NVMe\-oF or RDMA transport, GPUDirect Storage and the inference engine's loader, and remove the bottleneck wherever it sits. * Select, benchmark and operate the storage systems themselves: parallel and distributed file systems, object storage, NVMe drives and enclosures, and the software that manages them. Validate every choice on our hardware before it ships to a pod. * Set and hit reliability and durability targets. Own capacity planning, monitoring, alerting, drive health and failure prediction, rebuild behaviour, backup and recovery, and on\-call for the storage layer. * Make storage a routine part of pod bring\-up: a documented, automated playbook so that the storage tier of the next 1 MW pod is provisioned, validated and warm in hours, not weeks. * Partner with inference engine, platform and hardware engineering so that what we design is operable at scale, and feed what you learn from production back into the next generation of servers and pods. * Use AI to accelerate the work: automate benchmarks, runbooks, triage and tooling with LLM\-based agents, so that a very small team can run storage for a very large fleet. * Own data residency and the operational side of storage security: encryption at rest, access control, retention and in\-country placement for sovereign deployments. **Requirements** **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 8\+ years in storage or systems engineering, with several of those designing and running storage at a company that operates its own hardware at scale. * A track record of building storage systems, not just operating what someone else built. You have taken a design from a whiteboard to petabytes in production and know what goes wrong between the two. * Deep, current, hands\-on Linux storage expertise: the block layer, io\_uring and NVMe queues, file systems such as XFS, ext4 and ZFS, the page cache, and the tools to see exactly where an I/O spends its time. * Real experience with at least one parallel or distributed file system in production (Lustre, WEKA, VAST, GPFS, Ceph or similar) and with S3\-compatible object storage at petabyte scale. * Strong understanding of NVMe, NVMe\-oF, RDMA transports and the networking that storage rides on. You can tell a saturated PCIe link from a slow drive from a misconfigured switch. * Fluent in a systems language (Go, Rust or C/C\+\+) and Python, and comfortable writing the tooling, benchmarks and automation yourself rather than waiting for someone else to. * You use AI to accelerate your own output every day, for scripting, benchmarking, analysis, documentation and debugging, and you have a clear view of how a small team armed with these tools should operate differently. * Comfortable owning outcomes in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment, making decisions with incomplete information and being accountable for latency, durability and cost. * Able to travel to sites in the US and Europe as needed. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience feeding large GPU fleets for AI training or inference: GPUDirect Storage, NCCL\-aware data loading, model weight caching and the loaders in vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM or similar engines. * Hands\-on experience with InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics and 400G\+ Ethernet from the storage side. * Experience with content\-addressed or deduplicated storage, erasure coding, and multi\-region replication and consistency trade\-offs. * Kernel or driver contributions, or deep familiarity with SPDK, DPDK or user\-space storage stacks. * Experience with Kubernetes CSI, Ceph or Rook on bare metal, and an automation stack such as Ansible and Terraform with Prometheus and Grafana observability. * Familiarity with the storage hardware supply chain: drive qualification, firmware lifecycle, enclosure and backplane design, spares and RMA economics. * Experience building or running storage to meet data residency, sovereignty or compliance requirements across jurisdictions. **Benefits** **What we offer** ----------------- * A rare mandate: design the storage layer of an AI supercomputer from the ground up, at a company whose business depends on doing it better than anyone else, with the hardware budget and backing to match. * Meaningful stock options. * We're a remote\-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm and celebrate wins. We keep core hours for collaboration and calls; outside those, you set your own schedule. * Our release cycles are fast and intense, and they're followed by real downtime. We expect you to take it. * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick days and public holidays. * Paid maternity, paternity and caregiver leave. * Twice\-yearly company retreats in inspiring locations.

jobs.description: **At SCP Health, what you do matters** As part of the SCP Health team, you have an opportunity to make a difference. At our core, we work to bring hospitals and healers together in the pursuit of clinical effectiveness. With a portfolio of over 8 million patients, 7500 providers, 30 states, and 400 healthcare facilities, SCP Health is a leader in clinical practice management spanning the entire continuum of care, including emergency medicine, hospital medicine, wellness, telemedicine, intensive care, and ambulatory care. **Why you will love working here:** * Strong track record of providing excellent work/life balance. * Comprehensive benefits package and competitive compensation. \- Commitment to fostering an inclusive culture of belonging and empowerment through our core values \- collaboration, courage, agility, and respect. **Responsibilities:** * **Platform architecture \& technical direction:** Define and evolve reference architectures and standards for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and serving layers (Snowflake \+ dbt and adjacent tooling); lead design reviews and set guardrails that enable teams to deliver scalable, secure, observable, and maintainable solutions. * **Highest\-impact data products (ownership \& service levels):** Own end\-to\-end delivery and operational excellence for the most critical datasets and pipelines that support revenue cycle, physician scheduling, billing, and performance monitoring; define SLAs/SLOs, error budgets (where applicable), and support models for sustained reliability. * **Complex integrations \& facility onboarding at scale:** Lead strategy and implementation for complex, multi\-facility integrations (EHR extracts, HL7, FHIR, APIs, flat files), including backfills, reconciliation, and long\-term maintainability; ability to partner with Security/Compliance to design controls and lead remediation when gaps are found. * **Influence \& enablement:** Lead discovery and design reviews, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence without authority; Additional duties include diagnosing and resolving technical issues over the phone by using advanced remote management tools or on\-site and logging tickets into our ticketing database to track time and facilitate tactical report generation. ### **Responsibilities** * Respond to calls, tickets, and emails that are escalated from the NHD team members to troubleshoot reported issues in a helpdesk environment * Analyze and respond to Server and infrastructure alerts * Onsite deployment of customer desktops, servers, and infrastructure equipment * Work on customer projects with teams of NHD team members and Project Engineers * Troubleshoot, monitor, and maintain client computers and desktop applications * Support current Windows Server operating systems * Support current Microsoft and other Server products * Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate internal channel * Must be motivated and work well in a team environment * Excellent customer service skills * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical terms and concepts into layman's terms * Some weekend work may be required on occasion, so must have the ability to occasionally work remotely updating servers ### **Qualifications** * 5\-7 years experience in a technical support role * At least 5 years experience in a remote technical support role * Current related Microsoft Azure Certification is highly preferred. jobs.description: Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI\-driven engine that finally gives the C\-Suite a clear, quantified, and real\-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide **certainty**. We are a **$170M Series C\-funded** category leader. We don’t play in the mid\-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to **serve 10% of the Fortune 500**, protecting global icons such as **Apple, Netflix, AT\&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret**. As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high\-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity. ### **The Culture Memo: Our Operating System** Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high\-intensity, mission\-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence. * **Extreme Ownership:** We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish. * **The Elite Standard:** We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier\-1 quality every time. * **Methodology \& Rigor:** We don’t wing it. From **Force Management** and **MEDDICC** in sales to **data\-driven sprints** in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable. * **Radical Candor:** We move too fast for politics or sugar\-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly. * **The Series C Hustle:** We have the stability of a well\-funded leader but the heart of a startup. ### **The Perks \& Ownership:** We want our team to feel like owners because they **are** owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time. * **Meaningful Equity:** Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success. * **Unlimited Leaves:** We don’t believe in clock\-watching. We offer **unlimited leave** because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** We provide top\-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. * **Career Trajectory:** We are growing aggressively. For high\-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the implementation owner of a customer’s success with SAFE, from the first onboarding call to a working, trusted deployment delivering value as a key part of their business processes. You sit between the customer's implementation teams and SAFE's engineering teams, understanding all sides well enough to translate between them. You have detailed product knowledge to be able to implement customers' business needs using existing features, and create customisations as needed. In this role you will have a strong understanding of SAFE/Industry best practice, guiding the customer to achieve their outcomes on the SAFE Platform, This will include educating and enabling the customer, as well as a technical implementation. You build the scripts, configure the platform, integrations, agents and automations that get a customer live. You diagnose what stands in the way of a customer's success, and where necessary engage internal teams with a clear, evidenced problem statement with an agreed outcome. You hold the end\-to\-end picture of how SAFE works, so a conversation between a customer and SAFE teams reaches a decision quickly. You use AI tooling every day to engage with customers more effectively, work with more autonomy and enable others, improving existing processes and tooling to achieve rapid deployments and value realisation. ### **What you'll do:** **Own customer onboarding and delivery** * Lead technical onboarding for assigned customers: scope, plan, configure, integrate and confirm the customer is getting value. * Own each engagement to a defined outcome. Keep the customer and internal teams informed on progress, risks and next steps. * Travel to customer sites for workshops, deployments and escalations. * Write scripts and lightweight automations that speed up onboarding, data loading, integration set\-up and repeat tasks. **Technical implementation** * Collect technical details from customers about their environment, data sources and integrations: authentication, permissions, network constraints, payload formats and expected behaviour. * Configure and customise the SAFE platform to meet customer business needs, making direct product fixes where appropriate. * Build and test customer\-specific workflows and AI agents, using SAFE and third\-party APIs as needed. * Build custom solutions to achieve customer outcomes where product gaps exist. * Create tooling to accelerate delivery proce gineering stakeholders as a peer. Define the outcome a customer needs, not the implementation. * Join customer and internal technical calls to provide expert guidance and drive project deliverables to completion. * Spot patterns across customers. Raise them as product feedback with the customer's business outcome and their own words. * Act as an internal customer, working closely with Product teams to ensure that new features are understood and have a clear route to deliver customer value. **Use AI tooling to scale your work** * Use AI tools to analyse logs, draft scripts, summarise issues and prepare customer\-facing material, using your experience to refine outcomes. * Turn repeated tasks into reusable scripts, AI skills or automations that the wider team can use. ### **What you'll bring:** **Essential** * Ownership and accountability. You take a problem as yours until it is closed, and you say so early when something slips. * Creative thinking and problem\-solving. You find a route to success, resolving issues as you hit them. * Curiosity. Not everything is documented. You explore, discover and experiment to achieve an outcome. * Experience in script building, product delivery and working directly with customers. This can come from a customer\-facing technical role or substantial project work. * Product onboarding experience. You have taken customers or users from set\-up to live use of a technical product. * API fluency. You can read API documentation, call and chain endpoints, handle authentication, and interpret responses and errors. * Debugging and troubleshooting skills. You work methodically from symptom to evidence to cause, respecting customer data handling requirements. * Excellent written/verbal communication. You explain technical findings and concepts clearly to the level of the target audience, backed by an expert understanding of the system architecture. * Development. You write scripts that call APIs, process data, and automate customer tasks using Python as a preferred language. You understand code generated by AI tools for human review and challenge. * Cloud Services. You understand core cloud\-based services and how they can be implemented at customers and used by SAFE. * Demonstrable use of AI tooling. You can show real examples of using AI to troubleshoot, script or automate, and you can say where it fell short. * Ability to travel to customer sites. **Nice to have** * Exposure to cybersecurity, risk management or security\-tool integrations (for example, vulnerability scanners, SIEM, asset inventories or identity providers). * Bash or PowerShell. * Experience in a customer\-facing technical role (forward deployed, solutions, customer or support engineering) at a SaaS or enterprise software company. * Experience working in distributed, multi\-time\-zone teams. ### **Why this role is exciting:** * Own customer outcomes at the point where SAFE meets real enterprise environments. * Work with engineering, product and customer teams on problems that shape the platform. * Build creative solutions to problems, both customer facing and internal * Learn cyber risk, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), a growing part of cybersecurity. * Use Python, APIs and AI tooling to remove manual work for yourself and the team. If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, **we want to hear from you!** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Foxboro DCS Senior Engineer I, Digital Systems Design
jobs.description: Job Description: The **Senior System Engineer** is responsible for designing, configuring, installing, and maintaining **Foxboro Distributed Control Systems** (DCS) and related infrastructure. This role requires expertise in system architecture, network configuration, software installation, and commissioning activities to ensure reliable, secure operation of industrial automation systems. **What will you do?****System Design \& Architecture*** Develop system architecture drawings using MS Visio or CAD. * Review and validate Bill of Materials (BOM) for accuracy and completeness. * Size system components (servers, workstations, controllers, switches) to meet project requirements. **Network \& Security Configuration*** Configure iDMZ domain, user access, and Fortinet firewalls for secure remote connectivity. * Set up MESH and ACN switches using Foxboro DCS Switch Configurator (SCAS). * Apply cybersecurity hardening guidance for Windows 10 21H2 LTSC and Windows Server 2022 platforms and manage Remote Desktop Services licensing. * Support secure interoperability with third\-party systems and interfaces, including Modbus drivers and OPC UA. **Software Installation \& Configuration*** Install and configure Foxboro DCS Control Core Services (CCS) v9\.9 (Enterprise and Local Editions), Control Software v8\.2, and related applications. * Apply CCS software fixes and Control Software maintenance packs, document updates in project Software Matrix. * Install and configure Trellix (formerly McAfee) ePO and ENS endpoint security software, Veritas backup solutions, and non\-standard software as required. **System Management \& Applications*** Configure Active Directory users and Group Policy Objects (GPOs). * Utilize ICC, IACC, FoxView/FoxDraw7, System Manager, AIM Historian, AVEVA Historian, and ADMC for system and application configuration. * Deploy and configure EcoStruxure Foxboro DCS System Advisor applications (including alarm and point/tag search functionality that replaces legacy DAS applications). * Install Control Core Services on supported hardware and on V91/V95 virtualization platforms. * Perform database migrations, including upgrades to current CCS and Control Software releases, and validate system health. **Project Execution*** Lead technical discussions during project kick\-off meetings. * Support sales team during proposal development and BOM reviews. * Support FEED studies and pre\-engineering workshops, including bid specification development for new Foxboro DCS opportunities. * Develop FAT and commissioning test documents; execute FAT and site commissioning activities. **Migration \& Upgrades*** Implement Foxboro DCS Series FBM upgrades and competitive migration offerings. * Support intelligent fieldbus integration (HART, FF, Profibus, DeviceNet). * Configure Intelligent Marshalling Fieldbus Modules (FBM247/FBM248\) and Sequence of Events (SOE) collection using compatible FBMs. * Integrate third\-party systems through the FDC280 controller and interfaces. * Support Foxboro SDA (EcoStruxure Automation Expert) and EcoStruxure Automation Processor solutions for higher\-level orchestration and control. * Use current engineering tools such as the Direct Access Script Generator (DASG) and Foxboro Asset Link. **Current Foxboro DCS Versions \& Platforms*** Foxboro DCS Control Core Services (CCS): v9\.9 (latest release); v9\.8 also supported in current projects * Foxboro DCS Control Software: v8\.2 (v8\.0 in recent project scopes) * HMI software: FoxView/FoxDraw v10\.7 * Operating systems: Windows 10 21H2 LTSC and Windows Server 2022 * Virtualization platforms: V91 and V95, with CCS v9\.9 running on platform\-managed VMs * Historians: AIM\* and AVEVA Historian * Endpoint protection: Trellix (formerly McAfee) **Who will you report to?** Engineering Manager (External) English Qualifications: **What qualifications will make you successful for this role?*** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. * 5\+ years of experience in industrial automation or control systems engineering. * Strong knowledge of Foxboro DCS hardware and software components. * Proficiency in network configuration, cybersecurity tools, and system backup solutions. * Ability to troubleshoot and maintain complex control systems. * Excellent documentation and communication skills for customer engagement and project reporting. * Familiarity with Foxboro DCS, AVEVA (formerly Wonderware) Historian, and related technologies. * Working knowledge of Foxboro SDA (EcoStruxure Automation Expert) and System Advisor is a plus. * Experience with virtualization (V91/V95\), Windows Server 2022, and competitive DCS migrations. * Experience with Active Directory, firewall configuration, and cybersecurity best practices. Bring your digital systems expertise to a team that values innovation and technical excellence—apply today! Supports an enterprise Wi\-Fi environment with over 1,700 access points, guest networks, Mist Edge controllers, and Juniper and Cisco network infrastructure. Troubleshoots complex connectivity issues, manages essential network services, and performs upgrades, maintenance, and security updates to keep systems running smoothly. Provides backup firewall support. Works closely with IT teams and stakeholders to resolve issues, improve network performance, communicate updates, and support a positive user experience. jobs.title: Product Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **About Sherman \+ Reilly** Established in 1927, Sherman \+ Reilly is North America's leading manufacturer of transmission and distribution line\-stringing equipment for the electric utility industry. From our Chattanooga headquarters, we design and build pullers, bullwheel tensioners, puller\-tensioners, pilot line winders, underground pullers, reel trailers, reel stands, and stringing blocks, engineered for safety and built to last. Driven by a nearly century\-long commitment to lineman safety and continuous innovation, we partner with the electric power industry to help meet the energy needs of the future. As part of Quanta Services, a leading infrastructure solutions provider for the electric power industry, we pair a nearly century\-old brand with the scale and career opportunity of a large parent organization. **Position Summary** The Product Data Engineer (PDE) is responsible for the integrity, governance, and lifecycle management of all product\-related data within the organization and report to the Program Manager. This role owns the structure and accuracy of the Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM), part master data, technical drawings, and engineering change processes. Serving as the business data owner of SolidWorks PDM Professional (DocVault), the PDE is the authoritative source for product information across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and SAP — ensuring that the right data is available, accurate, and accessible at every stage of product development and production. System administration of SolidWorks PDM Professional remains with the CAD/PDM Systems Administrator in IT. **Key Responsibilities** **Product Data Governance** ? Own and maintain the Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) for all active and new products ? Establish and enforce part numbering standards, naming conventions, and data entry guidelines ? Manage the accuracy of the SAP material master as it pertains to engineering data, ensuring alignment between engineering data and operational records ? Govern the release and revision status of all technical drawings, specifications, and product documents within SolidWorks PDM Professional ? Define and be responsible for the maintenance of data quality standards across SolidWorks PDM Professional (DocVault) and SAP **Engineering Change Management** ? Serve as the process owner for the Engineering Change Order (ECO) and Engineering Change Notice (ECN) processes ? Coordinate cross\-functional review and approval of engineering changes with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality ? Ensure controlled, documented transition of design changes into production BOMs and SAP procurement records ? Maintain accuracy of revision history and audit trails for all product changes within SolidWorks PDM Professional **SolidWorks PDM Professional Administration** ? Serve as the administrator of data for SolidWorks PDM Professional (DocVault), including defining requirements for folder structure and data migration ? Coordinate with the CAD/PDM Systems Administrator on requirements, design input, and user acceptance testing for document workflows, revision states, and approval routing within the PDM Vault ? Own the data requirements for, and validate the accuracy of, the integration between SolidWorks PDM Professional and SAP (BOM and material master synchronization) ? Coordinate with the CAD/PDM Systems Administrator on system upgrades (including acceptance testing of upgrades), backups, and performance of the PDM environment ? Assist IT and the CAD/PDM Systems Administrator with requirements, user acceptance testing, and rollout of planned BOM comparison and synchronization tooling between SolidWorks PDM and SAP, including defining part name and content consistency rules and training users ? Train and support engineering staff on SolidWorks PDM Professional data standards and data processes ? Establish and document DocVault data governance procedures; train users on proper modeling, drawing, and eBOM maintenance protocols ? The CAD/PDM Systems Administrator retains final authority over PDM system configuration, permissions, workflows, upgrades, backups, and integrations. **SAP Material Master \& BOM Management** ? Serve as the functional subject matter expert for product data within SAP (Business ByDesign today, S/4HANA Public Cloud planned) ? Manage SAP material master data and BOM structures, as it pertains to engineering data, ensuring data integrity and consistency across plant codes ? Partner with IT and SAP support teams to define data standards, migration requirements, and system improvements ? Establish and document SAP data governance procedures; train users on proper material master and BOM maintenance protocols **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** ? Serve as the primary liaison between Engineering and Operations/Supply Chain on product data matters ? Support New Product Development (NPD) by establishing BOM structure and SAP/PDM data readiness milestones ? Partic s degree with significant relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a four\-year degree **Experience** ? 3–7 years of experience in product data management, configuration management, or a related engineering role within a manufacturing environment ? Direct, hands\-on experience with SolidWorks PDM Professional (DocVault) required — including advanced user experience and familiarity with vault administration and workflow concepts ? Demonstrated experience managing Bills of Materials and engineering change processes ? Direct experience working within SAP (Business ByDesign and/or S/4HANA) required; experience with SAP material master and BOM management strongly preferred ? Experience supporting or participating in an SAP implementation or upgrade is a significant plus; S/4HANA Public Cloud experience is especially valued ? Experience using and managing data in SolidWorks Electrical is a significant plus ? Experience using company\-approved AI assistants to aid in daily tasks, consistent with company data\-handling policy is a significant plus **Technical Skills** ? Proficiency reading and interpreting engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications ? Strong understanding of BOM structures (single\-level, multi\-level, eBOM vs. mBOM) and SAP BOM management ? Working knowledge of SolidWorks (CAD) sufficient to navigate assemblies, drawings, and file relationships within the PDM vault ? Working knowledge of SAP material master concepts: material types, MRP views, unit of measure, procurement types, and understanding of cost rollups (costing is Finance\-owned) ? Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel for data analysis, mass upload preparation (loads performed through approved, logged templates), and reporting **Competencies** ? Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy ? Strong organizational and process\-orientation; comfortable building and enforcing standards ? Effective communicator across technical and non\-technical audiences ? Collaborative by nature with the ability to influence without direct authority ? Continuous improvement mindset; proactively identifies gaps and drives resolution **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ? Experience in industrial equipment, capital goods, or specialty manufacturing ? Familiarity with ISO 9001 document control requirements ? Exposure to ISA\-95 manufacturing hierarchy and integration concepts (MES/SAP/PDM layers) ? Understanding of rental or configured\-to\-order product models as they affect SAP BOM and material master structure ? SolidWorks PDM Professional certification a plus ? SAP certification (ByDesign or S/4HANA) a plus ? APICS CPIM or similar supply chain certification a plus **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This position is primarily office\-based within the engineering environment, with regular interaction with the manufacturing floor and IT to support data accuracy and change management activities. Occasional travel to supplier or customer sites may be required. The role requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. **Total Rewards** Sherman \+ Reilly offers a competitive total rewards package backed by the scale of Quanta Services, designed to support your financial, physical, and professional well\-being: * Competitive base salary with annual performance\-based bonus eligibility. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match. * Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and company\-paid life and disability insurance. * Support for professional development and CPA/CMA continuing education. * Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates. *Sherman \+ Reilly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About SimpliSafe** We're a high\-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state\-of\-the\-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. **Why are we hiring?** Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. The Device Connectivity team owns the cloud services that every SimpliSafe base station and camera connects to. We're modernizing those services, moving device messaging onto a new event\-streaming platform, and building the connectivity for our next generation of devices. All of this has to stay reliable through our busiest seasonal peaks. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and operate the C\+\+ and Go services that provide secure, reliable connections between the cloud and SimpliSafe devices and route their messages to the rest of our platform * Contribute to the shared libraries our services are built on, including metrics, tracing, logging, authentication, and concurrency primitives * Lead engineering projects end to end, from design doc through staged rollout, zero\-downtime production cutover and decommissioning (for example EC2 to Kubernetes, OS upgrades, CI/CD platform changes) * Help move device messaging onto an event\-streaming platform, including a shared event format, schemas and code generation, and load testing * Build cloud\-side connectivity for next\-generation devices, including new device capabilities, device provisioning, and certificate management * Design for reliability at peak load: connection limits, load shedding, connection draining, graceful shutdown, pre\-scaling, and multi\-region architecture. * Own observability for the services you work on: distributed tracing, metrics, crash detection, and dashboards and alerts managed as code * Debug hard production problems across services and AWS infrastructure, lead root\-cause analyses, and see the follow\-up work through * Write design documents, review designs from other teams, and work with other engineering teams on features that span devices and the cloud * Keep services secure and current: certificates and CAs, least\-privilege IAM, network policy, fixing security scan findings, and regular releases and dependency updates **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience * Very comfortable with AWS (EKS, load balancers, Lambda, SQS, S3, IAM), ideally including IoT Core (MQTT, rules, device certificates), or a similar cloud provider * Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions * Experience debugging production systems with traces, metrics, and logs (for example OpenTelemetry and Prometheus\-style metrics), and leading root\-cause analyses * A track record of leading a migration or large project from design doc through production cutover, and of setting a direction other engineers can follow * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar **Nice to have** * Strong production experience in modern C\+\+ and/or Go, including async I/O and concurrency * Hands\-on experience running production services on Kubernetes. * Experience with event\-streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pulsar, and with schema formats such as Avro or JSON Schema * IoT or embedded\-adjacent experience, such as device provisioning, PKI for device fleets, or MQTT\-based device protocols * C\+\+ build and library ecosystem experience, such as CMake, Conan. * Experience with Redis in production * Experience building networked services that manage many long\-lived TCP/TLS connections, including mutual TLS, backpressure, TLS termination * Experience writing automated integration and end\-to\-end tests in Python **What Values You'll Share** * Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them. * Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. * No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. * One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. The target annual base pay range for this role is $117,300 \- $156,400\. This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here. We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. *We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact* *careers@simplisafe.com**.*

jobs.title: Automation & Controls Engineer, Data Center Facilities
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. #### **AUTOMATION \& CONTROLS ENGINEER, DATA CENTER FACILITIES** As an Automation and Controls Engineer, you will design, program, commission, and own the controls for that plant. You will write robust control code, build operator interfaces people can trust, and take total ownership of live systems — tuning sequences, closing reliability gaps, and bringing new capacity online while the cluster is already in production. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, develop, and manage facility automation projects from sequence of operations and control narrative through panel build, point\-to\-point checkout, commissioning, failover testing, and handoff to operations. * Architect, write, and debug PLC and controller code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable across chillers, pumps, cooling towers, coolant distribution units, air handlers, heat rejection, and related plant equipment. * Implement lead/lag, staging, rotation, free\-cooling, and liquid\-cooling control strategies that hold capacity, efficiency, and redundancy (N\+1 / 2N) as the cluster load changes. * Keep the plant safe and reliable with fail\-safe interlocks, emergency power off and transfer logic, and alarm philosophy that meets NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 75, and applicable life\-safety requirements. * Build clear HMI and control\-room graphics so operators can see plant state, acknowledge alarms, trend equipment health, and troubleshoot without calling an engineer first. * Integrate equipment controllers into the site BMS, EPMS, and historian so power, cooling, and environmental data are one operational picture. * Design control panels and electrical interfaces compliant with NEC, NFPA, and UL 508A, including motor and VFD interfaces, safety circuits, and network architecture. * Own the systems after go\-live: alarm rationalization, loop tuning, sequence changes, outage support, and continuous improvement of uptime and energy performance. * Build schedules and punch lists for controls scope and drive vendors, contractors, and internal teams to hit them during construction and live expansions. #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, controls, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. * 1\+ years of experience in industrial controls, building or plant automation, data center facilities, or related programming (internship and extracurricular experience applies). #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Energized by fast, iterative design, construction, and commissioning on a live critical facility. * Proven ability to turn a messy plant problem into a simple, reliable control solution. * Clear written and verbal communication, including control narratives, sequences of operations, and recommendations across mechanical, electrical, and operations teams. * Judgment to move quickly while protecting people and equipment around high voltage, stored energy, refrigerants, fuel systems, and high\-pressure hydronics. * Experience in data centers, power generation, district energy, industrial utilities, or other 24/7 process plants. * Experience in at least one of the disciplines below, with a real interest in learning the others. * Sizing and application of motors, VFDs, starters, valves, actuators, instrumentation, and circuit protection for pumps, fans, towers, and plant equipment. * Design of fail\-safe circuits using safety relays and safety controllers, including interlocks that must hold during a loss of power or a controls failure. * Hands\-on troubleshooting of industrial electrical systems with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and network diagnostics. * Reading and producing schematics, panel layouts, riser diagrams, and one\-line diagrams (EPLAN preferred). * Fieldbus and Ethernet plant networks: BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, Profinet, and OPC UA. * Designing, building, and commissioning control panels and electromechanical systems with arc\-flash, lockout/tagout, and construction\-power constraints in mind. * Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, UL 508A, and data center facility standards, with the ability to apply them to control design. * PLC programming in structured text and ladder, preferably Rockwell (Studio 5000\), Siemens TIA Portal, or Beckhoff TwinCAT. * HMI, BMS, and SCADA development — Ignition, Niagara, or an equivalent platform — focused on fast navigation, meaningful alarms, trends, and equipment health. * Industrial protocols used in critical facilities: BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, SNMP, EtherNet/IP, and Profinet. * Applying control software to mechanical and electrical assemblies: sensors, VFDs, valves, and pump or fan systems, including a disciplined checkout before a system is allowed to carry load. * Experience with EPMS, power metering, generator or ATS status, and historian or alarming tools used to operate a data center. #### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Ability to work long hours, nights, and weekends when commissioning, failover testing, or a live plant event requires it. * Willingness to work on site in the data center, including mechanical plants, electrical rooms, and the data halls, for checkout and troubleshooting. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.***Hybrid Work Arrangement:*** A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **HUB LOCATIONS:** **Bloomington, IL****; Richardson, TX;** **Tempe, AZ; or** **Dunwoody, GA****SPONSORSHIP:** Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity. Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: Our team is helping shape the future of customer communications at State Farm through the **Merna platform**, an enterprise modernization initiative focused on creating simpler, more connected, and personalized digital experiences. A key part of this work is building the **Customer Communications Portal**, which will provide customers with a centralized location to access important documents, view communications across insurance products, and identify information or actions requiring their attention. Our initial focus is modernizing and consolidating existing customer and claims document experiences, while establishing the foundation for a future Digital Inbox that supports communication history, notifications, customer preferences, and personalized interactions. We are seeking an **experienced** **Software Engineer** to join our team. This is an **exciting opportunity** to help design, develop, and deliver modern, scalable solutions using cloud\-based technologies, APIs, GraphQL, and Merna's enterprise architecture. You will collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product partners, and user experience designers to build intuitive customer experiences and integrate with enterprise services and data sources. The role will involve solving complex integration challenges, contributing to technical design decisions, applying Agile and DevOps practices, and helping establish reusable capabilities that support future growth. This is an opportunity to contribute to a highly visible enterprise initiative, influence emerging technology solutions, and help transform how State Farm customers access and interact with their communications. Qualifications: **We Are Seeking Candidates With:*** AWS/Rosa Experience * Angular Experience * Java Experience Competencies* Adaptability * Initiative * Relationship building * Self\-Improvement * Teamwork Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $85,500 \- $110,000 + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + **High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience** * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!** * **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. Come join a \#1 team and do some good!**HYBRID:** A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Richardson, TX**SPONSORSHIP: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: The Policy Graph team is building the GraphQL layer that unifies policy data across State Farm's lines of business and policy systems, making it accessible to applications, digital experiences, and AI. We're building this from the ground up, defining the schemas, engineering patterns, and architecture that will support enterprise\-wide access to policy data. The technical challenges are significant. Policy data varies by state, line of business, and underlying system, spanning legacy platforms and multiple generations of modernization efforts. Our job is to bring that complexity into a consistent, modernized data model exposed through a performant and scalable graph. We're currently prototyping in TypeScript, but the production stack is still open. TypeScript, Go, Java, or a combination will be evaluated based on performance, scalability, and engineering tradeoffs. We're looking for engineers who have built and run federated GraphQL in production and want to help shape it at enterprise scale. What you'll do* Bring federated GraphQL expertise to the team: entity design, schema composition and evolution, and patterns other domains can follow. * Design the Policy GraphQL schema with architects and data model stewards. * Work closely with partner teams: architecture, consuming domains, policy administration system teams and the GraphQL platform team. * Build federated subgraphs that read close to the source: straight from databases, policy administration system APIs, or a read model we own. * Own performance against p99 targets: load test, profile and tune. Qualifications: * 6\+ years of software engineering experience. * Production experience with federated GraphQL: designing entities and keys, composing and evolving schemas across teams, for example with Apollo Federation or similar. * Passion for the work and a collaborative approach: you pair, give thoughtful code reviews, and welcome healthy debate with teammates and partner teams. * Backend development in one or more of Go, Java or Node.js/TypeScript. * Picks up new languages and technologies quickly. * Uses AI coding assistants effectively in day\-to\-day work. * Integrated services that call other systems, handling slow or failing dependencies, for example with timeouts, retries and batching. * Builds for the long term: automated unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests that catch regressions and keep the code safe to change. Desired, not required* Led federated GraphQL adoption or schema governance across multiple teams. * Go GraphQL (gqlgen) or Java GraphQL (Spring for GraphQL, Netflix DGS). * Temporal, or another durable workflow engine, for long\-running processes. * Diagnosed and fixed a latency or throughput problem using an APM tool such as Dynatrace or OpenTelemetry. * Built APIs on Kubernetes or OpenShift, and AWS. * Worked with canonical or industry data models, such as ACORD. * Insurance experience is a plus, not a requirement. * gRPC, event\-driven systems or caching. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $123,000 \- $142,000\. Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience. High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience. * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. You'll be at the forefront of providing operational support for DOL's extensive servers, infrastructure, networks, PCs, and hardware, spanning 19 offices and diverse security zones. Dive into exciting challenges, delivering top\-tier end\-user support through the DOL IT Helpdesk queue and MESD ticketing system, managing IT equipment, and resolving a variety of hardware, software, and network issues while supporting a wide range of in\-house and third\-party applications. **Our Mission, Values, and Culture:** The Department of Labor and Workforce Development is a dynamic department with diverse divisions.
