jobs.description: **Department Information** -------------------------- The Judicial Department works to provide equal access to justice, contribute to public safety, and strengthen the rule of law across Colorado. Together our courts and probation departments are committed to impartial and timely dispute resolution; support for families, litigants, and victims; client rehabilitation; and meaningful community engagement. **Description of Job** ---------------------- **General Statement Of Duties:** **Job Code: R44023** **Full Time Salary Range: $96,735\.84 \- $140,266\.80** **FLSA Status: Exempt** Learn more about employee benefits This posting may be used to create a Talent Pool. Talent Pools may be used for a period of 10 months after the closing date on a job posting. **Notice to Colorado Applicants:** In compliance with the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. The Senior Systems Engineer works with the private and public cloud infrastructure of the Colorado Judicial Department as a part of the Systems Engineering team. This includes consulting, planning, designing, installing, configuring, administering, and maintaining on\-premise x86 servers, SAN hardware, on\-premise and cloud Microsoft Windows and Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems, SaaS products and other elements of the Department’s IT infrastructure. **Distinguishing Factors:** This classification is distinguished from lower level Systems Engineers by a greater need for independent judgment, decision\-making, designing and planning to assist the Lead Systems Architect and the Systems Engineering team. Work focuses on private and public cloud infrastructure. Positions are within the Information Technology Services (ITS) Division. **Essential Functions:** Maintains the private and public cloud infrastructure. Acts as a resource to internal ITS staff, judicial districts, other state agencies, and/or other organizational units as directed. Displays leadership and mentoring for employees at the Systems Engineer I and II levels. Provides expertise and assistance to other employees. Assists with multi\-tier architectures including web servers, caching, application servers, load balancers, and storage. Assists with scripting and workload automation processes. Adheres to established change control procedures and assists development team during testing and deployment processes. Provides Tier 3 support for relevant systems. Develops and maintains relationships with vendors. Assists with database administration for server implementations. Assists with Java application server configuration. Provides architectural consulting expertise, direction, and assistance to other systems engineers. Conducts research on emerging technologies in support of infrastructure development efforts and recommends technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and infrastructure flexibility. Assists with duties relating to Active Directory and Office 365 infrastructure, including administration of users and groups, DNS, and PKI. Private cloud responsibilities include consulting on, planning, designing, installing, configuring, administering and maintaining x86 server and SAN hardware and related software, Fibre channel SAN infrastructure, VMware virtualization, backup infrastructure, and connectivity to other clouds and hosted services. Assists in operational duties relating to Active Directory and Office 365 infrastructure, including administration of users and groups, DNS, and PKI. Public cloud responsibilities include designing, deploying and migrating systems for IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and archiving environments. Works closely with Lead Systems Architect to identify, analyze and select cloud services for infrastructure architecture and business applications, and proposes plans for infrastructure investment. Assists Lead Systems Architect to develop and manage cloud infrastructure capacity plan. Maintains the private and public cloud infrastructure. Acts as a resource to internal ITS staff, judicial districts, other state agencies, and/or other organizational units as directed. Displays leadership and mentoring for employees at the Systems Engineer I and II levels. Provides expertise and assistance to other employees. Assists with multi\-tier architectures including web servers, caching, application servers, load balancers, and storage. Assists with scripting and workload automation processes. Adheres to established change control procedures and assists development team during testing and deployment processes. Provides Tier 3 support for relevant systems. Develops and maintains relationships with vendors. Assists with database administration for server implementations. Assists with Java application server configuration. Provides architectural consulting expertise, direction, rming the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit and reach with hands and arms and perform repetitive motions with wrists, hands, and fingers. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds or more. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, depth perception, ability to adjust and focus, and the ability to see clearly at 20 feet or more. **Work Environment:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts, work in high precarious places and the risk of electrical shock. Frequently handles emergency or crisis situations and may be subject to varying and unpredictable situations and work hours. The employee is subject to frequent interruptions, multiple calls and inquiries, and may occasionally handle absentee replacement on short notice. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. **Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Desired Experience:** Experience as an Engineer on IBM Power 9 servers of higher * Demonstrated working understanding of IBMi Operating Systems (V7R5M0 or Higher) and related products. * Experience with software replication technologies (Assure MIMIX) + Diverse experience in Disaster Recovery concepts and switch events + Would also like experience with Connect CDC (formerly MIMIX Share) * Monitor systems for performance and integrity * Excellent oral and written communication skills and strong attention to detail + Maintain complete and current technical documentation * Ability to help plan/coordinate and execute tasks as necessary. * Ability to handle multiple projects and work activities to meet deadlines. * Ability to work effectively as a member of a team and independently. The Information Technology Services (ITS) division is part of the State Court Administrator's Office within the Colorado Judicial Branch. Judicial ITS is a separate technology organization from the State of Colorado's Office of Information Technology (OIT), which serves executive branch agencies. Judicial ITS provides technology services exclusively for Colorado's courts, probation, and judicial operations. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- ***This position is only responsible for the IBM based functions of the job description.*** * Candidate must be available for on\-call, rotated every 3 weeks within the team, and become a point person for any production issues during that time. * This is a hybrid position based in Denver Colorado **\*Please note we are unable to provide H1B visa sponsorship\*** The Colorado Judicial Department is committed to ensuring equal access to and full participation in court and probation services and programs for qualified individuals with disabilities, including employees of the Colorado Judicial Department. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) is an important part of our culture, and we are committed to provide reasonable accommodations when needed without causing undue hardship to the Colorado Judicial Department. Each district has an ADA Coordinator and Jury Commissioner. Incomplete or new applications will not be accepted after this time.

jobs.title: Global PLM & AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description: **Shape the Future of Manufacturing Engineering** At **Stellantis**, we're transforming the future of mobility through advanced engineering, digital innovation, and global collaboration. As a **Global PLM \& AI Transformation Lead**, you'll help drive the evolution of our Manufacturing Engineering processes by combining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), enterprise data, and Artificial Intelligence to improve how we work, innovate, and scale knowledge across the organization. **What You'll Do** * Lead PLM transformation initiatives supporting global Manufacturing digital transformation initiatives. * Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, Teamcenter X, Active Workspace * **Working knowledge** of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI applications. * **Strong jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Foundations)
jobs.description: The **Senior Data Engineer – Platform Foundation** is a hands\-on, senior\-level contributor embedded in the Foundations squad. You will design, build, and evolve the shared ingestion platform that underpins data delivery across the company. The platform is the product — your job is to make it reliable, extensible, and easy for other teams to adopt. The Foundations squad operates across three pillars: simplifying the overall data platform landscape by reducing complexity and consolidating redundant patterns; enabling structured and unstructured data ingestion at scale; and supporting the exposure of data products to consumers across the organization. You contribute to all three — making architectural decisions, writing production code, and enabling other teams through documentation and hands\-on support. **Platform Foundation Development** * Design and implement reusable ingestion components using dlt and dbt\-core, covering both structured and unstructured data sources, handling high\-volume, append\-heavy, and schema\-drifting patterns * Own the Airflow platform end\-to\-end: extend and maintain DAGs and shared operators, handle deployments and version upgrades, and provide hands\-on support to consuming teams * Ensure incremental loading strategies, data quality checks, and lineage metadata are first\-class outputs of every pipeline **Platform Simplification \& Architecture** * Identify and eliminate redundant ingestion patterns across consuming teams, drive standardization onto shared Platform Foundation components * Collaborate with Solution Architects to evolve the platform architecture in response to new data sources and shifting business requirements * Support data product exposure: define and implement governed interfaces that make data reliably accessible to internal consumers * Contribute to Terraform\-managed infrastructure; participate in multi\-cloud (AWS / Azure) deployment patterns **AI Tooling \& Developer Productivity** * Actively use and evaluate AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) to accelerate platform Foundation delivery * Champion AI tooling adoption within the squad; share best practices and guardrails around AI\-generated code review * Explore AI\-powered capabilities (RAG pipelines, LLM\-assisted data cataloguing) for internal platform documentation and self\-service enablement **DevOps \& Reliability** * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, GitHub Actions) for platform Foundation components * Define and enforce observability standards: DAG/Task\-level alerting, SLA tracking * Participate in on\-call rotation for critical ingestion pipelines; drive post\-incident improvements **Team Enablement \& Stakeholder Management** * Produce platform Foundation documentation, runbooks, and enablement materials for consuming squads * Translate ambiguous or moving business requirements into concrete technical designs — comfortable challenging scope when needed * Mentor mid\-level engineers; participate in hiring and technical assessments Requirements: **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, Computer Science, or related field * Minimum 5 years in data engineering roles, with at least 2 years in a senior / platform\-level position * Proven track record building production ingestion and transformation pipelines at scale * Experience contributing to a shared platform or internal developer tooling consumed by multiple teams **Core Technical Skills**: * Python: idiomatic, testable, production\-grade code — not just scripting * dbt\-core: advanced modelling (custom materializations), testing, documentation, packages * Apache Airflow: DAG design patterns, custom operators, dynamic task mapping, SLA management * Cloud data platforms: comfortable with one or more major cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric) * SQL: complex analytical queries, window functions, query profiling * Git, CI/CD: trunk\-based development, automated testing gates, pipeline\-as\-code **AI \& Modern Tooling:** * Daily user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code or equivalent) * Understands the limits of AI\-generated code — applies rigorous review, not blind trust * Interest in LLM\-powered data tooling (RAG pipelines, Cortex, semantic layers) is a plus

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer- Contract Role
jobs.description: **Data Platform Engineer – Contract** **Sterling Infrastructure, Inc.** **Build the Technology Behind the Infrastructure** At Sterling Infrastructure, we're building more than infrastructure. We're investing in technology and data solutions that help drive smarter business decisions across our organization. We're seeking an experienced Data Platform Engineer for a **contract opportunity** at our office in The Woodlands, TX. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: **About Telegent** ------------------ Want to use your mobile phone to set up call routing? Transfer a call to a colleague or an AI agent? Set up call filtering or a receptionist? All without an app, directly on the mobile network. ✅ Done. Now, want to do all of that without a SIM installed on a mobile device, or without a device at all? That's headless programmability: AI\-native workflows on a real mobile number. Come help us build the mobile network for all agents, and the safe tech it can power. **Culture \& pace** ------------------- We build fast, deliver fast, and ship fast, and what we ship is high\-quality code. You'll move faster than you ever imagined and feel truly accomplished doing it. This may be some of the most meaningful work of your career: building technology that doesn't exist anywhere else. Expect to contribute to patents and verifiable work, and to learn more here than anywhere you've been. **Who you are** --------------- You've written enough code and built enough systems at scale to show real mastery. You get the git versioning jokes and the Linux memes, and your servers hiccup in fear of Kai Lentit Seriously, though, you: * Know the end\-to\-end systems lifecycle and full\-stack development inside and out * Build apps and services on our established architecture and own your work end to end * Have mastery over agentic coding, including: * + Worktree management vs. multi\-agent workflows + Skills, hooks, and routines + Flexibility across clients: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, even custom harnesses like OpenClaw and Hermes + Token optimization, plan mode, and structured approaches like SDD, TDD, SpecKit, and role\-based development * Have deployed systems at scale with agentic coding, and know the difference between vibe coding and enterprise\-grade agentic coding * Geek out over paradigm\-shifting approaches, like TypeSafe's Jev decision model routing an agent's steps, but don't let shiny object syndrome get in the way of shipping You can't imagine coding by hand anymore. Your best friend might be an agent. We don't judge. You can't imagine a world without Wispr Flow, and you can't believe humans used to spend their time typing. **Level: Senior** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Deliver the product roadmap.** Design, build and ship new capabilities across messaging (SMS, MMS and RCS), voice and carrier integrations as services on the new platform. * **Build on the target architecture.** Use the right store for each feature, follow the patterns and standards already set, and extend them where the roadmap needs it. * **Own features end to end.** From design through testing, release and monitoring in production, including the rollout and rollback plan. * **Keep services reliable at scale.** Watch performance and failure behaviour as partners and traffic grow, and fix what holds us back. * **Retire legacy workflows as you go.** When a feature moves to the new platform, switch off the legacy workflow it replaces, with no downtime. * **Keep the platform on track.** Work with engineering leadership on architecture decisions, raise risks early, and hold the standard: small, versioned, reversible changes behind PRs with CI. * **Grow together.** Collaborate closely with engineering, product and leadership in an AI\-native environment, learning from each other and raising the bar as a team. **The platform you will build on:** ----------------------------------- * **Relational database:** The transactional system of record, with real keys and integrity * **Wide\-column store:** High\-throughput message and call records (append\-heavy, the hot path) * **Event streaming:** The event and streaming backbone between producers and consumers * **Analytics store:** Analytics and reporting over message and call volume * **Ledger:** The accounting and usage ledger * **Cache:** Caching, hot lookups and rate limiting * **Object storage:** Large payloads, MMS media and archives **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **Product and application engineering.** A track record of shipping customer\-facing services and APIs at scale, from design to production. * **Distributed systems and data.** Deep, hands\-on experience across transactional, wide\-column, streaming, analytical, ledger, cache and object stores, and the judgment to use each one well. * **Reliability at scale.** Replication, consistency, sharding, and read and write access patterns, with RPO and RTO in mind. * **Cloud and infrastructure.** Azure first, plus multi\-region and multi\-provider deployments. * **Languages.** Fluent in TypeScript for product, services and APIs, and Go for high\-throughput services, plus SQL. * **AI\-native.** You practice enterprise\-grade agentic coding, not vibe coding, and you move easily across coding clients and harnesses. You arrive with your own setup of agents, skills and automations, and ideas on how to make ours better. * **Ownership and judgment.** You take work from idea to production without hand\-offs, raise problems early, and help keep the team pointed in the right direction. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Telecom or messaging platforms: SMS, MMS, SIP or carrier integrations * CQRS and event\-driven designs in production * Billing or ledger systems, where every entry is append\-only and auditable * Building to SOC 2 controls from the first line of code * Rust or C/C\+\+ for performance\-critical paths in the ledger and data plane **How we work** --------------- * **Learn, assess, benchmark, prepare solutions.** Every responsibility runs this arc, done fast. Your first deliverable is your own assessment and 100\-day plan. * **AI\-first.** Design and implementation are agent\-driven across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and multi\-agent workflows, so one engineer moves at the pace of a team. * **End\-to\-end ownership.** Engineers take their work from design through deployment and production. * **Small, reversible changes.** Versioned, behind PRs with CI, with release tags and documentation that updates as the code does. * **Security from the start.** New systems are built to SOC 2 controls, with architecture decisions recorded as ADRs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI-Powered Software Assurance
jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D Job ID: A236737A to this job Responsibilities We build an internal software assurance platform that helps engineering and security teams analyze source code, assess vulnerabilities and evaluate compliance requirements. The platform combines agentic AI workflows with code\-analysis tools to investigate complex codebases and produce actionable, evidence\-backed findings. We focus on deep code understanding across languages, rigorous measurement of analysis quality, and reliable execution at production scale. We are looking for a hands\-on software engineer who can expand these workflows’ analytical capabilities and build the reliable, scalable services that run them. Build and improve agentic workflows. Develop orchestration, tool integrations, context retrieval, state management and recovery mechanisms for multi\-step software assurance investigations. Develop deep, multi\-language code analysis. Build tools that navigate large repositories, trace control and data flows, resolve cross\-file references and dependencies, and connect evidence across files, services and languages. Combine LLM reasoning with deterministic analysis where appropriate. Measure output quality rigorously. Build representative evaluation datasets, expert\-reviewed reference cases and repeatable evaluation pipelines. jobs.title: Senior Agent Designer
jobs.description: **Role** -------- You will be the first designer dedicated to Sidekick Labs. You will design how Sidekick (our AI agent) thinks, behaves, and acts, not just how it looks. That means the conversation, the moments where Sidekick hands over a real thing (a quote, an invoice, a post), how it shows its work, how it recovers when it gets something wrong, and how a Pro finds out what it can do. You'll write the prompts and the rubrics that define "good." Then you'll check the traces to see if we hit it. You'll report to the VP of Design and work closely with our Head of App Experience, Sidekick Labs engineers and product manager. **What you'll work on** * **One Sidekick, everywhere** \- Sidekick shows up across the app, the web dashboard, and partner surfaces. Today Sidekick is only available on our mobile app and is not available for all our products. You'll lead the audit and set the patterns to fix that. * **From chat to artifact** \- A pro says "okay, make it a quote." Sidekick keeps writing text. You'll design the handoff from conversation to real, editable work. * **Show your work** \- Pros trust what they can see. You'll design how Sidekick explains what it did and why, without burying a busy pro in detail. * **The wait** \- Complex requests take time. You'll design the waiting experience so Sidekick feels fast and in control, even when it's thinking. * **Discoverability** \- Our bet is that pros adopt features by talking to Sidekick, not by hunting through menus. You'll figure out how Sidekick teaches a pro what it can do, at the right moment. * **Agent behavior** \- Define tone, clarifying questions vs. just acting, error recovery, confirmation before anything goes out to a customer. You'll own these as design decisions and write them into prompts and system rules. * **Evals** \- You'll define what a good response looks like, write the rubrics, label real conversations, and work with engineering to turn that into automated checks. * **The cookbook** \- You'll turn what we learn into reusable agent design patterns other pods can pick up and use. Think design system, but for agent behavior. * **New conventions** \- Most of the patterns for agents don't exist yet. You'll invent new ones that feel obvious to a pro the first time they see them. * **Where Sidekick goes next** \- You'll help shape the Sidekick Labs roadmap with the PM and engineers. You'll bring a point of view on what we should build, not just how it should look. **What you bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years of product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work. * 2\+ years designing LLM\-powered products that are live with real users. Agents, assistants, or copilots. Not just concepts. * You've written prompts and system instructions that shipped. You know how a small wording change moves behavior. * You're comfortable in the weeds. You can read a trace, spot where an agent went wrong, and say why. * You think in systems. You can design a pattern once and make it work across ten agents. * You write clearly and plainly. In an agent product, the copy is the product. * You've done research with people who aren't tech\-first, and you respect how they work. * You prototype in code. HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, or React Native, with help from AI tools like Claude Code. You use prototypes to test behavior against the real model, not just screens. * You stay close to the models. You know what the latest ones can and can't do, and you design for where they're going, not where they were six months ago. * Your craft is strong. Your UI is polished, clear, and builds trust. * You've owned complex products end to end in messy, undefined spaces, and shipped anyway. * You're happy in a small, fast team where the problem isn't fully defined yet. **About Sidekick Labs** ----------------------- Sidekick Labs is our AI agent team that is focused on making our agents trustworthy for the pros who use them, and for the teams who build them. We have three jobs: * **Build a platform other teams can build on.** Any pod at Topline Pro should be able to ship an agent without us holding their hand. * **Build a conversational experience Pros trust.** Every agent should feel like one Sidekick. Pros stay in control while Sidekick does the work. * **Build agents we're confident in.** Every agent completes real tasks correctly, and we can prove it. **About Topline Pro** ===================== We're building an AI\-powered Shopify for service businesses. We help service pros (e.g., roofers, landscapers, painters, cleaners) acquire direct business, fast. Up and running within minutes using Gen AI, our digital storefront products help pros get discovered, trusted, and booked repeatedly. Topline Pro was co\-founded by Nick Ornitz (CEO) and Shannon Kay (COO), with an excellent team of 120\+ rockstars and plans to expand further in 2026\. We serve thousands of local service businesses and were named one of the top 50 Tech Companies building for SMBs in 2023 and 2024\. We're YC\-backed and well\-funded, with several years of runway, and we've experienced rapid growth over the past year. We're in a phenomenal position to scale, with the financial foundation, product\-market fit, and momentum to go big. You'll be joining at an inflection point, where the groundwork is laid, and the path to massive impact is clear. We believe "great candidates" do not come about simply from a check mark next to past experience. We believe in hiring people, not just skills. Even if you do not check every box but find excitement at the prospect of working with us in this capacity, please apply. Topline Pro is committed to building an inclusive workplace and assembling a team from diverse backgrounds. We ensure that individuals with disabilities receive reasonable accommodation throughout the application and interview process. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented candidates and those from nontraditional backgrounds.

frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs. * A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI\-agent, forward\-deployed, or data\-product company. * Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon. **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. jobs.title: Intermediate Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT Operations**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Intermediate Data Engineer is responsible for the development and support of systems, services, and applications required for the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of all forms of data to enable data\-driven decisions and outcomes across the enterprise.**Job Description** **Responsibilities** * Work collaboratively with other engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and business product owners in an agile environment. * Build and support the operation of Cloud and On\-Premises enterprise data infrastructure and tools. * Design robust, reusable and scalable data driven solutions, and data pipeline frameworks to automate the ingestion, processing and delivery of structured and unstructured batch and real\-time streaming data. * Build data APIs and data delivery services to support critical operational processes, analytical models and machine learning applications. * Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities. * Understand and implement best practices in management of enterprise data, including master data, reference data, metadata, data quality and lineage. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, engineering, or relevant technical field * Two years of collective experience in the application of data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, business intelligence, database administration and data integration concepts and methodologies * One year of experience developing and supporting modern data architectures * One year of experience developing and supporting large\-scale distributed applications * One year of experience with Linux operations and development, including basic commands and shell scripting * One year of experience with execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery * Knowledge of SQL for data profiling, analysis and extraction * Results oriented with a strong customer focus * Ability to work within a team environment * Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines * Ability to learn and keep pace with the latest technology advances and quickly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g. computer science, math, engineering) * Two years of experience developing, integrating REST APIs with backend data processing workflows using AWS Services * Experience with Snowflake cloud data platform, including data integration and ETL/ETL development * Understanding of b omes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure. With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data \& analytics, risk \& controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development. Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change. **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role and team** Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a Software Engineer II on our Data and Storage teams, you will architect the foundational infrastructure that powers business decisions and core services for millions of users. Whether you are scaling distributed storage platforms or building high\-performance data pipelines, you will be solving complex challenges at the intersection of low latency, high correctness, and massive scale. The problems here are messy and the systems are global. You’ll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end\-to\-end, and stay calm when high\-load systems are on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring, and believe that the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross\-functional collaboration. If you’re energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world \- this is where you’ll grow. **What you’ll do** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality code for features of moderate complexity and projects with multiple dependencies. * Build and scale foundational infrastructure and data pipelines, balancing technical debt and shifting priorities while keeping long\-term impact in mind. * Own the software lifecycle end\-to\-end, from drafting design docs to debugging production issues and managing incidents independently. * Collaborate across disciplines \- including Product, Data Science, and Ops \- to translate ambiguous requirements into simple, elegant system designs. * Champion engineering best practices by providing quality code reviews, creating comprehensive tests, and improving system performance. * Navigate internal complexity and stakeholder inquiries to unblock dependencies and ensure the reliability of our production environment. **Basic Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+). * Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design. * Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience identifying and reducing code\-level technical debt in high\-load distributed systems. * Background in mentoring new team members and contributing to engineering culture. * Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real\-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering architectural rewrites. * **Bridge Systems and ML:** Integrate production machine learning models and real\-time inference pipelines into the critical serving path for dynamic pricing, ETA estimation, reliability. * **Drive Engineering Excellence:** Lead performance profiling, capacity planning, and chaos testing across high\-traffic production environments, raising the bar for system resilience Our engineers embed directly with operational teams to understand complex workflows, reimagine what's possible with agentic AI, and build production\-grade systems that turn those opportunities into reality. We are looking for an Agentic Software Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent, reliable agentic systems that transform complex operational workflows at scale. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, production reliability, and applied AI, combining strong technical ownership with a forward\-deployed engineering approach. You'll work closely with operators and domain experts to identify high\-impact opportunities, determine where AI agents can safely and effectively improve workflows, and translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production\-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to shape how Uber applies agentic AI to real\-world operations while helping establish the technical foundations for broader adoption across the company. **What You'll Do** Measurable, and Trustworthy AI Systems** * Develop evaluation frameworks to measure agent effectiveness, including task completion, output quality, tool selection, policy compliance, and failure handling. * Implement testing and validation strategies across development, controlled rollouts, and production environments to ensure consistent and predictable system behavior. * Design appropriate safeguards, including access controls, human approvals, auditability, data protection, reversible actions, and escalation mechanisms. * Collaborate with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Data teams to ensure AI\-powered workflows meet Uber's standards for safety, compliance, and operational integrity. **Drive Reusability and Engineering Excellence** * Identify opportunities to transform individual solutions into reusable agent capabilities, shared services, platform components, and standardized integration patterns. * Design flexible architectures that support different business needs and regional requirements without unnecessary duplication. * Contribute to engineering standards, architecture decisions, development tooling, deployment practices, and reliability frameworks that enable scalability, reliability, and opportunities for reuse. * **Collaborative problem solver:** You learn unfamiliar domains quickly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and communicate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams. **Minimum Qualifications** * PhD or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field; **or** 3 years of full\-time software engineering experience, including 2 years of specialized technical software engineering experience in one or more programming languages, such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, or Go. *Note: The 2 years of specialized software engineering experience may be gained through education, full\-time employment, additional training, coursework, research, or a combination of these. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Uber Health
jobs.description: About the Role At **Uber Health**, we are reimagining how patients access care, medications, and health services by connecting healthcare organizations, payers, and patients directly with Uber’s global mobility and delivery logistics network. Operating at massive scale, Uber Health powers millions of non\-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) rides and prescription deliveries annually across thousands of enterprise healthcare partners. Beyond core logistics infrastructure, as a Staff Software Engineer you will serve as a key technical leader, setting long\-term architectural strategy and pioneering our next\-generation **agentic AI platform**. You will architect autonomous workflows across secure, HIPAA\-compliant patient and provider communication channels, mentor senior engineers across the organization, and drive engineering excellence to solve critical healthcare access challenges reliably and safely within highly regulated environments. What You’ll Do * **Architect the Shared Agentic AI Platform:** Lead the backend design and long\-term system architecture of a shared, reusable agentic platform, enabling AI models to safely execute connected, multi\-step autonomous workflows across secure healthcare communication channels. * **Build Production AI Guardrails \& Control Systems:** Connect AI\-driven agentic capabilities to core business systems with explicit access boundaries, fine\-grained action permissions, deterministic fallbacks, and automated verification layers to ensure predictable, highly reliable execution. * **Healthcare API Integrations:** Build secure, reliable integrations with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, Third\-Party Administrators (TPAs), and enterprise healthcare portals, extending them to support intelligent, AI\-driven automation. * **Ensure Compliance \& Security:** Drive best practices around data privacy, HIPAA compliance, and data governance across multi\-tenant platform services—guaranteeing robust PHI isolation across all traditional and AI\-driven workflows. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Operations, Legal, and Design to turn complex, highly regulated healthcare and AI\-driven requirements into robust, reusable technical roadmaps for Uber for Business (U4B) enterprise customers. * **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:** Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior and mid\-level engineers, champion high engineering standards, lead architecture reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence across the team. Basic Qualifications * **Education \& Experience:** BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, with 8\+ years of professional software development experience. * **Distributed Systems Expertise:** Proven track record of designing, building, scaling, and operating high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems and microservices in cloud environments. * **Core Engineering Proficiency:** Deep programming expertise in languages such as Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+. Preferred Qualifications * **Domain Expertise:** Experience in healthcare tech, HIPAA/PHI compliance, NEMT, or enterprise SaaS integrations. * **Production AI \& Agentic Workflows:** Hands\-on experience building, scaling, and operating production\-grade AI systems, agentic frameworks, or LLM\-integrated workflows connected directly to enterprise backend systems. * **AI Security \& Governance Controls:** Direct experience defining runtime permissions, execution limits, access boundaries, and auditability mechanisms for AI agents taking actions within production systems. * **Enterprise Client\-Facing Architecture:** History of collaborating closely with strategic enterprise customers or partners to distill complex operational requirements into unified platform architecture. * **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:** Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy for cross\-team initiatives, navigate ambiguous business requirements, balance speed with platform stability, and mentor engineers to level up overall technical capability. jobs.title: Middle SOC Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Position Summary:** We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Middle SOC Security Engineer. UnderDefense is looking for a motivated and proactive engineer to join our MDR Engineering team. This role focuses on configuring, maintaining, and improving security monitoring infrastructure across multiple client environments. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with at least one SIEM platform, a solid understanding of security technologies, and a willingness to learn new tools and approaches. We value engineers who take ownership of technical challenges, work independently, and collaborate with the team to deliver effective solutions for our clients. ### **Job Responsibilities:** * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SIEM platforms, including Elastic Security, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and other solutions depending on client environments. * Integrate log sources from Windows, Linux, network devices, cloud services, Microsoft 365, and EDR/XDR solutions. * Configure and maintain log collection through agents, connectors, APIs, and Syslog. * Troubleshoot log ingestion, parsing, indexing, and integration issues. * Develop and maintain parsers for different log sources. * Create, test, and optimize detection and correlation rules to improve threat detection and reduce false positives. * Configure SIEM indexes, retention policies, and manage log ingestion volumes. * Maintain integrations between SIEM/EDR/XDR solutions and the MAXI platform. * Support technical onboarding of new clients and ensure proper integration into SOC monitoring. * Monitor the health and performance of existing security solutions. * Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. * Communicate directly with clients’ IT and security teams to understand technical requirements, discuss challenges, and provide solutions. * Prepare technical documentation, configuration guides, and troubleshooting instructions. * Collaborate with other engineers to improve existing processes, automate repetitive tasks, and support the scalability of MDR services. ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience with at least one SIEM platform, preferably Elastic Security, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or a similar solution. * Practical experience with log collection, processing, analysis, or security integrations. * Understanding of Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and common network protocols. * Familiarity with Syslog, APIs, JSON, and log formats. * Experience writing SIEM queries and working with detection or correlation rules. * Understanding of EDR/XDR technologies and their role in security monitoring. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills. * Basic scripting skills in Bash, Python, or PowerShell. * Ability to independently investigate technical issues, take ownership of tasks, and deliver results. * Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different security platforms and client environments. * English communication skills sufficient to discuss technical issues and solutions directly with clients. ### **Nice to Have:** * Previous experience in a SOC, MDR, or MSSP environment. * Hands\-on experience with Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Elastic Agent). * Experience with CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender. * Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Experience configuring SIEM environments or integrating log sources from scratch. * Experience with Git and automating repetitive engineering tasks. * Experience supporting multiple client environments. ### **The UnderDefense Mission Is Rooted in Values That Drive Us:** * We believe that success lies in execution, not credentials. * We act like owners, not just employees. * We work to find answers on our own, not wait for them to be given to us. * We optimize for mission, not ego. * We take responsibility for solving problems, even when they involve unfamiliar technologies. * We have growth mindsets, not fixed ones. ##### **About this position** Location Remote Employment type Full time Department SOC ##### **Got Questions?** **Let Us Help!** ##### **Mariia Ostrovska** Recruitment Specialist job@underdefense.com

jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** =========================== Organization's Summary Statement: The A. James Clark School of Engineering at the University of Maryland serves as the catalyst for high\-quality research, innovation, and learning, delivering on a promise that all graduates will leave ready to impact the Grand Challenges (e.g., energy, environment, security, and human health) of the 21st century. The Clark School is dedicated to leading and transforming the engineering discipline and profession, to accelerating entrepreneurship, and to transforming research and learning activities into new innovations that benefit millions. About the CATT Lab The Center for Advanced Transportation Technology (CATT) Laboratory is the industry leader for transportation information analysis, visualization, and user interface design. We provide cutting\-edge analytics products and an integrated suite of situational awareness tools for transportation practitioners. These products and services are rapidly changing the way governments operate and make decisions. You can learn more about our products at https://ritis.org/. We receive hundreds of gigabytes of transportation data daily, making our petabytes of archived data likely the largest collection of traffic data in the world. Our clients use our software to monitor real\-time operations and analyze historical data to generate valuable insights. Our work saves taxpayers money, improves the environment, and saves lives! We’re as passionate about transportation as we are about building great software. We care about building usable, stable, and secure software to analyze massive amounts of data. We use cutting\-edge tech to build and maintain our software. We have a mature development process and use industry best practices to build the best software possible. Our team is composed of application developers, analysts, UX designers, data scientists, IT, quality assurance specialists, and customer support operating in an Agile environment. Our office is in College Park near the University of Maryland, easily accessible by DC Metro, MARC train, bus, car, and bike. Local employees are welcome to work in our office, or other locations, with a flexible schedule around our core hours. We also have many employees who are fully remote and work from different states. UMD requires all employees to live in the US, and we periodically bring remote employees to work with colleagues on\-site. We believe varied perspectives build better products, are proud to have a diverse team, and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. When you join our team, you will work to define, document, and test a wide variety of transportation data analytics and operations applications. You will learn new skills and stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies. Data Engineer Position Summary: The CATT Lab is seeking a mid\-career or senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This individual will work to design, develop, and support over 40 relational database instances and distributed Cassandra and Hadoop instances. They will design geospatial data processing solutions for critical infrastructure planning and operations managers, applying their knowledge, skills, and experience to create stable, secure, and reliable data platforms supporting custom data analytics applications. If you’re looking for complex data problems in the GIS domain to collaboratively solve with a brilliant research and development team, please apply! Essential duties and responsibilities: Design, develop, deploy, and manage data storage and processing solutions Develop data models and schemas for new data sources for both relational and non\-relational distributed platforms Write and maintain data pipelines to ingest large datasets from APIs and cloud storage to local storage instances Write data retrieval, statistical calculation, and geospatial analysis queries and stored procedures Assist with analysis and discovery of new datasets for integration into existing internal platforms Collaborate with the data platform team to optimize data processing pipeline performance. Work with application developers to debug and tune queries for performance Estimate effort for work tasks and report on work progress to technical team lead Participate in our Tier II Support team rotation Minimum Qualifications Education: B.S. Degree in Computer Science or related field Experience: 2\+ years relevant professional experience with design, development, and administration of data platform solutions Experience deploying, configuring, maintaining, and upgrading production\-level database servers and services Experience leading or supporting the implementation of complex, high demand and volume data platform solutions. Experience in a technical team individual contributor role, responsible for deliverables on multiple projects. Experience writing ETL scripts, APIs and standalone applications in both Python and Java with advanced knowledge of SQL. Preferences: Experience administering PostgreSQL servers, performance tuning, streaming replication, and PgBouncer failover configuration Experience with non\-relational data storage and processing solutions like Cassandra, Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg, Sedona etc. Experience working with geospatial datasets, using geospatial extensions (such as PostGIS) and querying features. Experience with Linux (RHEL), including writing robust Bash scripts. Experience architecting and implementing backup and recovery strategies. Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket. Experience with cloud platforms including AWS and GCP. Experience as a technical lead, overseeing the work product of others and mentoring more junior developers. Physical Demands: Sedentary work performed in an office environment. Regularly required to communicate and exchange information and to use technology/devices. Location Position can be 100% remote (US based only) Licenses/ Certifications: NA **Additional Job Details** ========================== **Required Application Materials: Resume** **Best Consideration Date: 11/19/2026** **Posting Close Date: NA** **Open Until Filled: YES** **Financial Disclosure Required** ================================= No For more information on Financial Disclosure, please visit Maryland's State Ethics Commission website . **Department** ============== ENGR\-Civil\-Center for Advanced Transportation Technology **Worker Sub\-Type** ==================== Faculty Regular **Salary Range** ================ $100,000\- $130,000 **Benefits Summary** ==================== For more information on Regular Faculty benefits, select this link . **Background Checks** ===================== Offers of employment are contingent on completion of a background check. Information reported by the background check will not automatically disqualify anyone from employment. Before any adverse decision, the finalist will have an opportunity to provide information to the University regarding disclosable background check information. The University reserves the right to rescind the offer of employment or otherwise decline or terminate employment if the information reported by the background check is deemed incompatible with the position, regardless of when the background check is completed. **Employment Eligibility** ========================== The successful candidate must complete employment eligibility verification (on Form I\-9\) by presenting documents that establish identity and work authorization within the timeframe required by federal immigration law, and where applicable, to demonstrate renewed employment authorization. Failure to complete employment eligibility verification or reverification within the timeframe set forth by law may result in suspension or termination of employment. **EEO Statement** ================= The University of Maryland, College Park is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. Please read the University’s Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy. **Title IX Non\-Discrimination Notice** ======================================= **Resources** ============= * Learn how military skills translate to civilian opportunities with O\*Net Online **Search Firm Managed Recruitment** =================================== There are some positions that are not advertised on this career site as the search is being managed by a Search Firm.

certification. * Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Engineer/Programmer/Analyst or equivalent in an information systems development environment. **Performance Expectations \- Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Two to three years of hands\-on technical experience with Web programming in Java/Spring/HTML/CSS/JS * One to two years’ hands\-on technical experience with at least three of the following technologies: * + Portal Solutions + Spring + XML, JSON + Oracle development tools such as SQL Developer, including Oracle Forms. + Relational database expertise and design of relational databases either Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server + PL/SQL, packages, stored procedures and triggers. + UNIX shell (or similar scripting languages), Linux/UNIX + Identity and Access Management/LDAP + Document Imaging solutions + Mobile/Hybrid Technologies (Ex: Flutter) * Experience in handling and supporting patches and upgrades in a production environment. * Understanding database technical architecture, APIs, middle tier integration, Webservices and integration. * Good Understanding of cyber security and their best practices. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose/resolve technical problems Cursor) to support coding, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output and recognize its limitations, including inaccuracies, security vulnerabilities, and licensing concerns. * Familiarity with prompt engineering and rapid prototyping (“vibe coding”) approaches. * Understanding of data privacy, security, and ethical considerations related to the use of AI in a higher education environment. * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with technical staff as well as non\-technical users. * Clearly demonstrated ability to jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** ------------ Upstart's Bank Technology team builds the software systems, automation, and internal platforms that enable Upstart Bank to operate efficiently, securely, and at scale. The team partners closely with stakeholders across risk, legal, compliance, and operations to replace manual processes with purpose\-built solutions that support the bank's growth and regulatory requirements. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build internal applications that power critical bank functions. You'll work across software systems, automation, integrations, and platform tooling, helping translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions that deliver meaningful operational impact. **How you'll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Design, build, and maintain internal software platforms that support risk, compliance, legal, and operational workflows across Upstart Bank. * Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and intuitive user experiences. * Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and data workflows that connect internal systems with third\-party platforms. * Design relational data models, authorization frameworks, audit capabilities, and background processing systems that support secure and reliable operations. * Write technical designs, architectural documentation, and implementation plans that establish durable engineering patterns and reduce future maintenance costs. * Contribute to technical decisions regarding system architecture, build\-versus\-buy evaluations, and long\-term platform scalability. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 4\+ years of software engineering experience. * Experience designing, building, and operating production web applications used by internal or external customers. * Experience designing relational database schemas and managing complex data models using PostgreSQL or a similar relational database. * Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs, integrations, webhooks, or distributed system interfaces. * Experience implementing application security fundamentals, including authentication, role\-based access control, audit logging, and schema migrations. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Knowledge of TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Prisma, or similar modern web application frameworks. * Experience building internal tooling, workflow platforms, or operational software systems. * Familiarity with regulated environments such as financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance\-driven industries. * Knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, security tooling, or operational controls. * Ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $164,800—$228,400 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

**Your Role at a Glance** Analytics engineering and Gold\-layer development * Develop and maintain certified use\-case data models in dbt, including dimensional models, fact tables and reusable business metrics Semantic layer and metric governance * Author domain metrics, dimensions, hierarchies and time\-intelligence logic according to the approved framework, maintaining definitions and lineage Business intelligence delivery * Build and optimize Power BI dashboards based on certified Gold data and governed semantic metrics Quality, documentation and enablement * Implement automated data\-quality tests, maintain technical documentation and support self\-service adoption and training materials **Operational tasks** * Develop and maintain the domain Use\-case (Gold) layer in dbt, following approved modeling and naming standards * Build dimensional models, fact tables and business metrics from the Domain (Silver) layer * Implement and maintain dbt data\-quality tests and semantic metrics * Apply data\-security requirements, including appropriate access controls and row\-level security when required * Support business analysts and end users with self\-service guidance and training materials. Management * No direct people management responsibility. Expected to coordinate technical work across business and technology stakeholders and contribute to peer reviews and knowledge sharing. Expected deliverables * Certified Gold\-layer dbt models; tested and documented data products; governed semantic metrics; optimized Power BI dashboards; data contracts; lineage and metric documentation; user enablement materials **Tools** * SQL, dbt, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Power BI, DAX, Git, CI/CD pipelines and a semantic\-layer framework such as MetricFlow or the approved platform equivalent #### **What Sets You Apart** We're looking for individuals who bring the right mix of experience, mindset, and motivation: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics or a related field * Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered * Training or certification in dbt, Power BI, Databricks, dimensional modeling or cloud data platforms is an advantage * Advanced SQL skills * Hands\-on experience with dbt, including models, tests and documentation * Intermediate to advanced dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, grain and star schemas * Intermediate Power BI and DAX skills, including data modeling and report\-performance optimization * Experience with Git\-based version control and collaborative development practices * Working knowledge of data quality, metadata and lineage concepts * Experience with Databricks SQL and Unity Catalog * Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework such as dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for analytics engineering * Experience with data contracts and cross\-domain metric governance * Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric or cloud data platforms * Experience supporting self\-service analytics and user enablement #### **What Powers Your Performance** Success in this role is driven by a strong mix of personal ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Protecting our people is more than a priority, it's a promise we make to every colleague, every day.
