jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Verne is building physical AI to make physical work as scalable as software and bring general\-purpose robots to every business. We develop robots, foundation models, and the tools that turn them into reliable industrial deployments. Our open\-weight world action model, Verne V0\.5, brings together video and action learning. Alongside it, we build data and training systems, a fine\-tuning platform, and inference and control software. Our work is grounded in real deployments: learning new tasks efficiently, adapting to different environments, and operating reliably in production. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to design and build the core systems that power Verne’s robots in the real world. This is a hands\-on role where your work will directly translate to physical robots performing customer\-critical tasks. You’ll work across the full robotics software stack, from low\-level sensor and actuator interfaces, to deploying large\-scale policy learning pipelines, to shipping reliable features that customers depend on. Beyond just writing code, you’ll help design solutions, lead engineering efforts, and think cross\-functionally to bridge hardware, machine learning, and product requirements. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build and optimize robotics software in Python and C\+\+, spanning device drivers, control interfaces, and high\-level APIs that power real\-world deployments. * Integrate and deploy ML policies (PyTorch) into visuomotor control loops, ensuring efficient inference on edge hardware. * Design and test training pipelines for policy learning, including dataset preparation, augmentation, and scaling across massive multi\-modal datasets (video, teleop trajectories, sensor streams). * Develop infrastructure for teleoperation and autonomy, including real\-time data streaming, low\-latency WebRTC systems, and fallback human\-in\-the\-loop control. * Prototype new robot capabilities by collaborating closely with the hardware and research teams, translating experimental ideas into production\-ready features. * Systematically evaluate and test policies through lab trials and live customer proofs of concept, measuring performance, robustness, and safety at scale. * Contribute to cloud \+ edge scaling efforts, including AWS\-based data ingestion pipelines, IoT fleet management, and distributed training/serving infrastructure. * Take ownership of engineering projects end\-to\-end, from design discussions and architecture, to implementation, testing, and deployment in the field. * Work cross\-functionally with product, research, and customer teams to ensure the systems you build align with real\-world needs and unlock tangible customer value. **Qualifications** ------------------ * B.S., M.S., Ph.D. in computer science or related fields. * Strong programming skills in Python (you write clean, efficient, production\-ready code) * Solid experience with PyTorch and modern ML workflows * Systems engineering skills (networking, concurrency, performance) * At least 3 years of full\-time work experience for candidates with a B.S. in related fields. 1 year of experience for M.S. or Ph.D. candidates. * Experience with robotic arms, embedded systems, etc (e.g., Arduinos, motors, robot arms) **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with real\-time systems (cameras, sensors, streaming) * Hands\-on with AWS services (EC2, IoT, WebRTC) **Why Join Us** --------------- At Verne, you won’t just be writing code, you’ll be shaping the future of physical AI. You’ll see your work run on real robots, in real customer environments, with immediate impact. You’ll join a small, world\-class team where your contributions matter and your growth is accelerated. **Details** ----------- * Location: South San Francisco, CA (on\-site required) * Compensation: Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity * Perks: Free meals vouchers, hardware access, health benefits, PTO This is a rare chance to join a YC\-backed robotics startup early and help build the foundation of the company. If you’re excited about robots, passionate about solving hard problems, and eager to see your work come alive in the real world — we’d love to hear from you. Compensation Range: $140K \- $200K

jobs.title: AI Native Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** Versaterm is a PE\-backed, high\-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high\-stakes moments. When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real. **The Role** The AI Native Senior Software Engineer is a change agent and a driver of value within our public safety ecosystem. Public safety agencies, dispatchers, and first responders count on our software every day, so reliability and security come first. You will architect, own, and deliver innovation to customers and be accountable for the results it produces for our users and our business. You will work across the VersatermOS platform and our broader product portfolio, bringing deep technical and architecture knowledge together with AI native development practices to build solutions that are reliable, secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient. You will also lead by example and help engineers on the team(s) adopt the same ways of working. You should be passionate about shaping the future of public safety and revel in the fact that no task is too small or too big to make a difference to the people we serve. You will own and shape product with your team, from idea through production, and set the direction and tone for generating value for our customers and business. **The Direction** This position will have the opportunity to contribute to several tech stacks across our public safety portfolio. Our direction is to build working solutions quickly using the full range of AI native tools and practices, including coding agents, spec\-driven development, AI\-assisted design and code review, automated test generation, and agent workflows built into our CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with your team to do this without giving up the reliability, security, and quality our customers rely on. You will be a hands\-on leader in this space, setting the example for how we use AI to deliver software and helping staff build the same skill set you have. The AI Native Senior Software Engineer should be passionate about agentic development, architecture, and driving innovation to help shape the future of our software products. **What You Do** * Lead the design and architecture of complex, scalable software solutions, ensuring they are secure, highly available, fault tolerant, maintainable, and optimized for performance. * Take ownership of high\-impact projects from understanding the user's problem through design, implementation, deployment, and support in production, and check that what you shipped delivered the value we expected. * Mentor and provide guidance to associate engineers, helping them grow in their careers and improve their coding practices, including how they work with AI tools. Provide constructive feedback and assistance. * Be a leader in how our teams use AI to deliver software. Try new tools and approaches, figure out what actually works for our products, and turn it into shared practices, agent configurations, and examples the rest of the team can pick up. * Work closely with product managers, designers, customers, and other teams to deliver software in small increments of business value, using customer feedback and data to decide what comes next. * Focus on optimizing application performance, ensuring that the software scales effectively under increased loads and performs reliably in production. Set service level objectives (SLOs) and put the monitoring and alerting in place to meet them. * Support what you build in production. This includes taking part in on\-call, leading the response when critical issues come up, and following through on post\-incident reviews so the same problem doesn't happen twice. * Lead efforts to resolve complex technical issues and make sure software meets business requirements. Catch defects before they reach customers through automated test suites that cover the depth and breadth of solutions, quality gates in the CI/CD pipeline, and safe release practices like feature flags, staged rollouts, and quick rollback. * Build security into your work from the beginning with secure coding pr d proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\#, Python, JavaScript, or similar. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and principles for delivering Software as a Service (SaaS). Experience in designing scalable and distributed systems. * Experience building and running production systems with high availability requirements, including monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis. * Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, including continuous integration, continuous deployment, and tools like Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Terraform. * Experience with automated testing, test\-driven development (TDD), and testing frameworks. * Good understanding of secure development practices (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, and secrets management) and experience applying security controls in software and DevOps processes. * Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work cross\-functionally with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to pass required background and security screening, including the fingerprint\-based check required under the FBI CJIS Security Policy. **Asset Qualifications:** * Working knowledge of Microservices, SOA, Monolith, REST, RPC, SQL, NoSQL, etc. * Experience building and evaluating AI harnesses, MCP servers, knowledge graphs, multi\-agent workflows, and other agentic tooling. * Experience managing cost and token usage across multiple AI models and providers. * Experience setting up evaluations or other ways to measure the quality and impact of AI in the development process. * Experience with real\-time media processing algorithms and machine learning for transcribing and translating information. * Expertise in optimizing and fine\-tuning large\-scale applications for performance, scalability, and high availability. * Previous experience in mentoring or coaching associate engineers and fostering a positive, collaborative team culture. * Experience in industries such as finance, healthcare, public safety or government. * Familiarity with public safety and compliance standards such as CJIS, SOC 2, StateRAMP/FedRAMP, or NG911\. **Note:** Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint\-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the **FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center****.** Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate's skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. In addition to base salary and our comprehensive benefits offering, some roles may also be eligible for variable compensation such as incentive plans or discretionary performance bonuses. AI is central to how Versaterm builds and delivers solutions for our customers. Within Talent Acquisition, we use AI\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, helping our team work more efficiently and spend more time connecting with great talent. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people. Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier\-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact info@versaterm.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Management & Data Analytics
jobs.description: **I. Job Summary** The Senior Manager, Revenue Management Data Science leads a team of Data Scientists responsible for developing advanced analytics, predictive models, and data\-driven insights that optimize pricing strategies, customer lifetime value (CLV), and revenue growth. This role serves as a strategic partner to Customer Experience, Sales, and Pricing leadership, translating complex data into actionable recommendations that drive business performance and customer retention. The Senior Manager oversees the design, development, and implementation of statistical and machine learning models to support revenue management initiatives, including customer segmentation, lifetime value forecasting, price increase effectiveness, retention analysis, and revenue optimization. The role is accountable for ensuring high\-quality analytical deliverables while fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong leadership capabilities with deep technical expertise in SAS, Python, SQL, predictive analytics, and data modeling. They must be able to communicate complex analytical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, influence strategic decisions, and align analytics initiatives with business objectives. **II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, proactively identifying opportunities, challenging assumptions, and collaborating to develop data\-driven solutions. Demonstrate the business acumen to move beyond simply executing requests and help shape the right analytical approach. * Lead and develop a team of highly technical data scientists while remaining actively engaged in solution design, coding, and model development. Effectively balance individual technical contributions with delegating, reviewing, and guiding the team's work. * Partner with stakeholders to define business problems, recommend analytical approaches, and drive solutions from initial concept through development, implementation, and continuous refinement to deliver measurable business value. * Establishes strategic plans and objectives. * Creates and/or approves project plans and application designs to ensure projects are aligned with standards and IT strategy. Approves standards, policies, and procedures. * Provides expert technical and functional leadership and problem resolution to teams. * Coordinates with multiple teams and suggests solutions in support of technology needs of the business unit or function served. * Assigns and reviews work. Allocates appropriate resources to ensure that projects are completed within committed time and budget and are integrated with other software applications. * Maintains working relationship and coordinates with several teams to integrate project with applications and/or initiatives. * Coordinates communication about project status to all levels of the organization. * Prepares and/or provides budget input for ongoing and future expenditures, monitors budget performance, and provides forecasts. Monitors departmental performance against budget. * Coordinates and oversees recruiting, interviewing, hiring, career development, performance management, pay determination and team communication. **III. Qualifications** A. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's Degree (accredited) in Computer Science, MIS, Business Administration or similar area of study, or in lieu of degree * High School Diploma or GED (accredited) and 4 years of relevant experience. * 8 years or more years previous experience (in addition to education requirement) B. Preferred Qualifications * Project Management Certification * ITIL * Certified Software Test Engineer * equivalent C. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities * May require in\-depth skills in one or more of the following: PeopleSoft HRMS, ERP development, implementation and support, QA management experience and training experience, managing large\-scale data centers, ISeries, software analysis design and development, application development projects, programming/relational database, data warehousing, application testing, project lifecycle methodology, analytical skills, general IT knowledge, budgeting, accounting and finance, communication skills, executive leadership, strategic planning and simultaneous project management of multiple projects. D. Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities * Possess advanced, hands\-on proficiency in SAS, Python, SQL, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics. Must be capable of independently writing code, developing complex analytical models, troubleshooting technical challenges, and translating data into actionable business insights. **IV. Physical Requirements** Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. * Repetitive Motions * Eye/Hand/Foot Coordination * Sitting * Talking * Hearing Office: This job primarily operates in a professional office environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, copy machines, etc. **V. Benefits** At WM, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and short\-term disability. In addition, we offer a stock purchase plan, company matching on a 401(k), and more. Employees also receive paid vacation, holidays, and personal days. Please note that benefits may vary by site. If this sounds like the opportunity that you have been looking for, please click Apply.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Would you like to apply the leading edge of AI to some of the hardest problems in risk and insurance, inside a global company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join our Willis Neuron Technology team in New York or London as Lead AI Engineer: a senior, high\-autonomy individual contributor role in technology delivery, for someone already working at the frontier of AI engineering. You will work like a forward deployed engineer, as part of our delivery team rather than apart from it. Alongside brokers, actuaries, catastrophe modellers, architects and fellow engineers, you will get close to the real problem, prove what is possible in days, and then see it through to an industrialised solution: secure, tested, observable and supportable on our shared platform. This is not a line management role. We are looking for exceptional personal productivity and judgement: strong enough to deliver on your own, and collaborative enough to make the team around you better. Our delivery model is pivoting towards AI agent\-led development, and we are building agentic analytics, MCP services and AI\-enabled products on a rich estate of risk data and models. You will keep pace with the field and have the standing to decide what is worth adopting. **The Role** * Work as a forward deployed engineer within our delivery team: get close to brokers, actuaries, modellers and clients, and build AI solutions that differentiate WTW in the market, wherever they add the most value across R\&A and Data. * Prove ideas fast, with working software in days, then industrialise what works: take it through our delivery pipeline (backlog, code review, CI/CD, QA and release) into secure, supportable production services, handed over cleanly to service teams. * Design and build agentic analytics and AI\-enabled products using large language models, RAG, MCP and modern agent frameworks, as reusable components and services on our shared platform rather than one\-off solutions. * Own the quality bar for AI in production, including evaluation, testing, guardrails, observability, security and cost management, so that AI answers over risk data can be trusted by clients and colleagues. * Bring analytical rigour and domain depth: apply your quantitative background and your understanding of insurance, exposure, loss and catastrophe modelling to build solutions that stand up to scrutiny from actuaries and modellers. * Deliver as part of a team: plan and prioritise with Delivery Leads and Product Leads, and shape the technical direction for AI with Product Architects, within our architecture, security and compliance standards. * Direct AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) alongside your own hands\-on expertise to multiply your output, and rigorously review human\-written and AI\-generated code against our standards. * Lead by example, without line management: raise the standard through the quality and pace of your own work, mentor colleagues informally, and share what you learn so capability spreads across the team. * Stay at the frontier: track new models, tools and techniques, test them hands\-on, and bring the credible ones into our roadmap and delivery approach. **Qualifications** ------------------ **The Requirements** **Essential:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, in any modern stack, with a record of leading complex delivery as a hands\-on technical authority and mentoring others through your work. * Recent hands\-on experience (2\+ years) building and shipping LLM\-based and agentic systems to production as part of a delivery team, using RAG, prompt engineering and agent frameworks / orchestration (e.g. LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), including evaluation, guardrails and cost management. * Expert, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to deliver exceptional personal output, with the discipline to critically review, validate and secure what they produce. * Strong engineering capability in Python and at least one of C\# / .NET or TypeScript (Angular and/or React), with hands\-on commercial experience of cloud (Azure preferred), GitHub or Azure DevOps, and the SDLC, CI/CD and Agile delivery. * A strong analytical and quantitative background (e.g. mathematics, statistics, engineering or computer science), with the ability to reason rigorously about data, models and uncertainty. * Strong domain knowledge of insurance, reinsurance or risk analytics (ideally actuarial or catastrophe modelling), or a record of becoming expert quickly in a complex quantitative field. * Proven ability to work directly with business users or clients and move a concept from conversation to working demo in days, then carry it into production, challenging established approaches constructively and communicating complex trade\-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, actuaries and engineers alike. * Proven ability to work well both individually and as part of a team: self\-directed and highly productive on your own, and collaborative in how you deliver with others, through shared backlogs, code review and handover to service teams. * Evidence of staying current at the frontier of AI: recent tools, models and techniques you have tested hands\-on, and what you concluded about them. **Desirable:** * Experience designing multi\-agent workflows and building reusable MCP servers or tools that expose enterprise data and calculations to AI agents. * Experience running AI / LLM solutions at scale in a regulated environment, including evaluation frameworks, model governance and responsible\-AI practices. * Experience with our platform stack (C\# / .NET, Angular or React, Azure), microservice architectures and containerisation. * Experience with geospatial, catastrophe or financial\-modelling data, or with building mathematical algorithms. * Earlier applied machine learning, statistics or data science experience, alongside your recent work with LLMs. * Visible contribution to the AI engineering community, such as open\-source work, writing or speaking. * Degree\-level qualification in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Science, Engineering or Computer Science); postgraduate study valued. * The role offers hybrid working with travel to office expected on a regular cadence for meetings and workshops. * Some occasional travel may be required as part of the engagement with business and technology stakeholders. Note: Employment\-based non\-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity. **This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.** **Compensation and Benefits (US locations)** Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only). **Compensation** The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $100,000– $350,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short\-term incentive bonus. **Company Benefits** WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply): * **Health and Welfare Benefits:** Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD\&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program) * **Leave Benefits:** Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short\-Term Disability, Long\-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off * **Retirement Benefits:** Contributory Pension Plan and Savings Plan (401k). All Level 38 and more senior roles may also be eligible for non\-qualified Deferred Compensation and Deferred Savings Plans. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **EOE, including disability/vets**

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.** We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support \- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. **What we do:** For 150 years, Watts has built best\-in\-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting\-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead. **Scope of Position** Watts Water Technologies is seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer I to support New Product Development (NPD) initiatives. In this on\-site role, the Software Engineer will collaborate cross\-functionally to design, develop, integrate, debug, and test embedded software for proprietary electronic control systems used in hydronic heating and water heating products. The engineer will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software architecture, implementation, verification, validation, and product release, helping bring innovative solutions from concept to market within the Watts Applied Solutions (WAS) business unit. This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities. The Software Engineer I reports to the Embedded Software Engineering Manager. This is an on\-site position located in Blauvelt, New York. **Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain C\+\+20 / Qt 6 applications for ARM\-based embedded Linux controllers used in commercial hydronic and water heating products. * Implement new features and resolve defects across the firmware stack, including UI screens, control logic, and I/O handling for analog inputs, RTDs, flow sensors, relays, and touchscreens. * Write clean, deterministic C\+\+ code suitable for real\-time control, avoiding dynamic memory allocation in time\-critical paths. * Integrate device communication over Modbus, BACnet, RS\-485/RS\-232, CAN bus, and Ethernet. * Build and cross\-compile firmware using CMake and Yocto toolchains; deploy binaries to target hardware via SSH for on\-device debugging in Qt Creator. * Write and maintain unit tests (Qt Test / GoogleTest) and Doxygen documentation per team coding standards (. clang\-format, license headers, enum constants). * Contribute to Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and packaging. * Use Git/GitHub for version control; triage issues, reproduce reported bugs, and submit changes through pull requests and code reviews. * Utilize AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) effectively and responsibly to streamline development, increase efficiency, and strengthen code quality. * Read schematics and PCBs to support hardware/software integration and lab validation against test benches. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Controls, Hardware, QA, and Product teams on NPD projects from concept to acceptance. * Assume responsibility for other projects assigned by the Embedded Software Engineering Manager or Company management. * Responsibility directly tied to Watts Values (Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, Transparency) * Travel up to 5%. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electronics and communications, software engineering, computer science/engineering or related field. * 1\+ years of experience developing production\-level code using C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or newer preferred). * Experience with software development in a Linux desktop environment * Experience with version control using Git \& GitHub * Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, CAN bus, Ethernet/IP, Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, MQTT, and Cellular. * Familiarity with Schematic design and PCB layout * Excellent interpersonal skills, maintain strong working relationship with all internal groups * Proficient in business applications \- MS Office, Adobe Acrobat, etc. * Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. * Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks, including drug screening, and required pre\-employment testing as a condition of employment. **Preferred Qualifications** * 2\+ years of experience in C\+\+ software development. * Experience with Qt framework for GUI development . * Expert in C\+\+20, strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), and unit testing frameworks (Qt Test, GoogleTest). * Experience developing user\-space C\+\+ applications targeting ARM\-based embedded Linux platforms * Past exposure to building and deploying Yocto\-based kernel images with Jenkins * Development experience with AI Agents/LLMs for code generation, review, of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. * Punctuality and dependability. * Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. * Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. * Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. * Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer\-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. **Working Conditions** While performing the job duties, you will be working on\-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Blauvelt, NY location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. **Physical Requirements***: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:* * Ability to stand for long periods of time. * Ability to lift and carry up to \[insert amount] pounds. * Ability to push and pull up to \[insert amount] pounds. * Ability to physically move around manufacturing floor. * Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers. * Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasse*s.* **Pay Range** The expected salary range for this position is $88K \- $95K annually. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. **\#LIOnsite** **Watts in it for you**: ***Please note that the following******benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles.*** * Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience * Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits * Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave * 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off * Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement * Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs * Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ **How we work:** At Watts, our culture is team\-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Watts is committed to equal employment opportunity. We follow a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic disposition or carrier status, marital status, military or veteran status, minorities, or any other category protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the obligations of state and federal law, Watts will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Any employee who needs a reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources.

This role supports quality engineering practices across Digital, Mobile, and IT teams by contributing to test automation, validating application functionality, documenting defects, and helping improve overall software quality. This role is expected to actively participate in agile ceremonies, support CI/CD testing activities, and help ensure that features meet defined acceptance criteria and quality standards. jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. You’ll work across CX, Product, Operations, AI, Payments, Logistics, Trust, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous customer and business problems into durable systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You’ll lead architecture and delivery across multi\-team initiatives, make thoughtful tradeoffs between near\-term customer impact and long\-term platform health, and raise the quality and effectiveness of the broader engineering organization. This role is based near one of our hubs in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. **You** ------- Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that low ego and a growth mindset, while leaning into action, details, and impact, go a long way here. As our next Staff\+ Backend Engineer, you bring 9\+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on complex backend systems, and: * **Customer experience domain depth:** Meaningful experience building customer support, service, marketplace post\-purchase, or other operationally complex customer\-facing systems. You understand that CX is a system of experiences, policies, workflows, and operations—not just a ticketing tool—and can bring that context to technical decisions. * **Backend systems expertise:** A track record of designing, building, and operating reliable, high\-scale backend services and end\-to\-end product experiences. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. jobs.description: Opening Type: Business Professionals Department: Information Technology Employment Type: Full\-Time Location: Palo Alto 650 Page Mill Road Palo Alto CA 94304\-1050 US * 650\-493\-9300 Wilson Sonsini is the premier legal advisor to technology, life sciences, and other growth enterprises worldwide. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** ------------------------------------------ **Framework Alignment and Control Mapping** * Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of the client’s NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) program, including tracking progress against current and target profiles and supporting assessments against related standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2\). * Map the security controls in the current environment to NIST requirements (e.g., SP 800\-53\) and other applicable frameworks, perform gap analyses and self\-assessments, and identify gaps for remediation. * Support delivery of the client’s current security risk and compliance standards and maintain related documentation. **Risk Management and GRC Tooling** * Record and maintain security risks in the Risk Register, and coordinate with other teams as needed to obtain status and provide insights for remediation of risks. * Contribute to the ServiceNow implementation (e.g., requirements, testing, and workflow input). * Identify critical/high\-risk systems and processes and document the associated risk profiles. * Resolve tickets assigned to the governance, risk and compliance team and track them to closure. * Prepare and deliver periodic risk, compliance, and service\-level metrics and reports for the client’s program, tailored to leadership and stakeholder audiences. **Threat and Risk Analysis** * Gather and analyze data from various IT systems and security tooling (e.g., SIEM and log sources, unauthorized access attempts, phishing reports) that identify risk, and create reports that provide specific details. * Use threat, vulnerability, and endpoint/cloud security management systems and tools (e.g., SIEM, vulnerability scanners, Microsoft Defender) to identify critical/high\-risk systems, create threat analysis reports, initiate follow\-up action, and help reduce risk. * Partner with security operations and incident response teams to translate incident and vulnerability trends into risk register entries and remediation recommendations, and maintain related standard operating procedures. * Analyze policies, systems, hardware, software, cloud, and network infrastructure and recommend methods and strategies that reduce risk. **Awareness, Third\-Party Risk and Client Assurance** * Administer the cybersecurity awareness training program (e.g., assigning courses, tracking completion, and reporting results). * Conduct Third\-Party Risk Management analysis, including review of vendor security documentation and recording of results. * Complete security questionnaires and provide supporting documentation within agreed turnaround times. * Perform other related duties as assigned by the client’s governance, risk and compliance leadership. **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** -------------------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in security risk, governance, and compliance (GRC). Security operations or incident response experience with demonstrated GRC exposure (e.g., control assessments, audits, compliance reporting) will be considered. * Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53, SP 800\-30, and SP 800\-39, with an understanding of the cybersecurity risk assessment process. * Working knowledge of IT fundamentals, including networking, identity and access management (e.g., Active Directory), and cloud security (e.g., Microsoft Azure). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain risk to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong organizational, interpersonal, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure, work independently, and collaborate with diverse teams. * Sound judgment, high ethical standards, and the discretion to handle confidential client information. * Ability to respond promptly to unplanned requests within agreed service\-level expectations and to accurately estimate time and resources for projects. * Commitment to continuous learning of new technologies, frameworks, and skills. * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in information security, information technology, risk management, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, certification, and experience. * Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CISA, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, Microsoft SC\-200 or AZ\-500\). **Preferred:** -------------- * Law firm experience, including responding to client security questionnaires and reviewing outside counsel guidelines. * Experience with a GRC platform (e.g., ServiceNow, RSA Archer) and with SIEM, vulnerability, or threat management tools (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk). * Scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, KQL) to streamline recurring GRC reporting and data\-gathering. * Working knowledge of Claude, Legora, BitSight, and/or Prompt Armor. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Products, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and products, early deployments surface complex real\-world challenges—from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge\-case enterprise workflows. FDE pods deploy directly into active customer engagements to resolve technical friction, debug complex setups, and build lightweight integrations. Crucially, FDEs serve as the primary feedback engine for Product and Engineering: field insights, recurring customer friction, and configuration patterns are converted directly into scalable, out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. It's a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact, every day. **About the Role** As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll bridge hands\-on software development with high\-impact customer technical strategy — taking on the most complex, ambiguous engagements where no existing playbook applies. You will partner with enterprise customers, often at the executive level, to architect, deploy, debug, and optimize Workday's AI agents and developer platform solutions inside live customer environments. You'll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. Beyond delivering for individual customers, you'll help set the technical direction for the FDE practice itself: turning field\-tested solutions into scalable product capabilities and mentoring other engineers along the way. **What you'll do:** * **Technical Deployment \& Engineering:** Architect, deploy, configure, and debug AI agents and integrations inside the most complex live enterprise tenant environments, frequently in situations with no established precedent. * **Customer Discovery \& Solution Architecture:** Lead technical discovery sessions with senior leaders at customer organizations, translating ambiguous business requirements into robust product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. * **Product Feedback \& Influence:** Synthesize field telemetry, edge\-case failures, and recurring customer friction into insights that directly shape the product roadmap and engineering backlog. * **Productization of Field Insights:** Identify patterns across many engagements and lead the work of turning custom fixes into standardized, automated, out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. * **Cross\-Functional \& Executive Alignment:** Act as a trusted technical advisor to Workday Services leads, AI Deployment Architects, Account Teams, and customer executives, keeping every engagement focused on core product strength. * **Engagement Leadership \& Mentorship:** Own the most strategically important or technically complex engagements end\-to\-end — from kickoff through graduation — within standard 6\-month deployment cycles, while coaching other FDEs on technical approach and customer engagement. **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * **Experience:** 10\+ years of experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Software Development, including experience leading complex, high\-stakes enterprise technical engagements. * **Technical Execution:** Hands\-on coding and debugging skills (for example, Python, Java, or similar), with deep knowledge of REST APIs, object\-oriented design, system architecture, and integration patterns. * **Workday Knowledge:** Working knowledge of Workday, including business processes, security and permissions, tenant configuration, integrations, and how customers implement and govern Workday, so you can read a customer's tenant and understand how agentic features and agents will  mate who mentors other engineers and helps multi\-disciplinary account and delivery pods work well together. **Preferred Qualifications** Applied experience with LLM\-powered or agentic AI systems — e.g., prompt/context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluations, or agent orchestration frameworks — and a working understanding of how model behavior shows up as product and customer\-facing issues in the field. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $206,400 USD \- $309,600 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $173,300 USD \- $309,600 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers. Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not. In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

If you have any questions or concerns about this posting, please email **taposting@wwt.com** \#LI\-AS1 Requirements: **Why WWT?** World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe. Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world\-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state\-of\-the\-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities. With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada. Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high\-performance teams? Join WWT today! **Why should you join Global Enterprise Sales?** As a Consulting Systems Engineer (CSE), you will be partnering with Client Managers to provide the technical Pre\-Sales work for our Fortune 500 clients across all verticals. No two days will be the same as our broad offerings include Infrastructure Modernization, Multicloud Architecture, Security Transformation and Digital Strategy among others. With our Advanced Technology Center (https://www.wwt.com/atc) at your fingertips for briefings, training, workshops, demos and POC's you'll be delivering best in class results for your clients. **What will you be doing?** The Consulting Systems Engineer (CSE) role will bring technical Pre\-Sales experience to our customers within the local Detroit, MI market. Day\-to\-day responsibilities will include participation in customer sales meetings, presentations, white board sessions and custom technical design work. The CSE will team with local Client Managers to build customer relationships, partner with multiple OEM's, and take part in technical training to provide continued value to the customers. Technical expertise expansion is highly encouraged as you look to learn about new areas of interest and be on the forefront of cutting\-edge technologies. This position will require the ability to travel up to 25%. **Responsibilities:** * Technical Pre\-Sales systems engineering * Serve as the technical liaison to all supported clients * Assist in developing Statements of Work, Proof of Concepts and Bill of Materials * Network design and architecture * Attend business appointments with Account teams * Estimate labor hours for Professional Services work * Aligns with WWT Sales team to represent WWT's expertise in technical areas such as Networking, Data, Storage, Compute, Security, and AI, etc. for all assigned accounts. * Uses knowledge of technology, products and services to build world\-class enterprise solutions (and solution options) for the customer. * Works with clients and WWT Sales team to obtain technical priorities, challenges, and initiatives that can be translated into WWT technical sales opportunities. * Responsible for the coordination, delivery, and quality of presales technology solution deliverables across multiple domains, which may include items such as configurations, architectural diagrams, and proposals. * Manages and achieves a sales gross profit (GP) number. * Develops and fosters relationships with strategic original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and key partners who are local to your region and/or territory. * Assists in Statement of Work and Proof of Concept review and development. * Ensures that proposed solutions, when implemented, meet the needs and functional requirements of the customer. * Must have passion driving networking/storage/server/virtualization/security solution strategies and be highly consultative with clients and all levels of an organization. * Strong personality with leadership skills working in a complex matrix organization. * Strong presence and credibility to be proven at client site and internally. * Knowledge of the technical aspects of networking, storage, server, backup and virtualization hardware, software and architecture(s). * Dell, HPE, Pure, Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto, Juniper, zScaler, and/or similar certifications are highly desired.

Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven\-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale! The IT, Software Engineer 3 is responsible for: * Microservices Development: Design and implement high\-performance backend services using Golang and Ruby. * Backend Orchestration \& APIs: Develop and operate Spinup’s collection of RESTful micro\-service APIs that orchestrate resource provisioning across providers, implementing the layered orchestration pattern (e.g., Server API delegating to
