jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Specialist
jobs.description: **Yogurtland** **Hiring: AI \& Process Automation Specialist** Location: Farmers Branch, TX (Hybrid) Shift: Monday–Friday (Overtime as Needed) Pay: $75,000–$85,000/year \*Depending on Experience. **POSITION SUMMARY** We are seeking an AI \& Process Automation Specialist to drive efficiency and innovation across our operations. In this role, you will implement cutting\-edge AI solutions (including Large Language Models and other automation tools) to streamline business processes and boost company efficiency. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities and lead AI\-driven initiatives that modernize how we work. This position is hybrid, based in Farmers Branch, TX, with 4 days on\-site and 1 day remote each week. If you’re excited about leveraging AI to solve problems and improve systems in a supportive, values\-driven team, we’d love to hear from you. **Web Development:** Hands\-on experience building and deploying modern web applications using Next.js (React framework), TypeScript/JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, with deployment via Vercel. Familiarity with REST/GraphQL API integration and responsive design. **Database \& Cloud:** Experience with Azure SQL Database (or similar cloud\-based relational databases): schema design, query optimization using T\-SQL, and managing connections via tools like Azure Data Studio or SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). General familiarity with the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (e.g., Azure App Service, Azure Functions) is a plus. **Data Engineering:** Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Python (pandas, SQLAlchemy), or dbt. Ability to structure, clean, and move data reliably between systems (Azure SQL, POS/ERP platforms, and dashboards) using version control (Git/GitHub) to support the AI and automation initiatives described above. **REQUIREMENTS \& QUALIFICATIONS (LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS)** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field requirement. * **Experience:** 2\-5 years of hands\-on experience in AI automation, process automation, or data\-driven operations. Early career professionals with relevant project experience (including vibe coding projects) are welcome. * **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to analyze complex datasets and processes to find inefficiencies and recommend improvements. Comfort working with ambiguous or high\-level requirements and rapidly iterating solutions is a strong plus. * **Collaboration \& Communication Skills:** Excellent teamwork and communication abilities. Proven capacity to coordinate projects, work cross\-functionally, and drive initiatives to completion. Ability to effectively articulate high\-level “vibes” or conceptual requirements to both technical teams and AI coding tools is highly desirable. * **Project Management (Preferred but not required):** Experience managing projects (e.g., scoping requirements, assigning tasks, meeting deadlines) is a plus. **Technical Proficiency:** * **AI/Automation:** Experience with AI tools and frameworks (e.g. chatbots, robotic process automation, machine learning models). Strong preference for candidates experienced in AI\-augmented development workflows. * **Programming \& Scripting:** Proficiency in Python or similar languages to build and maintain automation scripts or workflows. Experience with vibe coding practices is highly valued. * **Vibe Coding \& AI\-Assisted Development (Highly Valued):** Demonstrated experience with vibe coding using modern AI coding agents and tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Replit Agent, or similar). This includes using natural\-language prompting to describe desired functionality (“the vibe”), rapidly generating and iterating on code, reviewing and refining AI\-generated output, and accelerating automation development. * **Automation Platforms:** Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate or similar workflow tools. * **Data Management (Preferred but Not Required):** Exposure to managing and manipulating data in SQL databases, creating dashboards in Power BI, and optimizing data pipelines. **OFFERED** * **Benefits Package:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plan; paid time off. * **Professional Growth:** Training, mentorship, and opportunities to work on cross\-department projects. * **Collaborative Culture:** A supportive environment that values innovation, teamwork, and diverse perspectives. * **Employee Perks:** Product discounts, access to exclusive events, and additional incentives. **Work Location:** Hybrid remote in Farmers Branch, TX Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Farmers Branch, TX

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it! **A Little About Us** Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 725 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients. At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture. **A Little About You** You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are. **Position Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer on the Cost Engine team, you’ll design, build and run the core API and backend service that standardizes and serves healthcare procedure cost, negotiated rate, member, eligibility, benefit, treatment, provider, and incentive data to downstream products. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll spend most of your time designing, writing and reviewing code, and you'll help raise the bar for the team through mentoring and technical leadership. You'll own the quality and reliability of the services you build. You'll partner closely with the team's Principal Engineer, Product Managers, Scrum Masters and architecture for member cost and transparency to turn the roadmap into shipped reliable software. What You'll Do Mentor and Influence * Contribute to technical direction in partnership with principal engineer and architecture and help create an environment where engineers do their best work. * Mentor and pair with other engineers and lead by example through thoughtful design and code reviews. Build and Ship * Write and review production code across the .NET REST APIs, C\# services, Rust microservice, and the ETL and data\-movement estate. * Set and uphold engineering standards, raising the bar on code quality, testing, and observability. * Take on the complex and higher\-risk technical work directly, from design decisions made in partnership with the principal engineer, to thorny production issues. * Design, build and test features end to end, from API contracts and data models to deployment and monitoring. * Tune the performance of high\-throughput APIs and SQL queries that serve cost and rate data to downstream products. * Participate in the on\-call rotation, lead incident response and drive root\-cause fixes for Cost Engine services. Deliver with the Team * Participate actively in agile ceremonies and help keep delivery predictable across planning cycles. * Break features down into well\-scoped technical tasks, estimate the work, flag risks early and help unblock teammates. * Help balance new feature work with platform health – security, reliability and maintenance. Drive Technical Direction * Communicate progress, delivery risk, tradeoffs, and decisions early. * Partner closely with the Product Manager for member cost and transparency to turn strategy into shipped reliable software. * Be a trusted partner to the Principal Engineer. Share context openly, ask for input early, and help spread their platform knowledge across the team through pairing and documentation. What You’ll Bring: Required * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong, current hands\-on coding ability. (Typically a Bachelor’s \+ 5 years or a Master’s \+ 3\) * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design and code reviews. * Depth in C\# / .NET building and operating production REST APIs and backend services. * Experience with relational data stores (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL) and cloud\-hosted services on AWS. * Comfort operating in an Agile environment, sprints, PI planning, and commitment\-based delivery, partnering with Scrum Masters and Product Managers. * Ability to work across a hybrid legacy\-and\-modern codebase, make sound technical tradeoffs, with security and reliability in mind. * Strong software design fundamentals, including API design, data modeling, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. * A collaborative, low\-ego approach. You learn from experienced technical leads while bringing your own ideas and perspective. Preferred * Healthcare IT experience, especially member cost, claims, benefits, or price\-transparency data (e.g., X12 EDI 270/271 and 837, No Surprises Act, Transparency in Coverage). * Experience modernizing legacy systems, service decomposition, or migrations such as cache or secrets\-management changes. * Familiarity with Rust, distributed caching (Redis/Valkey), messaging (SQS/RabbitMQ), and observability tooling (Datadog, OpenTelemetry). * Experience with containers and infrastructure as code (for example, Docker, ECS or Kubernetes, and Terraform). * Working knowledge of healthcare data privacy and security concepts (PHI/PII). * Experience with Jira and Confluence for delivery and documentation. ***Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.*** **Location and Workplace Flexibility** Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In\-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies. While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in\-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule. **Base Salary Range** $122,400\.00 \- $168,300\.00 At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job\-related and industry\-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role. Zelis’ full\-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well\-being, and financial protection. The US\-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. **Accessibility Support** We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com. **Disclaimer** *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities, duties, and skills from time to time.*

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Agentic AI team at Zillow is at the forefront of transforming the real estate industry by helping millions of people use AI assistants to find their next home. Within this organization, the Agentic Solutions team develops AI\-powered experiences that help people navigate their real estate journey, understand their options, make informed decisions and take action. Our applied scientists work closely with engineering, product and design to turn advances in AI into reliable features that deliver measurable customer value. Our work sits at the intersection of large language models and traditional machine learning, such as ranking and personalization, and we are a small team where every scientist has real ownership and influence over what we build. **About the role** ------------------ As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Agentic AI team, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems from scientific framing and modeling through evaluation, experimentation and production delivery, and help shape which problems we solve and how we measure success. You will: * Own ambiguous applied\-science problems end to end, from identifying an opportunity and forming a hypothesis through data analysis, modeling, experimentation and production iteration * Develop and compare machine learning and LLM\-based approaches to improve customer experiences, establishing useful baselines, adapting relevant research and adding complexity when the evidence supports it * Build reliable datasets and offline evaluations, and design online experiments that connect model quality to meaningful customer and business outcomes * Partner with engineering, product, design and science teams to turn promising methods into reliable production capabilities, balancing quality, safety, latency and cost * Write maintainable Python and SQL, contribute production\-ready scientific components, and share methods, findings and technical decisions with other scientists and engineers This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400\.00 \- $262,600\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200\.00 \- $249,400\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- You are a hands\-on applied scientist who enjoys turning new ideas into shipped features. You are curious, you learn new domains quickly, and you change direction when the results tell you to. *Must\-haves* * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field and 8\+ years applying machine learning or advanced statistical modeling in industry, including production delivery; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong applied machine learning and statistical foundations, demonstrated through model development, evaluation and production impact * Depth in a relevant area such as recommendations, ranking, search, personalization or conversational AI, with evidence of independently solving ambiguous problems and learning new domains * Experience with large\-scale datasets, experimentation or A/B testing, and model\-performance measurement, including sound reasoning about data quality, bias, uncertainty and causal impact * Practical understanding of LLM\-based systems, including context, generation, evaluation and limitations, and the ability to apply that understanding to new problems * Strong Python and SQL skills and the ability to turn an analysis or model into tested, reusable code that can be integrated into a production system Clear technical communication and a track record of delivering with engineering, product and science partners, with personal ownership and sound tradeoffs * *Nice\-to\-haves* * Experience with recommendation, ranking or personalization systems * Deep hands\-on experience building and evaluating LLM\-based or agentic systems in production * Experience with model distillation, supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization or small\-model deployment, especially when balancing quality, latency and maintenance cost * Experience evaluating multi\-turn conversations, recommendation sets, session quality or longer\-horizon customer outcomes * Familiarity with large consumer marketplaces, sparse and delayed outcomes, cold\-start experiences, or real estate * Research contributions that show the ability to adapt new methods to a practical problem and establish whether they help **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, 3D Simulation
jobs.description: The 3D Simulation group at Zoox is looking for machine learning engineers to bring the latest research in 3D vision to accelerate autonomy by blurring the line between simulation and reality. Our ML group is working on generating rich and diverse 3D environments, humans, and environmental conditions using reconstruction and generative models. You will have access to the best sensor data in the world and an incredible infrastructure for testing and validation to bring new algorithms into our robotics stack. ### **In this role, you will:** * Research, implement, and optimize state of the art machine learning approaches to improve 3D simulation variation and fidelity * Collaborate with ML Researchers, Technical Artists and Simulation engineers to bring new ML techniques to our production simulator * Train 4D generative and world models for simulating rare scenarios * Build scalable, useable cloud pipelines for machine learning solutions in 3D simulation * Improve rendering and tooling for generating realistic data at scale ### **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with Python/C\+\+ programming and algorithm design * Experience building and extending radiance field ML models * Experience with generative models for 3D or video content * Publications or production experience in human\-centric 3D vision, 3D reconstruction, or style transfer * Strong mathematical skills and understanding of probabilistic techniques ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience automating 3D content pipelines using applications like Houdini, Maya, or Blender * Experience in distributed systems and cloud computing platforms * Experience in generative camera, lidar, radar, or LWIR **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Backend
jobs.description: Jitterbit is a recognized leader in Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) and API Management, named in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for seven consecutive years. Our mission is to simplify and accelerate digital transformation through our low\-code iPaaS, API Management (APIM), Low\-Code Application Platform (LCAP), and B2B solutions. Our platform helps businesses automate mission\-critical systems quickly and effectively. To do this, we continuously build and evolve a robust, scalable, secure, and highly reliable SaaS platform serving customers around the world. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who combines strong people leadership, execution discipline, and technical depth. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high\-performing distributed teams while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team make sound engineering decisions. About the Team At Jitterbit, engineering is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building high\- quality, maintainable software and delivering a world\-class experience for our customers. Our engineering organization operates in a collaborative, remote\-first environment with team members across multiple countries and time zones. You will work closely with engineers, Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, DevOps/SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to build and operate enterprise\-grade integration and API management capabilities. We value ownership, transparency, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and a willingness to solve problems collaboratively. **About the Role** As a Senior Engineering Manager – Backend, you will lead a distributed team of backend engineers responsible for designing, building, operating, and evolving critical components of Jitterbit's iPaaS and API Management platform. You will be accountable for both people leadership and engineering delivery. You will establish clear priorities, help the team execute predictably, develop engineering talent, remove obstacles, and create an environment in which engineers can do their best work. You will partner closely with Product Management and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into executable engineering plans while balancing product delivery with platform scalability, reliability, technical debt, and operational excellence. This is not a purely administrative management position. You should be technically strong enough to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge technical assumptions, review approaches, and dive deeply into complex production or engineering problems when necessary. When critical situations arise, you are comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working alongside the team to drive them to resolution. Our technology environment includes: * Languages \& Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, C\+\+, Lua * Infrastructure \& DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Nginx, Tomcat, Apache * Data \& Messaging: MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB * Cloud Services: AWS, including S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, and related services What You'll Do Lead and Develop the Team * Lead, coach, and mentor a geographically distributed engineering team across multiple countries and time zones. * Build a high\-performing engineering culture based on ownership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning. * Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback, establish development goals, and support engineers in their career growth. * Manage performance effectively, recognizing strong contributors while addressing performance gaps in a timely and constructive manner. * Participate in workforce planning, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and retaining high\- quality engineering talent. * Identify future technical and team leaders and create opportunities for them to grow. * Foster an inclusive environment where team members are comfortable sharing ideas, raising risks, and challenging assumptions. Drive Engineering Execution * Own the planning and execution of engineering initiatives from requirements and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Partner with Product Management to understand business priorities, define scope, evaluate trade\-offs, and establish realistic delivery commitments. * Lead Agile ceremonies and ensure effective sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily execution, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement. * Maintain visibility into sprint progress, dependencies, blockers, risks, and delivery commitments. * Use engineering metrics and data to improve delivery predictability, quality, operational performance, and team effectiveness. * Balance feature development with technical debt, platform improvements, scalability, reliability, and engineering productivity. * Identify delivery risks early and communicate clearly with stakeholders when priorities, s  planning, execution, and delivery of complex software initiatives. * Strong experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, estimation, execution tracking, retrospectives, and continuous improvement. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration experience working with Product Management, Support, L3 Engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and other engineering teams. * Strong technical foundation in backend and distributed systems, with the ability to participate deeply in architecture, design, debugging, and production troubleshooting conversations. * Experience building and operating multi\-tenant SaaS applications. * Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and event\- driven systems. * Experience or strong familiarity with Java and Spring Boot. * Experience or strong familiarity with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Tomcat, and Apache. **You'll Thrive Here If You...** * Are passionate about building, coaching, and retaining high\-performing engineering teams. * Balance people leadership, delivery accountability, and technical excellence. * Stay technically engaged and are comfortable diving deeply into difficult engineering problems when the situation requires it. * Can move comfortably between a team member's career discussion, a sprint\-planning conversation, an architecture review, and a critical production issue. * Create clarity when priorities or requirements are ambiguous. * Hold yourself and your team accountable while creating an environment built on trust and transparency. * Communicate proactively and clearly in a globally distributed, remote\-first environment. * Use data and engineering metrics to identify problems and drive continuous improvement. * Think beyond individual features and consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, customer impact, and long\-term platform health. * Collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries and focus on solving problems rather than assigning blame. * Champion the best ideas regardless of where they originate. * Know when to delegate and empower your team—and when to roll up your sleeves and work alongside them. * Solid understanding of relational databases, particularly MySQL and SQL Server. * Familiarity with technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, and other distributed data technologies is a plus. * Experience supporting highly available, business\-critical production systems. * Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and operational readiness. * Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and organizational skills. * Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical teams and business stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **What You’ll Get:** * Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space * Join a mission\-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business\-critical processes. * Career development and mentorship * A flexible, remote\-friendly company with personality and heart Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** We’re one of the world’s leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000\. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 10,000 people and serve over 120 million customers in 26 languages. We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of growth opportunities, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling and gaming. As a forward\-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide. Our focus on In\-Play betting has solidified our market\-leading position, featuring more than 1\.38 million In\-Play sporting events a year. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe (750,000\), we handle over 6 million HTTP requests daily and process more than 1\.5 million bets per hour at peak. **Job Description** Keep our critical tech running at scale and build resilient systems that power millions of real\-time interactions as an Infrastructure Engineer. The IT Services department supports the robust on\-premise and cloud infrastructure underpinning 24/7 global operations. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will maintain, scale and optimise key enterprise platforms across hybrid environments to ensure seamless service delivery and high availability. Working across modern virtualisation, identity management and cloud services, the role blends proactive operational support with automation. You will tackle complex technical challenges, streamline workflows through scripting, and ensure platforms remain secure, resilient and performant. **Qualifications** * Citrix XenServer, Virtual Apps and Desktops administration * Identity and access management platforms including Okta and Entra ID * Cloud platforms and services across M365, AVD and GCP * Exchange Online/SE and Cisco ESA administration * Active Directory and Group Policy management * Ivanti UWM configuration and support * Monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk * PowerShell scripting for automation and task acceleration * Building access and monitoring technologies including Net2 and CCTV **Additional Information** * Install, configure and monitor high\-availability Citrix virtual infrastructure * Oversee and maintain enterprise mail services across Exchange and Cisco ESA * Manage identity and access governance using Okta and Entra ID * Optimise M365 configurations to support wider business operations * Investigate and resolve complex technical incidents across hybrid platforms * Develop PowerShell scripts to automate operational workflows and routine tasks * Configure Group Policy objects and user personalisation settings * Maintain accurate technical documentation and share operational knowledge across the team bet365 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000\+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership\-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition. Our team is growing and we are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will own the full arc of our most strategic services engagements, from the first conversation about what AI could do for a customer's business, through the delivery that builds it, to the value they realize from it. You will scope and price the services that move an enterprise from AI ambition to AI running in production, support the sale of that work alongside the Account Owner, and orchestrate the consultants and engineers who deliver it. You will stay with the engagement well past the build, accountable for turning what the customer bought into AI that is genuinely doing their work. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our **Denver** office. **About The Role** * Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent\-driven execution on the monday AI work platform. * Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it. * Support the sale of services alongside the Account Owner, articulating the path from a customer's current state to AI in production for stakeholders from technical staff to executive sponsors. * Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it. * Own timeline, budget, quality, risk, and commercial administration across your engagements, running one\-time projects directly, overseeing execution on ongoing ones, and directing the resources assigned to you. * Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence. * Own AI value realization inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back. * Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified. * Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and
